open scoped BigOperators Classical
variable {X : Type*} [sectionInstance89 : Fintype X]

noncomputable def expect (K : List X → X → ℝ) : ℕ → List X → (List X → ℝ) → ℝ
  | 0,h,φ => φ h
  | t+1,h,φ => ∑ x,K h x*expect K t (h++[x]) φ
noncomputable def mass (K : List X → X → ℝ) (t : ℕ) (h : List X) : ℝ :=
  expect K t h (fun _ => 1)
lemma expect_nonneg (K : List X → X → ℝ) (hK : ∀ h x,0 ≤ K h x)
    (φ : List X → ℝ) (hφ : ∀ h,0 ≤ φ h) (t : ℕ) (h : List X) :
    0 ≤ expect K t h φ := by
  induction t generalizing h with
  | zero => exact hφ h
  | succ t ih => exact Finset.sum_nonneg (fun x _ => mul_nonneg (hK h x) (ih _))
lemma expect_mono (K : List X → X → ℝ) (hK : ∀ h x,0 ≤ K h x)
    (φ ψ : List X → ℝ) (hh : ∀ h,φ h ≤ ψ h) (t : ℕ) (h : List X) :
    expect K t h φ ≤ expect K t h ψ := by
  induction t generalizing h with
  | zero => exact hh h
  | succ t ih => exact Finset.sum_le_sum (fun x _ => mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (ih _) (hK h x))
lemma expect_kernel_mono (K P : List X → X → ℝ) (hK : ∀ h x,0 ≤ K h x)
    (hKP : ∀ h x,K h x ≤ P h x) (φ : List X → ℝ) (hφ : ∀ h,0 ≤ φ h)
    (t : ℕ) (h : List X) : expect K t h φ ≤ expect P t h φ := by
  have hP : ∀ h x,0 ≤ P h x := fun h x => (hK h x).trans (hKP h x)
  induction t generalizing h with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ t ih =>
    exact Finset.sum_le_sum (fun x _ => mul_le_mul (hKP h x) (ih _)
      (expect_nonneg K hK φ hφ t _) (hP h x))
lemma mass_nonneg (K : List X → X → ℝ) (hK : ∀ h x,0 ≤ K h x) (t : ℕ) (h : List X) :
    0 ≤ mass K t h := expect_nonneg K hK _ (by intros; norm_num) t h
lemma mass_le_one (K : List X → X → ℝ) (hK : ∀ h x,0 ≤ K h x)
    (hrow : ∀ h,∑ x,K h x ≤ 1) (t : ℕ) (h : List X) : mass K t h ≤ 1 := by
  induction t generalizing h with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ t ih =>
    change (∑ x,K h x*mass K t (h++[x])) ≤ 1
    calc
      _ ≤ ∑ x,K h x*1 := Finset.sum_le_sum (fun x _ => mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (ih _) (hK h x))
      _ ≤ 1 := by simpa using hrow h

theorem adaptive_success (K : List X → X → ℝ) (Good : List X → Prop)
    (hK : ∀ h x,0 ≤ K h x) (hrow : ∀ h,∑ x,K h x ≤ 1)
    (hsupport : ∀ h,Good h → ∀ x,0<K h x → Good (h++[x]))
    (e : ℝ) (he : 0 ≤ e) (hloss : ∀ h,Good h → 1-e ≤ ∑ x,K h x)
    (t : ℕ) (h : List X) (hh : Good h) : 1-(t:ℝ)*e ≤ mass K t h := by
  induction t generalizing h with
  | zero => simp [mass,expect]
  | succ t ih =>
    have hlocal : ∀ x,K h x*(1-(t:ℝ)*e) ≤ K h x*mass K t (h++[x]) := by
      intro x
      by_cases hz : K h x=0
      · simp [hz]
      · exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (ih _ (hsupport h hh x (lt_of_le_of_ne (hK h x) (Ne.symm hz)))) (hK h x)
    change 1-((t+1:ℕ):ℝ)*e ≤ ∑ x,K h x*mass K t (h++[x])
    have hs := Finset.sum_le_sum (fun x (_ : x∈Finset.univ) => hlocal x)
    rw [← Finset.sum_mul] at hs
    have hm := hloss h hh
    have hu := hrow h
    have ht : 0 ≤ (t:ℝ)*e := mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) he
    push_cast
    nlinarith [mul_nonneg ht (sub_nonneg.mpr hu)]

noncomputable def restrict (P : List X → X → ℝ) (Good : List X → Prop) (h : List X) (x : X) : ℝ :=
  if Good (h++[x]) then P h x else 0
omit sectionInstance89 in
lemma restrict_nonneg [Fintype X] (P : List X → X → ℝ) (Good : List X → Prop) (hP : ∀ h x,0 ≤ P h x)
    (h : List X) (x : X) : 0 ≤ restrict P Good h x := by
  unfold restrict; split_ifs; exact hP _ _; rfl
omit sectionInstance89 in
lemma restrict_le [Fintype X] (P : List X → X → ℝ) (Good : List X → Prop) (hP : ∀ h x,0 ≤ P h x)
    (h : List X) (x : X) : restrict P Good h x ≤ P h x := by
  unfold restrict; split_ifs; rfl; exact hP _ _
omit sectionInstance89 in
lemma restrict_support [Fintype X] (P : List X → X → ℝ) (Good : List X → Prop)
    (h : List X) (x : X) (hx : 0<restrict P Good h x) : Good (h++[x]) := by
  by_contra hg
  simp [restrict,hg] at hx
lemma mass_le_good_probability (P : List X → X → ℝ) (Good : List X → Prop)
    (hP : ∀ h x,0 ≤ P h x) (t : ℕ) (h : List X) (hh : Good h) :
    mass (restrict P Good) t h ≤ expect P t h (fun l => if Good l then 1 else 0) := by
  induction t generalizing h with
  | zero => simp [mass,expect,hh]
  | succ t ih =>
    change (∑ x,restrict P Good h x*mass (restrict P Good) t (h++[x])) ≤ _
    apply Finset.sum_le_sum
    intro x _
    by_cases hg : Good (h++[x])
    · simpa only [restrict,ite_eq_left hg] using mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (ih _ hg) (hP h x)
    · have hr : restrict P Good h x=0 := by simp [restrict,hg]
      rw [hr,zero_mul]
      exact mul_nonneg (hP h x) (expect_nonneg P hP _ (by intro l; split_ifs <;> norm_num) t _)

theorem good_probability (P : List X → X → ℝ) (Good : List X → Prop)
    (hP : ∀ h x,0 ≤ P h x) (hrow : ∀ h,∑ x,P h x ≤ 1)
    (e : ℝ) (he : 0 ≤ e)
    (hstep : ∀ h,Good h → 1-e ≤ ∑ x,restrict P Good h x)
    (t : ℕ) (h : List X) (hh : Good h) :
    1-(t:ℝ)*e ≤ expect P t h (fun l => if Good l then 1 else 0) := by
  have hb := adaptive_success (restrict P Good) Good (restrict_nonneg P Good hP)
    (fun h => (Finset.sum_le_sum (fun x _ => restrict_le P Good hP h x)).trans (hrow h))
    (fun h _ x hx => restrict_support P Good h x hx) e he hstep t h hh
  exact hb.trans (mass_le_good_probability P Good hP t h hh)
end FiniteExperiment
section PairedSlots
open scoped BigOperators Classical
variable {α : Type*} [sectionInstance90 : Fintype α] [sectionInstance91 : DecidableEq α]
def slotPair (i : α) : (α ⊕ α) × (α ⊕ α) := (Sum.inl i,Sum.inr i)
def pairedSlots (n : ℕ) : List ((Fin n ⊕ Fin n) × (Fin n ⊕ Fin n)) :=
  (List.finRange n).map slotPair
omit sectionInstance90 sectionInstance91 in
lemma slotPairList_fresh [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] (l : List α) (hl : l.Nodup) (B : Set (α ⊕ α))
    (hB : ∀ i ∈ l,Sum.inl i ∉ B ∧ Sum.inr i ∉ B) : SlotsFresh (l.map slotPair) B := by
  induction l generalizing B with
  | nil => trivial
  | cons a l ih =>
    obtain ⟨ha,hl⟩ := List.nodup_cons.mp hl
    refine ⟨by simp [slotPair],(hB a (by simp)).1,(hB a (by simp)).2,?_⟩
    apply ih hl
    intro i hi
    have hn : i ≠ a := fun he => ha (he ▸ hi)
    have hb := hB i (by simp [hi])
    simpa [slotPair,hn] using hb
lemma pairedSlots_fresh (n : ℕ) : SlotsFresh (pairedSlots n) ∅ :=
  slotPairList_fresh _ (List.nodup_finRange n) ∅ (by intros; simp)
@[simp] lemma pairedSlots_length (n : ℕ) : (pairedSlots n).length = n := by simp [pairedSlots]
lemma pairedSlots_ne_nil (n : ℕ) (hn : 0<n) : pairedSlots n ≠ [] := by
  intro h; have hh := congrArg List.length h
  simp only [pairedSlots_length,List.length_nil] at hh
  omega
lemma pairedSlots_cover (n : ℕ) : pairSupport (pairedSlots n) = Set.univ := by
  ext x
  simp only [pairSupport,Set.mem_ofPred_eq,Set.mem_univ,iff_true]
  cases x with
  | inl i => exact ⟨slotPair i,by simp [pairedSlots],Or.inl rfl⟩
  | inr i => exact ⟨slotPair i,by simp [pairedSlots],Or.inr rfl⟩
lemma pairedSlots_plain (n : ℕ) (S : Set (Fin n ⊕ Fin n)) :
    PlainState (pairedSlots n) S ↔ ∀ i, (Sum.inl i ∈ S ↔ Sum.inr i ∉ S) := by
  simp only [PlainState,pairedSlots,List.mem_map,forall_exists_index,and_imp]
  constructor
  · intro h i
    have hh := h (slotPair i) i (by simp) rfl
    simp only [PairSingle,slotPair] at hh
    tauto
  · intro h p i hi he
    subst p
    have hh := h i
    simp only [PairSingle,slotPair]
    tauto
lemma transversal_plain (n : ℕ) (A : Set (Fin n)) : PlainState (pairedSlots n) (transversal A) := by
  rw [pairedSlots_plain]
  intro i
  have hl : Sum.inl i ∈ transversal A ↔ i ∈ A := by
    change i ∈ Sum.inl ⁻¹' transversal A ↔ _
    rw [preimage_inl_transversal]
  have hr : Sum.inr i ∈ transversal A ↔ i ∉ A := by
    change i ∈ Sum.inr ⁻¹' transversal A ↔ _
    rw [preimage_inr_transversal]; rfl
  rw [hl,hr,not_not]
lemma plain_eq_transversal (n : ℕ) (S : Set (Fin n ⊕ Fin n)) (hS : PlainState (pairedSlots n) S) :
    S = transversal (Sum.inl ⁻¹' S) := by
  rw [pairedSlots_plain] at hS
  ext x
  cases x with
  | inl i =>
    change i ∈ Sum.inl ⁻¹' S ↔ i ∈ Sum.inl ⁻¹' transversal (Sum.inl ⁻¹' S)
    rw [preimage_inl_transversal]
  | inr i =>
    change Sum.inr i ∈ S ↔ i ∈ Sum.inr ⁻¹' transversal (Sum.inl ⁻¹' S)
    rw [preimage_inr_transversal]
    change Sum.inr i ∈ S ↔ Sum.inl i ∉ S
    have hh := hS i
    tauto
noncomputable def plainEquivSubsets (n : ℕ) :
    {S : Set (Fin n ⊕ Fin n) // PlainState (pairedSlots n) S} ≃ Set (Fin n) where
  toFun S := Sum.inl ⁻¹' S.val
  invFun A := ⟨transversal A,transversal_plain n A⟩
  left_inv S := Subtype.ext (plain_eq_transversal n S.val S.property).symm
  right_inv A := preimage_inl_transversal A
lemma pairedPlain_card (n : ℕ) : Fintype.card {S : Set (Fin n ⊕ Fin n) // PlainState (pairedSlots n) S} = 2^n := by
  rw [Fintype.card_congr (plainEquivSubsets n),Fintype.card_set,Fintype.card_fin]
end PairedSlots

noncomputable def subsetDeficiency {n : ℕ} (M₁ M₂ : Matroid (Fin n)) (A : Set (Fin n)) : ℕ :=
  n-((pairedMatroid M₁ M₂).eRk (transversal A)).toNat
lemma subsetDeficiency_zero {n : ℕ} (M₁ M₂ : Matroid (Fin n))
    (hE₂ : M₂.E=Set.univ) (hr : M₁.eRank=M₂.eRank) (A : Set (Fin n)) :
    subsetDeficiency M₁ M₂ A=0 ↔ M₁.IsBase A ∧ M₂.IsBase A := by
  have hR : (pairedMatroid M₁ M₂).eRank=(n:ℕ∞) := by simpa using paired_eRank M₁ M₂ hE₂ hr
  have hk : ((pairedMatroid M₁ M₂).eRk (transversal A)).toNat≤n :=
    ENat.toNat_le_of_le_natCast (by rw [← hR]; exact Matroid.eRk_le_eRank _ _)
  rw [← transversal_isBase_iff M₁ M₂ hE₂ A]
  constructor
  · intro hd
    have hn : ((pairedMatroid M₁ M₂).eRk (transversal A)).toNat=n := by unfold subsetDeficiency at hd; omega
    have he : (pairedMatroid M₁ M₂).eRk (transversal A)=(n:ℕ∞) := by
      calc
        _ = (((pairedMatroid M₁ M₂).eRk (transversal A)).toNat:ℕ∞) :=
          (ENat.natCast_toNat (Matroid.isRkFinite_set _ _).eRk_lt_top.ne).symm
        _ = _ := congrArg (fun k : ℕ => (k:ℕ∞)) hn
    have hi : (pairedMatroid M₁ M₂).Indep (transversal A) := by
      apply (Matroid.indep_iff_eRk_eq_encard_of_finite (Set.toFinite _)).mpr
      rw [he,transversal_encard,Fintype.card_fin]
    exact hi.isBase_of_eRk_ge (Set.toFinite _) (by rw [he,hR])
  · intro h
    unfold subsetDeficiency
    rw [h.eRk_eq_eRank,hR,ENat.toNat_natCast,Nat.sub_self]

noncomputable def commonSetFinsetEquiv {n : ℕ} (M₁ M₂ : Matroid (Fin n)) :
    {A : Set (Fin n) // M₁.IsBase A ∧ M₂.IsBase A} ≃
    {A : Finset (Fin n) // M₁.IsBase (A:Set (Fin n)) ∧ M₂.IsBase (A:Set (Fin n))} where
  toFun A := ⟨A.val.toFinset,by simpa only [Set.coe_toFinset] using A.property⟩
  invFun A := ⟨(A.val:Set (Fin n)),A.property⟩
  left_inv A := by apply Subtype.ext; exact Set.coe_toFinset _
  right_inv A := by apply Subtype.ext; simp
lemma zeroDeficiency_eq_commonBaseCount {n : ℕ} (M₁ M₂ : Matroid (Fin n))
    (hE₂ : M₂.E=Set.univ) (hr : M₁.eRank=M₂.eRank) :
    zeroDeficiencyCount (subsetDeficiency M₁ M₂)=commonBaseCount M₁ M₂ := by
  have hp : (fun A => subsetDeficiency M₁ M₂ A=0) = (fun A => M₁.IsBase A ∧ M₂.IsBase A) :=
    funext (fun A => propext (subsetDeficiency_zero M₁ M₂ hE₂ hr A))
  unfold zeroDeficiencyCount commonBaseCount
  rw [← Fintype.card_subtype,← Nat.card_eq_fintype_card]
  calc
    _ = Nat.card {A : Set (Fin n) // M₁.IsBase A ∧ M₂.IsBase A} :=
      Nat.card_congr (Equiv.subtypeEquivRight (fun A => subsetDeficiency_zero M₁ M₂ hE₂ hr A))
    _ = _ := Nat.card_congr (commonSetFinsetEquiv M₁ M₂)

lemma plainPartition_eq_subsets {n : ℕ} (M₁ M₂ : Matroid (Fin n)) (q : ℝ) :
    slotTotal (pairedSlots n) (matroidWeight (pairedMatroid M₁ M₂) n q) ∅ =
      deficiencyPartition (subsetDeficiency M₁ M₂) q := by
  rw [slotTotal_eq_plain_sum (pairedSlots n) (pairedSlots_fresh n) (pairedSlots_cover n)]
  rw [Finset.sum_subtype (p := PlainState (pairedSlots n)) _ (by intro S; simp)]
  unfold deficiencyPartition
  apply Fintype.sum_equiv (plainEquivSubsets n)
  intro S
  change q^(n-((pairedMatroid M₁ M₂).eRk S.val).toNat)=
    q^(n-((pairedMatroid M₁ M₂).eRk (transversal (Sum.inl ⁻¹' S.val))).toNat)
  rw [← plain_eq_transversal n S.val S.property]

theorem paired_partition_contamination {n : ℕ} (M₁ M₂ : Matroid (Fin n))
    (hE₂ : M₂.E=Set.univ) (hr : M₁.eRank=M₂.eRank) (q : ℝ) (hq0 : 0≤q) (hq1 : q≤1) :
    (commonBaseCount M₁ M₂:ℝ) ≤ slotTotal (pairedSlots n) (matroidWeight (pairedMatroid M₁ M₂) n q) ∅ ∧
      slotTotal (pairedSlots n) (matroidWeight (pairedMatroid M₁ M₂) n q) ∅ ≤
        (commonBaseCount M₁ M₂:ℝ)+(2:ℝ)^n*q := by
  have h := partition_contamination (subsetDeficiency M₁ M₂) q hq0 hq1
  rw [zeroDeficiency_eq_commonBaseCount M₁ M₂ hE₂ hr,Fintype.card_set,Fintype.card_fin] at h
  rw [plainPartition_eq_subsets]
  exact_mod_cast h
open scoped BigOperators Classical
lemma annealRho_pow_upper (n : ℕ) (hn : 0<n) : annealRho n^(2*n)≤1/2 := by
  have hn' : (0:ℝ)<n := by exact_mod_cast hn
  have hr0 : 0≤annealRho n := le_trans (by norm_num) (annealRho_bounds n hn).1
  have he : annealRho n≤Real.exp (-1/(2*(n:ℝ))) := by
    have h := Real.add_one_le_exp (-1/(2*(n:ℝ)))
    unfold annealRho
    convert h using 1 ; ring
  calc
    _ ≤ (Real.exp (-1/(2*(n:ℝ))))^(2*n) := pow_le_pow_left₀ hr0 he _
    _ = Real.exp (-1) := by
      rw [← Real.exp_nat_mul]
      congr 1
      push_cast
      field_simp
    _ ≤ 1/2 := by
      rw [Real.exp_neg]
      have h2 : (2:ℝ)≤Real.exp 1 := by nlinarith [Real.add_one_le_exp (1:ℝ)]
      simpa only [one_div] using one_div_le_one_div_of_le (by norm_num : (0:ℝ)<2) h2
lemma anneal_final_bounds (n b : ℕ) (hn : 0<n) :
    (1/2:ℝ)^annealLength n b≤annealRho n^annealLength n b ∧
      annealRho n^annealLength n b≤(1/2:ℝ)^(n+b) := by
  constructor
  · exact pow_le_pow_left₀ (by norm_num) (annealRho_bounds n hn).1 _
  · unfold annealLength
    rw [pow_mul]
    exact pow_le_pow_left₀ (pow_nonneg (le_trans (by norm_num) (annealRho_bounds n hn).1) _)
      (annealRho_pow_upper n hn) _
lemma anneal_final_contamination (n b : ℕ) (hn : 0<n) (ε : ℝ) (hb : (1/2:ℝ)^b≤ε/10) :
    (2:ℝ)^n*(annealRho n^annealLength n b)≤ε/10 := by
  calc
    _ ≤ (2:ℝ)^n*((1/2:ℝ)^(n+b)) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (anneal_final_bounds n b hn).2 (by positivity)
    _ = (1/2:ℝ)^b := by rw [pow_add,← mul_assoc,← mul_pow]; norm_num
    _ ≤ _ := hb
lemma partition_le_card {X : Type*} [Fintype X] (d : X → ℕ) (q : ℝ) (hq0 : 0≤q) (hq1 : q≤1) :
    deficiencyPartition d q≤Fintype.card X := by
  calc
    _ ≤ ∑ _ : X,(1:ℝ) := Finset.sum_le_sum (fun x _ => pow_le_one₀ hq0 hq1)
    _ = _ := by simp

lemma anneal_minimum_mass {X : Type*} [Fintype X] [Nonempty X]
    (n L j : ℕ) (hn : 0<n) (hj : j≤L) (hcard : Fintype.card X=2^n)
    (d : X → ℕ) (hd : ∀ x,d x≤n) (x : X) :
    (1/2:ℝ)^(n*(L+1))≤(annealRho n^j)^(d x)/deficiencyPartition d (annealRho n^j) := by
  have hr := annealRho_bounds n hn
  have hr0 : 0<annealRho n := lt_of_lt_of_le (by norm_num) hr.1
  have hq0 : 0<annealRho n^j := pow_pos hr0 _
  have hq1 : annealRho n^j≤1 := pow_le_one₀ hr0.le hr.2.le
  have hf : (1/2:ℝ)^(n*L)≤(annealRho n^j)^(d x) := by
    calc
      _ = ((1/2:ℝ)^L)^n := by simp only [← pow_mul,Nat.mul_comm]
      _ ≤ (annealRho n^L)^n := pow_le_pow_left₀ (by positivity)
        (pow_le_pow_left₀ (by norm_num) hr.1 L) _
      _ ≤ (annealRho n^j)^n := pow_le_pow_left₀ (by positivity)
        (pow_le_pow_of_le_one hr0.le hr.2.le hj) _
      _ ≤ _ := pow_le_pow_of_le_one hq0.le hq1 (hd x)
  have hZ := deficiencyPartition_pos d _ hq0
  calc
    _ = ((1/2:ℝ)^(n*L))/(2:ℝ)^n := by
      rw [Nat.mul_add,Nat.mul_one,pow_add]
      simp [inv_pow,div_eq_mul_inv]
    _ ≤ ((annealRho n^j)^(d x))/(2:ℝ)^n := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hf (by positivity)
    _ ≤ _ := div_le_div_of_nonneg_left (by positivity) hZ (by
      have h := partition_le_card d (annealRho n^j) hq0.le hq1
      rw [hcard] at h
      exact_mod_cast h)
namespace FiniteChain
open scoped BigOperators Classical
variable {X : Type*} [Fintype X] (C : FiniteChain X)
lemma kernel_power_action (k : ℕ) (f : X → ℝ) (x : X) :
    ∑ y,(C.kernel.power k).P x y*f y=C.iterate k f x := by
  induction k generalizing f with
  | zero => simp [FiniteKernel.power,FiniteKernel.identity]
  | succ k ih =>
    change (∑ y,(∑ z,(C.kernel.power k).P x z*C.P z y)*f y)=_
    simp_rw [Finset.sum_mul,mul_assoc]
    rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    simp_rw [← Finset.mul_sum]
    change (∑ z,(C.kernel.power k).P x z*C.apply f z)=_
    rw [ih]
    exact congrFun (Function.iterate_succ_apply C.apply k f).symm x
lemma kernel_power_density (k : ℕ) (x y : X) :
    (C.kernel.power k).P x y/C.π y=C.iterate k (C.pointDensity y) x := by
  rw [← C.kernel_power_action]
  simp [pointDensity,div_eq_mul_inv]
lemma kernel_point_mixing (K m : ℝ) (hK : 1≤K) (hm : 0 < m) (hπ : ∀ x,m≤C.π x)
    (hp : ∀ f : X → ℝ,C.variance f≤K*C.energy f) (k : ℕ) (x y : X) :
    |(C.kernel.power k).P x y/C.π y-1|≤Real.exp (-(k:ℝ)/K)/m := by
  rw [C.kernel_power_density]
  exact C.point_mixing_exp K m hK hm hπ hp k x y

lemma kernel_power_warm_any (K m e : ℝ) (hK : 1≤K) (hm : 0 < m)
    (hπ : ∀ x,m≤C.π x) (hp : ∀ f : X → ℝ,C.variance f≤K*C.energy f)
    (k : ℕ) (he : Real.exp (-(k:ℝ)/K)/m≤e) (he' : 0≤1+e)
    (ν : X → ℝ) (hν : ∀ x,0≤ν x) (hnorm : ∑ x,ν x≤1) (y : X) :
    (C.kernel.power k).push ν y≤(1+e)*C.π y := by
  have hrow : ∀ x,(C.kernel.power k).P x y≤(1+e)*C.π y := by
    intro x
    have h := (le_abs_self _).trans ((C.kernel_point_mixing K m hK hm hπ hp k x y).trans he)
    apply (div_le_iff₀ (C.positive y)).mp
    linarith
  calc
    _ ≤ ∑ x,ν x*((1+e)*C.π y) := Finset.sum_le_sum (fun x _ => mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hrow x) (hν x))
    _ = (∑ x,ν x)*((1+e)*C.π y) := by rw [Finset.sum_mul]
    _ ≤ _ := by simpa using mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hnorm (mul_nonneg he' (C.positive y).le)
end FiniteChain

lemma restart_exponential (n L : ℕ) (hn : 0<n) :
    Real.exp (-((20*n^4*(n*(L+1)+2):ℕ):ℝ)/(18*(n:ℝ)^4)) /
      ((2:ℝ)^(-((n*(L+1):ℕ):ℤ))) ≤ 1/2 := by
  have hn' : (0:ℝ)<n := by exact_mod_cast hn
  have h2 : (2:ℝ)≤Real.exp 1 := by nlinarith [Real.add_one_le_exp (1:ℝ)]
  have hpow : (2:ℝ)^(n*(L+1))≤Real.exp ((n*(L+1):ℕ):ℝ) := by
    calc
      _ ≤ (Real.exp 1)^(n*(L+1)) := pow_le_pow_left₀ (by norm_num) h2 _
      _ = _ := by rw [← Real.exp_nat_mul]; simp
  rw [zpow_neg,zpow_natCast,div_inv_eq_mul]
  calc
    _ ≤ Real.exp (-((20*n^4*(n*(L+1)+2):ℕ):ℝ)/(18*(n:ℝ)^4))*
        Real.exp ((n*(L+1):ℕ):ℝ) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hpow (Real.exp_nonneg _)
    _ = Real.exp (-((20*n^4*(n*(L+1)+2):ℕ):ℝ)/(18*(n:ℝ)^4)+((n*(L+1):ℕ):ℝ)) := (Real.exp_add _ _).symm
    _ ≤ Real.exp (-1) := by
      apply Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
      have heq : -((20*n^4*(n*(L+1)+2):ℕ):ℝ)/(18*(n:ℝ)^4) =
          -(10/9)*((n:ℝ)*(L+1)+2) := by
        push_cast
        field_simp
        ; ring
      rw [heq]
      push_cast
      nlinarith [show 0≤(n:ℝ)*(L+1) by positivity]
    _ ≤ 1/2 := by rw [Real.exp_neg]; simpa only [one_div] using one_div_le_one_div_of_le (by norm_num : (0:ℝ)<2) h2
end Annealing

open scoped BigOperators Classical
variable {Γ : Type*} [sectionInstance93 : Fintype Γ] [sectionInstance94 : DecidableEq Γ]
lemma slotTotal_mono (ps : List (Γ × Γ)) (f g : Set Γ → ℝ)
    (h : ∀ S,f S ≤ g S) (A : Set Γ) : slotTotal ps f A ≤ slotTotal ps g A := by
  induction ps generalizing A with
  | nil => exact h A
  | cons p ps ih =>
    change coeffDeriv (pairDirection p) (slotTotal ps f) A ≤ coeffDeriv (pairDirection p) (slotTotal ps g) A
    unfold coeffDeriv
    apply Finset.sum_le_sum
    intro i _
    split_ifs
    · rfl
    · exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (ih _) (slotDirection_nonneg _ _)
lemma slotTotal_scale (ps : List (Γ × Γ)) (f : Set Γ → ℝ) (c : ℝ) (A : Set Γ) :
    slotTotal ps (fun S => c*f S) A=c*slotTotal ps f A := coeffDerivs_scale _ _ _ _
noncomputable def annealWeight (M : Matroid Γ) (n j : ℕ) : Set Γ → ℝ :=
  matroidWeight M n (annealRho n^j)
lemma annealWeight_pos (M : Matroid Γ) (n j : ℕ) (hn : 0<n) (S : Set Γ) :
    0<annealWeight M n j S :=
  matroidWeight_pos M n _ (pow_pos (lt_of_lt_of_le (by norm_num) (annealRho_bounds n hn).1) _) S
omit sectionInstance93 sectionInstance94 in
lemma annealWeight_step [Fintype Γ] [DecidableEq Γ] (M : Matroid Γ) (n j : ℕ) (_ : 0<n) (S : Set Γ) :
    annealWeight M n (j+1) S=annealWeight M n j S*annealRho n^(n-(M.eRk S).toNat) := by
  unfold annealWeight matroidWeight
  rw [pow_succ,mul_pow]
lemma annealWeight_drift (M : Matroid Γ) (n j : ℕ) (hn : 0<n) (S : Set Γ) :
    (1/2)*annealWeight M n j S ≤ annealWeight M n (j+1) S ∧
      annealWeight M n (j+1) S ≤ annealWeight M n j S := by
  rw [annealWeight_step M n j hn]
  have h := annealStep_bounds n (n-(M.eRk S).toNat) hn (Nat.sub_le _ _)
  have hp := (annealWeight_pos M n j hn S).le
  constructor
  · nlinarith [mul_nonneg hp (sub_nonneg.mpr h.1)]
  · nlinarith [mul_nonneg hp (sub_nonneg.mpr h.2)]
lemma anneal_slot_drift (ps : List (Γ × Γ)) (M : Matroid Γ) (n j : ℕ) (hn : 0<n) (A : Set Γ) :
    (1/2)*slotTotal ps (annealWeight M n j) A ≤ slotTotal ps (annealWeight M n (j+1)) A ∧
      slotTotal ps (annealWeight M n (j+1)) A ≤ slotTotal ps (annealWeight M n j) A := by
  constructor
  · rw [← slotTotal_scale]
    exact slotTotal_mono _ _ _ (fun S => (annealWeight_drift M n j hn S).1) _
  · exact slotTotal_mono _ _ _ (fun S => (annealWeight_drift M n j hn S).2) _
lemma anneal_ideal_drift (ps : List (Γ × Γ)) (hps : SlotsFresh ps ∅)
    (M : Matroid Γ) (n j : ℕ) (hn : 0<n) (p r : Γ × Γ)
    (hp : p∈ps) (hr : r∈ps) (hpr : p≠r) :
    (slotTotal ps (annealWeight M n j) ∅/slotDefect ps (annealWeight M n j) ∅ p r)/2  ≤
      slotTotal ps (annealWeight M n (j+1)) ∅/slotDefect ps (annealWeight M n (j+1)) ∅ p r ∧
    slotTotal ps (annealWeight M n (j+1)) ∅/slotDefect ps (annealWeight M n (j+1)) ∅ p r  ≤
      2*(slotTotal ps (annealWeight M n j) ∅/slotDefect ps (annealWeight M n j) ∅ p r) := by
  have h0 := slotTotal_pos ps _ (annealWeight_pos M n j hn) ∅ hps
  have h1 := slotTotal_pos ps _ (annealWeight_pos M n (j+1) hn) ∅ hps
  have hd0 := slotDefect_pos ps _ (annealWeight_pos M n j hn) ∅ hps p r hp hr hpr
  have hd1 := slotDefect_pos ps _ (annealWeight_pos M n (j+1) hn) ∅ hps p r hp hr hpr
  have ha := anneal_slot_drift ps M n j hn ∅
  have hb := anneal_slot_drift ((ps.erase p).erase r) M n j hn (insert r.1 (insert r.2 ∅))
  change (1/2)*slotDefect ps (annealWeight M n j) ∅ p r ≤ slotDefect ps (annealWeight M n (j+1)) ∅ p r ∧ slotDefect ps (annealWeight M n (j+1)) ∅ p r ≤ slotDefect ps (annealWeight M n j) ∅ p r at hb
  constructor
  · rw [div_div,div_le_div_iff₀ (mul_pos hd0 (by norm_num)) hd1]
    nlinarith [mul_nonneg h0.le (sub_nonneg.mpr hb.2),mul_nonneg hd0.le (sub_nonneg.mpr ha.1)]
  · rw [← mul_div_assoc,div_le_div_iff₀ hd1 hd0]
    nlinarith [mul_nonneg hd0.le (sub_nonneg.mpr ha.2),mul_nonneg h0.le (sub_nonneg.mpr hb.1)]

structure GoodMultipliers (gs : List (Γ × Γ)) (f : Set Γ → ℝ)
    (w : (Γ × Γ) → (Γ × Γ) → ℝ) : Prop where
  positive : ∀ p r,0<w p r
  lower : ∀ p∈gs,∀ r∈gs,p≠r → slotTotal gs f ∅/(4*slotDefect gs f ∅ p r) ≤ w p r
  upper : ∀ p∈gs,∀ r∈gs,p≠r → w p r ≤ 4*slotTotal gs f ∅/slotDefect gs f ∅ p r

lemma anneal_ratio_mean (gs : List (Γ × Γ)) (hgs : SlotsFresh gs ∅)
    (hcover : pairSupport gs=Set.univ) (M : Matroid Γ) (n j : ℕ) (hn : 0<n)
    (w : (Γ × Γ) → (Γ × Γ) → ℝ) :
    chainMean gs w (annealWeight M n j)
      (plainObservable gs (fun S => annealRho n^(n-(M.eRk S).toNat))) =
      slotTotal gs (annealWeight M n (j+1)) ∅/chainTotal gs w (annealWeight M n j) := by
  rw [plainObservable_mean gs hgs hcover]
  congr 2
  funext S
  exact (annealWeight_step M n j hn S).symm
lemma plain_probability_mean (gs : List (Γ × Γ)) (hgs : SlotsFresh gs ∅)
    (hcover : pairSupport gs=Set.univ) (f : Set Γ → ℝ)
    (w : (Γ × Γ) → (Γ × Γ) → ℝ) :
    chainMean gs w f (plainObservable gs (fun _ => 1))=slotTotal gs f ∅/chainTotal gs w f := by
  rw [plainObservable_mean gs hgs hcover]
  simp
lemma weight_mean_identity (gs : List (Γ × Γ)) (hgs : SlotsFresh gs ∅)
    (hcover : pairSupport gs=Set.univ) (f : Set Γ → ℝ) (hf : ∀ S,0<f S)
    (w : (Γ × Γ) → (Γ × Γ) → ℝ) (hw : ∀ p r,0<w p r)
    (p r : Γ × Γ) (hp : p∈gs) (hr : r∈gs) (hpr : p≠r) :
    w p r*(chainMean gs w f (plainObservable gs (fun _ => 1))/
      chainMean gs w f (defectIndicator gs p r))=slotTotal gs f ∅/slotDefect gs f ∅ p r := by
  rw [plain_probability_mean gs hgs hcover,defectIndicator_mean gs hgs hcover _ _ p r hp hr hpr]
  field_simp [(chainTotal_pos gs hgs hcover w f hf hw).ne',(hw p r).ne']

lemma plainIndex_card (n : ℕ) : Fintype.card (PlainIndex (pairedSlots n))=2^n := by
  let e : PlainIndex (pairedSlots n) ≃ {S : Set (Fin n ⊕ Fin n) // PlainState (pairedSlots n) S} :=
    { toFun := fun S => ⟨S.val.val,S.property⟩
      invFun := fun S => ⟨⟨S.val,Or.inl S.property⟩,S.property⟩
      left_inv := by intro S; rfl
      right_inv := by intro S; rfl }
  rw [Fintype.card_congr e,pairedPlain_card]
lemma anneal_plainPartition (gs : List (Γ × Γ)) (hgs : SlotsFresh gs ∅)
    (hcover : pairSupport gs=Set.univ) (M : Matroid Γ) (n j : ℕ) :
    slotTotal gs (annealWeight M n j) ∅=
      deficiencyPartition (fun S : PlainIndex gs => n-(M.eRk S.val.val).toNat) (annealRho n^j) := by
  rw [slotTotal_eq_plain_sum gs hgs hcover]
  symm
  exact plainIndex_sum gs (annealWeight M n j)
lemma actual_trace_minimum (n L j : ℕ) (hn : 0<n) (hj : j ≤ L) (M : Matroid (Fin n ⊕ Fin n))
    (w : ((Fin n ⊕ Fin n) × (Fin n ⊕ Fin n)) → ((Fin n ⊕ Fin n) × (Fin n ⊕ Fin n)) → ℝ)
    (hw : ∀ p r,0<w p r) (S : PlainIndex (pairedSlots n)) :
    (1/2:ℝ)^(n*(L+1))  ≤
      (metropolisTrace (pairedSlots n) (pairedSlots_fresh n) (pairedSlots_ne_nil n hn) (pairedSlots_cover n)
        w (annealWeight M n j) hw (annealWeight_pos M n j hn)).π S := by
  let := plainIndex_nonempty (pairedSlots n) (pairedSlots_fresh n) (pairedSlots_cover n)
  rw [metropolisTrace_pi,anneal_plainPartition _ (pairedSlots_fresh n) (pairedSlots_cover n)]
  exact anneal_minimum_mass n L j hn hj (plainIndex_card n) (fun S : PlainIndex (pairedSlots n) => n-(M.eRk S.val.val).toNat) (fun _ => Nat.sub_le _ _) S
lemma slotTotal_one (ps : List (Γ × Γ)) (A : Set Γ) (hps : SlotsFresh ps A) :
    slotTotal ps (fun _ => 1) A=(2:ℝ)^ps.length := by
  induction ps generalizing A with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons p ps ih =>
    rw [slotTotal_cons p ps _ A hps.1 hps.2.1 hps.2.2.1]
    have hleft : SlotsFresh ps (insert p.1 A) := hps.2.2.2.mono (by intro i hi; simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff] at hi ⊢; tauto)
    have hright : SlotsFresh ps (insert p.2 A) := hps.2.2.2.mono (by intro i hi; simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff] at hi ⊢; tauto)
    rw [ih _ hleft,ih _ hright,List.length_cons,pow_succ]
    ring
lemma initial_ideal (gs : List (Γ × Γ)) (hgs : SlotsFresh gs ∅) (p r : Γ × Γ)
    (hp : p∈gs) (hr : r∈gs) (hpr : p≠r) :
    slotTotal gs (fun _ => 1) ∅/slotDefect gs (fun _ => 1) ∅ p r=4 := by
  have hperm := slots_perm_two hp hr hpr
  have hh := (SlotsFresh.perm hperm ∅).mp hgs
  have hrest : SlotsFresh ((gs.erase p).erase r) (insert r.1 (insert r.2 ∅)) :=
    hh.2.2.2.2.2.2.mono (by intro i hi; simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff] at hi ⊢; tauto)
  have hlen := List.Perm.length_eq hperm
  simp only [List.length_cons] at hlen
  rw [slotTotal_one _ _ hgs,slotDefect,slotTotal_one _ _ hrest,hlen,pow_succ,pow_succ]
  have hp : (2:ℝ)^((gs.erase p).erase r).length≠0 := by positivity
  field_simp
  ; ring
lemma initial_good (gs : List (Γ × Γ)) (hgs : SlotsFresh gs ∅) (M : Matroid Γ) (n : ℕ) :
    GoodMultipliers gs (annealWeight M n 0) (fun _ _ => 4) := by
  have he : annealWeight M n 0=(fun _ => 1) := by funext S; simp [annealWeight,matroidWeight]
  rw [he]
  refine ⟨by intros; norm_num,?_,?_⟩
  · intro p hp r hr hpr
    rw [mul_comm (4:ℝ),← div_div,initial_ideal gs hgs p r hp hr hpr]
    norm_num
  · intro p hp r hr hpr
    rw [mul_div_assoc,initial_ideal gs hgs p r hp hr hpr]
    norm_num

noncomputable def empirical (H : Set Γ → ℝ) (l : List (Set Γ)) : ℝ :=
  (l.map H).sum/(l.length:ℝ)
noncomputable def learnedMultipliers (gs : List (Γ × Γ))
    (w : (Γ × Γ) → (Γ × Γ) → ℝ) (l : List (Set Γ)) (p r : Γ × Γ) : ℝ :=
  if p∈gs ∧ r∈gs ∧ p≠r then
    w p r*(empirical (plainObservable gs (fun _ => 1)) l/empirical (defectIndicator gs p r) l)
  else w p r
noncomputable def empiricalRatio (gs : List (Γ × Γ)) (g : Set Γ → ℝ) (l : List (Set Γ)) : ℝ :=
  empirical (plainObservable gs g) l/empirical (plainObservable gs (fun _ => 1)) l

def AccuratePhase (gs : List (Γ × Γ)) (w : (Γ × Γ) → (Γ × Γ) → ℝ)
    (f g : Set Γ → ℝ) (η : ℝ) (l : List (Set Γ)) : Prop :=
  ∀ j : PhaseObservables gs,
    |empirical (phaseObservable gs g j) l-chainMean gs w f (phaseObservable gs g j)| ≤
      η*chainMean gs w f (phaseObservable gs g j)
lemma relative_error_bounds (x m η : ℝ) (h : |x-m| ≤ η*m) :
    (1-η)*m ≤ x ∧ x ≤ (1+η)*m := by
  obtain ⟨h1,h2⟩ := abs_le.mp h
  constructor <;> nlinarith
lemma accurate_plain (gs : List (Γ × Γ)) (w : (Γ × Γ) → (Γ × Γ) → ℝ)
    (f g : Set Γ → ℝ) (η : ℝ) (l : List (Set Γ)) (h : AccuratePhase gs w f g η l) :
    (1-η)*chainMean gs w f (plainObservable gs (fun _ => 1)) ≤ empirical (plainObservable gs (fun _ => 1)) l ∧
    empirical (plainObservable gs (fun _ => 1)) l ≤ (1+η)*chainMean gs w f (plainObservable gs (fun _ => 1)) :=
  relative_error_bounds _ _ _ (h (.inl none))
lemma accurate_defect (gs : List (Γ × Γ)) (w : (Γ × Γ) → (Γ × Γ) → ℝ)
    (f g : Set Γ → ℝ) (η : ℝ) (l : List (Set Γ)) (h : AccuratePhase gs w f g η l)
    (p r : Γ × Γ) (hp : p∈gs) (hr : r∈gs) (hpr : p≠r) :
    (1-η)*chainMean gs w f (defectIndicator gs p r) ≤ empirical (defectIndicator gs p r) l ∧
    empirical (defectIndicator gs p r) l ≤ (1+η)*chainMean gs w f (defectIndicator gs p r) :=
  relative_error_bounds _ _ _ (h (.inl (some ⟨(p,r),(mem_defectTypes gs (p,r)).mpr ⟨hp,hr,hpr⟩⟩)))

theorem successful_phase_learns (gs : List (Γ × Γ)) (hgs : SlotsFresh gs ∅)
    (hcover : pairSupport gs=Set.univ) (M : Matroid Γ) (n j : ℕ) (hn : 0<n)
    (w : (Γ × Γ) → (Γ × Γ) → ℝ) (hw : ∀ p r,0<w p r)
    (η : ℝ) (hη0 : 0 ≤ η) (hη1 : η ≤ 1/3) (l : List (Set Γ))
    (hacc : AccuratePhase gs w (annealWeight M n j)
      (fun S => annealRho n^(n-(M.eRk S).toNat)) η l) :
    GoodMultipliers gs (annealWeight M n (j+1)) (learnedMultipliers gs w l) := by
  let f := annealWeight M n j
  let g := fun S => annealRho n^(n-(M.eRk S).toNat)
  have hf := annealWeight_pos M n j hn
  have hΛ := chainTotal_pos gs hgs hcover w f hf hw
  have hp0 : 0<chainMean gs w f (plainObservable gs (fun _ => 1)) := by
    rw [plain_probability_mean gs hgs hcover]
    exact div_pos (slotTotal_pos gs f hf ∅ hgs) hΛ
  have hp0h := accurate_plain gs w f g η l hacc
  have hp0hp : 0<empirical (plainObservable gs (fun _ => 1)) l :=
    lt_of_lt_of_le (mul_pos (by linarith) hp0) hp0h.1
  have hpt : ∀ p∈gs,∀ r∈gs,p≠r → 0<chainMean gs w f (defectIndicator gs p r) := by
    intro p hp r hr hpr
    rw [defectIndicator_mean gs hgs hcover w f p r hp hr hpr]
    exact div_pos (mul_pos (hw p r) (slotDefect_pos gs f hf ∅ hgs p r hp hr hpr)) hΛ
  have hptp : ∀ p∈gs,∀ r∈gs,p≠r → 0<empirical (defectIndicator gs p r) l := by
    intro p hp r hr hpr
    exact lt_of_lt_of_le (mul_pos (by linarith) (hpt p hp r hr hpr))
      (accurate_defect gs w f g η l hacc p r hp hr hpr).1
  have hb : ∀ p∈gs,∀ r∈gs,p≠r →
      (slotTotal gs (annealWeight M n (j+1)) ∅/slotDefect gs (annealWeight M n (j+1)) ∅ p r)/4 ≤
        learnedMultipliers gs w l p r ∧
      learnedMultipliers gs w l p r ≤ 4*(slotTotal gs (annealWeight M n (j+1)) ∅/slotDefect gs (annealWeight M n (j+1)) ∅ p r) := by
    intro p hp r hr hpr
    rw [learnedMultipliers,ite_eq_left ⟨hp,hr,hpr⟩]
    exact learned_multiplier_good _ _ _ _ _ _ _ η (hw p r) hp0 (hpt p hp r hr hpr)
      (div_pos (slotTotal_pos gs f hf ∅ hgs) (slotDefect_pos gs f hf ∅ hgs p r hp hr hpr))
      (weight_mean_identity gs hgs hcover f hf w hw p r hp hr hpr) hη0 hη1 hp0h
      (accurate_defect gs w f g η l hacc p r hp hr hpr)
      (anneal_ideal_drift gs hgs M n j hn p r hp hr hpr)
  refine ⟨?_,?_,?_⟩
  · intro p r
    unfold learnedMultipliers
    split_ifs with h
    · exact mul_pos (hw p r) (div_pos hp0hp (hptp p h.1 r h.2.1 h.2.2))
    · exact hw p r
  · intro p hp r hr hpr
    simpa only [div_div,mul_comm] using (hb p hp r hr hpr).1
  · intro p hp r hr hpr
    simpa only [mul_div_assoc] using (hb p hp r hr hpr).2

theorem successful_phase_ratio (gs : List (Γ × Γ)) (hgs : SlotsFresh gs ∅)
    (hcover : pairSupport gs=Set.univ) (M : Matroid Γ) (n j : ℕ) (hn : 0<n)
    (w : (Γ × Γ) → (Γ × Γ) → ℝ) (hw : ∀ p r,0<w p r)
    (η : ℝ) (hη0 : 0 ≤ η) (hη1 : η<1) (l : List (Set Γ))
    (hacc : AccuratePhase gs w (annealWeight M n j)
      (fun S => annealRho n^(n-(M.eRk S).toNat)) η l) :
    (1-η)/(1+η) ≤ empiricalRatio gs (fun S => annealRho n^(n-(M.eRk S).toNat)) l/
      (slotTotal gs (annealWeight M n (j+1)) ∅/slotTotal gs (annealWeight M n j) ∅) ∧
    empiricalRatio gs (fun S => annealRho n^(n-(M.eRk S).toNat)) l/
      (slotTotal gs (annealWeight M n (j+1)) ∅/slotTotal gs (annealWeight M n j) ∅) ≤ (1+η)/(1-η) := by
  let f := annealWeight M n j
  let g := fun S => annealRho n^(n-(M.eRk S).toNat)
  have hΛ := chainTotal_pos gs hgs hcover w f (annealWeight_pos M n j hn) hw
  have hp0 : 0<chainMean gs w f (plainObservable gs (fun _ => 1)) := by
    rw [plain_probability_mean gs hgs hcover]
    exact div_pos (slotTotal_pos gs f (annealWeight_pos M n j hn) ∅ hgs) hΛ
  have hu : 0<chainMean gs w f (plainObservable gs g) := by
    rw [anneal_ratio_mean gs hgs hcover M n j hn]
    exact div_pos (slotTotal_pos gs _ (annealWeight_pos M n (j+1) hn) ∅ hgs) hΛ
  have he : chainMean gs w f (plainObservable gs g)/chainMean gs w f (plainObservable gs (fun _ => 1)) =
      slotTotal gs (annealWeight M n (j+1)) ∅/slotTotal gs (annealWeight M n j) ∅ := by
    rw [anneal_ratio_mean gs hgs hcover M n j hn,plain_probability_mean gs hgs hcover]
    dsimp only [f] at hΛ ⊢
    field_simp [hΛ.ne']
  have h := estimated_ratio_bounds η _ _ _ _ hη0 hη1 hp0 hu
    (accurate_plain gs w f g η l hacc) (relative_error_bounds _ _ _ (hacc (.inr ())))
  rw [he] at h
  exact h.2
end ActualAnnealing
namespace FiniteChain
open scoped BigOperators Classical
variable {X : Type*} [Fintype X] (C : FiniteChain X)
lemma capped_power_submass (K : FiniteKernel X X) (hK : ∀ x y,K.P x y ≤ C.P x y)
    (ν : X → ℝ) (hν : ∀ x,0 ≤ ν x) (U e : ℝ) (hwarm : ∀ x,ν x ≤ U*C.π x)
    (hloss : ∀ a : X → ℝ,(∀ x,0 ≤ a x) → (∀ x,a x ≤ U*C.π x) →
      (∑ x,a x*(1-∑ y,K.P x y)) ≤ e) (T : ℕ) :
    (∑ x,ν x)-(∑ x,(K.power T).push ν x) ≤ (T:ℝ)*e := by
  have hdom := fun n x => K.power_domination C.kernel hK n ν hν x
  induction T with
  | zero => simp [FiniteKernel.power,FiniteKernel.push_identity]
  | succ T ih =>
    have h := K.one_step_defect C.kernel C.stochastic
      ((K.power T).push ν) ((C.kernel.power T).push ν)
      ((K.power T).push_nonneg ν hν) (hdom T)
    have hl := hloss ((C.kernel.power T).push ν)
      ((C.kernel.power T).push_nonneg ν hν) (C.power_warm T ν U hwarm)
    have hm := C.power_push_mass T ν
    have hm' := C.power_push_mass (T+1) ν
    rw [FiniteKernel.power_push_succ] at hm'
    rw [FiniteKernel.power_push_succ]
    rw [hm,hm'] at h
    push_cast
    linarith
variable (A : X → Prop) (Q : KilledKernel (Outside A)) (hQ : ∀ x y,Q.Q x y=C.P x.val y.val)
lemma cappedTrace_power_submass [Nonempty (Inside A)] (N T : ℕ) (hN : 0<N)
    (U : ℝ) (ν : Inside A → ℝ) (hν : ∀ x,0 ≤ ν x)
    (hwarm : ∀ x,ν x ≤ U*(C.traceChain A Q hQ).π x) :
    (∑ x,ν x)-(∑ x,((C.cappedTraceKernel A Q hQ N).power T).push ν x) ≤
      (T:ℝ)*(U/C.insideMass A/(N:ℝ)) := by
  apply (C.traceChain A Q hQ).capped_power_submass (C.cappedTraceKernel A Q hQ N)
    (C.cappedTrace_le A Q N) ν hν U _ hwarm
  intro a ha haw
  have h := C.cappedTrace_warm_loss A Q hQ N U a ha haw
  apply (le_div_iff₀ (by exact_mod_cast hN : (0:ℝ)<N)).mpr
  simpa only [cappedTraceKernel,mul_comm] using h
end FiniteChain

section RestartBridge
open scoped BigOperators Classical
variable (n : ℕ) (hn : 0<n) (M : Matroid (Fin n ⊕ Fin n))
    (hE : M.E=Set.univ) (hR : M.eRank=(n:ℕ∞))
local notation "GS" => pairedSlots n
local notation "W" => (((Fin n ⊕ Fin n) × (Fin n ⊕ Fin n)) → ((Fin n ⊕ Fin n) × (Fin n ⊕ Fin n)) → ℝ)
noncomputable def actualTrace (j : ℕ) (w : W) (hw : ∀ p r,0<w p r) : FiniteChain (PlainIndex GS) :=
  metropolisTrace GS (pairedSlots_fresh n) (pairedSlots_ne_nil n hn) (pairedSlots_cover n)
    w (annealWeight M n j) hw (annealWeight_pos M n j hn)
include hE hR in
lemma actual_trace_poincare (j : ℕ) (w : W) (hw : GoodMultipliers GS (annealWeight M n j) w)
    (H : PlainIndex GS → ℝ) :
    (actualTrace n hn M j w hw.positive).variance H ≤
      18*(n:ℝ)^4*(actualTrace n hn M j w hw.positive).energy H := by
  have hr := annealRho_bounds n hn
  have hp : 0<annealRho n := lt_of_lt_of_le (by norm_num) hr.1
  have hs := matroidWeight_signature M hE n hR (annealRho n^j) (pow_pos hp j) (pow_le_one₀ hp.le hr.2.le)
  simpa only [actualTrace,pairedSlots_length] using
    metropolisTrace_poincare GS (pairedSlots_fresh n) (pairedSlots_ne_nil n hn) (pairedSlots_cover n)
      w (annealWeight M n j) hw.positive (annealWeight_pos M n j hn) hs hw.lower H
include hE hR in
lemma actual_trace_mixing_warm (L j : ℕ) (hj : j ≤ L) (w : W)
    (hw : GoodMultipliers GS (annealWeight M n j) w)
    (ν : PlainIndex GS → ℝ) (hν : ∀ x,0 ≤ ν x) (hnorm : ∑ x,ν x ≤ 1)
    (y : PlainIndex GS) :
    ((actualTrace n hn M j w hw.positive).kernel.power (20*n^4*(n*(L+1)+2))).push ν y ≤
      (3/2)*(actualTrace n hn M j w hw.positive).π y := by
  have hn' : (1:ℝ) ≤ n := by exact_mod_cast hn
  have hK : (1:ℝ) ≤ 18*(n:ℝ)^4 := by nlinarith [pow_le_pow_left₀ (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) ≤ 1) hn' 4]
  have he := Annealing.restart_exponential n L hn
  have hm : (1/2:ℝ)^(n*(L+1))=(2:ℝ)^(-((n*(L+1):ℕ):ℤ)) := by
    simp only [zpow_neg,zpow_natCast,one_div,inv_pow]
  rw [← hm] at he
  convert (actualTrace n hn M j w hw.positive).kernel_power_warm_any
    (18*(n:ℝ)^4) ((1/2)^(n*(L+1))) (1/2) hK (by positivity)
    (actual_trace_minimum n L j hn hj M w hw.positive)
    (actual_trace_poincare n hn M hE hR j w hw) _ he (by norm_num) ν hν hnorm y using 1 ; norm_num
lemma actual_mu_drift (j : ℕ) (w w' : W) (hw : ∀ p r,0<w p r) (hw' : ∀ p r,0<w' p r)
    (x : PlainIndex GS) :
    (actualTrace n hn M j w hw).π x ≤ 2*(actualTrace n hn M (j+1) w' hw').π x := by
  dsimp only [actualTrace]
  rw [metropolisTrace_pi,metropolisTrace_pi]
  have ha := annealWeight_drift M n j hn x.val.val
  have hb := anneal_slot_drift GS M n j hn ∅
  have hz := slotTotal_pos GS (annealWeight M n j) (annealWeight_pos M n j hn) ∅ (pairedSlots_fresh n)
  have hz' := slotTotal_pos GS (annealWeight M n (j+1)) (annealWeight_pos M n (j+1) hn) ∅ (pairedSlots_fresh n)
  rw [← mul_div_assoc,div_le_div_iff₀ hz hz']
  have hfp := (annealWeight_pos M n j hn x.val.val).le
  nlinarith [mul_nonneg hfp (sub_nonneg.mpr hb.2),mul_nonneg hz.le (sub_nonneg.mpr ha.1)]
end RestartBridge

section ActualRestart
open scoped BigOperators Classical
variable (n : ℕ) (hn : 0<n) (M : Matroid (Fin n ⊕ Fin n))
local notation "GS" => pairedSlots n
local notation "W" => (((Fin n ⊕ Fin n) × (Fin n ⊕ Fin n)) → ((Fin n ⊕ Fin n) × (Fin n ⊕ Fin n)) → ℝ)
noncomputable def actualCappedTrace (j : ℕ) (w : W) (hw : ∀ p r,0<w p r) (cap : ℕ) :
    FiniteKernel (PlainIndex GS) (PlainIndex GS) :=
  (metropolisChain GS (pairedSlots_fresh n) (pairedSlots_ne_nil n hn) (pairedSlots_cover n)
    w (annealWeight M n j) hw (annealWeight_pos M n j hn)).cappedTraceKernel (plainPredicate GS)
    (metropolisKilled GS (pairedSlots_fresh n) (pairedSlots_ne_nil n hn) (pairedSlots_cover n)
      w (annealWeight M n j) hw (annealWeight_pos M n j hn)) (by intros; rfl) cap
lemma actualCappedTrace_le (j : ℕ) (w : W) (hw : ∀ p r,0<w p r) (cap : ℕ) (x y : PlainIndex GS) :
    (actualCappedTrace n hn M j w hw cap).P x y ≤ (actualTrace n hn M j w hw).P x y := by
  exact FiniteChain.cappedTrace_le _ _ _ cap x y
lemma actual_capped_mixing (hE : M.E=Set.univ) (hR : M.eRank=(n:ℕ∞))
    (L j : ℕ) (hj : j ≤ L) (w : W) (hw : GoodMultipliers GS (annealWeight M n j) w)
    (cap : ℕ) (ν : PlainIndex GS → ℝ) (hν : ∀ x,0 ≤ ν x) (hnorm : ∑ x,ν x ≤ 1)
    (y : PlainIndex GS) :
    ((actualCappedTrace n hn M j w hw.positive cap).power (20*n^4*(n*(L+1)+2))).push ν y ≤
      (3/2)*(actualTrace n hn M j w hw.positive).π y := by
  exact ((actualCappedTrace n hn M j w hw.positive cap).power_domination
    (actualTrace n hn M j w hw.positive).kernel (actualCappedTrace_le n hn M j w hw.positive cap)
    _ ν hν y).trans (actual_trace_mixing_warm n hn M hE hR L j hj w hw ν hν hnorm y)
lemma actual_capped_loss (j : ℕ) (w : W) (hw : GoodMultipliers GS (annealWeight M n j) w)
    (cap T : ℕ) (hcap : 0<cap) (ν : PlainIndex GS → ℝ) (hν : ∀ x,0 ≤ ν x)
    (hwarm : ∀ x,ν x ≤ 4*(actualTrace n hn M j w hw.positive).π x) :
    (∑ x,ν x)-(∑ x,((actualCappedTrace n hn M j w hw.positive cap).power T).push ν x) ≤
      (T:ℝ)*(20*(n:ℝ)^2/(cap:ℝ)) := by
  let := plainIndex_nonempty GS (pairedSlots_fresh n) (pairedSlots_cover n)
  let C := metropolisChain GS (pairedSlots_fresh n) (pairedSlots_ne_nil n hn) (pairedSlots_cover n)
    w (annealWeight M n j) hw.positive (annealWeight_pos M n j hn)
  let Q := metropolisKilled GS (pairedSlots_fresh n) (pairedSlots_ne_nil n hn) (pairedSlots_cover n)
    w (annealWeight M n j) hw.positive (annealWeight_pos M n j hn)
  have h := C.cappedTrace_power_submass (plainPredicate GS) Q (by intros; rfl) cap T hcap 4 ν hν hwarm
  change _ ≤ (T:ℝ)*(4/C.insideMass (plainPredicate GS)/(cap:ℝ)) at h
  apply h.trans
  apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (Nat.cast_nonneg _)
  apply div_le_div_of_nonneg_right _ (Nat.cast_nonneg _)
  have hmass := plain_mass_lower GS (pairedSlots_fresh n) (pairedSlots_ne_nil n hn) (pairedSlots_cover n)
    w (annealWeight M n j) hw.positive (annealWeight_pos M n j hn) hw.upper
  simp only [pairedSlots_length] at hmass
  have hm' : 1/(5*(n:ℝ)^2) ≤ C.insideMass (plainPredicate GS) := by
    rw [metropolis_insideMass]; exact hmass
  have hn' : (0:ℝ)<n := by exact_mod_cast hn
  have hp : 0<C.insideMass (plainPredicate GS) := (by positivity : (0:ℝ)<1/(5*(n:ℝ)^2)).trans_le hm'
  apply (div_le_iff₀ hp).mpr
  have hh := (div_le_iff₀ (by positivity : (0:ℝ)<5*(n:ℝ)^2)).mp hm'
  nlinarith
noncomputable def uniformPlain (_ : PlainIndex GS) : ℝ := by
  exact 1/(2:ℝ)^n
lemma uniformPlain_mass : ∑ x : PlainIndex GS,uniformPlain n x=1 := by
  simp [uniformPlain,plainIndex_card]
lemma uniformPlain_pi (w : W) (hw : ∀ p r,0<w p r) (x : PlainIndex GS) :
    uniformPlain n x=(actualTrace n hn M 0 w hw).π x := by
  rw [actualTrace,metropolisTrace_pi]
  have he : annealWeight M n 0=(fun _ => 1) := by funext S; simp [annealWeight,matroidWeight]
  rw [he,slotTotal_one GS ∅ (pairedSlots_fresh n),pairedSlots_length]
  rfl
noncomputable def restartLaw (L cap : ℕ) (w : ℕ → W) (hw : ∀ j p r,0<w j p r) : ℕ → PlainIndex GS → ℝ
  | 0 => uniformPlain n
  | j+1 => ((actualCappedTrace n hn M (j+1) (w (j+1)) (hw (j+1)) cap).power
      (20*n^4*(n*(L+1)+2))).push (restartLaw L cap w hw j)
lemma restartLaw_nonneg (L cap : ℕ) (w : ℕ → W) (hw : ∀ j p r,0<w j p r)
    (j : ℕ) (x : PlainIndex GS) : 0 ≤ restartLaw n hn M L cap w hw j x := by
  induction j generalizing x with
  | zero => simp only [restartLaw,uniformPlain]; positivity
  | succ j ih => exact FiniteKernel.push_nonneg _ _ ih x
lemma restartLaw_mass_le (L cap : ℕ) (w : ℕ → W) (hw : ∀ j p r,0<w j p r) (j : ℕ) :
    (∑ x,restartLaw n hn M L cap w hw j x) ≤ 1 := by
  induction j with
  | zero => exact (uniformPlain_mass n).le
  | succ j ih => exact (FiniteKernel.push_mass_le _ _ (restartLaw_nonneg n hn M L cap w hw j)).trans ih
lemma restartLaw_warm (hE : M.E=Set.univ) (hR : M.eRank=(n:ℕ∞))
    (L cap : ℕ) (w : ℕ → W) (hw : ∀ j p r,0<w j p r)
    (j : ℕ) (hj : j ≤ L) (hgood : GoodMultipliers GS (annealWeight M n j) (w j))
    (x : PlainIndex GS) :
    restartLaw n hn M L cap w hw j x ≤ 2*(actualTrace n hn M j (w j) (hw j)).π x := by
  cases j with
  | zero =>
    rw [restartLaw,uniformPlain_pi n hn M (w 0) (hw 0)]
    have h := (actualTrace n hn M 0 (w 0) (hw 0)).positive x
    linarith
  | succ j =>
    have h := actual_capped_mixing n hn M hE hR L (j+1) hj (w (j+1)) hgood cap
      (restartLaw n hn M L cap w hw j) (restartLaw_nonneg n hn M L cap w hw j)
      (restartLaw_mass_le n hn M L cap w hw j) x
    change _ ≤ 2*(actualTrace n hn M (j+1) (w (j+1)) (hw (j+1))).π x
    have hp := (actualTrace n hn M (j+1) (w (j+1)) (hw (j+1))).positive x
    exact h.trans (by linarith)
lemma restartLaw_missing_mass (hE : M.E=Set.univ) (hR : M.eRank=(n:ℕ∞))
    (L cap : ℕ) (hcap : 0<cap) (w : ℕ → W) (hw : ∀ j p r,0<w j p r)
    (j : ℕ) (hj : j ≤ L)
    (hgood : ∀ a ≤ j,GoodMultipliers GS (annealWeight M n a) (w a)) :
    1-(∑ x,restartLaw n hn M L cap w hw j x) ≤
      (j:ℝ)*((20*n^4*(n*(L+1)+2):ℕ):ℝ)*(20*(n:ℝ)^2/(cap:ℝ)) := by
  induction j with
  | zero => simp [restartLaw,uniformPlain_mass]
  | succ j ih =>
    have hj' : j ≤ L := by omega
    have hb := ih hj' (fun a ha => hgood a (by omega))
    have hwarm : ∀ x,restartLaw n hn M L cap w hw j x ≤ 4*(actualTrace n hn M (j+1) (w (j+1)) (hw (j+1))).π x := by
      intro x
      have h1 := restartLaw_warm n hn M hE hR L cap w hw j hj' (hgood j (by omega)) x
      have h2 := actual_mu_drift n hn M j (w j) (w (j+1)) (hw j) (hw (j+1)) x
      linarith
    have h := actual_capped_loss n hn M (j+1) (w (j+1)) (hgood (j+1) le_rfl) cap
      (20*n^4*(n*(L+1)+2)) hcap (restartLaw n hn M L cap w hw j)
      (restartLaw_nonneg n hn M L cap w hw j) hwarm
    change 1-(∑ x,(_ : FiniteKernel _ _).push _ x) ≤ _
    simp only [Nat.cast_add,Nat.cast_one]
    nlinarith
end ActualRestart

open scoped BigOperators Classical
variable {X : Type*} [Fintype X] (C : FiniteChain X)
lemma pathProbability_congr_length (ν : X → ℝ) (N : ℕ) (E F : List X → Prop)
    (h : ∀ l,l.length=N+1 → (E l ↔ F l)) :
    C.pathProbability ν N E=C.pathProbability ν N F := by
  unfold pathProbability
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro x _
  congr 1
  apply C.pathExpectation_congr_length
  intro l hl
  simp only [h l hl]
lemma pathProbability_compl (ν : X → ℝ) (N : ℕ) (E : List X → Prop) :
    C.pathProbability ν N E+C.pathProbability ν N (fun l => ¬E l)=∑ x,ν x := by
  unfold pathProbability
  rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro x _
  rw [← mul_add,← C.pathExpectation_add]
  calc
    _ = ν x*C.pathExpectation N x (fun _ => 1) := by
      congr 1
      apply C.pathExpectation_congr
      intro l
      by_cases h : E l <;> simp [h]
    _ = ν x := by rw [C.pathExpectation_const,mul_one]
lemma pathProbability_le_mass (ν : X → ℝ) (hν : ∀ x,0 ≤ ν x) (N : ℕ) (E : List X → Prop) :
    C.pathProbability ν N E ≤ ∑ x,ν x := by
  have h := C.pathProbability_compl ν N E
  have hn := C.pathProbability_nonneg ν hν N (fun l => ¬E l)
  linarith
end FiniteChain

lemma empirical_trajectory [Fintype Γ] [DecidableEq Γ] (gs : List (Γ × Γ)) (H : Set Γ → ℝ) (l : List (ChainIndex gs)) :
    empirical H (l.map Subtype.val)=FiniteChain.pathSum (fun S => H S.val) l/(l.length:ℝ) := by
  simp [empirical,FiniteChain.pathSum,]

theorem accurate_phase_probability (gs : List (Γ × Γ)) (hgs : SlotsFresh gs ∅) (hne : gs≠[])
    (hcover : pairSupport gs=Set.univ) (w : (Γ × Γ) → (Γ × Γ) → ℝ)
    (f g : Set Γ → ℝ) (hw : GoodMultipliers gs f w) (hf : ∀ S,0<f S)
    (hsig : HasSlotSignature f) (hg : ∀ S,PlainState gs S → 1/2 ≤ g S ∧ g S ≤ 1)
    (ν : ChainIndex gs → ℝ) (hν : ∀ S,0 ≤ ν S)
    (hwarm : ∀ S,ν S ≤ (10*(gs.length:ℝ)^2)*chainWeight gs w f S.val/chainTotal gs w f)
    (L N : ℕ) (η : ℝ) (hη : 0<η) (hN : (10:ℝ)^10*(L+1)*gs.length^14/η^2 ≤ N) :
    let C := metropolisChain gs hgs hne hcover w f hw.positive hf
    (∑ S,ν S)-1/(32*(L+1:ℝ)) ≤
      C.pathProbability ν (N-1) (fun l => AccuratePhase gs w f g η (l.map Subtype.val)) := by
  let C := metropolisChain gs hgs hne hcover w f hw.positive hf
  have hn : 0<gs.length := List.length_pos_iff.mpr hne
  have hn' : (0:ℝ)<gs.length := by exact_mod_cast hn
  have hNp : (0:ℝ)<N := lt_of_lt_of_le (by positivity) hN
  have hNp' : 0<N := by exact_mod_cast hNp
  have h := metropolis_phase_failure gs hgs hne hcover w f g hw.positive hf hsig hg
    hw.lower hw.upper ν hν hwarm L N η hη hN
  change C.pathProbability ν (N-1) _ ≤ _ at h
  have he := C.pathProbability_congr_length ν (N-1)
    (fun l => ∃ j : PhaseObservables gs,η*C.mean (fun S => phaseObservable gs g j S.val)<
      |FiniteChain.pathSum (fun S => phaseObservable gs g j S.val) l/(N:ℝ)-C.mean (fun S => phaseObservable gs g j S.val)|)
    (fun l => ¬AccuratePhase gs w f g η (l.map Subtype.val)) (by
      intro l hl
      have hl' : l.length=N := by omega
      simp only [AccuratePhase,empirical_trajectory,hl',not_forall,not_le]
      simp only [C,metropolisChain_mean])
  rw [he] at h
  have hc := C.pathProbability_compl ν (N-1) (fun l => AccuratePhase gs w f g η (l.map Subtype.val))
  dsimp only
  linarith
end PhaseBridge
section EstimatorBridge
open scoped BigOperators Classical
variable {Γ : Type*} [Fintype Γ] [DecidableEq Γ]
lemma product_ratios_telescope (a : ℕ → ℝ) (ha : ∀ j,a j≠0) (L : ℕ) :
    (∏ j ∈ Finset.range L,a (j+1)/a j)=a L/a 0 := by
  induction L with
  | zero => simp [ha]
  | succ L ih => rw [Finset.prod_range_succ,ih]; field_simp [ha L,ha 0]
lemma accurate_phases_product (gs : List (Γ × Γ)) (hgs : SlotsFresh gs ∅)
    (hcover : pairSupport gs=Set.univ) (M : Matroid Γ) (n : ℕ) (hn : 0<n)
    (ε : ℝ) (hε0 : 0<ε) (hε1 : ε<1) (L : ℕ)
    (w : ℕ → (Γ × Γ) → (Γ × Γ) → ℝ) (hw : ∀ j p r,0<w j p r)
    (ls : ℕ → List (Set Γ))
    (hacc : ∀ j<L,AccuratePhase gs (w j) (annealWeight M n j)
      (fun S => annealRho n^(n-(M.eRk S).toNat)) (annealTolerance ε L) (ls j)) :
    let Zhat := (2:ℝ)^gs.length * ∏ j ∈ Finset.range L,
      empiricalRatio gs (fun S => annealRho n^(n-(M.eRk S).toNat)) (ls j)
    (1-ε/4)*slotTotal gs (annealWeight M n L) ∅ ≤ Zhat ∧
      Zhat ≤ (1+ε/4)*slotTotal gs (annealWeight M n L) ∅ := by
  let c := fun j => slotTotal gs (annealWeight M n j) ∅
  let R := fun j => empiricalRatio gs (fun S => annealRho n^(n-(M.eRk S).toNat)) (ls j)
  have hc : ∀ j,0<c j := fun j => slotTotal_pos gs _ (annealWeight_pos M n j hn) ∅ hgs
  have ht := product_ratios_telescope c (fun j => (hc j).ne') L
  have he : c 0=(2:ℝ)^gs.length := by
    have hf : annealWeight M n 0=(fun _ => 1) := by funext S; simp [annealWeight,matroidWeight]
    dsimp only [c]; rw [hf,slotTotal_one gs ∅ hgs]
  have hη : 0<annealTolerance ε L ∧ annealTolerance ε L<1/32 := by
    have hd : 0<32*((L:ℝ)+1) := by positivity
    constructor
    · exact div_pos hε0 hd
    · apply (div_lt_iff₀ hd).mpr
      nlinarith [Nat.cast_nonneg (α := ℝ) L]
  have hp := product_accuracy (fun j => R j/(c (j+1)/c j)) ε L hε0 hε1
    (fun j hj => successful_phase_ratio gs hgs hcover M n j hn (w j) (hw j)
      (annealTolerance ε L) hη.1.le (by linarith [hη.2]) (ls j) (hacc j hj))
  have hidentity : (∏ j ∈ Finset.range L,R j/(c (j+1)/c j)) =
      ((2:ℝ)^gs.length*(∏ j ∈ Finset.range L,R j))/c L := by
    rw [Finset.prod_div_distrib,ht,he]
    field_simp
  rw [hidentity] at hp
  constructor
  · exact (le_div_iff₀ (hc L)).mp hp.1
  · exact (div_le_iff₀ (hc L)).mp hp.2

theorem actual_estimator_accuracy {n : ℕ} (hn : 0<n) (M₁ M₂ : Matroid (Fin n))
    (hE₂ : M₂.E=Set.univ) (hr : M₁.eRank=M₂.eRank)
    (ε : ℝ) (hε0 : 0<ε) (hε1 : ε<1) (b : ℕ) (hb : (1/2:ℝ)^b ≤ ε/10)
    (hZ : 0<commonBaseCount M₁ M₂)
    (w : ℕ → ((Fin n ⊕ Fin n) × (Fin n ⊕ Fin n)) → ((Fin n ⊕ Fin n) × (Fin n ⊕ Fin n)) → ℝ)
    (hw : ∀ j p r,0<w j p r) (ls : ℕ → List (Set (Fin n ⊕ Fin n)))
    (hacc : ∀ j<annealLength n b,AccuratePhase (pairedSlots n) (w j) (annealWeight (pairedMatroid M₁ M₂) n j)
      (fun S => annealRho n^(n-((pairedMatroid M₁ M₂).eRk S).toNat))
      (annealTolerance ε (annealLength n b)) (ls j)) :
    let Zhat := (2:ℝ)^n * ∏ j ∈ Finset.range (annealLength n b),
      empiricalRatio (pairedSlots n) (fun S => annealRho n^(n-((pairedMatroid M₁ M₂).eRk S).toNat)) (ls j)
    (1-ε)*(commonBaseCount M₁ M₂:ℝ) ≤ Zhat ∧ Zhat ≤ (1+ε)*(commonBaseCount M₁ M₂:ℝ) := by
  have hp := accurate_phases_product (pairedSlots n) (pairedSlots_fresh n) (pairedSlots_cover n)
    (pairedMatroid M₁ M₂) n hn ε hε0 hε1 (annealLength n b) w hw ls hacc
  simp only [pairedSlots_length] at hp
  have hrho := annealRho_bounds n hn
  have hq0 : 0 ≤ annealRho n^annealLength n b := pow_nonneg (le_trans (by norm_num) hrho.1) _
  have hq1 : annealRho n^annealLength n b ≤ 1 := pow_le_one₀ (le_trans (by norm_num) hrho.1) hrho.2.le
  have hc := paired_partition_contamination M₁ M₂ hE₂ hr _ hq0 hq1
  have hcont := anneal_final_contamination n b hn ε hb
  have hZ' : (1:ℝ) ≤ commonBaseCount M₁ M₂ := by exact_mod_cast hZ
  apply final_estimate_accuracy ε _ _ _ hε0 hε1 (by positivity) ⟨hc.1,?_⟩ hp
  have hm := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hZ' (show 0 ≤ ε/10 by positivity)
  nlinarith [hc.2]
end EstimatorBridge

def Sample (X : Type u) : ℕ → Type u
  | 0 => X
  | k+1 => X × Sample X k
instance sampleFintype (k : ℕ) : Fintype (Sample X k) := by
  induction k with
  | zero => exact inferInstanceAs (Fintype X)
  | succ k ih =>
    letI : Fintype (Sample X k) := ih
    exact inferInstanceAs (Fintype (X × Sample X k))
def Sample.toList : {k : ℕ} → Sample X k → List X
  | 0,x => [x]
  | _+1,(x,v) => x::v.toList
omit sectionInstance101 in
lemma Sample.toList_length [Fintype X] {k : ℕ} (v : Sample X k) : v.toList.length=k+1 := by
  induction k with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ k ih => exact congrArg Nat.succ (ih v.2)
variable (C : FiniteChain X)
noncomputable def sampleMass (C : FiniteChain X) (ν : X → ℝ) : {k : ℕ} → Sample X k → ℝ
  | 0,x => ν x
  | _+1,(x,v) => ν x*sampleMass C (C.P x) v
lemma sampleMass_nonneg (ν : X → ℝ) (hν : ∀ x,0 ≤ ν x) {k : ℕ} (v : Sample X k) :
    0 ≤ C.sampleMass ν v := by
  induction k generalizing ν with
  | zero => exact hν v
  | succ k ih => exact mul_nonneg (hν _) (ih _ (C.nonnegative _) v.2)
lemma sampleMass_expect (ν : X → ℝ) (k : ℕ) (F : List X → ℝ) :
    (∑ v : Sample X k,C.sampleMass ν v*F v.toList)=
      ∑ x,ν x*C.pathExpectation k x F := by
  induction k generalizing ν F with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ k ih =>
    change (∑ v : X × Sample X k,_)=_
    rw [Fintype.sum_prod_type]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro x _
    simp only [sampleMass,Sample.toList,mul_assoc,← Finset.mul_sum]
    rw [ih (C.P x) (fun l => F (x::l))]
    rfl
lemma sampleMass_total (ν : X → ℝ) (k : ℕ) :
    (∑ v : Sample X k,C.sampleMass ν v)=∑ x,ν x := by
  have h := C.sampleMass_expect ν k (fun _ => 1)
  simpa only [mul_one,C.pathExpectation_const] using h
lemma sampleMass_event (ν : X → ℝ) (k : ℕ) (E : List X → Prop) :
    (∑ v : Sample X k,if E v.toList then C.sampleMass ν v else 0)=C.pathProbability ν k E := by
  unfold pathProbability
  rw [← C.sampleMass_expect]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro v _
  split_ifs <;> simp
end FiniteChain

lemma plainLift_nonneg [Fintype Γ] [DecidableEq Γ] (gs : List (Γ × Γ)) (ν : PlainIndex gs → ℝ) (hν : ∀ x,0 ≤ ν x) (S : ChainIndex gs) :

lemma plainLift_mass [DecidableEq Γ] (gs : List (Γ × Γ)) (ν : PlainIndex gs → ℝ) :
    (∑ S,plainLift gs ν S)=∑ S : PlainIndex gs,ν S := by
  have h := Fintype.sum_subtype_add_sum_subtype (plainPredicate gs) (fun S => plainLift gs ν S)
  have ht : ∀ S : PlainIndex gs,plainLift gs ν S.val=ν S := by
    intro S; exact dite_eq_left S.property
  have hf : ∀ S : {S : ChainIndex gs // ¬plainPredicate gs S},plainLift gs ν S.val=0 := by
    intro S; exact dite_eq_right S.property
  simp_rw [ht,hf,Finset.sum_const_zero,add_zero] at h
  exact h.symm
lemma plainLift_warm (gs : List (Γ × Γ)) (hgs : SlotsFresh gs ∅) (hne : gs≠[])
    (hcover : pairSupport gs=Set.univ) (w : (Γ × Γ) → (Γ × Γ) → ℝ)
    (f : Set Γ → ℝ) (hf : ∀ S,0<f S) (hw : GoodMultipliers gs f w)
    (ν : PlainIndex gs → ℝ)
    (hν : ∀ S,ν S ≤ 2*(metropolisTrace gs hgs hne hcover w f hw.positive hf).π S)
    (S : ChainIndex gs) :
    plainLift gs ν S ≤ (10*(gs.length:ℝ)^2)*chainWeight gs w f S.val/chainTotal gs w f := by
  have hΛ := chainTotal_pos gs hgs hcover w f hf hw.positive
  unfold plainLift
  split_ifs with hS
  · have hn : (0:ℝ)<gs.length := by exact_mod_cast List.length_pos_iff.mpr hne
    have hz := slotTotal_pos gs f hf ∅ hgs
    have hbound := plain_mass_lower gs hgs hne hcover w f hw.positive hf hw.upper
    have hh := hν ⟨S,hS⟩
    rw [metropolisTrace_pi] at hh
    rw [chainWeight,chainMultiplier_plain gs w S.val hS,one_mul]
    apply hh.trans
    rw [← mul_div_assoc,div_le_div_iff₀ hz hΛ]
    have hm := (div_le_div_iff₀ (by positivity : (0:ℝ)<5*(gs.length:ℝ)^2) hΛ).mp hbound
    nlinarith [mul_nonneg (hf S.val).le (sub_nonneg.mpr (show chainTotal gs w f ≤ 5*(gs.length:ℝ)^2*slotTotal gs f ∅ by nlinarith))]
  · exact div_nonneg (mul_nonneg (by positivity) (chainWeight_pos gs w f hw.positive hf S.val).le) hΛ.le
end WarmLift

open scoped BigOperators Classical
variable {X : Type*} [Fintype X]
theorem adaptive_success_bounded (K : List X → X → ℝ) (Good : List X → Prop)
    (hK : ∀ h x,0 ≤ K h x) (hrow : ∀ h,∑ x,K h x ≤ 1)
    (hsupport : ∀ h,Good h → ∀ x,0<K h x → Good (h++[x]))
    (L : ℕ) (e : ℝ) (he : 0 ≤ e)
    (hloss : ∀ h,Good h → h.length<L → 1-e ≤ ∑ x,K h x)
    (t : ℕ) (h : List X) (hh : Good h) (hsize : h.length+t ≤ L) :
    1-(t:ℝ)*e ≤ mass K t h := by
  induction t generalizing h with
  | zero => simp [mass,expect]
  | succ t ih =>
    have hlocal : ∀ x,K h x*(1-(t:ℝ)*e) ≤ K h x*mass K t (h++[x]) := by
      intro x
      by_cases hz : K h x=0
      · simp [hz]
      · exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (ih _ (hsupport h hh x (lt_of_le_of_ne (hK h x) (Ne.symm hz))) (by simp only [List.length_append,List.length_singleton]; omega)) (hK h x)
    change 1-((t+1:ℕ):ℝ)*e ≤ ∑ x,K h x*mass K t (h++[x])
    have hs := Finset.sum_le_sum (fun x (_ : x∈Finset.univ) => hlocal x)
    rw [← Finset.sum_mul] at hs
    have hm := hloss h hh (by omega)
    have hu := hrow h
    have ht : 0 ≤ (t:ℝ)*e := mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) he
    push_cast
    nlinarith [mul_nonneg ht (sub_nonneg.mpr hu)]
theorem good_probability_bounded (P : List X → X → ℝ) (Good : List X → Prop)
    (hP : ∀ h x,0 ≤ P h x) (hrow : ∀ h,∑ x,P h x ≤ 1)
    (L : ℕ) (e : ℝ) (he : 0 ≤ e)
    (hstep : ∀ h,Good h → h.length<L → 1-e ≤ ∑ x,restrict P Good h x) :
    Good [] → 1-(L:ℝ)*e ≤ expect P L [] (fun l => if Good l then 1 else 0) := by
  intro hh
  have hb := adaptive_success_bounded (restrict P Good) Good (restrict_nonneg P Good hP)
    (fun h => (Finset.sum_le_sum (fun x _ => restrict_le P Good hP h x)).trans (hrow h))
    (fun h _ x hx => restrict_support P Good h x hx) L e he hstep L [] hh (by simp)
  exact hb.trans (mass_le_good_probability P Good hP L [] hh)
end FiniteExperiment

variable (M : Matroid Γ) (n : ℕ) (η : ℝ)
inductive SuccessfulHistory {X : Type*} (sample : X → List (Set Γ)) : List X → Prop
  | nil : SuccessfulHistory sample []
  | snoc (h : List X) (x : X) (hh : SuccessfulHistory sample h)
      (hx : AccuratePhase gs (historyWeights gs sample h) (annealWeight M n h.length)
        (fun S => annealRho n^(n-(M.eRk S).toNat)) η (sample x)) : SuccessfulHistory sample (h++[x])
lemma successfulHistory_take {X : Type*} (sample : X → List (Set Γ)) (h : List X)
    (hh : SuccessfulHistory gs M n η sample h) (a : ℕ) :
    SuccessfulHistory gs M n η sample (h.take a) := by
  induction hh with
  | nil => simpa using SuccessfulHistory.nil (gs := gs) (M := M) (n := n) (η := η) (sample := sample)
  | snoc h x hh hx ih =>
    by_cases ha : a ≤ h.length
    · rw [List.take_append_of_le_length ha]
      exact ih
    · have he : a ≥ (h++[x]).length := by simp; omega
      rw [List.take_of_length_le he]
      exact SuccessfulHistory.snoc h x hh hx
lemma successfulHistory_good {X : Type*} (sample : X → List (Set Γ))
    (hgs : SlotsFresh gs ∅) (hcover : pairSupport gs=Set.univ) (hn : 0<n)
    (hη0 : 0 ≤ η) (hη1 : η ≤ 1/3) (h : List X) (hh : SuccessfulHistory gs M n η sample h) :
    GoodMultipliers gs (annealWeight M n h.length) (historyWeights gs sample h) := by
  induction hh with
  | nil => exact initial_good gs hgs M n
  | snoc h x hh hx ih =>
    rw [historyWeights_snoc,List.length_append,List.length_singleton]
    exact successful_phase_learns gs hgs hcover M n h.length hn (historyWeights gs sample h)
      ih.positive η hη0 hη1 (sample x) hx
lemma successfulHistory_snoc_iff {X : Type*} (sample : X → List (Set Γ)) (h : List X) (x : X)
    (hh : SuccessfulHistory gs M n η sample h) :
    SuccessfulHistory gs M n η sample (h++[x]) ↔
      AccuratePhase gs (historyWeights gs sample h) (annealWeight M n h.length)
        (fun S => annealRho n^(n-(M.eRk S).toNat)) η (sample x) := by
  constructor
  · intro hs
    have aux : ∀ l,SuccessfulHistory gs M n η sample l → ∀ h x,l=h++[x] →
        AccuratePhase gs (historyWeights gs sample h) (annealWeight M n h.length)
          (fun S => annealRho n^(n-(M.eRk S).toNat)) η (sample x) := by
      intro l hl h x he
      cases hl with
      | nil => simp at he
      | snoc l y hl hy =>
        have hlen := congrArg List.length he
        simp only [List.length_append,List.length_singleton] at hlen
        have hex := List.append_inj he (by omega : l.length=h.length)
        obtain ⟨rfl,hyx⟩ := hex
        have : y=x := by simpa using hyx
        subst y
        exact hy
    exact aux _ hs h x rfl
  · exact SuccessfulHistory.snoc h x hh
end ActualHistory

variable (N : ℕ)

  metropolisChain GS (pairedSlots_fresh n) (pairedSlots_ne_nil n hn) (pairedSlots_cover n)

    (annealWeight_pos M n h.length hn)

    (phaseChain n hn M N h hp).sampleMass (phaseStart n hn M N L h hp) v else 0

  plainLift_nonneg _ _ (restartLaw_nonneg n hn M L _ _ _ _) S

  unfold phaseKernel; split_ifs with hp
  · exact FiniteChain.sampleMass_nonneg _ _ (phaseStart_nonneg n hn M N L h hp) v
  · rfl

  by_cases hp : HistoryPositive n N h

  nlinarith

variable {X : Type*} [Fintype X]
lemma expect_mul_left (K : List X → X → ℝ) (r : ℝ) (φ : List X → ℝ) (t : ℕ) (h : List X) :
    expect K t h (fun l => r*φ l)=r*expect K t h φ := by
  induction t generalizing h with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ t ih =>
    simp only [expect,ih]
    rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro x _
    ring
lemma expect_mono_length (K : List X → X → ℝ) (hK : ∀ h x,0 ≤ K h x)
    (φ ψ : List X → ℝ) (t : ℕ) (h : List X)
    (hh : ∀ l,l.length=h.length+t → φ l ≤ ψ l) :
    expect K t h φ ≤ expect K t h ψ := by
  induction t generalizing h with
  | zero => exact hh h (by simp)
  | succ t ih =>
    apply Finset.sum_le_sum
    intro x _
    apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (hK h x)
    apply ih
    intro l hl
    apply hh l
    simp only [List.length_append,List.length_singleton] at hl
    omega
end FiniteExperiment
open scoped BigOperators Classical
variable (n : ℕ) (hn : 0<n) (M₁ M₂ : Matroid (Fin n)) (N L : ℕ)
local notation "K" => pairedMatroid M₁ M₂
local notation "GS" => pairedSlots n
noncomputable def guardedEstimate (h : List (PhaseSample n N)) (x : PlainIndex GS) : ℝ :=
  if Witnessed n M₁ M₂ x then historyEstimate n N L K h else 0
include hn in
lemma guardedEstimate_nonneg (h : List (PhaseSample n N)) (x : PlainIndex GS) :
    0 ≤ guardedEstimate n M₁ M₂ N L h x := by
  unfold guardedEstimate
  split_ifs
  · exact historyEstimate_nonneg n N L K hn h
  · rfl
lemma guardedEstimate_zero (hE₂ : M₂.E=Set.univ) (hr : M₁.eRank=M₂.eRank)
    (hZ : commonBaseCount M₁ M₂=0) (h : List (PhaseSample n N)) (x : PlainIndex GS) :
    guardedEstimate n M₁ M₂ N L h x=0 := by
  unfold guardedEstimate
  apply ite_eq_right
  intro hx
  have hp := witnessed_count_pos n M₁ M₂ hE₂ hr x hx
  omega
noncomputable def actualRealSuccess (ε : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  FiniteExperiment.expect (phaseKernel n hn K N L) L [] (fun h =>
    ∑ x,if (1-ε)*(commonBaseCount M₁ M₂:ℝ) ≤ guardedEstimate n M₁ M₂ N L h x ∧
      guardedEstimate n M₁ M₂ N L h x ≤ (1+ε)*(commonBaseCount M₁ M₂:ℝ)
      then witnessKernel n hn M₁ M₂ N L h x else 0)

theorem real_annealing_success (hE₁ : M₁.E=Set.univ) (hE₂ : M₂.E=Set.univ)
    (hr : M₁.eRank=M₂.eRank) (ε : ℝ) (hε0 : 0<ε) (hε1 : ε<1)
    (b : ℕ) (hb : (1/2:ℝ)^b ≤ ε/10) (hZ : 0<commonBaseCount M₁ M₂)
    (hN : (10:ℝ)^10*(annealLength n b+1)*n^14/(annealTolerance ε (annealLength n b))^2 ≤ N) :
    3/4 ≤ actualRealSuccess n hn M₁ M₂ N (annealLength n b) ε := by
  let L := annealLength n b
  let η := annealTolerance ε L
  have hη0 : 0<η := by dsimp only [η,annealTolerance]; positivity
  have hη1 : η ≤ 1/3 := by
    dsimp only [η,annealTolerance]
    apply (div_le_iff₀ (by positivity : (0:ℝ)<32*((L:ℝ)+1))).mpr
    nlinarith [Nat.cast_nonneg (α := ℝ) L]
  have hE := paired_ground M₁ M₂ hE₁ hE₂
  have hR : (K).eRank=(n:ℕ∞) := by simpa using paired_eRank M₁ M₂ hE₂ hr
  let Good := SuccessfulHistory GS K n η (observedSets n N)
  have hmain := actual_history_success n hn K hE hR N L η hη0 hη1 hN
  have hmono := FiniteExperiment.expect_mono_length (phaseKernel n hn K N L)
    (phaseKernel_nonneg n hn K N L)
    (fun h => (79/100)*(if Good h then 1 else 0))
    (fun h => ∑ x,if (1-ε)*(commonBaseCount M₁ M₂:ℝ) ≤ guardedEstimate n M₁ M₂ N L h x ∧
      guardedEstimate n M₁ M₂ N L h x ≤ (1+ε)*(commonBaseCount M₁ M₂:ℝ)
      then witnessKernel n hn M₁ M₂ N L h x else 0) L [] (by
      intro h hlen
      have hlen' : h.length=L := by simpa using hlen
      by_cases hh : Good h
      · simp only [ite_eq_left hh,mul_one]
        have he := historyEstimate_accuracy n N hn M₁ M₂ hE₂ hr ε hε0 hε1 b hb hZ h hlen' hh
        apply (witnessKernel_good_mass n hn M₁ M₂ N hE₁ hE₂ hr ε hε0 hε1 b hb hZ h hlen' hh).trans
        apply Finset.sum_le_sum
        intro x _
        by_cases hx : Witnessed n M₁ M₂ x
        · simp only [guardedEstimate,ite_eq_left hx]
          rw [ite_eq_left he]
        · simp only [ite_eq_right hx]
          split_ifs
          · exact witnessKernel_nonneg n hn M₁ M₂ N L h x
          · rfl
      · simp only [ite_eq_right hh,mul_zero]
        exact Finset.sum_nonneg (fun x _ => by
          split_ifs
          · exact witnessKernel_nonneg n hn M₁ M₂ N L h x
          · rfl))
  rw [FiniteExperiment.expect_mul_left] at hmono
  change 3/4 ≤ actualRealSuccess n hn M₁ M₂ N L ε
  apply le_trans _ hmono
  have h := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hmain (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) ≤ 79/100)
  norm_num at h ⊢
  exact le_trans (by norm_num) h

end
