open scoped BigOperators Classical
abbrev BitWord (h : ℕ) := Fin h → Bool

def wordEquiv : (h : ℕ) → BitWord h ≃ Fin (2^h)
  | 0 => { toFun := fun _ => 0
           invFun := fun _ => Fin.elim0
           left_inv := fun _ => Subsingleton.elim _ _
           right_inv := by
             intro i
             apply Fin.ext
             have hi : i.val < 1 := by exact i.isLt
             change 0=i.val
             omega }
  | h+1 => (Fin.consEquiv (fun _ : Fin (h+1) => Bool)).symm |>.trans
      ((Equiv.prodCongr finTwoEquiv.symm (wordEquiv h)).trans
        (finProdFinEquiv.trans (finCongr (by rw [pow_succ]; omega : 2*2^h=2^(h+1)))))
noncomputable def uniformAverage {X : Type*} [Fintype X] (f : X → ℝ) : ℝ :=
  (∑ x,f x)/(Fintype.card X:ℝ)
lemma uniformAverage_equiv {X Y : Type*} [Fintype X] [Fintype Y]
    (e : X ≃ Y) (f : Y → ℝ) : uniformAverage (fun x => f (e x))=uniformAverage f := by
  rw [uniformAverage,uniformAverage,e.sum_comp,Fintype.card_congr e]
lemma uniformAverage_const {X : Type*} [Fintype X] [Nonempty X] (r : ℝ) :
    uniformAverage (fun _ : X => r)=r := by
  have h : (Fintype.card X:ℝ)≠0 := by exact_mod_cast ne_of_gt (Fintype.card_pos)
  simp [uniformAverage,h]
lemma uniformAverage_add {X : Type*} [Fintype X] (f g : X → ℝ) :
    uniformAverage (fun x => f x+g x)=uniformAverage f+uniformAverage g := by
  simp [uniformAverage,Finset.sum_add_distrib,add_div]
lemma uniformAverage_mul_left {X : Type*} [Fintype X] (r : ℝ) (f : X → ℝ) :
    uniformAverage (fun x => r*f x)=r*uniformAverage f := by
  simp [uniformAverage,← Finset.mul_sum,mul_div_assoc]
lemma uniformAverage_prod {X Y : Type*} [Fintype X] [Fintype Y] (f : X × Y → ℝ) :
    uniformAverage f=uniformAverage (fun x => uniformAverage (fun y => f (x,y))) := by
  simp only [uniformAverage,Fintype.sum_prod_type,Fintype.card_prod,Nat.cast_mul]
  rw [← Finset.sum_div]
  ring
lemma uniformAverage_fin_succ {X : Type*} [Fintype X] (D : ℕ)
    (f : (Fin (D+1) → X) → ℝ) :
    uniformAverage f=uniformAverage (fun x => uniformAverage (fun rest => f (Fin.cons x rest))) := by
  rw [← uniformAverage_equiv (Fin.consEquiv (fun _ : Fin (D+1) => X)) f,uniformAverage_prod]
  rfl

def boundedUniform (v h : ℕ) : (D : ℕ) → (Fin D → BitWord h) → Option (Fin v)
  | 0,_ => none
  | D+1,bits =>
      let x := wordEquiv h (bits 0)
      if hx : x.val < v then some ⟨x.val,hx⟩ else boundedUniform v h D (Fin.tail bits)
noncomputable def rejectionRate (v h : ℕ) : ℝ := (2^h-v:ℕ)/(2:ℝ)^h
lemma acceptedCard (v T : ℕ) (hv : v≤T) :
    Fintype.card {x : Fin T // x.val < v}=v := by
  let e : {x : Fin T // x.val < v} ≃ Fin v :=
    { toFun := fun x => ⟨x.val.val,x.property⟩
      invFun := fun x => ⟨⟨x.val,lt_of_lt_of_le x.isLt hv⟩,x.isLt⟩
      left_inv := by intro x; rfl
      right_inv := by intro x; rfl }
  simpa using Fintype.card_congr e
lemma rejectedCard (v T : ℕ) (hv : v≤T) :
    Fintype.card {x : Fin T // ¬x.val < v}=T-v := by
  rw [Fintype.card_subtype_compl,acceptedCard v T hv,Fintype.card_fin]
lemma sum_ite_count {X : Type*} [Fintype X] (p : X → Prop) [DecidablePred p] (r : ℝ) :
    (∑ x,if p x then r else 0)=(Fintype.card {x // p x}:ℝ)*r := by
  rw [← Finset.sum_filter]
  simp only [Finset.sum_const,nsmul_eq_mul]
  congr 1
  exact_mod_cast (Fintype.card_subtype p).symm
lemma one_trial_none (v h : ℕ) (hv : v≤2^h) (r : ℝ) :
    uniformAverage (fun bits : BitWord h => if (wordEquiv h bits).val < v then 0 else r)=
      rejectionRate v h*r := by
  rw [uniformAverage_equiv (wordEquiv h) (fun x => if x.val<v then 0 else r)]
  unfold uniformAverage rejectionRate
  have he : (∑ x : Fin (2^h),if x.val<v then (0:ℝ) else r)=(2^h-v:ℕ)*r := by
    calc
      _ = ∑ x : Fin (2^h),if ¬x.val<v then r else 0 := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro x _
        by_cases hx : x.val<v <;> simp [hx]
      _ = _ := by rw [sum_ite_count,rejectedCard _ _ hv]
  rw [he,Fintype.card_fin,Nat.cast_pow,Nat.cast_ofNat]
  ring
lemma one_trial_some (v h : ℕ) (hv : v≤2^h) (a : Fin v) (r : ℝ) :
    uniformAverage (fun bits : BitWord h =>
      if hx : (wordEquiv h bits).val<v then
        (if (⟨(wordEquiv h bits).val,hx⟩ : Fin v)=a then (1:ℝ) else 0)
      else r) = 1/(2:ℝ)^h+rejectionRate v h*r := by
  let aT : Fin (2^h) := ⟨a.val,lt_of_lt_of_le a.isLt hv⟩
  have he : (fun bits : BitWord h =>
      if hx : (wordEquiv h bits).val<v then
        (if (⟨(wordEquiv h bits).val,hx⟩ : Fin v)=a then (1:ℝ) else 0)
      else r) = fun bits => (if wordEquiv h bits=aT then 1 else 0)+
        (if (wordEquiv h bits).val<v then 0 else r) := by
    funext bits
    by_cases hx : (wordEquiv h bits).val<v
    · have he : (⟨(wordEquiv h bits).val,hx⟩ : Fin v)=a ↔ wordEquiv h bits=aT := by
        simp only [Fin.ext_iff,aT]
      simp [hx,he]
    · have he : wordEquiv h bits≠aT := by
        intro hh
        have ht : (wordEquiv h bits).val=a.val := congrArg Fin.val hh
        exact hx (ht ▸ a.isLt)
      simp [hx,he]
  rw [he,uniformAverage_add,one_trial_none v h hv r]
  congr 1
  rw [uniformAverage_equiv (wordEquiv h) (fun x => if x=aT then 1 else 0)]
  simp [uniformAverage,aT]
lemma boundedUniform_failure (v h D : ℕ) (hv : v≤2^h) :
    uniformAverage (fun bits => if boundedUniform v h D bits=none then (1:ℝ) else 0)=
      rejectionRate v h^D := by
  induction D with
  | zero => simp [boundedUniform,uniformAverage_const]
  | succ D ih =>
    rw [uniformAverage_fin_succ]
    have he : (fun x : BitWord h => uniformAverage (fun rest : Fin D → BitWord h =>
        if boundedUniform v h (D+1) (Fin.cons x rest)=none then (1:ℝ) else 0)) =
        fun x => if (wordEquiv h x).val<v then 0 else rejectionRate v h^D := by
      funext x
      by_cases hx : (wordEquiv h x).val<v
      · simp only [boundedUniform,Fin.cons_zero,dite_eq_left hx,Option.some_ne_none,ite_false,ite_eq_left hx]
        try simp only [Fin.ext_iff]
        apply uniformAverage_const
      · simpa [boundedUniform,hx] using ih
    rw [he,one_trial_none v h hv,pow_succ']
lemma rejectionRate_bounds (v h : ℕ) (hv : v≤2^h) (hhalf : 2^h≤2*v) :
    0≤rejectionRate v h ∧ rejectionRate v h≤1/2 := by
  have hT : (0:ℝ)<(2:ℝ)^h := by positivity
  have hc : ((2^h-v:ℕ):ℝ)=(2:ℝ)^h-v := by rw [Nat.cast_sub hv,Nat.cast_pow,Nat.cast_ofNat]
  have hh : (2:ℝ)^h≤2*(v:ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hhalf
  unfold rejectionRate
  constructor
  · positivity
  · rw [hc,div_le_iff₀ hT]; linarith
lemma boundedUniform_failure_bound (v h D : ℕ) (hv : v≤2^h) (hhalf : 2^h≤2*v) :
    uniformAverage (fun bits => if boundedUniform v h D bits=none then (1:ℝ) else 0)≤(1/2:ℝ)^D := by
  rw [boundedUniform_failure v h D hv]
  exact pow_le_pow_left₀ (rejectionRate_bounds v h hv hhalf).1
    (rejectionRate_bounds v h hv hhalf).2 D
lemma clog_trial_size (v : ℕ) (hv : 0<v) : v≤2^Nat.clog 2 v ∧ 2^Nat.clog 2 v≤2*v := by
  refine ⟨Nat.le_pow_clog (by norm_num) v,?_⟩
  by_cases h : v=1
  · subst v; norm_num
  have hv' : 1<v := by omega
  have hh := Nat.pow_pred_clog_lt_self (by norm_num : 1<2) hv'
  have hc := Nat.clog_pos (by norm_num : 1<2) hv'
  have hp : Nat.clog 2 v=(Nat.clog 2 v).pred+1 := by exact (Nat.succ_pred_eq_of_pos hc).symm
  rw [hp,pow_succ]
  omega
lemma boundedUniform_probability (v h D : ℕ) (hv : v ≤ 2^h) (hv0 : 0 < v) (a : Fin v) :
    uniformAverage (fun bits => if boundedUniform v h D bits=some a then (1:ℝ) else 0)=
      (1-rejectionRate v h^D)/(v:ℝ) := by
  have hv' : (v:ℝ)≠0 := by exact_mod_cast ne_of_gt hv0
  have hT : (2:ℝ)^h≠0 := by positivity
  induction D with
  | zero => simp [boundedUniform,uniformAverage_const]
  | succ D ih =>
    rw [uniformAverage_fin_succ]
    have he : (fun x : BitWord h => uniformAverage (fun rest : Fin D → BitWord h =>
        if boundedUniform v h (D+1) (Fin.cons x rest)=some a then (1:ℝ) else 0)) =
        fun x => if hx : (wordEquiv h x).val<v then
          (if (⟨(wordEquiv h x).val,hx⟩ : Fin v)=a then 1 else 0)
          else (1-rejectionRate v h^D)/(v:ℝ) := by
      funext x
      by_cases hx : (wordEquiv h x).val<v
      · simp only [boundedUniform,Fin.cons_zero,dite_eq_left hx,Option.some.injEq,]
        try simp only [Fin.ext_iff]
        apply uniformAverage_const
      · simpa [boundedUniform,hx] using ih
    rw [he,one_trial_some v h hv]
    have hr : rejectionRate v h=1-(v:ℝ)/(2:ℝ)^h := by
      unfold rejectionRate
      rw [Nat.cast_sub hv,Nat.cast_pow,Nat.cast_ofNat]
      field_simp
    rw [pow_succ]
    calc
      _ = ((v:ℝ)/(2:ℝ)^h+rejectionRate v h-rejectionRate v h^D*rejectionRate v h)/v := by
        field_simp ; ring
      _ = _ := by rw [hr]; ring
lemma uniformAverage_sum {X J : Type*} [Fintype X] [Fintype J] (f : J → X → ℝ) :
    uniformAverage (fun x => ∑ j,f j x)=∑ j,uniformAverage (f j) := by
  unfold uniformAverage
  rw [Finset.sum_comm,Finset.sum_div]

lemma boundedUniform_law (v h D : ℕ) (hv : v ≤ 2^h) (hv0 : 0 < v) (φ : Option (Fin v) → ℝ) :
    uniformAverage (fun bits => φ (boundedUniform v h D bits)) =
      rejectionRate v h^D*φ none + (1-rejectionRate v h^D)*uniformAverage (fun a => φ (some a)) := by
  have he : (fun bits => φ (boundedUniform v h D bits)) = fun bits =>
      φ none*(if boundedUniform v h D bits=none then 1 else 0) +
        ∑ a : Fin v,φ (some a)*(if boundedUniform v h D bits=some a then 1 else 0) := by
    funext bits
    cases e : boundedUniform v h D bits with
    | none => simp
    | some a => simp
  rw [he,uniformAverage_add,uniformAverage_mul_left,boundedUniform_failure v h D hv,
    uniformAverage_sum]
  simp_rw [uniformAverage_mul_left,boundedUniform_probability v h D hv hv0]
  rw [← Finset.sum_mul]
  unfold uniformAverage
  rw [Fintype.card_fin]
  ring

lemma uniformAverage_nonneg {X : Type*} [Fintype X] (f : X → ℝ)
    (hf : ∀ x,0≤f x) : 0≤uniformAverage f := by
  exact div_nonneg (Finset.sum_nonneg (fun x _ => hf x)) (Nat.cast_nonneg _)
lemma uniformAverage_mono {X : Type*} [Fintype X] (f g : X → ℝ)
    (hfg : ∀ x,f x≤g x) : uniformAverage f≤uniformAverage g := by
  exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (Finset.sum_le_sum (fun x _ => hfg x)) (Nat.cast_nonneg _)
lemma uniformAverage_sub_const {X : Type*} [Fintype X] [Nonempty X] (f : X → ℝ) (r : ℝ) :
    uniformAverage (fun x => f x-r)=uniformAverage f-r := by
  unfold uniformAverage
  rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib,sub_div]
  simp only [Finset.sum_const,Finset.card_univ,nsmul_eq_mul]
  have h : (Fintype.card X:ℝ)≠0 := by exact_mod_cast ne_of_gt (Fintype.card_pos)
  field_simp

def bitPrefix (h H : ℕ) (hh : h≤H) (w : BitWord H) : BitWord h :=
  fun i => w ⟨i.val,lt_of_lt_of_le i.isLt hh⟩
lemma uniformAverage_bitPrefix (h H : ℕ) (hh : h≤H) (φ : BitWord h → ℝ) :
    uniformAverage (fun w => φ (bitPrefix h H hh w))=uniformAverage φ := by
  obtain ⟨t,rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le hh
  rw [← uniformAverage_equiv (Fin.appendEquiv h t) (fun w => φ (bitPrefix h (h+t) hh w)),uniformAverage_prod]
  have he : ∀ a : BitWord h,∀ b : BitWord t,bitPrefix h (h+t) hh ((Fin.appendEquiv h t) (a,b))=a := by
    intro a b
    funext i
    change Fin.append a b (Fin.castAdd t i)=a i
    simp
  simp_rw [he,uniformAverage_const]
lemma uniformAverage_prefixTrials (h H D : ℕ) (hh : h≤H)
    (φ : (Fin D → BitWord h) → ℝ) :
    uniformAverage (fun w : Fin D → BitWord H => φ (fun d => bitPrefix h H hh (w d)))=uniformAverage φ := by
  induction D with
  | zero =>
    have he : ∀ w : Fin 0 → BitWord H,(fun d => bitPrefix h H hh (w d))=(fun d : Fin 0 => Fin.elim0 d) := by
      intro w; funext d; exact Fin.elim0 d
    have hf : ∀ w : Fin 0 → BitWord h,w=(fun d : Fin 0 => Fin.elim0 d) := by
      intro w; funext d; exact Fin.elim0 d
    simp_rw [he]
    rw [uniformAverage_const]
    conv_rhs => arg 1; ext w; rw [hf w]
    rw [uniformAverage_const]
  | succ D ih =>
    rw [uniformAverage_fin_succ,uniformAverage_fin_succ]
    have he : ∀ x : BitWord H,∀ xs : Fin D → BitWord H,
        (fun d : Fin (D+1) => bitPrefix h H hh ((Fin.cons x xs : Fin (D+1) → BitWord H) d))=
        Fin.cons (bitPrefix h H hh x) (fun d => bitPrefix h H hh (xs d)) := by
      intro x xs; funext d; refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun i => ?_) d <;> rfl
    simp_rw [he]
    have hhφ : ∀ x : BitWord H,
        uniformAverage (fun xs : Fin D → BitWord H => φ (Fin.cons (bitPrefix h H hh x) (fun d => bitPrefix h H hh (xs d))))=
        uniformAverage (fun xs : Fin D → BitWord h => φ (Fin.cons (bitPrefix h H hh x) xs)) := by
      intro x
      exact ih (fun xs => φ (Fin.cons (bitPrefix h H hh x) xs))
    simp_rw [hhφ]
    exact uniformAverage_bitPrefix h H hh (fun x => uniformAverage (fun xs => φ (Fin.cons x xs)))

inductive DrawTree (A : Type*) where
  | leaf (a : A)
  | draw (v : ℕ) (next : Fin (v+1) → DrawTree A)
namespace DrawTree

section
open scoped BigOperators Classical
variable {A : Type*}
noncomputable def expectation (φ : A → ℝ) : DrawTree A → ℝ
  | .leaf a => φ a
  | .draw _ k => uniformAverage (fun i => expectation φ (k i))
lemma expectation_nonneg (φ : A → ℝ) (hφ : ∀ a,0≤φ a) (t : DrawTree A) :
    0≤t.expectation φ := by
  induction t with
  | leaf a => exact hφ a
  | draw v k ih => exact uniformAverage_nonneg _ ih
lemma expectation_le_one (φ : A → ℝ) (hφ : ∀ a,φ a≤1) (t : DrawTree A) :
    t.expectation φ≤1 := by
  induction t with
  | leaf a => exact hφ a
  | draw v k ih =>
    have h := uniformAverage_mono _ (fun _ : Fin (v+1) => 1) ih
    simpa only [expectation,uniformAverage_const] using h

def Fits (H : ℕ) : ℕ → DrawTree A → Prop
  | _,.leaf _ => True
  | 0,.draw _ _ => False
  | M+1,.draw v k => Nat.clog 2 (v+1)≤H ∧ ∀ i,Fits H M (k i)

def run (H D : ℕ) : (M : ℕ) → DrawTree A → (Fin M → Fin D → BitWord H) → Option A
  | _,.leaf a,_ => some a
  | 0,.draw _ _,_ => none
  | M+1,.draw v k,bits =>
    if hh : Nat.clog 2 (v+1)≤H then
      match boundedUniform (v+1) (Nat.clog 2 (v+1)) D
        (fun d => bitPrefix _ H hh (bits 0 d)) with
      | none => none
      | some a => run H D M (k a) (Fin.tail bits)
    else none

def optionValue (φ : A → ℝ) : Option A → ℝ
  | none => 0
  | some a => φ a
lemma run_draw_average (H D M v : ℕ) (k : Fin (v+1) → DrawTree A)
    (hh : Nat.clog 2 (v+1)≤H) (φ : A → ℝ) :
    uniformAverage (fun bits => optionValue φ (run H D (M+1) (.draw v k) bits))=
      (1-rejectionRate (v+1) (Nat.clog 2 (v+1))^D)*
        uniformAverage (fun a : Fin (v+1) => uniformAverage
          (fun rest => optionValue φ (run H D M (k a) rest))) := by
  rw [uniformAverage_fin_succ]
  simp only [run,dite_eq_left hh,Fin.cons_zero,Fin.tail_cons]
  let ψ : Option (Fin (v+1)) → ℝ := fun z => match z with
    | none => 0
    | some a => uniformAverage (fun rest => optionValue φ (run H D M (k a) rest))
  have he : (fun x : Fin D → BitWord H => uniformAverage
      (fun rest : Fin M → Fin D → BitWord H => optionValue φ
        (match boundedUniform (v+1) (Nat.clog 2 (v+1)) D
          (fun d => bitPrefix _ H hh (x d)) with
         | none => none
         | some a => run H D M (k a) rest))) =
      fun x => ψ (boundedUniform (v+1) (Nat.clog 2 (v+1)) D
          (fun d => bitPrefix _ H hh (x d))) := by
    funext x
    cases hz : boundedUniform (v+1) (Nat.clog 2 (v+1)) D
      (fun d => bitPrefix _ H hh (x d)) with
    | none => exact uniformAverage_const 0
    | some a => rfl
  rw [he,uniformAverage_prefixTrials _ _ D hh (fun w => ψ (boundedUniform (v+1) (Nat.clog 2 (v+1)) D w))]
  rw [boundedUniform_law _ _ _ (clog_trial_size _ (by omega)).1 (by omega)]
  simp only [ψ,mul_zero,zero_add]

theorem run_lower (H D M : ℕ) (t : DrawTree A) (ht : Fits H M t)
    (φ : A → ℝ) (_ : ∀ a,0≤φ a) (hφ1 : ∀ a,φ a≤1) :
    t.expectation φ-(M:ℝ)*(1/2:ℝ)^D ≤
      uniformAverage (fun bits => optionValue φ (run H D M t bits)) := by
  induction M generalizing t with
  | zero =>
    cases t with
    | leaf a => simp [run,optionValue,expectation,uniformAverage_const]
    | draw v k => exact False.elim ht
  | succ M ih =>
    cases t with
    | leaf a =>
      simp only [expectation,run,optionValue,uniformAverage_const]
      have h : 0 ≤ ((M+1:ℕ):ℝ)*(1/2:ℝ)^D := by positivity
      linarith
    | draw v k =>
      obtain ⟨hh,hk⟩ := ht
      rw [run_draw_average H D M v k hh φ]
      have hlocal := uniformAverage_mono
        (fun a => (k a).expectation φ-(M:ℝ)*(1/2:ℝ)^D)
        (fun a => uniformAverage (fun bits => optionValue φ (run H D M (k a) bits)))
        (fun a => ih (k a) (hk a))
      rw [uniformAverage_sub_const] at hlocal
      let r := rejectionRate (v+1) (Nat.clog 2 (v+1))^D
      have hb := rejectionRate_bounds (v+1) (Nat.clog 2 (v+1))
        (clog_trial_size _ (by omega)).1 (clog_trial_size _ (by omega)).2
      have hr0 : 0≤r := pow_nonneg hb.1 D
      have hr : r≤(1/2:ℝ)^D := pow_le_pow_left₀ hb.1 hb.2 D
      have hr1 : r≤1 := hr.trans (pow_le_one₀ (by norm_num) (by norm_num))
      have hE : uniformAverage (fun a => (k a).expectation φ)≤1 :=
        expectation_le_one φ hφ1 (.draw v k)
      have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hlocal (sub_nonneg.mpr hr1)
      have hz : 0≤(M:ℝ)*(1/2:ℝ)^D := by positivity
      change _ ≤ (1-r)*_
      change uniformAverage (fun a => (k a).expectation φ)-((M+1:ℕ):ℝ)*(1/2:ℝ)^D ≤ _
      push_cast
      nlinarith [mul_nonneg hr0 hz,mul_nonneg hr0 (sub_nonneg.mpr hE)]
end

variable {A B : Type*}
def bind : DrawTree A → (A → DrawTree B) → DrawTree B
  | .leaf a,k => k a
  | .draw v f,k => .draw v (fun i => (f i).bind k)
def map (f : A → B) (t : DrawTree A) : DrawTree B := t.bind (fun a => .leaf (f a))
lemma expectation_bind (t : DrawTree A) (k : A → DrawTree B) (φ : B → ℝ) :
    (t.bind k).expectation φ=t.expectation (fun a => (k a).expectation φ) := by
  induction t with
  | leaf a => rfl
  | draw v f ih => simp only [bind,expectation,ih]
lemma expectation_map (t : DrawTree A) (f : A → B) (φ : B → ℝ) :
    (t.map f).expectation φ=t.expectation (fun a => φ (f a)) := by
  rw [map,expectation_bind]; rfl
lemma fits_mono_steps (H M M' : ℕ) (hM : M≤M') (t : DrawTree A) (ht : Fits H M t) :
    Fits H M' t := by
  induction M generalizing M' t with
  | zero => cases t <;> simp_all [Fits]
  | succ M ih =>
    cases t with
    | leaf a => simp [Fits]
    | draw v f =>
      cases M' with
      | zero => omega
      | succ M' => exact ⟨ht.1,fun i => ih M' (by omega) (f i) (ht.2 i)⟩
lemma fits_bind (H M N : ℕ) (t : DrawTree A) (k : A → DrawTree B)
    (ht : Fits H M t) (hk : ∀ a,Fits H N (k a)) : Fits H (M+N) (t.bind k) := by
  induction M generalizing t with
  | zero => cases t with
    | leaf a => simpa only [bind,Nat.zero_add] using hk a
    | draw v f => exact False.elim ht
  | succ M ih =>
    cases t with
    | leaf a => exact fits_mono_steps H N (M+1+N) (by omega) (k a) (hk a)
    | draw v f =>
      have he : M+1+N=(M+N)+1 := by omega
      rw [he]
      exact ⟨ht.1,fun i => ih (f i) (ht.2 i)⟩

def rationalCoin (a v : ℕ) : DrawTree Bool :=
  .draw v (fun i => .leaf (decide (i.val<a)))
lemma rationalCoin_expectation (a v : ℕ) (ha : a≤v+1) (φ : Bool → ℝ) :
    (rationalCoin a v).expectation φ=
      (a:ℝ)/(v+1:ℕ)*φ true+(1-(a:ℝ)/(v+1:ℕ))*φ false := by
  change uniformAverage (fun i : Fin (v+1) => φ (decide (i.val<a)))=_
  have he : (fun i : Fin (v+1) => φ (decide (i.val<a)))=
      fun i => φ false+if i.val<a then φ true-φ false else 0 := by
    funext i; by_cases h : i.val<a <;> simp [h]
  rw [he,uniformAverage_add,uniformAverage_const]
  unfold uniformAverage
  rw [sum_ite_count,acceptedCard a (v+1) ha,Fintype.card_fin]
  have hv : ((v+1:ℕ):ℝ)≠0 := by positivity
  field_simp
  ; ring
lemma rationalCoin_fits (a v H : ℕ) (hh : Nat.clog 2 (v+1)≤H) :
    Fits H 1 (rationalCoin a v) := ⟨hh,fun _ => trivial⟩
def bernoulli (p : ℚ) : DrawTree Bool := rationalCoin p.num.natAbs (p.den-1)
lemma bernoulli_expectation (p : ℚ) (hp0 : 0≤p) (hp1 : p≤1) (φ : Bool → ℝ) :
    (bernoulli p).expectation φ=(p:ℝ)*φ true+(1-(p:ℝ))*φ false := by
  have hd : p.den-1+1=p.den := by have h := p.den_pos; omega
  have hn : (p.num.natAbs:ℤ)=p.num := Int.natAbs_of_nonneg (Rat.num_nonneg.mpr hp0)
  have hnr : (p.num.natAbs:ℝ)=(p.num:ℝ) := by simpa only [Int.cast_natCast] using congrArg (fun z : ℤ => (z:ℝ)) hn
  have he : (p.num.natAbs:ℝ)/(p.den:ℝ)=(p:ℝ) := by rw [hnr,Rat.cast_def]
  have ha : p.num.natAbs≤p.den := by
    have hd' : (0:ℝ)<p.den := by exact_mod_cast p.den_pos
    have hp1' : (p:ℝ)≤1 := by exact_mod_cast hp1
    have hh' : (p.num.natAbs:ℝ)≤p.den := by
      have h := (div_le_iff₀ hd').mp (he.symm ▸ hp1')
      simpa only [one_mul] using h
    exact_mod_cast hh'
  unfold bernoulli
  rw [rationalCoin_expectation _ _ (by omega),hd,he]
lemma bernoulli_fits (p : ℚ) (H : ℕ) (hh : Nat.clog 2 p.den≤H) :
    Fits H 1 (bernoulli p) := by
  unfold bernoulli
  apply rationalCoin_fits
  have hd : p.den-1+1=p.den := by have h := p.den_pos; omega
  simpa only [hd] using hh
end DrawTree

open scoped BigOperators Classical
variable {Γ : Type*} [sectionInstance110 : Fintype Γ] [sectionInstance111 : DecidableEq Γ]
abbrev ExchangeChoice (S : Set Γ) := ↥S × ↥(Sᶜ)
def exchangedSet (S : Set Γ) (a : ExchangeChoice S) : Set Γ := insert a.2.val (S\{a.1.val})
omit sectionInstance110 in
lemma exchangedSet_adjacent [Fintype Γ] (S : Set Γ) (a : ExchangeChoice S) :
    ExchangeAdjacent S (exchangedSet S a) := by
  refine ⟨S\{a.1.val},a.1.val,a.2.val,?_,?_,?_,?_,rfl⟩
  · intro he
    exact a.2.property (he ▸ a.1.property)
  · simp
  · intro hx; exact a.2.property hx.1
  · ext x
    simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff,Set.mem_sdiff,Set.mem_singleton_iff]
    constructor
    · intro hx; by_cases he : x=a.1.val
      · exact Or.inl he
      · exact Or.inr ⟨hx,he⟩
    · rintro (rfl|⟨hx,_⟩)
      · exact a.1.property
      · exact hx
omit sectionInstance110 in
lemma exchangedSet_left_difference [Fintype Γ] (S : Set Γ) (a : ExchangeChoice S) :
    S\exchangedSet S a={a.1.val} := by
  ext x
  simp only [exchangedSet,Set.mem_sdiff,Set.mem_insert_iff,Set.mem_singleton_iff,not_or,not_and]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hx,_,ha⟩
    by_contra hh
    exact ha hx hh
  · intro he
    subst x
    refine ⟨a.1.property,?_,fun _ hn => hn rfl⟩
    intro he
    exact a.2.property (he ▸ a.1.property)
omit sectionInstance110 sectionInstance111 in
lemma exchangedSet_right_difference [Fintype Γ] [DecidableEq Γ] (S : Set Γ) (a : ExchangeChoice S) :
    exchangedSet S a\S={a.2.val} := by
  ext x
  simp only [exchangedSet,Set.mem_sdiff,Set.mem_insert_iff,Set.mem_singleton_iff]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hh,hn⟩
    exact hh.resolve_right (fun h => hn h.1)
  · intro he; subst x
    exact ⟨Or.inl rfl,a.2.property⟩
lemma exchangedSet_injective (S : Set Γ) : Function.Injective (exchangedSet S) := by
  intro a b he
  apply Prod.ext
  · apply Subtype.ext
    have h := congrArg (fun T => S\T) he
    rw [exchangedSet_left_difference,exchangedSet_left_difference] at h
    exact Set.singleton_injective h
  · apply Subtype.ext
    have h := congrArg (fun T => T\S) he
    rw [exchangedSet_right_difference,exchangedSet_right_difference] at h
    exact Set.singleton_injective h
lemma exchangedSet_exists_iff (S T : Set Γ) :
    (∃ a : ExchangeChoice S,exchangedSet S a=T) ↔ ExchangeAdjacent S T := by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨a,rfl⟩; exact exchangedSet_adjacent S a
  · intro h
    obtain ⟨a,ha,b,hb,he⟩ := h.move
    exact ⟨(⟨a,ha⟩,⟨b,hb⟩),he.symm⟩
lemma sum_exchangedSet_indicator (S T : Set Γ) (r : ℝ) :
    (∑ a : ExchangeChoice S,if exchangedSet S a=T then r else 0)=
      if ExchangeAdjacent S T then r else 0 := by
  by_cases h : ExchangeAdjacent S T
  · obtain ⟨a,ha⟩ := (exchangedSet_exists_iff S T).mpr h
    have he : ∀ b : ExchangeChoice S,exchangedSet S b=T ↔ b=a := by
      intro b; rw [←ha]; exact (exchangedSet_injective S).eq_iff
    simp [he,h]
  · have he : ∀ a : ExchangeChoice S, exchangedSet S a≠T := by
      intro a ha; exact h ((exchangedSet_exists_iff S T).mp ⟨a,ha⟩)
    simp [he,h]
lemma exchangeChoice_card (gs : List (Γ × Γ)) (hgs : SlotsFresh gs ∅)
    (hcover : pairSupport gs=Set.univ) (S : ChainIndex gs) :
    Fintype.card (ExchangeChoice S.val)=gs.length^2 := by
  rw [Fintype.card_prod]
  have hs : Fintype.card S.val=S.val.ncard := by rw [Set.ncard_eq_toFinset_card',Set.toFinset_card]
  have hc : Fintype.card ↥(S.valᶜ)=S.valᶜ.ncard := by rw [Set.ncard_eq_toFinset_card',Set.toFinset_card]
  rw [hs,hc]
  have ht := S.val.ncard_add_ncard_compl
  rw [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card,slots_ground_card gs hgs hcover,S.property.ncard hgs hcover] at ht
  have hh : S.valᶜ.ncard=gs.length := by omega
  rw [S.property.ncard hgs hcover,hh,pow_two]

noncomputable def metropolisAcceptance (gs : List (Γ × Γ))
    (w : (Γ × Γ) → (Γ × Γ) → ℝ) (f : Set Γ → ℝ) (S T : ChainIndex gs) : ℝ :=
  min 1 (chainWeight gs w f T.val/chainWeight gs w f S.val)
noncomputable def exchangeOffer (gs : List (Γ × Γ))
    (w : (Γ × Γ) → (Γ × Γ) → ℝ) (f : Set Γ → ℝ) (S : ChainIndex gs)
    (a : ExchangeChoice S.val) (φ : ChainIndex gs → ℝ) : ℝ :=
  if ht : ChainState gs (exchangedSet S.val a) then
    let T : ChainIndex gs := ⟨exchangedSet S.val a,ht⟩
    metropolisAcceptance gs w f S T*φ T+(1-metropolisAcceptance gs w f S T)*φ S
  else φ S
omit sectionInstance111 in
lemma exchangeOffer_expansion [DecidableEq Γ] (gs : List (Γ × Γ))
    (w : (Γ × Γ) → (Γ × Γ) → ℝ) (f : Set Γ → ℝ) (S : ChainIndex gs)
    (a : ExchangeChoice S.val) (φ : ChainIndex gs → ℝ) :
    exchangeOffer gs w f S a φ=φ S+∑ T : ChainIndex gs,
      if exchangedSet S.val a=T.val then metropolisAcceptance gs w f S T*(φ T-φ S) else 0 := by
  unfold exchangeOffer
  split_ifs with ht
  · let T : ChainIndex gs := ⟨exchangedSet S.val a,ht⟩
    have he : ∀ U : ChainIndex gs,exchangedSet S.val a=U.val ↔ U=T := by
      intro U
      constructor
      · intro he; exact Subtype.ext he.symm
      · intro he; subst U; rfl
    simp only [he,Finset.sum_ite_eq',Finset.mem_univ,ite_true]
    change _=φ S+metropolisAcceptance gs w f S T*(φ T-φ S)
    ring
  · have he : ∀ T : ChainIndex gs,exchangedSet S.val a≠T.val := by
      intro T he; exact ht (he ▸ T.property)
    simp [he]
lemma metropolisAcceptance_min (gs : List (Γ × Γ))
    (w : (Γ × Γ) → (Γ × Γ) → ℝ) (f : Set Γ → ℝ)
    (hw : ∀ p r,0<w p r) (hf : ∀ S,0<f S) (S T : ChainIndex gs) :
    metropolisAcceptance gs w f S T=
      min (chainWeight gs w f S.val) (chainWeight gs w f T.val)/chainWeight gs w f S.val := by
  have hs := chainWeight_pos gs w f hw hf S.val
  unfold metropolisAcceptance
  rw [←min_div_div_right hs.le,div_self hs.ne']

lemma lazy_exchange_expectation (gs : List (Γ × Γ)) (hgs : SlotsFresh gs ∅)
    (hne : gs≠[]) (hcover : pairSupport gs=Set.univ)
    (w : (Γ × Γ) → (Γ × Γ) → ℝ) (f : Set Γ → ℝ)
    (hw : ∀ p r,0<w p r) (hf : ∀ S,0<f S)
    (S : ChainIndex gs) (φ : ChainIndex gs → ℝ) :
    (φ S+uniformAverage (fun a => exchangeOffer gs w f S a φ))/2=
      (metropolisChain gs hgs hne hcover w f hw hf).apply φ S := by
  have hn : (gs.length:ℝ)≠0 := by exact_mod_cast ne_of_gt (List.length_pos_iff.mpr hne)
  have hc : (Fintype.card (ExchangeChoice S.val):ℝ)=(gs.length:ℝ)^2 := by
    rw [exchangeChoice_card gs hgs hcover S,Nat.cast_pow]
  have hex : uniformAverage (fun a => exchangeOffer gs w f S a φ)=
      φ S+(∑ T : ChainIndex gs,if ExchangeAdjacent S.val T.val then
        metropolisAcceptance gs w f S T*(φ T-φ S) else 0)/(gs.length:ℝ)^2 := by
    simp_rw [exchangeOffer_expansion]
    rw [uniformAverage_add]
    have hnon : Nonempty (ExchangeChoice S.val) := Fintype.card_pos_iff.mp (by
      rw [exchangeChoice_card gs hgs hcover S]
      exact pow_pos (List.length_pos_iff.mpr hne) _)
    let := hnon
    rw [uniformAverage_const]
    congr 1
    unfold uniformAverage
    rw [hc,Finset.sum_comm]
    simp_rw [sum_exchangedSet_indicator]
  rw [hex]
  change _=∑ T,(metropolisMove gs w f S T+if S=T then 1-∑ U,metropolisMove gs w f S U else 0)*φ T
  simp_rw [add_mul,ite_mul,zero_mul]
  rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  simp only [Finset.sum_ite_eq,Finset.mem_univ,ite_true]
  have he : (∑ T : ChainIndex gs,if ExchangeAdjacent S.val T.val then
        metropolisAcceptance gs w f S T*(φ T-φ S) else 0)/(gs.length:ℝ)^2/2=
      ∑ T : ChainIndex gs,metropolisMove gs w f S T*(φ T-φ S) := by
    rw [Finset.sum_div,Finset.sum_div]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro T _
    by_cases ht : ExchangeAdjacent S.val T.val
    · simp only [metropolisMove,ite_eq_left ht,metropolisAcceptance_min gs w f hw hf]
      field_simp

    · simp [metropolisMove,ht]
  have hsum : (∑ T : ChainIndex gs,metropolisMove gs w f S T*(φ T-φ S))=
      (∑ T : ChainIndex gs,metropolisMove gs w f S T*φ T)-
        (∑ T : ChainIndex gs,metropolisMove gs w f S T)*φ S := by
    simp [mul_sub,Finset.sum_sub_distrib,Finset.sum_mul]
  linarith
end MetropolisSampling

open scoped BigOperators Classical
variable {Γ : Type*} [sectionInstance112 : Fintype Γ] [sectionInstance113 : DecidableEq Γ]
noncomputable def rationalMultiplier (gs : List (Γ × Γ))
    (w : (Γ × Γ) → (Γ × Γ) → ℚ) (S : Set Γ) : ℚ :=
  if h : ∃ p r,DefectState gs p r S then w h.choose h.choose_spec.choose else 1
noncomputable def rationalWeight (gs : List (Γ × Γ))
    (w : (Γ × Γ) → (Γ × Γ) → ℚ) (f : Set Γ → ℚ) (S : Set Γ) : ℚ :=

noncomputable def rationalPlain (gs : List (Γ × Γ)) (g : Set Γ → ℚ) (S : Set Γ) : ℚ :=

lemma rationalPlain_cast [Fintype Γ] [DecidableEq Γ] (gs : List (Γ × Γ)) (g : Set Γ → ℚ) (S : Set Γ) :

lemma rationalDefect_cast [Fintype Γ] [DecidableEq Γ] (gs : List (Γ × Γ)) (p r : Γ × Γ) (S : Set Γ) :
    (rationalDefect gs p r S:ℝ)=defectIndicator gs p r S := by
  unfold rationalDefect defectIndicator; split_ifs <;> simp
noncomputable def rationalLearn (gs : List (Γ × Γ))
    (w : (Γ × Γ) → (Γ × Γ) → ℚ) (l : List (Set Γ)) (p r : Γ × Γ) : ℚ :=
  if p∈gs ∧ r∈gs ∧ p≠r then
    w p r*(rationalEmpirical (rationalPlain gs (fun _ => 1)) l/rationalEmpirical (rationalDefect gs p r) l)
  else w p r

    (w : (Γ × Γ) → (Γ × Γ) → ℚ) (l : List (Set Γ)) (p r : Γ × Γ) :

  unfold rationalLearn learnedMultipliers

noncomputable def rationalHistory {X : Type*} (gs : List (Γ × Γ))
    (sample : X → List (Set Γ)) (h : List X) : (Γ × Γ) → (Γ × Γ) → ℚ :=
  h.foldl (fun w x => rationalLearn gs w (sample x)) (fun _ _ => 4)
lemma rationalHistory_cast {X : Type*} (gs : List (Γ × Γ))
    (sample : X → List (Set Γ)) (h : List X) (p r : Γ × Γ) :
    (rationalHistory gs sample h p r:ℝ)=historyWeights gs sample h p r := by
  induction h using List.reverseRecOn generalizing p r with
  | nil => norm_num [rationalHistory,historyWeights]
  | append_singleton h x ih =>
    simp only [rationalHistory,List.foldl_append,List.foldl_cons,List.foldl_nil,historyWeights_snoc]
    rw [rationalLearn_cast]
    have he : (fun p r => ((h.foldl (fun w x => rationalLearn gs w (sample x)) (fun _ _ => 4)) p r:ℝ))=
        historyWeights gs sample h := by funext p r; exact ih p r
    rw [he]

def rationalRho (n : ℕ) : ℚ := 1-1/(2*(n:ℚ))
lemma rationalRho_cast (n : ℕ) : (rationalRho n:ℝ)=annealRho n := by simp [rationalRho,annealRho]
noncomputable def rationalAnneal (M : Matroid Γ) (n j : ℕ) (S : Set Γ) : ℚ :=
  (rationalRho n^j)^(n-(M.eRk S).toNat)
omit sectionInstance112 sectionInstance113 in
lemma rationalAnneal_cast [Fintype Γ] [DecidableEq Γ] (M : Matroid Γ) (n j : ℕ) (S : Set Γ) :
    (rationalAnneal M n j S:ℝ)=annealWeight M n j S := by simp [rationalAnneal,annealWeight,matroidWeight,rationalRho_cast]

    (rationalRatio gs g l:ℝ)=empiricalRatio gs (fun S => (g S:ℝ)) l := by

  let h : Fintype.card A-1+1=Fintype.card A := by have hh := Fintype.card_pos (α := A); omega

lemma uniformChoice_expectation (A : Type*) [Fintype A] [Nonempty A] (φ : A → ℝ) :

  unfold uniformChoice

section RationalMetropolis
open scoped BigOperators Classical
variable {Γ : Type*} [Fintype Γ] [sectionInstance115 : DecidableEq Γ]
variable (gs : List (Γ × Γ))
noncomputable def rationalAcceptance (w : (Γ × Γ) → (Γ × Γ) → ℚ) (f : Set Γ → ℚ)
    (S T : ChainIndex gs) : ℚ := min 1 (rationalWeight gs w f T.val/rationalWeight gs w f S.val)
lemma rationalAcceptance_cast (w : (Γ × Γ) → (Γ × Γ) → ℚ) (f : Set Γ → ℚ) (S T : ChainIndex gs) :
    (rationalAcceptance gs w f S T:ℝ)=metropolisAcceptance gs (fun p r => (w p r:ℝ)) (fun S => (f S:ℝ)) S T := by
  simp [rationalAcceptance,metropolisAcceptance,rationalWeight_cast]
omit sectionInstance115 in
lemma rationalAcceptance_bounds [DecidableEq Γ] (w : (Γ × Γ) → (Γ × Γ) → ℚ) (f : Set Γ → ℚ)
    (hw : ∀ p r,0<w p r) (hf : ∀ S,0<f S) (S T : ChainIndex gs) :
    0≤rationalAcceptance gs w f S T ∧ rationalAcceptance gs w f S T≤1 := by
  have hpos : ∀ S,rationalWeight gs w f S>0 := by
    intro S
    unfold rationalWeight rationalMultiplier
    apply mul_pos _ (hf S)
    split_ifs <;> first | exact hw _ _ | norm_num
  exact ⟨le_min (by norm_num) (div_nonneg (hpos _).le (hpos _).le),min_le_left _ _⟩
noncomputable def rationalExchange (w : (Γ × Γ) → (Γ × Γ) → ℚ) (f : Set Γ → ℚ)
    (S : ChainIndex gs) (a : ExchangeChoice S.val) : DrawTree (ChainIndex gs) :=
  if ht : ChainState gs (exchangedSet S.val a) then
    let T : ChainIndex gs := ⟨exchangedSet S.val a,ht⟩
    (DrawTree.bernoulli (rationalAcceptance gs w f S T)).map (fun accept => if accept then T else S)
  else .leaf S
lemma rationalExchange_expectation (w : (Γ × Γ) → (Γ × Γ) → ℚ) (f : Set Γ → ℚ)
    (hw : ∀ p r,0<w p r) (hf : ∀ S,0<f S) (S : ChainIndex gs) (a : ExchangeChoice S.val)
    (φ : ChainIndex gs → ℝ) :
    (rationalExchange gs w f S a).expectation φ=
      exchangeOffer gs (fun p r => (w p r:ℝ)) (fun S => (f S:ℝ)) S a φ := by
  unfold rationalExchange exchangeOffer
  split_ifs with ht
  · rw [DrawTree.expectation_map,DrawTree.bernoulli_expectation _
      (rationalAcceptance_bounds gs w f hw hf S _).1 (rationalAcceptance_bounds gs w f hw hf S _).2]
    simp only [ite_true,Bool.false_eq_true,ite_false,rationalAcceptance_cast]
  · rfl
noncomputable def rationalMetropolis (hgs : SlotsFresh gs ∅) (hne : gs≠[])
    (hcover : pairSupport gs=Set.univ) (w : (Γ × Γ) → (Γ × Γ) → ℚ) (f : Set Γ → ℚ)
    (S : ChainIndex gs) : DrawTree (ChainIndex gs) :=
  letI : Nonempty (ExchangeChoice S.val) := Fintype.card_pos_iff.mp (by
    rw [exchangeChoice_card gs hgs hcover S]; exact pow_pos (List.length_pos_iff.mpr hne) _)
  (DrawTree.bernoulli (1/2)).bind (fun lazy => if lazy then .leaf S else
    (DrawTree.uniformChoice (ExchangeChoice S.val)).bind (rationalExchange gs w f S))
lemma rationalMetropolis_expectation (hgs : SlotsFresh gs ∅) (hne : gs≠[])
    (hcover : pairSupport gs=Set.univ) (w : (Γ × Γ) → (Γ × Γ) → ℚ) (f : Set Γ → ℚ)
    (hw : ∀ p r,0<w p r) (hf : ∀ S,0<f S) (S : ChainIndex gs) (φ : ChainIndex gs → ℝ) :
    (rationalMetropolis gs hgs hne hcover w f S).expectation φ=
      (metropolisChain gs hgs hne hcover (fun p r => (w p r:ℝ)) (fun S => (f S:ℝ))
        (by intro p r; exact_mod_cast hw p r) (by intro S; exact_mod_cast hf S)).apply φ S := by
  unfold rationalMetropolis
  rw [DrawTree.expectation_bind,DrawTree.bernoulli_expectation _ (by norm_num) (by norm_num)]
  simp only [ite_true,Bool.false_eq_true,ite_false,DrawTree.expectation,
    DrawTree.expectation_bind,DrawTree.uniformChoice_expectation,
    rationalExchange_expectation gs w f hw hf]
  have he := lazy_exchange_expectation gs hgs hne hcover (fun p r => (w p r:ℝ)) (fun S => (f S:ℝ))
    (by intro p r; exact_mod_cast hw p r) (by intro S; exact_mod_cast hf S) S φ
  rw [←he]
  norm_num
  ring
end RationalMetropolis

variable {A B D : Type*}
def optionBind (t : DrawTree (Option A)) (k : A → DrawTree (Option B)) : DrawTree (Option B) :=
  t.bind (fun z => match z with | none => .leaf none | some a => k a)
def pureSome (a : A) : DrawTree (Option A) := .leaf (some a)
lemma expectation_zero (t : DrawTree A) : t.expectation (fun _ => (0:ℝ))=0 := by
  induction t with
  | leaf a => rfl
  | draw v f ih => simp only [expectation,ih,uniformAverage_const]
lemma expectation_add (t : DrawTree A) (φ ψ : A → ℝ) :
    t.expectation (fun a => φ a+ψ a)=t.expectation φ+t.expectation ψ := by
  induction t with
  | leaf a => rfl
  | draw v f ih => simp only [expectation,ih,uniformAverage_add]
lemma expectation_mul_left (t : DrawTree A) (c : ℝ) (φ : A → ℝ) :
    t.expectation (fun a => c*φ a)=c*t.expectation φ := by
  induction t with
  | leaf a => rfl
  | draw v f ih => simp only [expectation,ih,uniformAverage_mul_left]
lemma expectation_sum (t : DrawTree A) {J : Type*} (s : Finset J) (φ : J → A → ℝ) :
    t.expectation (fun a => ∑ j ∈ s,φ j a)=∑ j ∈ s,t.expectation (φ j) := by
  induction s using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => simp only [Finset.sum_empty,expectation_zero]
  | @insert j s hj ih => simp only [Finset.sum_insert hj,expectation_add,ih]
lemma expectation_mono (t : DrawTree A) (φ ψ : A → ℝ) (h : ∀ a,φ a≤ψ a) :
    t.expectation φ≤t.expectation ψ := by
  induction t with
  | leaf a => exact h a
  | draw v f ih => exact uniformAverage_mono _ _ ih
lemma expectation_optionBind (t : DrawTree (Option A)) (k : A → DrawTree (Option B)) (φ : B → ℝ) :
    (t.optionBind k).expectation (optionValue φ)=
      t.expectation (optionValue (fun a => (k a).expectation (optionValue φ))) := by
  rw [optionBind,expectation_bind]
  congr 1; funext a; cases a <;> rfl
lemma optionBind_fits (t : DrawTree (Option A)) (k : A → DrawTree (Option B))
    (H M N : ℕ) (ht : Fits H M t) (hk : ∀ a,Fits H N (k a)) :
    Fits H (M+N) (t.optionBind k) := by
  apply fits_bind H M N t _ ht
  intro a; cases a with
  | none => cases N <;> trivial
  | some a => exact hk a

def Matches [Fintype B] (t : A → DrawTree (Option B)) (P : A → B → ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ a φ,(t a).expectation (optionValue φ)=∑ b,P a b*φ b
lemma matches_comp [Fintype A] [Fintype B] [Fintype D]
    (t : A → DrawTree (Option B)) (u : B → DrawTree (Option D))
    (P : A → B → ℝ) (Q : B → D → ℝ) (ht : Matches t P) (hu : Matches u Q) :
    Matches (fun a => (t a).optionBind u) (fun a d => ∑ b,P a b*Q b d) := by
  intro a φ
  rw [expectation_optionBind,ht]
  simp_rw [show ∀ b,(u b).expectation (optionValue φ)=∑ d,Q b d*φ d from fun b => hu b φ]
  simp only [Finset.mul_sum,Finset.sum_mul,mul_assoc]
  exact Finset.sum_comm

def iterate (t : A → DrawTree (Option A)) : ℕ → A → DrawTree (Option A)
  | 0,a => pureSome a
  | k+1,a => (iterate t k a).optionBind t
lemma iterate_matches [Fintype A] (t : A → DrawTree (Option A)) (K : FiniteKernel A A)
    (ht : Matches t K.P) (k : ℕ) : Matches (iterate t k) (K.power k).P := by
  induction k with
  | zero =>
    intro a φ
    change φ a=∑ b,(if a=b then (1:ℝ) else 0)*φ b
    simp
  | succ k ih =>
    have h := matches_comp (iterate t k) t (K.power k).P K.P ih ht
    simpa only [iterate,FiniteKernel.power,FiniteKernel.comp] using h
lemma iterate_fits (t : A → DrawTree (Option A)) (H M k : ℕ)
    (ht : ∀ a,Fits H M (t a)) : ∀ a,Fits H (M*k) (iterate t k a) := by
  induction k with
  | zero => intro a; trivial
  | succ k ih =>
    intro a
    have h := optionBind_fits (iterate t k a) t H (M*k) M (ih a) ht
    simpa only [iterate,Nat.mul_succ] using h
end DrawTree

open scoped BigOperators Classical
variable {X : Type*} [sectionInstance116 : Fintype X]
variable (step : X → DrawTree X) (A : X → Prop)
noncomputable def hittingTree : ℕ → X → DrawTree (Option (FiniteChain.Inside A))
  | 0,_ => .leaf none

omit sectionInstance116 in
lemma hittingTree_fits [Fintype X] (H M k : ℕ) (hs : ∀ x,DrawTree.Fits H M (step x)) :
    ∀ x,DrawTree.Fits H (M*k) (hittingTree step A k x) := by
  induction k with
  | zero => intro x; trivial
  | succ k ih =>
    intro x
    unfold hittingTree
    have h := DrawTree.fits_bind H M (M*k) (step x)
      (fun y => if hy : A y then DrawTree.leaf (some (⟨y,hy⟩ : FiniteChain.Inside A)) else hittingTree step A k y)
      (hs x) (by intro y; split_ifs; exacts [by cases M*k <;> trivial,ih y])
    simpa only [Nat.mul_succ,Nat.add_comm] using h
variable (C : FiniteChain X) (Q : KilledKernel (FiniteChain.Outside A))
    (hQ : ∀ x y,Q.Q x y=C.P x.val y.val)
    (hstep : ∀ x φ,(step x).expectation φ=C.apply φ x)
lemma partialGreen_succ_apply (k : ℕ) (f : FiniteChain.Outside A → ℝ) (x : FiniteChain.Outside A) :
    Q.partialGreen (k+1) f x=f x+Q.apply (Q.partialGreen k f) x := by
  unfold KilledKernel.partialGreen
  rw [Finset.sum_range_succ']
  simp only [KilledKernel.iterate_succ,KilledKernel.iterate_zero]

lemma hittingTree_outside (k : ℕ) (φ : FiniteChain.Inside A → ℝ) (x : FiniteChain.Outside A) :
    (hittingTree step A k x.val).expectation (DrawTree.optionValue φ)=
      Q.partialGreen k (fun z => ∑ y : FiniteChain.Inside A,C.P z.val y.val*φ y) x := by
  induction k generalizing x with
  | zero => simp [hittingTree,DrawTree.expectation,DrawTree.optionValue,KilledKernel.partialGreen]
  | succ k ih =>
    rw [hittingTree,DrawTree.expectation_bind,hstep,FiniteChain.apply]
    rw [←Fintype.sum_subtype_add_sum_subtype A]
    have hin : (∑ y : FiniteChain.Inside A,C.P x.val y.val*
        (if hy : A y.val then DrawTree.leaf (some (⟨y.val,hy⟩ : FiniteChain.Inside A)) else hittingTree step A k y.val).expectation (DrawTree.optionValue φ))=
        ∑ y : FiniteChain.Inside A,C.P x.val y.val*φ y := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl; intro y _
      simp only [dite_eq_left y.property,DrawTree.expectation,DrawTree.optionValue]
    have hout : (∑ y : FiniteChain.Outside A,C.P x.val y.val*
        (if hy : A y.val then DrawTree.leaf (some (⟨y.val,hy⟩ : FiniteChain.Inside A)) else hittingTree step A k y.val).expectation (DrawTree.optionValue φ))=
        Q.apply (Q.partialGreen k (fun z => ∑ y : FiniteChain.Inside A,C.P z.val y.val*φ y)) x := by
      unfold KilledKernel.apply
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl; intro y _
      rw [dite_eq_right y.property,ih,hQ]
    rw [hin,hout,partialGreen_succ_apply]
include hQ hstep in
lemma hittingTree_inside (k : ℕ) (x : FiniteChain.Inside A) (φ : FiniteChain.Inside A → ℝ) :
    (hittingTree step A (k+1) x.val).expectation (DrawTree.optionValue φ)=
      ∑ y : FiniteChain.Inside A,C.cappedTrace A Q k x y*φ y := by
  rw [hittingTree,DrawTree.expectation_bind,hstep,FiniteChain.apply]
  rw [←Fintype.sum_subtype_add_sum_subtype A]
  have hin : (∑ y : FiniteChain.Inside A,C.P x.val y.val*
      (if hy : A y.val then DrawTree.leaf (some (⟨y.val,hy⟩ : FiniteChain.Inside A)) else hittingTree step A k y.val).expectation (DrawTree.optionValue φ))=
      ∑ y : FiniteChain.Inside A,C.P x.val y.val*φ y := by
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl; intro y _
    simp only [dite_eq_left y.property,DrawTree.expectation,DrawTree.optionValue]
  have hout : (∑ y : FiniteChain.Outside A,C.P x.val y.val*
      (if hy : A y.val then DrawTree.leaf (some (⟨y.val,hy⟩ : FiniteChain.Inside A)) else hittingTree step A k y.val).expectation (DrawTree.optionValue φ))=
      ∑ z : FiniteChain.Outside A,C.P x.val z.val*

    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl; intro y _

  rw [hin,hout]
  simp only [FiniteChain.cappedTrace,add_mul,Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  congr 1
  simp only [Finset.sum_mul]
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl; intro z _
  simp only [mul_assoc]
  rw [←Finset.mul_sum,KilledKernel.partialGreen_sum]
  congr 1
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl; intro y _
  unfold KilledKernel.partialGreen
  simp_rw [show (fun t : FiniteChain.Outside A => C.P t.val y.val*φ y)=fun t => φ y*C.P t.val y.val by funext t; ring]

end DrawHitting

lemma map_fits [Fintype X] (t : DrawTree X) (f : X → Y) (H M : ℕ) (ht : Fits H M t) :

lemma sampleMass_delta (C : FiniteChain X) (ν : X → ℝ) (k : ℕ) (v : FiniteChain.Sample X k) :
    (∑ x,ν x*C.sampleMass (fun y => if x=y then 1 else 0) v)=C.sampleMass ν v := by
  cases k with
  | zero =>
    dsimp only [FiniteChain.Sample] at v
    change (∑ x : X,ν x*(if x=v then 1 else 0))=ν v
    simp
  | succ k =>
    change (∑ x,ν x*((if x=v.1 then 1 else 0)*C.sampleMass (C.P v.1) v.2))=_
    change (∑ x : X,ν x*((if x=v.1 then 1 else 0)*C.sampleMass (C.P v.1) v.2))=ν v.1*C.sampleMass (C.P v.1) v.2

    simp only [Finset.sum_ite_irrel,Finset.sum_const_zero,Finset.sum_ite_eq,Finset.mem_univ,ite_true]

def RatBound (q : ℚ) (B : ℕ) : Prop :=
  ∃ a b : ℕ,a≤B ∧ b≤B ∧ 0<b ∧ q=(a:ℚ)/(b:ℚ)

variable {q r : ℚ} {B D : ℕ}
lemma nonneg (h : RatBound q B) : 0≤q := by
  obtain ⟨a,b,ha,hb,hpos,rfl⟩ := h; positivity
lemma one_le (h : RatBound q B) : 1≤B := by
  obtain ⟨a,b,ha,hb,hpos,he⟩ := h; omega
lemma mono (h : RatBound q B) (hBD : B≤D) : RatBound q D := by
  obtain ⟨a,b,ha,hb,hpos,he⟩ := h
  exact ⟨a,b,ha.trans hBD,hb.trans hBD,hpos,he⟩
lemma nat (a B : ℕ) (ha : a≤B) (hB : 0<B) : RatBound (a:ℚ) B :=
  ⟨a,1,ha,hB,by omega,by simp⟩
lemma zero (B : ℕ) (hB : 0<B) : RatBound 0 B := by exact_mod_cast nat 0 B (by omega) hB
lemma one (B : ℕ) (hB : 0<B) : RatBound 1 B := by exact_mod_cast nat 1 B hB hB
lemma mul (hq : RatBound q B) (hr : RatBound r D) : RatBound (q*r) (B*D) := by
  obtain ⟨a,b,ha,hb,hpos,rfl⟩ := hq
  obtain ⟨c,d,hc,hd,hdpos,rfl⟩ := hr
  exact ⟨a*c,b*d,Nat.mul_le_mul ha hc,Nat.mul_le_mul hb hd,Nat.mul_pos hpos hdpos,by push_cast; ring⟩
lemma inv (hq : RatBound q B) : RatBound q⁻¹ B := by
  obtain ⟨a,b,ha,hb,hpos,rfl⟩ := hq
  by_cases hz : a=0
  · subst a; simpa using zero B (by omega)
  · exact ⟨b,a,hb,ha,Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hz,by simp [inv_div]⟩
lemma div (hq : RatBound q B) (hr : RatBound r D) : RatBound (q/r) (B*D) := by
  simpa only [div_eq_mul_inv] using hq.mul hr.inv
lemma pow (hq : RatBound q B) (k : ℕ) : RatBound (q^k) (B^k) := by
  induction k with
  | zero => simpa using one 1 (by decide)
  | succ k ih => simpa only [pow_succ] using ih.mul hq
lemma min_one (hq : RatBound q B) : RatBound (min 1 q) B := by
  by_cases h : 1≤q
  · rw [min_eq_left h]; exact one B hq.one_le
  · rw [min_eq_right (le_of_not_ge h)]; exact hq
lemma den_le (hq : RatBound q B) : q.den≤B := by
  obtain ⟨a,b,ha,hb,hpos,rfl⟩ := hq
  have he : ((a:ℚ)/(b:ℚ))=Rat.divInt (a:ℤ) (b:ℤ) := by simp [Rat.divInt_eq_div]
  rw [he]
  have hd := Rat.den_dvd (a:ℤ) (b:ℤ)
  exact (Nat.le_of_dvd hpos (Int.natCast_dvd_natCast.mp hd)).trans hb
lemma num_le (hq : RatBound q B) : q.num.natAbs≤B := by
  obtain ⟨a,b,ha,hb,hpos,rfl⟩ := hq
  have he : ((a:ℚ)/(b:ℚ))=Rat.divInt (a:ℤ) (b:ℤ) := by simp [Rat.divInt_eq_div]
  rw [he,Rat.num_divInt]
  have hs : (b:ℤ).sign=1 := Int.sign_eq_one_of_pos (by exact_mod_cast hpos)
  rw [hs,one_mul]
  rw [Int.natAbs_ediv,Int.natAbs_natCast,Int.natAbs_natCast]
  exact (Nat.div_le_self _ _).trans ha
