inductive OracleDraw (n : ℕ) (A : Type) where
  | pure : A → OracleDraw n A
  | query : Bool → (Fin n → Bool) → (Bool → OracleDraw n A) → OracleDraw n A
  | draw : (v : ℕ) → (Fin (v+1) → OracleDraw n A) → OracleDraw n A
namespace OracleDraw
variable {n : ℕ} {A B : Type}
def bind : OracleDraw n A → (A → OracleDraw n B) → OracleDraw n B
  | .pure a,f => f a
  | .query w S k,f => .query w S (fun b => (k b).bind f)
  | .draw v k,f => .draw v (fun i => (k i).bind f)
def map (t : OracleDraw n A) (f : A → B) : OracleDraw n B := t.bind (fun a => .pure (f a))
def lift : DrawTree A → OracleDraw n A
  | .leaf a => .pure a
  | .draw v k => .draw v (fun i => lift (k i))
def resolve (O : IndependenceOracle n) : OracleDraw n A → DrawTree A
  | .pure a => .leaf a
  | .query w S k => resolve O (k (O w S))
  | .draw v k => .draw v (fun i => resolve O (k i))
lemma resolve_bind (O : IndependenceOracle n) (t : OracleDraw n A) (f : A → OracleDraw n B) :
    resolve O (t.bind f)=(resolve O t).bind (fun a => resolve O (f a)) := by
  induction t with
  | pure a => rfl
  | query w S k ih => exact ih (O w S)
  | draw v k ih => simp only [bind,resolve,DrawTree.bind]; congr; funext i; exact ih i
lemma resolve_map (O : IndependenceOracle n) (t : OracleDraw n A) (f : A → B) :
    resolve O (t.map f)=(resolve O t).map f := resolve_bind O t _
lemma resolve_lift (O : IndependenceOracle n) (t : DrawTree A) : resolve O (lift t)=t := by
  induction t with
  | leaf a => rfl
  | draw v k ih => simp only [lift,resolve]; congr; funext i; exact ih i

def Queries : ℕ → OracleDraw n A → Prop
  | _,.pure _ => True
  | Q,.query _ _ k => 0<Q ∧ ∀ b,Queries (Q-1) (k b)
  | Q,.draw _ k => ∀ i,Queries Q (k i)
lemma queries_mono (t : OracleDraw n A) {Q R : ℕ} (h : Queries Q t) (hle : Q≤R) : Queries R t := by
  induction t generalizing Q R with
  | pure a => trivial
  | query w S k ih =>
    have hq := h.1
    exact ⟨by omega,fun b => ih b (h.2 b) (by omega)⟩
  | draw v k ih => exact fun i => ih i (h i) hle
lemma queries_bind (t : OracleDraw n A) (f : A → OracleDraw n B) (Q R : ℕ)
    (ht : Queries Q t) (hf : ∀ a,Queries R (f a)) : Queries (Q+R) (t.bind f) := by
  induction t generalizing Q with
  | pure a => exact queries_mono (f a) (hf a) (by omega)
  | query w S k ih =>
    have hq := ht.1
    refine ⟨by omega,?_⟩
    intro b
    have he : Q+R-1=(Q-1)+R := by have hq := ht.1; omega
    rw [he]; exact ih b (Q-1) (ht.2 b)
  | draw v k ih => exact fun i => ih i Q (ht i)
lemma queries_map (t : OracleDraw n A) (f : A → B) (Q : ℕ) (ht : Queries Q t) : Queries Q (t.map f) := by
  exact queries_bind t (fun a => .pure (f a)) Q 0 ht (fun _ => trivial)
lemma queries_lift (t : DrawTree A) : Queries 0 (lift t : OracleDraw n A) := by
  induction t with
  | leaf a => trivial
  | draw v k ih => exact ih

def run (O : IndependenceOracle n) (H D : ℕ) :
    OracleDraw n A → (M : ℕ) → (Fin M → Fin D → BitWord H) → Option A × ℕ
  | .pure a,_,_ => (some a,0)
  | .query w S k,M,bits =>
    let out := run O H D (k (O w S)) M bits
    (out.1,out.2+1)
  | .draw _ _,0,_ => (none,0)
  | .draw v k,M+1,bits =>
    if hh : Nat.clog 2 (v+1)≤H then
      match boundedUniform (v+1) (Nat.clog 2 (v+1)) D (fun d => bitPrefix _ H hh (bits 0 d)) with
      | none => (none,0)
      | some i => run O H D (k i) M (Fin.tail bits)
    else (none,0)
lemma run_resolve (O : IndependenceOracle n) (H D : ℕ) (t : OracleDraw n A)
    (M : ℕ) (bits : Fin M → Fin D → BitWord H) :
    (run O H D t M bits).1=DrawTree.run H D M (resolve O t) bits := by
  induction t generalizing M with
  | pure a => simp [run,resolve,DrawTree.run]
  | query w S k ih => exact ih (O w S) M bits
  | draw v k ih =>
    cases M with
    | zero => rfl
    | succ M =>
      simp only [run,resolve,DrawTree.run]
      split_ifs
      · split <;> rename_i he
        · simp only []
        · simpa only [he] using ih _ M (Fin.tail bits)
      · rfl
lemma run_queries (O : IndependenceOracle n) (H D : ℕ) (t : OracleDraw n A)
    (Q M : ℕ) (ht : Queries Q t) (bits : Fin M → Fin D → BitWord H) :
    (run O H D t M bits).2≤Q := by
  induction t generalizing Q M with
  | pure a => simp [run]
  | query w S k ih =>
    have hq := ht.1
    have h := ih (O w S) (Q-1) M (ht.2 _) bits
    change (run O H D (k (O w S)) M bits).2+1≤Q
    omega
  | draw v k ih =>
    cases M with
    | zero => simp [run]
    | succ M =>
      simp only [run]
      split_ifs
      · split
        · simp
        · exact ih _ Q M (ht _) _
      · simp
end OracleDraw
open scoped Classical
variable {n : ℕ}
def greedyEffect (which : Bool) : List (Fin n) → OracleDraw n (Finset (Fin n))
  | [] => .pure ∅
  | a::l => (greedyEffect which l).bind (fun I =>
      .query which (fun i => decide (i ∈ insert a I)) (fun b => .pure (if b then insert a I else I)))
lemma greedyEffect_resolve (O : IndependenceOracle n) (which : Bool) (l : List (Fin n)) :
    OracleDraw.resolve O (greedyEffect which l)=.leaf (greedyOracle (queryFinset O which) l) := by
  induction l with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons a l ih => simp [greedyEffect,OracleDraw.resolve_bind,ih,DrawTree.bind,OracleDraw.resolve,greedyOracle,queryFinset]
lemma greedyEffect_queries (which : Bool) (l : List (Fin n)) :
    OracleDraw.Queries l.length (greedyEffect which l) := by
  induction l with
  | nil => trivial
  | cons a l ih =>
    exact OracleDraw.queries_bind _ _ l.length 1 ih (fun I => ⟨by omega,fun b => trivial⟩)
def rankEffect (which : Bool) (S : Finset (Fin n)) : OracleDraw n ℕ :=
  (greedyEffect which ((List.finRange n).filter (fun i => decide (i ∈ S)))).map Finset.card
lemma rankEffect_resolve (O : IndependenceOracle n) (which : Bool) (S : Finset (Fin n)) :
    OracleDraw.resolve O (rankEffect which S)=.leaf (rankOracle O which S) := by
  simp [rankEffect,OracleDraw.resolve_map,greedyEffect_resolve,DrawTree.map,DrawTree.bind,rankOracle]
lemma rankEffect_queries (which : Bool) (S : Finset (Fin n)) :
    OracleDraw.Queries n (rankEffect which S) := by
  apply OracleDraw.queries_mono _ (OracleDraw.queries_map _ _ _ (greedyEffect_queries which _))
  exact (List.length_filter_le _ _).trans_eq (List.length_finRange (n := n))
noncomputable def deficiencyEffect (r : ℕ) (S : Set (Fin n ⊕ Fin n)) : OracleDraw n ℕ :=
  (rankEffect false (Sum.inl ⁻¹' S).toFinset).bind (fun rx =>
    (rankEffect true (Sum.inr ⁻¹' S).toFinsetᶜ).map (fun rc => n+r-(rx+(Sum.inr ⁻¹' S).toFinset.card+rc)))
lemma deficiencyEffect_resolve (O : IndependenceOracle n) (r : ℕ) (S : Set (Fin n ⊕ Fin n)) :
    OracleDraw.resolve O (deficiencyEffect r S)=.leaf (oracleDeficiency n r O S) := by
  simp [deficiencyEffect,OracleDraw.resolve_bind,OracleDraw.resolve_map,rankEffect_resolve,
    DrawTree.map,DrawTree.bind,oracleDeficiency,pairedDeficiencyOracle]
lemma deficiencyEffect_queries (r : ℕ) (S : Set (Fin n ⊕ Fin n)) :
    OracleDraw.Queries (2*n) (deficiencyEffect r S) := by
  simpa only [two_mul,deficiencyEffect] using OracleDraw.queries_bind _ _ n n (rankEffect_queries false _)
    (fun rx => OracleDraw.queries_map _ _ n (rankEffect_queries true _))

end

namespace OracleDraw
open scoped Classical
variable {n : ℕ} {A B : Type}
def optionBind (t : OracleDraw n (Option A)) (f : A → OracleDraw n (Option B)) : OracleDraw n (Option B) :=
  t.bind (fun a => match a with | none => .pure none | some a => f a)
lemma resolve_optionBind (O : IndependenceOracle n) (t : OracleDraw n (Option A)) (f : A → OracleDraw n (Option B)) :
    resolve O (t.optionBind f)=(resolve O t).optionBind (fun a => resolve O (f a)) := by
  rw [optionBind,resolve_bind,DrawTree.optionBind]; congr; funext a; cases a <;> rfl
lemma queries_optionBind (t : OracleDraw n (Option A)) (f : A → OracleDraw n (Option B))
    (Q R : ℕ) (ht : Queries Q t) (hf : ∀ a,Queries R (f a)) : Queries (Q+R) (t.optionBind f) := by
  apply queries_bind _ _ Q R ht
  intro a; cases a with
  | none => trivial
  | some a => exact hf a
def iterate (t : A → OracleDraw n (Option A)) : ℕ → A → OracleDraw n (Option A)
  | 0,a => .pure (some a)
  | k+1,a => (iterate t k a).optionBind t
lemma resolve_iterate (O : IndependenceOracle n) (t : A → OracleDraw n (Option A)) (k : ℕ) (a : A) :
    resolve O (iterate t k a)=DrawTree.iterate (fun a => resolve O (t a)) k a := by
  induction k with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ k ih => simp [iterate,resolve_optionBind,ih,DrawTree.iterate]
lemma queries_iterate (t : A → OracleDraw n (Option A)) (Q k : ℕ) (ht : ∀ a,Queries Q (t a)) (a : A) :
    Queries (Q*k) (iterate t k a) := by
  induction k with
  | zero => trivial
  | succ k ih => simpa only [iterate,Nat.mul_succ] using queries_optionBind _ t (Q*k) Q ih ht
def sample (step : A → OracleDraw n A) : (k : ℕ) → A → OracleDraw n (FiniteChain.Sample A k)
  | 0,a => .pure a
  | k+1,a => (step a).bind (fun b => (sample step k b).map (fun v => (a,v)))
lemma resolve_sample (O : IndependenceOracle n) (step : A → OracleDraw n A) (k : ℕ) (a : A) :
    resolve O (sample step k a)=DrawTree.sample (fun a => resolve O (step a)) k a := by
  induction k generalizing a with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ k ih =>
    simp only [sample,resolve_bind,DrawTree.sample]
    congr; funext b
    exact (resolve_map O (sample step k b) (fun v => (a,v))).trans (by rw [ih]; rfl)
lemma queries_sample (step : A → OracleDraw n A) (Q k : ℕ) (hs : ∀ a,Queries Q (step a)) (a : A) :
    Queries (Q*k) (sample step k a) := by
  induction k generalizing a with
  | zero => trivial
  | succ k ih =>
    simpa only [sample,Nat.mul_succ,Nat.add_comm] using queries_bind (step a) _ Q (Q*k) (hs a)
      (fun b => queries_map _ _ _ (ih b))
noncomputable def hitting (step : A → OracleDraw n A) (p : A → Prop) : ℕ → A → OracleDraw n (Option {a // p a})
  | 0,_ => .pure none
  | k+1,a => (step a).bind (fun b => if hb : p b then .pure (some ⟨b,hb⟩) else hitting step p k b)
lemma resolve_hitting [Fintype A] (O : IndependenceOracle n) (step : A → OracleDraw n A) (p : A → Prop) (k : ℕ) (a : A) :
    resolve O (hitting step p k a)=hittingTree (fun a => resolve O (step a)) p k a := by
  induction k generalizing a with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ k ih =>
    simp only [hitting,resolve_bind,hittingTree]
    congr; funext b; split_ifs <;> first | rfl | exact ih b
lemma queries_hitting (step : A → OracleDraw n A) (p : A → Prop) (Q k : ℕ)
    (hs : ∀ a,Queries Q (step a)) (a : A) : Queries (Q*k) (hitting step p k a) := by
  induction k generalizing a with
  | zero => trivial
  | succ k ih =>
    have h := queries_bind (step a) (fun b => if hb : p b then .pure (some ⟨b,hb⟩) else hitting step p k b)
      Q (Q*k) (hs a) (by intro b; split_ifs; exacts [trivial,ih b])
    simpa only [hitting,Nat.mul_succ,Nat.add_comm] using h
noncomputable def traverse (f : A → OracleDraw n B) : List A → OracleDraw n (List B)
  | [] => .pure []
  | a::l => (f a).bind (fun b => (traverse f l).map (fun xs => b::xs))
lemma traverse_resolve (O : IndependenceOracle n) (f : A → OracleDraw n B) (g : A → B)
    (hf : ∀ a,resolve O (f a)=.leaf (g a)) (l : List A) : resolve O (traverse f l)=.leaf (l.map g) := by
  induction l with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons a l ih => simp [traverse,resolve_bind,resolve_map,hf,ih,DrawTree.bind,DrawTree.map]
lemma traverse_queries (f : A → OracleDraw n B) (Q : ℕ) (hf : ∀ a,Queries Q (f a)) (l : List A) :
    Queries (Q*l.length) (traverse f l) := by
  induction l with
  | nil => trivial
  | cons a l ih =>
    simpa only [traverse,List.length_cons,Nat.mul_succ,Nat.add_comm] using queries_bind (f a) _ Q (Q*l.length) (hf a)
      (fun b => queries_map _ _ _ ih)
end OracleDraw
open scoped BigOperators Classical
variable (n : ℕ) (hn : 0<n) (r : ℕ) (N L : ℕ)
local notation "GS" => pairedSlots n
noncomputable def exchangeEffect (w : ((Fin n ⊕ Fin n) × (Fin n ⊕ Fin n)) →
    ((Fin n ⊕ Fin n) × (Fin n ⊕ Fin n)) → ℚ) (j : ℕ)
    (S : ChainIndex GS) (a : ExchangeChoice S.val) : OracleDraw n (ChainIndex GS) :=
  if ht : ChainState GS (exchangedSet S.val a) then
    let T : ChainIndex GS := ⟨exchangedSet S.val a,ht⟩
    (deficiencyEffect r S.val).bind (fun ds => (deficiencyEffect r T.val).bind (fun dt =>
      OracleDraw.lift ((DrawTree.bernoulli (min 1
        ((rationalMultiplier GS w T.val*(rationalRho n^j)^dt)/
          (rationalMultiplier GS w S.val*(rationalRho n^j)^ds)))).map (fun accept => if accept then T else S))))
  else .pure S
lemma exchangeEffect_resolve (O : IndependenceOracle n) (w) (j : ℕ) (S : ChainIndex GS) (a : ExchangeChoice S.val) :
    OracleDraw.resolve O (exchangeEffect n r w j S a)=rationalExchange GS w (oracleAnneal n r O j) S a := by
  unfold exchangeEffect rationalExchange
  split_ifs
  · simp only [OracleDraw.resolve_bind,deficiencyEffect_resolve,DrawTree.bind,OracleDraw.resolve_lift]
    rfl
  · rfl
lemma exchangeEffect_queries (w) (j : ℕ) (S : ChainIndex GS) (a : ExchangeChoice S.val) :
    OracleDraw.Queries (4*n) (exchangeEffect n r w j S a) := by
  unfold exchangeEffect
  split_ifs
  · rw [show 4*n=2*n+2*n by omega]
    apply OracleDraw.queries_bind _ _ (2*n) (2*n) (deficiencyEffect_queries r _)
    intro ds
    exact OracleDraw.queries_bind _ _ (2*n) 0 (deficiencyEffect_queries r _)
      (fun dt => OracleDraw.queries_lift _)
  · trivial
noncomputable def stepEffect (h : List (PhaseSample n N)) (j : ℕ) (S : ChainIndex GS) : OracleDraw n (ChainIndex GS) :=
  letI : Nonempty (ExchangeChoice S.val) := Fintype.card_pos_iff.mp (by
    rw [exchangeChoice_card GS (pairedSlots_fresh n) (pairedSlots_cover n),pairedSlots_length]; positivity)
  (OracleDraw.lift (DrawTree.bernoulli (1/2))).bind (fun lazy => if lazy then .pure S else
    (OracleDraw.lift (DrawTree.uniformVia (ExchangeChoice S.val) (canonicalExchangeEnumeration n S.val))).bind
      (exchangeEffect n r (rationalStored n N h j) j S))
lemma stepEffect_resolve (O : IndependenceOracle n) (h : List (PhaseSample n N)) (j : ℕ) (S : ChainIndex GS) :
    OracleDraw.resolve O (stepEffect n hn r N h j S)=canonicalStepTree n hn r O N h j S := by
  unfold stepEffect canonicalStepTree canonicalMetropolis
  simp only [OracleDraw.resolve_bind,OracleDraw.resolve_lift]
  congr; funext a; cases a
  · simp only [Bool.false_eq_true,ite_false,OracleDraw.resolve_bind,OracleDraw.resolve_lift]
    congr; funext b; exact exchangeEffect_resolve n r O _ _ _ _
  · rfl
lemma stepEffect_queries (h : List (PhaseSample n N)) (j : ℕ) (S : ChainIndex GS) :
    OracleDraw.Queries (4*n) (stepEffect n hn r N h j S) := by
  let : Nonempty (ExchangeChoice S.val) := Fintype.card_pos_iff.mp (by
    rw [exchangeChoice_card GS (pairedSlots_fresh n) (pairedSlots_cover n),pairedSlots_length]; positivity)
  have hp : OracleDraw.Queries (0+4*n) (stepEffect n hn r N h j S) := by
    unfold stepEffect
    apply OracleDraw.queries_bind _ _ 0 (4*n) (OracleDraw.queries_lift _)
    intro a; cases a
    · simp only [Bool.false_eq_true,ite_false]
      have hq : OracleDraw.Queries (0+4*n)
          ((OracleDraw.lift (DrawTree.uniformVia (ExchangeChoice S.val)
            (canonicalExchangeEnumeration n S.val))).bind
            (exchangeEffect n r (rationalStored n N h j) j S)) :=
        OracleDraw.queries_bind _ _ 0 (4*n) (OracleDraw.queries_lift _)
          (fun b => exchangeEffect_queries n r _ _ _ b)
      simpa only [Nat.zero_add] using hq
    · trivial
  simpa only [Nat.zero_add] using hp
noncomputable def traceEffect (h : List (PhaseSample n N)) (j cap : ℕ) (x : PlainIndex GS) :
    OracleDraw n (Option (PlainIndex GS)) :=
  OracleDraw.hitting (stepEffect n hn r N h j) (plainPredicate GS) (cap+1) x.val
lemma traceEffect_resolve (O : IndependenceOracle n) (h : List (PhaseSample n N)) (j cap : ℕ) (x : PlainIndex GS) :
    OracleDraw.resolve O (traceEffect n hn r N h j cap x)=canonicalTraceTree n hn r O N h j cap x := by
  simp only [traceEffect,OracleDraw.resolve_hitting,stepEffect_resolve,canonicalTraceTree]
lemma traceEffect_queries (h : List (PhaseSample n N)) (j cap : ℕ) (x : PlainIndex GS) :
    OracleDraw.Queries (4*n*(cap+1)) (traceEffect n hn r N h j cap x) :=
  OracleDraw.queries_hitting _ _ _ _ (stepEffect_queries n hn r N h j) _
noncomputable def restartEffect (h : List (PhaseSample n N)) (cap : ℕ) : ℕ → OracleDraw n (Option (PlainIndex GS))
  | 0 =>
    letI := plainIndex_nonempty GS (pairedSlots_fresh n) (pairedSlots_cover n)
    OracleDraw.lift ((DrawTree.uniformVia (PlainIndex GS) (canonicalPlainEnumeration n)).map some)
  | j+1 => (restartEffect h cap j).optionBind
      (OracleDraw.iterate (traceEffect n hn r N h (j+1) cap) (20*n^4*(n*(L+1)+2)))
lemma restartEffect_resolve (O : IndependenceOracle n) (h : List (PhaseSample n N)) (cap j : ℕ) :
    OracleDraw.resolve O (restartEffect n hn r N L h cap j)=canonicalRestartTree n hn r O N L h cap j := by
  induction j with
  | zero => exact OracleDraw.resolve_lift O _
  | succ j ih => simp only [restartEffect,canonicalRestartTree,OracleDraw.resolve_optionBind,
      OracleDraw.resolve_iterate,traceEffect_resolve,ih]
lemma restartEffect_queries (h : List (PhaseSample n N)) (cap j : ℕ) :
    OracleDraw.Queries (4*n*(cap+1)*(20*n^4*(n*(L+1)+2))*j) (restartEffect n hn r N L h cap j) := by
  induction j with
  | zero => exact OracleDraw.queries_lift _
  | succ j ih =>
    simpa only [restartEffect,Nat.mul_succ] using OracleDraw.queries_optionBind _ _ _ _ ih
      (OracleDraw.queries_iterate _ _ _ (traceEffect_queries n hn r N h (j+1) cap))
noncomputable def startEffect (h : List (PhaseSample n N)) : OracleDraw n (Option (ChainIndex GS)) :=
  (restartEffect n hn r N L h (restartCap n L) h.length).map (Option.map Subtype.val)
noncomputable def phaseEffect (h : List (PhaseSample n N)) : OracleDraw n (Option (PhaseSample n N)) :=
  if rationalHistoryPositive n N h then
    (startEffect n hn r N L h).optionBind
      (fun x => (OracleDraw.sample (stepEffect n hn r N h h.length) (N-1) x).map some)
  else .pure none
lemma phaseEffect_resolve (O : IndependenceOracle n) (h : List (PhaseSample n N)) :
    OracleDraw.resolve O (phaseEffect n hn r N L h)=canonicalPhaseTree n hn r O N L h := by
  unfold phaseEffect canonicalPhaseTree
  split_ifs
  · simp only [OracleDraw.resolve_optionBind,startEffect,OracleDraw.resolve_map,restartEffect_resolve,
      canonicalStartTree,OracleDraw.resolve_sample,stepEffect_resolve]
  · rfl
noncomputable def witnessEffect (h : List (PhaseSample n N)) : OracleDraw n (Option (PlainIndex GS)) :=
  if rationalHistoryPositive n N h then restartEffect n hn r N L h (restartCap n L) h.length else .pure none
lemma witnessEffect_resolve (O : IndependenceOracle n) (h : List (PhaseSample n N)) :
    OracleDraw.resolve O (witnessEffect n hn r N L h)=canonicalWitnessTree n hn r O N L h := by
  unfold witnessEffect canonicalWitnessTree
  split_ifs
  · exact restartEffect_resolve n hn r N L O h _ _
  · rfl

end

section
open scoped BigOperators Classical
variable (n : ℕ) (hn : 0<n) (r N L : ℕ)
local notation "GS" => pairedSlots n
noncomputable def ratioEffect (l : List (Set (Fin n ⊕ Fin n))) : OracleDraw n ℚ :=
  (OracleDraw.traverse (fun S => (deficiencyEffect r S).map
    (fun d => rationalPlain GS (fun _ => rationalRho n ^ d) S)) l).map
      (fun vs => (vs.sum/(l.length:ℚ))/rationalEmpirical (rationalPlain GS (fun _ => 1)) l)
lemma ratioEffect_resolve (O : IndependenceOracle n) (l : List (Set (Fin n ⊕ Fin n))) :
    OracleDraw.resolve O (ratioEffect n r l)=.leaf
      (rationalRatio GS (fun S => rationalRho n ^ oracleDeficiency n r O S) l) := by
  unfold ratioEffect
  rw [OracleDraw.resolve_map,OracleDraw.traverse_resolve O _
    (fun S => rationalPlain GS (fun _ => rationalRho n ^ oracleDeficiency n r O S) S)]
  · simp only [DrawTree.map,DrawTree.bind,rationalRatio,rationalEmpirical]
    congr 3
  · intro S; simp only [OracleDraw.resolve_map,deficiencyEffect_resolve,DrawTree.map,DrawTree.bind]
lemma ratioEffect_queries (l : List (Set (Fin n ⊕ Fin n))) :
    OracleDraw.Queries (2*n*l.length) (ratioEffect n r l) := by
  apply OracleDraw.queries_map
  exact OracleDraw.traverse_queries _ (2*n)
    (fun S => OracleDraw.queries_map _ _ _ (deficiencyEffect_queries r S)) l
lemma historySample_length_bound (h : List (PhaseSample n N)) (j : ℕ) :
    (historySample (observedSets n N) h j).length≤N+1 := by
  unfold historySample
  by_cases hj : j<h.length
  · rw [List.getElem?_eq_getElem hj]
    simp only [Option.map_some,Option.getD_some,observedSets,List.length_map,
      FiniteChain.Sample.toList_length]
    omega
  · rw [List.getElem?_eq_none (by omega)]
    simp
noncomputable def estimateProductEffect (h : List (PhaseSample n N)) : ℕ → OracleDraw n ℚ
  | 0 => .pure 1
  | j+1 => (estimateProductEffect h j).bind (fun z =>
      (ratioEffect n r (historySample (observedSets n N) h j)).map (fun q => z*q))
lemma estimateProductEffect_resolve (O : IndependenceOracle n) (h : List (PhaseSample n N)) (j : ℕ) :
    OracleDraw.resolve O (estimateProductEffect n r N h j)=.leaf
      (∏ i ∈ Finset.range j,rationalRatio GS (fun S => rationalRho n ^ oracleDeficiency n r O S)
        (historySample (observedSets n N) h i)) := by
  induction j with
  | zero => simp [estimateProductEffect,OracleDraw.resolve]
  | succ j ih => simp only [estimateProductEffect,OracleDraw.resolve_bind,ih,DrawTree.bind,
      OracleDraw.resolve_map,ratioEffect_resolve,DrawTree.map,Finset.prod_range_succ]
lemma estimateProductEffect_queries (h : List (PhaseSample n N)) (j : ℕ) :
    OracleDraw.Queries (2*n*(N+1)*j) (estimateProductEffect n r N h j) := by
  induction j with
  | zero => trivial
  | succ j ih =>
    rw [Nat.mul_succ]
    apply OracleDraw.queries_bind _ _ _ _ ih
    intro z
    apply OracleDraw.queries_map
    exact OracleDraw.queries_mono _ (ratioEffect_queries n r _) (by
      have hh := historySample_length_bound n N h j
      gcongr)
noncomputable def estimateEffect (h : List (PhaseSample n N)) : OracleDraw n ℚ :=
  (estimateProductEffect n r N h L).map (fun z => (2:ℚ)^n*z)
lemma estimateEffect_resolve (O : IndependenceOracle n) (h : List (PhaseSample n N)) :
    OracleDraw.resolve O (estimateEffect n r N L h)=.leaf (oracleEstimate n r O N L h) := by
  simp only [estimateEffect,OracleDraw.resolve_map,estimateProductEffect_resolve,DrawTree.map,DrawTree.bind,oracleEstimate]
lemma estimateEffect_queries (h : List (PhaseSample n N)) :
    OracleDraw.Queries (2*n*(N+1)*L) (estimateEffect n r N L h) :=
  OracleDraw.queries_map _ _ _ (estimateProductEffect_queries n r N h L)
noncomputable def guardEffect (h : List (PhaseSample n N)) (x : PlainIndex GS) : OracleDraw n ℚ :=
  (deficiencyEffect r x.val.val).bind (fun d => if d=0 then estimateEffect n r N L h else .pure 0)
lemma guardEffect_resolve (O : IndependenceOracle n) (h : List (PhaseSample n N)) (x : PlainIndex GS) :
    OracleDraw.resolve O (guardEffect n r N L h x)=.leaf (oracleGuard n r O N L h x) := by
  simp only [guardEffect,OracleDraw.resolve_bind,deficiencyEffect_resolve,DrawTree.bind,oracleGuard]
  split_ifs
  · exact estimateEffect_resolve n r N L O h
  · rfl
lemma guardEffect_queries (h : List (PhaseSample n N)) (x : PlainIndex GS) :
    OracleDraw.Queries (2*n+2*n*(N+1)*L) (guardEffect n r N L h x) := by
  apply OracleDraw.queries_bind _ _ _ _ (deficiencyEffect_queries r _)
  intro d; split_ifs
  · exact estimateEffect_queries n r N L h
  · trivial
noncomputable def finishEffect (h : List (PhaseSample n N)) : OracleDraw n (Option ℚ) :=
  (witnessEffect n hn r N L h).optionBind (fun x => (guardEffect n r N L h x).map some)
lemma finishEffect_resolve (O : IndependenceOracle n) (h : List (PhaseSample n N)) :
    OracleDraw.resolve O (finishEffect n hn r N L h)=
      (canonicalWitnessTree n hn r O N L h).map (Option.map (oracleGuard n r O N L h)) := by
  rw [finishEffect,OracleDraw.resolve_optionBind,witnessEffect_resolve]
  simp only [OracleDraw.resolve_map,guardEffect_resolve,DrawTree.map,DrawTree.bind,DrawTree.optionBind]
  congr; funext a; cases a <;> rfl
noncomputable def historyFinishEffect : List (PhaseSample n N) → ℕ → OracleDraw n (Option ℚ)
  | h,0 => finishEffect n hn r N L h
  | h,k+1 => (phaseEffect n hn r N L h).optionBind (fun x => historyFinishEffect (h++[x]) k)
lemma historyFinishEffect_resolve (O : IndependenceOracle n) (h : List (PhaseSample n N)) (k : ℕ) :
    OracleDraw.resolve O (historyFinishEffect n hn r N L h k)=
      (DrawTree.history (canonicalPhaseTree n hn r O N L) k h).optionBind (fun h =>
        (canonicalWitnessTree n hn r O N L h).map (Option.map (oracleGuard n r O N L h))) := by
  induction k generalizing h with
  | zero => exact finishEffect_resolve n hn r N L O h
  | succ k ih => simp only [historyFinishEffect,OracleDraw.resolve_optionBind,phaseEffect_resolve,ih,
      DrawTree.history,DrawTree.optionBind_assoc]
noncomputable def queryAlgorithm : OracleDraw n (Option ℚ) := historyFinishEffect n hn r N L [] L
lemma queryAlgorithm_resolve (O : IndependenceOracle n) :
    OracleDraw.resolve O (queryAlgorithm n hn r N L)=canonicalAlgorithmTree n hn r O N L :=
  historyFinishEffect_resolve n hn r N L O [] L

end

open scoped Classical
variable (n : ℕ) (hn : 0<n) (r N L : ℕ)
def phaseQueryBound (n N L : ℕ) : ℕ :=
  4*n*(restartCap n L+1)*(20*n^4*(n*(L+1)+2))*L+4*n*N+2*n+2*n*(N+1)*L
lemma phaseEffect_queries (h : List (PhaseSample n N)) (hh : h.length≤L) :
    OracleDraw.Queries (phaseQueryBound n N L) (phaseEffect n hn r N L h) := by
  have hp : OracleDraw.Queries
      (4*n*(restartCap n L+1)*(20*n^4*(n*(L+1)+2))*h.length+4*n*(N-1))
      (phaseEffect n hn r N L h) := by
    unfold phaseEffect
    split_ifs
    · apply OracleDraw.queries_optionBind
      · exact OracleDraw.queries_map _ _ _ (restartEffect_queries n hn r N L h _ _)
      · intro x
        exact OracleDraw.queries_map _ _ _ (OracleDraw.queries_sample _ _ _
          (stepEffect_queries n hn r N h h.length) x)
    · trivial
  apply OracleDraw.queries_mono _ hp
  unfold phaseQueryBound
  have h1 : 4*n*(restartCap n L+1)*(20*n^4*(n*(L+1)+2))*h.length≤
      4*n*(restartCap n L+1)*(20*n^4*(n*(L+1)+2))*L := by gcongr
  have h2 : 4*n*(N-1)≤4*n*N := Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ (Nat.sub_le _ _)
  omega
lemma witnessEffect_queries (h : List (PhaseSample n N)) :
    OracleDraw.Queries (4*n*(restartCap n L+1)*(20*n^4*(n*(L+1)+2))*h.length)
      (witnessEffect n hn r N L h) := by
  unfold witnessEffect
  split_ifs
  · exact restartEffect_queries n hn r N L h _ _
  · trivial
lemma finishEffect_queries (h : List (PhaseSample n N)) (hh : h.length≤L) :
    OracleDraw.Queries (phaseQueryBound n N L) (finishEffect n hn r N L h) := by
  have hp : OracleDraw.Queries
      (4*n*(restartCap n L+1)*(20*n^4*(n*(L+1)+2))*h.length+(2*n+2*n*(N+1)*L))
      (finishEffect n hn r N L h) :=
    OracleDraw.queries_optionBind _ _ _ _ (witnessEffect_queries n hn r N L h)
      (fun x => OracleDraw.queries_map _ _ _ (guardEffect_queries n r N L h x))
  apply OracleDraw.queries_mono _ hp
  unfold phaseQueryBound
  have h1 : 4*n*(restartCap n L+1)*(20*n^4*(n*(L+1)+2))*h.length≤
      4*n*(restartCap n L+1)*(20*n^4*(n*(L+1)+2))*L := by gcongr
  omega
lemma historyFinishEffect_queries (h : List (PhaseSample n N)) (k : ℕ) (hk : h.length+k≤L) :
    OracleDraw.Queries (phaseQueryBound n N L*(k+1)) (historyFinishEffect n hn r N L h k) := by
  induction k generalizing h with
  | zero => simpa only [historyFinishEffect,Nat.zero_add,Nat.mul_one] using finishEffect_queries n hn r N L h (by omega)
  | succ k ih =>
    rw [show phaseQueryBound n N L*(k+1+1)=phaseQueryBound n N L+phaseQueryBound n N L*(k+1) by ring]
    apply OracleDraw.queries_optionBind _ _ _ _ (phaseEffect_queries n hn r N L h (by omega))
    intro x; apply ih
    simp only [List.length_append,List.length_singleton]; omega
def oracleQueryBound (n N L : ℕ) : ℕ := phaseQueryBound n N L*(L+1)
lemma queryAlgorithm_queries : OracleDraw.Queries (oracleQueryBound n N L) (queryAlgorithm n hn r N L) :=
  historyFinishEffect_queries n hn r N L [] L (by simp)
lemma capped_queryAlgorithm (O : IndependenceOracle n) (H D M : ℕ)
    (bits : Fin M → Fin D → BitWord H) :
    (OracleDraw.run O H D (queryAlgorithm n hn r N L) M bits).1=
      DrawTree.run H D M (canonicalAlgorithmTree n hn r O N L) bits ∧
    (OracleDraw.run O H D (queryAlgorithm n hn r N L) M bits).2≤oracleQueryBound n N L := by
  exact ⟨by rw [OracleDraw.run_resolve,queryAlgorithm_resolve],
    OracleDraw.run_queries O H D _ _ M (queryAlgorithm_queries n hn r N L) bits⟩

lemma oracleQueryBound_le (n N L : ℕ) :
    oracleQueryBound n N L≤4*n*(algorithmDrawBound n N L)+(2*n+2*n*(N+1)*L)*(L+1) := by
  have hp : 4*n*(restartCap n L+1)*(20*n^4*(n*(L+1)+2))*L+4*n*N≤4*n*phaseDrawBound n N L := by
    calc
      _ = 4*n*(L*(restartCap n L+1)*(20*n^4*(n*(L+1)+2))+N) := by ring
      _ ≤ 4*n*(1+3*(L*(restartCap n L+1)*(20*n^4*(n*(L+1)+2)))+3*N) := by gcongr <;> omega
      _ = _ := by unfold phaseDrawBound; ring
  calc
    _ ≤ (4*n*phaseDrawBound n N L+(2*n+2*n*(N+1)*L))*(L+1) := by
      unfold oracleQueryBound phaseQueryBound
      apply Nat.mul_le_mul_right
      omega
    _ = _ := by unfold algorithmDrawBound; ring

theorem allQueries_polynomial (n : ℕ) (ε δ : ℚ) :
    repetitionCount δ*oracleQueryBound n (sampleCount n (annealLength n (accuracyExponent ε)) ε)
      (annealLength n (accuracyExponent ε))≤10^31*(bitResourceParameter n ε δ)^30 := by
  let T := bitResourceParameter n ε δ
  have hT : 0<T := by dsimp [T,bitResourceParameter]; omega
  have hh := polynomial_recipe_bounds n ε.den.bits.length δ.den.bits.length ⌈ε⁻¹⌉₊ T hT
    (by dsimp [T,bitResourceParameter]; omega) (by dsimp [T,bitResourceParameter]; omega)
    (by dsimp [T,bitResourceParameter]; omega) (by dsimp [T,bitResourceParameter]; omega)
  dsimp only at hh
  let L := annealLength n (accuracyExponent ε)
  let N := sampleCount n L ε
  have hL : L≤14*T^2 := hh.1
  have hN : N≤10^18*T^22 := hh.2.1
  have hM : algorithmDrawBound n N L≤10^21*T^24 := hh.2.2.2.1
  have hR : repetitionCount δ≤128*T := hh.2.2.2.2
  have hn : n≤T := by dsimp [T,bitResourceParameter]; omega
  have hone (j : ℕ) : 1≤T^j := Nat.one_le_pow _ _ hT
  have hp (i j : ℕ) (hij : i≤j) : T^i≤T^j := Nat.pow_le_pow_right hT hij
  have hN1 : N+1≤2*10^18*T^22 := by have h := hone 22; omega
  have hL1 : L+1≤15*T^2 := by have h := hone 2; omega
  have hQ : oracleQueryBound n N L≤10^27*T^27 := by
    apply (oracleQueryBound_le n N L).trans
    calc
      _ ≤ 4*T*(10^21*T^24)+(2*T+2*T*(2*10^18*T^22)*(14*T^2))*(15*T^2) := by gcongr
      _ ≤ _ := by
        have h1 := hp 25 27 (by omega)
        have h2 := hp 3 27 (by omega)
        nlinarith [Nat.zero_le (T^27)]
  change repetitionCount δ*oracleQueryBound n N L≤10^31*T^30
  calc
    _ ≤ (128*T)*(10^27*T^27) := by gcongr
    _ ≤ _ := by have h := hp 28 30 (by omega); nlinarith [Nat.zero_le (T^30)]
end

open scoped BigOperators Classical
noncomputable def queryFairOutput (n : ℕ) (hn : 0<n) (r : ℕ) (O : IndependenceOracle n)
    (N L : ℕ) (bits : FairBank n N L) : ℚ × ℕ :=
  let out := OracleDraw.run O (drawWordBound n N L) (algorithmDrawBound n N L+6)
    (queryAlgorithm n hn r N L) (algorithmDrawBound n N L) bits
  (out.1.join.getD 0,out.2)
lemma queryFairOutput_value (n : ℕ) (hn : 0<n) (r : ℕ) (O : IndependenceOracle n)
    (N L : ℕ) (bits : FairBank n N L) :
    (queryFairOutput n hn r O N L bits).1=canonicalFairOutput n hn r O N L bits := by
  dsimp only [queryFairOutput,canonicalFairOutput]
  rw [OracleDraw.run_resolve,queryAlgorithm_resolve]
lemma queryFairOutput_queries (n : ℕ) (hn : 0<n) (r : ℕ) (O : IndependenceOracle n)
    (N L : ℕ) (bits : FairBank n N L) :
    (queryFairOutput n hn r O N L bits).2≤oracleQueryBound n N L :=
  (capped_queryAlgorithm n hn r N L O _ _ _ bits).2
noncomputable def queryAmplifiedOutput (n : ℕ) (hn : 0<n) (r : ℕ) (O : IndependenceOracle n)
    (N L : ℕ) (δ : ℚ) (bits : Fin (repetitionCount δ) → FairBank n N L) : ℚ × ℕ :=
  let outs := fun i => queryFairOutput n hn r O N L (bits i)
  (rationalMedian (List.ofFn (fun i => (outs i).1)),∑ i,(outs i).2)
lemma queryAmplifiedOutput_value (n : ℕ) (hn : 0<n) (r : ℕ) (O : IndependenceOracle n)
    (N L : ℕ) (δ : ℚ) (bits : Fin (repetitionCount δ) → FairBank n N L) :
    (queryAmplifiedOutput n hn r O N L δ bits).1=canonicalAmplifiedOutput n hn r O N L δ bits := by
  simp only [queryAmplifiedOutput,canonicalAmplifiedOutput,queryFairOutput_value]
lemma queryAmplifiedOutput_queries (n : ℕ) (hn : 0<n) (r : ℕ) (O : IndependenceOracle n)
    (N L : ℕ) (δ : ℚ) (bits : Fin (repetitionCount δ) → FairBank n N L) :
    (queryAmplifiedOutput n hn r O N L δ bits).2≤repetitionCount δ*oracleQueryBound n N L := by
  dsimp only [queryAmplifiedOutput]
  apply le_trans (Finset.sum_le_sum (fun i _ => queryFairOutput_queries n hn r O N L (bits i)))
  simp
noncomputable def queryBoundedOutput (n r : ℕ) (O : IndependenceOracle n)
    (ε δ : ℚ) (bits : FPRASBank n ε δ) : ℚ × ℕ :=
  if hn : 0<n then queryAmplifiedOutput n hn r O
    (sampleCount n (annealLength n (accuracyExponent ε)) ε) (annealLength n (accuracyExponent ε)) δ bits
  else (1,0)
lemma queryBoundedOutput_value (n r : ℕ) (O : IndependenceOracle n)
    (ε δ : ℚ) (bits : FPRASBank n ε δ) :
    (queryBoundedOutput n r O ε δ bits).1=canonicalBoundedOutput n r O ε δ bits := by
  unfold queryBoundedOutput canonicalBoundedOutput
  split_ifs
  · exact queryAmplifiedOutput_value n _ r O _ _ δ bits
  · rfl
lemma queryBoundedOutput_queries (n r : ℕ) (O : IndependenceOracle n)
    (ε δ : ℚ) (bits : FPRASBank n ε δ) :
    (queryBoundedOutput n r O ε δ bits).2≤10^31*(bitResourceParameter n ε δ)^30 := by
  unfold queryBoundedOutput
  split_ifs
  · exact (queryAmplifiedOutput_queries n _ r O _ _ δ bits).trans (allQueries_polynomial n ε δ)
  · simp
noncomputable def paddedQueryOutput (n r : ℕ) (O : IndependenceOracle n) (ε δ : ℚ)
    (B : ℕ) (hB : fairBitCount n ε δ≤B) (bits : BitWord B) : ℚ × ℕ :=
  queryBoundedOutput n r O ε δ (bankWordEquiv n ε δ (bitPrefix _ B hB bits))
lemma paddedQueryOutput_value (n r : ℕ) (O : IndependenceOracle n) (ε δ : ℚ)
    (B : ℕ) (hB : fairBitCount n ε δ≤B) (bits : BitWord B) :
    (paddedQueryOutput n r O ε δ B hB bits).1=paddedFPRASOutput n r O ε δ B hB bits :=
  queryBoundedOutput_value n r O ε δ _

theorem query_fair_experiment (n r : ℕ) (O : IndependenceOracle n)
    (M₁ M₂ : Matroid (Fin n)) (hO : ExactOracles M₁ M₂ O)
    (hE₁ : M₁.E=Set.univ) (hE₂ : M₂.E=Set.univ)
    (hr₁ : M₁.eRank=(r:ℕ∞)) (hr₂ : M₂.eRank=(r:ℕ∞))
    (ε δ : ℚ) (hε0 : 0<ε) (hε1 : ε<1) (hδ : 0<δ)
    (B : ℕ) (hB : fairBitCount n ε δ≤B) :
    (∀ bits : BitWord B,
      let out := paddedQueryOutput n r O ε δ B hB bits
      0≤out.1 ∧ (commonBaseCount M₁ M₂=0 → out.1=0) ∧
        out.2≤10^31*(bitResourceParameter n ε δ)^30) ∧
    (1-δ)*(2:ℚ)^B≤(Nat.card {bits : BitWord B //
      relativeAccuracy ε (commonBaseCount M₁ M₂) (paddedQueryOutput n r O ε δ B hB bits).1}:ℚ) := by
  have hp := padded_fair_experiment n r O M₁ M₂ hO hE₁ hE₂ hr₁ hr₂ ε δ hε0 hε1 hδ B hB
  constructor
  · intro bits
    refine ⟨?_,?_,queryBoundedOutput_queries n r O ε δ _⟩
    · rw [paddedQueryOutput_value]; exact (hp.1 bits).1
    · rw [paddedQueryOutput_value]; exact (hp.1 bits).2
  · simp only [paddedQueryOutput_value]
    exact hp.2

variable {k n : ℕ}
def workConfig (R : Fin (k+8) → List Bool) (pc : Fin 6) (q c : ℕ) : MachineConfig k 5 :=
  ⟨R,pc,none,q,c⟩
def pairRegisters (R : Fin (k+8) → List Bool) (a b : Fin (k+8)) (xs ys : List Bool) :=
  Function.update (Function.update R a xs) b ys
lemma pairRegisters_a (R : Fin (k+8) → List Bool) (a b : Fin (k+8)) (h : a≠b)
    (xs ys : List Bool) : pairRegisters R a b xs ys a=xs := by simp [pairRegisters,h]
lemma pairRegisters_b (R : Fin (k+8) → List Bool) (a b : Fin (k+8))
    (xs ys : List Bool) : pairRegisters R a b xs ys b=ys := by simp [pairRegisters]
lemma pairRegisters_update_a (R : Fin (k+8) → List Bool) (a b : Fin (k+8)) (h : a≠b)
    (xs ys zs : List Bool) : Function.update (pairRegisters R a b xs ys) a zs =pairRegisters R a b zs ys := by
  funext i
  by_cases ha : i=a
  · subst i; simp [pairRegisters,h]
  · by_cases hb : i=b
    · subst i; simp [pairRegisters,ha]
    · simp [pairRegisters,ha,hb]
lemma pairRegisters_update_b (R : Fin (k+8) → List Bool) (a b : Fin (k+8))
    (xs ys zs : List Bool) : Function.update (pairRegisters R a b xs ys) b zs =pairRegisters R a b xs zs := by
  simp [pairRegisters]
lemma execution_add {s : ℕ} (P : Program k s) (O : IndependenceOracle n)
    (c : MachineConfig k s) (bits : ℕ → Bool) (t u : ℕ) :
    execution P O c bits (t+u)=execution P O (execution P O c bits t) (fun i => bits (t+i)) u := by
  induction u with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ u ih =>
    change machineStep P O (bits (t+u)) (execution P O c bits (t+u))=
      machineStep P O (bits (t+u)) (execution P O (execution P O c bits t) (fun i => bits (t+i)) u)
    rw [ih]
def incrementProgram (a b : Fin (k+8)) : Program k 5 := fun pc =>
  match pc.val with
  | 0 => .pop a 1 1 2
  | 1 => .push a true 3
  | 2 => .push b false 0
  | 3 => .pop b 5 4 4
  | 4 => .push a false 3
  | _ => .halt
def leadingOnes : List Bool → ℕ
  | [] => 0
  | false::_ => 0
  | true::xs => leadingOnes xs+1
def carryTail : List Bool → List Bool
  | [] => [true]
  | false::xs => true::xs
  | true::xs => carryTail xs
lemma leadingOnes_le (xs : List Bool) : leadingOnes xs≤xs.length := by
  induction xs with
  | nil => simp [leadingOnes]
  | cons b xs ih => cases b <;> simp [leadingOnes,List.length_cons] ; omega
lemma replicate_append_false (m : ℕ) (xs : List Bool) :
    List.replicate m false ++ false::xs=List.replicate (m+1) false++xs := by
  rw [List.replicate_succ']; simp
lemma increment_carry (a b : Fin (k+8)) (hab : a≠b) (O : IndependenceOracle n)
    (R : Fin (k+8) → List Bool) (xs ys : List Bool) (q c : ℕ) (bits : ℕ → Bool) :
    execution (incrementProgram a b) O (workConfig (pairRegisters R a b xs ys) 0 q c) bits
      (2*leadingOnes xs+2)=
    workConfig (pairRegisters R a b (carryTail xs) (List.replicate (leadingOnes xs) false++ys))
      3 q (c+2*leadingOnes xs+2) := by
  induction xs generalizing ys c bits with
  | nil =>
    simp [leadingOnes,carryTail,execution,machineStep,incrementProgram,workConfig,
      pairRegisters_a _ _ _ hab,pairRegisters_update_a _ _ _ hab]
  | cons x xs ih =>
    cases x with
    | false =>
      simp [leadingOnes,carryTail,execution,machineStep,incrementProgram,workConfig,
        pairRegisters_a _ _ _ hab,pairRegisters_update_a _ _ _ hab]
    | true =>
      have ht : execution (incrementProgram a b) O (workConfig (pairRegisters R a b (true::xs) ys) 0 q c) bits 2 =
          workConfig (pairRegisters R a b xs (false::ys)) 0 q (c+2) := by
        simp [execution,machineStep,incrementProgram,workConfig,
          pairRegisters_a _ _ _ hab,pairRegisters_b,pairRegisters_update_a _ _ _ hab,pairRegisters_update_b]
      rw [leadingOnes,show 2*(leadingOnes xs+1)+2=2+(2*leadingOnes xs+2) by omega,execution_add,ht,ih]
      simp only [carryTail,replicate_append_false]
      congr 1 ; omega
lemma increment_restore (a b : Fin (k+8)) (hab : a≠b) (O : IndependenceOracle n)
    (R : Fin (k+8) → List Bool) (m : ℕ) (xs : List Bool) (q c : ℕ) (bits : ℕ → Bool) :
    execution (incrementProgram a b) O (workConfig (pairRegisters R a b xs (List.replicate m false)) 3 q c) bits
      (2*m+1)=workConfig (pairRegisters R a b (List.replicate m false++xs) []) 5 q (c+2*m+1) := by
  induction m generalizing xs c bits with
  | zero =>
    simp [execution,machineStep,incrementProgram,workConfig,pairRegisters_b]
  | succ m ih =>
    have ht : execution (incrementProgram a b) O
        (workConfig (pairRegisters R a b xs (List.replicate (m+1) false)) 3 q c) bits 2 =
        workConfig (pairRegisters R a b (false::xs) (List.replicate m false)) 3 q (c+2) := by
      simp [execution,machineStep,incrementProgram,workConfig,List.replicate_succ,
        pairRegisters_b,pairRegisters_a _ _ _ hab,pairRegisters_update_b,pairRegisters_update_a _ _ _ hab]
    rw [show 2*(m+1)+1=2+(2*m+1) by omega,execution_add,ht,ih,replicate_append_false]
    congr 1 ; omega
def incrementBits (xs : List Bool) : List Bool := List.replicate (leadingOnes xs) false ++ carryTail xs
lemma incrementBits_correct (xs : List Bool) : binaryValue (incrementBits xs)=binaryValue xs+1 := by
  induction xs with
  | nil => simp [incrementBits,leadingOnes,carryTail,binaryValue]
  | cons x xs ih =>
    cases x with
    | false => simp [incrementBits,leadingOnes,carryTail,binaryValue,Nat.add_comm]
    | true =>
      have he : incrementBits (true::xs)=false::incrementBits xs := by simp [incrementBits,leadingOnes,carryTail,List.replicate_succ]
      rw [he,binaryValue,binaryValue,ih]
      simp; omega

theorem increment_block (a b : Fin (k+8)) (hab : a≠b) (O : IndependenceOracle n)
    (R : Fin (k+8) → List Bool) (xs : List Bool) (q c : ℕ) (bits : ℕ → Bool) :
    execution (incrementProgram a b) O (workConfig (pairRegisters R a b xs []) 0 q c) bits
      (4*leadingOnes xs+3)=
      workConfig (pairRegisters R a b (incrementBits xs) []) 5 q (c+4*leadingOnes xs+3) ∧
    4*leadingOnes xs+3≤4*xs.length+3 ∧ binaryValue (incrementBits xs)=binaryValue xs+1 := by
  refine ⟨?_,by have h := leadingOnes_le xs; omega,incrementBits_correct xs⟩
  rw [show 4*leadingOnes xs+3=(2*leadingOnes xs+2)+(2*leadingOnes xs+1) by omega,execution_add,
    increment_carry a b hab]
  simp only [List.append_nil]
  rw [increment_restore a b hab]
  simp only [incrementBits]
  congr 1 ; omega

end

variable {k s t n : ℕ}
def Instruction.relabel (e : Fin (s+1) → Fin (t+1)) : Instruction k s → Instruction k t
  | .push i b j => .push i b (e j)
  | .pop i x y z => .pop i (e x) (e y) (e z)
  | .coin x y => .coin (e x) (e y)
  | .query w i x y => .query w i (e x) (e y)
  | .halt => .halt
def relabelConfig (e : Fin (s+1) → Fin (t+1)) (c : MachineConfig k s) : MachineConfig k t :=
  ⟨c.registers,e c.control,c.output,c.oracleCalls,c.bitOperations⟩
lemma machineStep_relabel (P : Program k s) (Q : Program k t) (e : Fin (s+1) → Fin (t+1))
    (O : IndependenceOracle n) (b : Bool) (c : MachineConfig k s)
    (h : Q (e c.control)=(P c.control).relabel e) :
    machineStep Q O b (relabelConfig e c)=relabelConfig e (machineStep P O b c) := by
  cases hc : c.output with
  | some z => simp [machineStep,relabelConfig,hc]
  | none =>
    cases hp : P c.control with
    | push i b j => simp [machineStep,relabelConfig,hc,h,hp,Instruction.relabel]
    | pop i x y z =>
      cases hl : c.registers i with
      | nil => simp [machineStep,relabelConfig,hc,h,hp,Instruction.relabel,hl]
      | cons a l => cases a <;> simp [machineStep,relabelConfig,hc,h,hp,Instruction.relabel,hl]
    | coin x y => cases b <;> simp [machineStep,relabelConfig,hc,h,hp,Instruction.relabel]
    | query w i x y =>
      by_cases hl : (c.registers i).length=n
      · simp [machineStep,relabelConfig,hc,h,hp,Instruction.relabel,hl,apply_ite]
      · simp [machineStep,relabelConfig,hc,h,hp,Instruction.relabel,hl]
    | halt => simp [machineStep,relabelConfig,hc,h,hp,Instruction.relabel]
lemma machineStep_none_pre (P : Program k s) (O : IndependenceOracle n) (b : Bool) (c : MachineConfig k s)
    (h : (machineStep P O b c).output=none) : c.output=none := by
  cases hc : c.output with
  | none => rfl
  | some z => simp [machineStep,hc] at h
lemma machineStep_none_not_halt (P : Program k s) (O : IndependenceOracle n) (b : Bool) (c : MachineConfig k s)
    (h : (machineStep P O b c).output=none) : P c.control≠.halt := by
  have hc := machineStep_none_pre P O b c h
  intro hh
  simp [machineStep,hc,hh] at h
lemma execution_relabel (P : Program k s) (Q : Program k t) (e : Fin (s+1) → Fin (t+1))
    (h : ∀ i,Q (e i)=(P i).relabel e) (O : IndependenceOracle n)
    (c : MachineConfig k s) (bits : ℕ → Bool) (u : ℕ) :
    execution Q O (relabelConfig e c) bits u=relabelConfig e (execution P O c bits u) := by
  induction u with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ u ih =>
    simp only [execution,ih]
    exact machineStep_relabel P Q e O _ _ (h _)
lemma execution_relabel_before_halt (P : Program k s) (Q : Program k t)
    (e : Fin (s+1) → Fin (t+1)) (exit : Fin (s+1)) (hexit : P exit=.halt)
    (h : ∀ i,i≠exit → Q (e i)=(P i).relabel e) (O : IndependenceOracle n)
    (c : MachineConfig k s) (bits : ℕ → Bool) (u : ℕ)
    (hu : (execution P O c bits u).output=none) :
    execution Q O (relabelConfig e c) bits u=relabelConfig e (execution P O c bits u) := by
  induction u with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ u ih =>
    have hn := machineStep_none_pre P O (bits u) (execution P O c bits u) hu
    have hh := machineStep_none_not_halt P O (bits u) (execution P O c bits u) hu
    have he : (execution P O c bits u).control≠exit := by intro he; rw [he,hexit] at hh; exact hh rfl
    simp only [execution,ih hn]
    exact machineStep_relabel P Q e O _ _ (h _ he)
def firstLabel (s t : ℕ) (i : Fin (s+1)) : Fin (s+t+1) := ⟨i.val,by omega⟩
def secondLabel (s t : ℕ) (i : Fin (t+1)) : Fin (s+t+1) := ⟨s+i.val,by omega⟩
def lastLabel (s : ℕ) : Fin (s+1) := ⟨s,by omega⟩

def concatProgram (P : Program k s) (Q : Program k t) : Program k (s+t) := fun i =>
  if hi : i.val<s then (P ⟨i.val,by omega⟩).relabel (firstLabel s t)
  else (Q ⟨i.val-s,by omega⟩).relabel (secondLabel s t)
lemma concatProgram_first (P : Program k s) (Q : Program k t) (i : Fin (s+1)) (hi : i≠lastLabel s) :
    concatProgram P Q (firstLabel s t i)=(P i).relabel (firstLabel s t) := by
  have hil : i.val<s := by
    have hh : i.val≠s := by intro he; apply hi; exact Fin.ext he
    omega
  simp [concatProgram,firstLabel,hil]
lemma concatProgram_second (P : Program k s) (Q : Program k t) (i : Fin (t+1)) :
    concatProgram P Q (secondLabel s t i)=(Q i).relabel (secondLabel s t) := by
  simp [concatProgram,secondLabel,show ¬s+i.val<s by omega]
lemma concat_first_run (P : Program k s) (Q : Program k t) (hexit : P (lastLabel s)=.halt)
    (O : IndependenceOracle n) (c : MachineConfig k s) (bits : ℕ → Bool) (u : ℕ)
    (hu : (execution P O c bits u).output=none) :
    execution (concatProgram P Q) O (relabelConfig (firstLabel s t) c) bits u=
      relabelConfig (firstLabel s t) (execution P O c bits u) :=
  execution_relabel_before_halt P _ _ _ hexit (concatProgram_first P Q) O c bits u hu
lemma concat_second_run (P : Program k s) (Q : Program k t)
    (O : IndependenceOracle n) (c : MachineConfig k t) (bits : ℕ → Bool) (u : ℕ) :
    execution (concatProgram P Q) O (relabelConfig (secondLabel s t) c) bits u=
      relabelConfig (secondLabel s t) (execution Q O c bits u) :=
  execution_relabel Q _ _ (concatProgram_second P Q) O c bits u

def restartControl (c : MachineConfig k s) (j : Fin (t+1)) : MachineConfig k t :=
  ⟨c.registers,j,c.output,c.oracleCalls,c.bitOperations⟩
lemma link_exit (c : MachineConfig k s) (hc : c.control=lastLabel s) :
    relabelConfig (firstLabel s t) c=relabelConfig (secondLabel s t) (restartControl c 0) := by
  cases c
  simp_all [relabelConfig,firstLabel,secondLabel,restartControl,lastLabel]

theorem concat_run (P : Program k s) (Q : Program k t) (hexit : P (lastLabel s)=.halt)
    (O : IndependenceOracle n) (c : MachineConfig k s) (bits : ℕ → Bool) (u v : ℕ)
    (hu : (execution P O c bits u).output=none)
    (hc : (execution P O c bits u).control=lastLabel s) :
    execution (concatProgram P Q) O (relabelConfig (firstLabel s t) c) bits (u+v)=
      relabelConfig (secondLabel s t)
        (execution Q O (restartControl (execution P O c bits u) 0) (fun i => bits (u+i)) v) := by
  rw [execution_add,concat_first_run P Q hexit O c bits u hu,link_exit _ hc,
    concat_second_run]

end

section
variable {k n : ℕ}
def tripleRegisters (R : Fin (k+8) → List Bool) (a b d : Fin (k+8)) (xs ys zs : List Bool) :=
  Function.update (pairRegisters R a b xs ys) d zs
lemma tripleRegisters_a (R : Fin (k+8) → List Bool) (a b d : Fin (k+8))
    (hab : a≠b) (had : a≠d) (xs ys zs : List Bool) : tripleRegisters R a b d xs ys zs a=xs := by
  simp [tripleRegisters,pairRegisters,hab,had]
lemma tripleRegisters_b (R : Fin (k+8) → List Bool) (a b d : Fin (k+8))
    (hbd : b≠d) (xs ys zs : List Bool) : tripleRegisters R a b d xs ys zs b=ys := by
  simp [tripleRegisters,pairRegisters,hbd]
lemma tripleRegisters_d (R : Fin (k+8) → List Bool) (a b d : Fin (k+8))
    (xs ys zs : List Bool) : tripleRegisters R a b d xs ys zs d=zs := by
  simp [tripleRegisters]
lemma tripleRegisters_update_a (R : Fin (k+8) → List Bool) (a b d : Fin (k+8))
    (hab : a≠b) (had : a≠d) (xs ys zs ws : List Bool) :
    Function.update (tripleRegisters R a b d xs ys zs) a ws=tripleRegisters R a b d ws ys zs := by
  funext i
  by_cases ha : i=a
  · subst i; simp [tripleRegisters,pairRegisters,hab,had]
  · by_cases hb : i=b
    · subst i; by_cases hbd : b=d <;> simp [tripleRegisters,pairRegisters,ha,hbd,Ne.symm had]
    · by_cases hd : i=d
      · subst i; simp [tripleRegisters,pairRegisters,ha]
      · simp [tripleRegisters,pairRegisters,ha,hb,hd]
lemma tripleRegisters_update_b (R : Fin (k+8) → List Bool) (a b d : Fin (k+8))
    (hbd : b≠d) (xs ys zs ws : List Bool) :
    Function.update (tripleRegisters R a b d xs ys zs) b ws=tripleRegisters R a b d xs ws zs := by
  funext i
  by_cases hb : i=b
  · subst i; simp [tripleRegisters,pairRegisters,hbd]
  · by_cases hd : i=d
    · subst i; simp [tripleRegisters,pairRegisters,hb]
    · simp [tripleRegisters,pairRegisters,hb,hd]
lemma tripleRegisters_update_d (R : Fin (k+8) → List Bool) (a b d : Fin (k+8))
    (xs ys zs ws : List Bool) :
    Function.update (tripleRegisters R a b d xs ys zs) d ws=tripleRegisters R a b d xs ys ws := by
  simp [tripleRegisters]
def copyConfig (R : Fin (k+8) → List Bool) (pc : Fin 9) (q c : ℕ) : MachineConfig k 8 :=
  ⟨R,pc,none,q,c⟩
def copyProgram (a b d : Fin (k+8)) : Program k 8 := fun pc =>
  match pc.val with
  | 0 => .pop a 3 1 2
  | 1 => .push b false 0
  | 2 => .push b true 0
  | 3 => .pop b 8 4 5
  | 4 => .push a false 6
  | 5 => .push a true 7
  | 6 => .push d false 3
  | 7 => .push d true 3
  | _ => .halt
lemma copy_scan (a b d : Fin (k+8)) (hab : a≠b) (had : a≠d) (hbd : b≠d)
    (O : IndependenceOracle n) (R : Fin (k+8) → List Bool) (xs ys zs : List Bool)
    (q c : ℕ) (bits : ℕ → Bool) :
    execution (copyProgram a b d) O (copyConfig (tripleRegisters R a b d xs ys zs) 0 q c) bits
      (2*xs.length+1)=copyConfig (tripleRegisters R a b d [] (xs.reverse++ys) zs) 3 q (c+2*xs.length+1) := by
  induction xs generalizing ys c bits with
  | nil => simp [execution,machineStep,copyProgram,copyConfig,tripleRegisters_a _ _ _ _ hab had]
  | cons x xs ih =>
    have ht : execution (copyProgram a b d) O (copyConfig (tripleRegisters R a b d (x::xs) ys zs) 0 q c) bits 2=
        copyConfig (tripleRegisters R a b d xs (x::ys) zs) 0 q (c+2) := by
      cases x <;> simp [execution,machineStep,copyProgram,copyConfig,tripleRegisters_a _ _ _ _ hab had,
        tripleRegisters_b _ _ _ _ hbd,tripleRegisters_update_a _ _ _ _ hab had,tripleRegisters_update_b _ _ _ _ hbd]
    rw [List.length_cons,show 2*(xs.length+1)+1=2+(2*xs.length+1) by omega,execution_add,ht,ih]
    simp only [List.reverse_cons,List.append_assoc,List.singleton_append]
    congr 1 ; omega
lemma copy_restore (a b d : Fin (k+8)) (hab : a≠b) (had : a≠d) (hbd : b≠d)
    (O : IndependenceOracle n) (R : Fin (k+8) → List Bool) (xs ys zs : List Bool)
    (q c : ℕ) (bits : ℕ → Bool) :
    execution (copyProgram a b d) O (copyConfig (tripleRegisters R a b d xs ys zs) 3 q c) bits
      (3*ys.length+1)=copyConfig (tripleRegisters R a b d (ys.reverse++xs) [] (ys.reverse++zs)) 8 q (c+3*ys.length+1) := by
  induction ys generalizing xs zs c bits with
  | nil => simp [execution,machineStep,copyProgram,copyConfig,tripleRegisters_b _ _ _ _ hbd]
  | cons y ys ih =>
    have ht : execution (copyProgram a b d) O (copyConfig (tripleRegisters R a b d xs (y::ys) zs) 3 q c) bits 3=
        copyConfig (tripleRegisters R a b d (y::xs) ys (y::zs)) 3 q (c+3) := by
      cases y <;> simp [execution,machineStep,copyProgram,copyConfig,tripleRegisters_a _ _ _ _ hab had,
        tripleRegisters_b _ _ _ _ hbd,tripleRegisters_d,tripleRegisters_update_a _ _ _ _ hab had,
        tripleRegisters_update_b _ _ _ _ hbd,tripleRegisters_update_d]
    rw [List.length_cons,show 3*(ys.length+1)+1=3+(3*ys.length+1) by omega,execution_add,ht,ih]
    simp only [List.reverse_cons,List.append_assoc,List.singleton_append]
    congr 1 ; omega

theorem copy_block (a b d : Fin (k+8)) (hab : a≠b) (had : a≠d) (hbd : b≠d)
    (O : IndependenceOracle n) (R : Fin (k+8) → List Bool) (xs zs : List Bool)
    (q c : ℕ) (bits : ℕ → Bool) :
    execution (copyProgram a b d) O (copyConfig (tripleRegisters R a b d xs [] zs) 0 q c) bits
      (5*xs.length+2)=copyConfig (tripleRegisters R a b d xs [] (xs++zs)) 8 q (c+5*xs.length+2) := by
  rw [show 5*xs.length+2=(2*xs.length+1)+(3*xs.length+1) by omega,execution_add,
    copy_scan a b d hab had hbd]
  simp only [List.append_nil]
  rw [←List.length_reverse (as:=xs),copy_restore a b d hab had hbd]
  simp only [List.reverse_reverse,List.length_reverse,List.append_nil]
  congr 1 ; omega

def sumDigit (x y c : Bool) : Bool := xor (xor x y) c
def sumCarry (x y c : Bool) : Bool := (x && y) || (x && c) || (y && c)
def addDigits (c : Bool) (xs ys : List Bool) : List Bool :=
  match xs,ys with
  | [],[] => if c then [true] else []
  | x::xs,[] => sumDigit x false c :: addDigits (sumCarry x false c) xs []
  | [],y::ys => sumDigit false y c :: addDigits (sumCarry false y c) [] ys
  | x::xs,y::ys => sumDigit x y c :: addDigits (sumCarry x y c) xs ys
termination_by xs.length+ys.length
def addCost (c : Bool) (xs ys : List Bool) : ℕ :=
  match xs,ys with
  | [],[] => if c then 3 else 2
  | x::xs,[] => 3+addCost (sumCarry x false c) xs []
  | [],y::ys => 3+addCost (sumCarry false y c) [] ys
  | x::xs,y::ys => 3+addCost (sumCarry x y c) xs ys
termination_by xs.length+ys.length
lemma addDigits_value (c : Bool) (xs ys : List Bool) :
    binaryValue (addDigits c xs ys)=binaryValue xs+binaryValue ys+(if c then 1 else 0) := by
  induction xs generalizing ys c with
  | nil =>
    induction ys generalizing c with
    | nil => cases c <;> simp [addDigits,binaryValue]
    | cons y ys ih =>
      simp only [addDigits,binaryValue,ih]
      cases y <;> cases c <;> simp [sumDigit,sumCarry] <;> omega
  | cons x xs ih =>
    cases ys with
    | nil =>
      simp only [addDigits,binaryValue,ih]
      cases x <;> cases c <;> simp [sumDigit,sumCarry] <;> omega
    | cons y ys =>
      simp only [addDigits,binaryValue,ih]
      cases x <;> cases y <;> cases c <;> simp [sumDigit,sumCarry] <;> omega
lemma addDigits_length_cost (c : Bool) (xs ys : List Bool) :
    (addDigits c xs ys).length≤xs.length+ys.length+1 ∧
      addCost c xs ys≤3*(xs.length+ys.length)+3 := by
  induction xs generalizing ys c with
  | nil =>
    induction ys generalizing c with
    | nil => cases c <;> simp [addDigits,addCost]
    | cons y ys ih =>
      have hi := ih (sumCarry false y c)
      simp only [addDigits,addCost,List.length_cons,List.length_nil] at *
      constructor <;> omega
  | cons x xs ih =>
    cases ys with
    | nil =>
      have hi := ih (sumCarry x false c) []
      simp only [addDigits,addCost,List.length_cons,List.length_nil] at *
      constructor <;> omega
    | cons y ys =>
      have hi := ih (sumCarry x y c) ys
      simp only [addDigits,addCost,List.length_cons] at *
      constructor <;> omega

def addConfig (R : Fin (k+8) → List Bool) (pc : Fin 17) (q c : ℕ) : MachineConfig k 16 :=
  ⟨R,pc,none,q,c⟩
def addProgram (a b d : Fin (k+8)) : Program k 16 := fun pc =>
  match pc.val with
  | 0 => .pop a 2 3 4
  | 1 => .pop a 5 6 7
  | 2 => .pop b 12 8 9
  | 3 => .pop b 8 8 9
  | 4 => .pop b 9 9 10
  | 5 => .pop b 13 9 10
  | 6 => .pop b 9 9 10
  | 7 => .pop b 10 10 11
  | 8 => .push d false 0
  | 9 => .push d true 0
  | 10 => .push d false 1
  | 11 => .push d true 1
  | 12 => .pop d 16 14 15
  | 13 => .push d true 12
  | 14 => .push a false 12
  | 15 => .push a true 12
  | _ => .halt
lemma add_build (a b d : Fin (k+8)) (hab : a≠b) (had : a≠d) (hbd : b≠d)
    (O : IndependenceOracle n) (R : Fin (k+8) → List Bool) (xs ys zs : List Bool)
    (carry : Bool) (q c : ℕ) (bits : ℕ → Bool) :
    execution (addProgram a b d) O
      (addConfig (tripleRegisters R a b d xs ys zs) (if carry then 1 else 0) q c) bits
      (addCost carry xs ys)=addConfig
        (tripleRegisters R a b d [] [] ((addDigits carry xs ys).reverse++zs)) 12 q (c+addCost carry xs ys) := by
  induction xs generalizing ys zs carry c bits with
  | nil =>
    induction ys generalizing zs carry c bits with
    | nil =>
      cases carry <;> simp [addCost,addDigits,execution,machineStep,addProgram,addConfig,
        tripleRegisters_a _ _ _ _ hab had,tripleRegisters_b _ _ _ _ hbd,tripleRegisters_d,
        tripleRegisters_update_d]
    | cons y ys ih =>
      have ht : execution (addProgram a b d) O
          (addConfig (tripleRegisters R a b d [] (y::ys) zs) (if carry then 1 else 0) q c) bits 3=
          addConfig (tripleRegisters R a b d [] ys (sumDigit false y carry::zs))
            (if sumCarry false y carry then 1 else 0) q (c+3) := by
        cases y <;> cases carry <;> simp [execution,machineStep,addProgram,addConfig,sumDigit,sumCarry,
          tripleRegisters_a _ _ _ _ hab had,tripleRegisters_b _ _ _ _ hbd,tripleRegisters_d,
          tripleRegisters_update_b _ _ _ _ hbd,tripleRegisters_update_d]
      rw [addCost,execution_add,ht,ih]
      simp only [addDigits,List.reverse_cons,List.append_assoc,List.singleton_append]
      congr 1 ; omega
  | cons x xs ih =>
    cases ys with
    | nil =>
      have ht : execution (addProgram a b d) O
          (addConfig (tripleRegisters R a b d (x::xs) [] zs) (if carry then 1 else 0) q c) bits 3=
          addConfig (tripleRegisters R a b d xs [] (sumDigit x false carry::zs))
            (if sumCarry x false carry then 1 else 0) q (c+3) := by
        cases x <;> cases carry <;> simp [execution,machineStep,addProgram,addConfig,sumDigit,sumCarry,
          tripleRegisters_a _ _ _ _ hab had,tripleRegisters_b _ _ _ _ hbd,tripleRegisters_d,
          tripleRegisters_update_a _ _ _ _ hab had,tripleRegisters_update_d]
      rw [addCost,execution_add,ht,ih]
      simp only [addDigits,List.reverse_cons,List.append_assoc,List.singleton_append]
      congr 1 ; omega
    | cons y ys =>
      have ht : execution (addProgram a b d) O
          (addConfig (tripleRegisters R a b d (x::xs) (y::ys) zs) (if carry then 1 else 0) q c) bits 3=
          addConfig (tripleRegisters R a b d xs ys (sumDigit x y carry::zs))
            (if sumCarry x y carry then 1 else 0) q (c+3) := by
        cases x <;> cases y <;> cases carry <;> simp [execution,machineStep,addProgram,addConfig,sumDigit,sumCarry,
          tripleRegisters_a _ _ _ _ hab had,tripleRegisters_b _ _ _ _ hbd,tripleRegisters_d,
          tripleRegisters_update_a _ _ _ _ hab had,tripleRegisters_update_b _ _ _ _ hbd,
          tripleRegisters_update_d]
      rw [addCost,execution_add,ht,ih]
      simp only [addDigits,List.reverse_cons,List.append_assoc,List.singleton_append]
      congr 1 ; omega
lemma add_restore (a b d : Fin (k+8)) (hab : a≠b) (had : a≠d) (_ : b≠d)
    (O : IndependenceOracle n) (R : Fin (k+8) → List Bool) (xs ys zs : List Bool)
    (q c : ℕ) (bits : ℕ → Bool) :
    execution (addProgram a b d) O (addConfig (tripleRegisters R a b d xs ys zs) 12 q c) bits
      (2*zs.length+1)=addConfig (tripleRegisters R a b d (zs.reverse++xs) ys []) 16 q (c+2*zs.length+1) := by
  induction zs generalizing xs c bits with
  | nil => simp [execution,machineStep,addProgram,addConfig,tripleRegisters_d]
  | cons z zs ih =>
    have ht : execution (addProgram a b d) O (addConfig (tripleRegisters R a b d xs ys (z::zs)) 12 q c) bits 2=
        addConfig (tripleRegisters R a b d (z::xs) ys zs) 12 q (c+2) := by
      cases z <;> simp [execution,machineStep,addProgram,addConfig,tripleRegisters_a _ _ _ _ hab had,
        tripleRegisters_d,tripleRegisters_update_a _ _ _ _ hab had,tripleRegisters_update_d]
    rw [List.length_cons,show 2*(zs.length+1)+1=2+(2*zs.length+1) by omega,execution_add,ht,ih]
    simp only [List.reverse_cons,List.append_assoc,List.singleton_append]
    congr 1 ; omega

theorem addition_block (a b d : Fin (k+8)) (hab : a≠b) (had : a≠d) (hbd : b≠d)
    (O : IndependenceOracle n) (R : Fin (k+8) → List Bool) (xs ys : List Bool)
    (q c : ℕ) (bits : ℕ → Bool) :
    let z := addDigits false xs ys
    let t := addCost false xs ys+2*z.length+1
    binaryValue z=binaryValue xs+binaryValue ys ∧ t≤5*(xs.length+ys.length)+6 ∧
      execution (addProgram a b d) O (addConfig (tripleRegisters R a b d xs ys []) 0 q c) bits t=
        addConfig (tripleRegisters R a b d z [] []) 16 q (c+t) := by
  dsimp only
  refine ⟨by simpa using addDigits_value false xs ys,?_,?_⟩
  · have h := addDigits_length_cost false xs ys
    omega
  · rw [show addCost false xs ys+2*(addDigits false xs ys).length+1=
        addCost false xs ys+(2*(addDigits false xs ys).length+1) by omega,execution_add]
    rw [show (0 : Fin 17)=(if false then 1 else 0) by rfl,add_build a b d hab had hbd]
    simp only [List.append_nil]
    rw [←List.length_reverse (as:=addDigits false xs ys),add_restore a b d hab had hbd]
    simp only [List.reverse_reverse,List.length_reverse,List.append_nil]
    congr 1 ; omega

lemma addDigits_length_max (c : Bool) (xs ys : List Bool) :
    (addDigits c xs ys).length≤ max xs.length ys.length+1 := by
  induction xs generalizing c ys with
  | nil =>
    induction ys generalizing c with
    | nil => cases c <;> simp [addDigits]
    | cons y ys ih =>
      have h := ih (sumCarry false y c)
      simp only [addDigits,List.length_cons,List.length_nil,Nat.zero_max] at *
      omega
  | cons x xs ih =>
    cases ys with
    | nil =>
      have h := ih (sumCarry x false c) []
      simp only [addDigits,List.length_cons,List.length_nil,Nat.max_zero] at *
      omega
    | cons y ys =>
      have h := ih (sumCarry x y c) ys
      simp only [addDigits,List.length_cons] at *
      omega

lemma workReg_ne {a b : ℕ} (ha : a<k+8) (hb : b<k+8) (hne : a≠b) :
    Fin.ofNat (k+8) a≠Fin.ofNat (k+8) b := by

  change a%(k+8)=b%(k+8) at hh
  rw [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt ha,Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hb] at hh
  exact hne hh
