  intro q w
  induction x generalizing y w bits with
  | nil => simp [execution,machineStep,boolListBlock,state,lastLabel]
  | cons b xs ih =>
    have hh : execution boolListBlock.code O
        (state (regs (words (y.map (fun b => [b]))) (b::xs) [] s) 0 q w) bits 5=
        state (regs (words ((b::y).map (fun b => [b]))) xs [] s) 0 q (w+5) := by
      cases b <;> simp [execution,machineStep,boolListBlock,state,words,pair,bitFrame,Nat.add_assoc] <;> rfl
    rw [List.length_cons,show 5*(xs.length+1)+1=5+(5*xs.length+1) by omega,execution_add,hh,ih]
    simp only [List.reverse_cons,List.append_assoc,List.singleton_append]
    congr 1; omega

def boolListCode : Block 1 := seq (reverse 0 1) boolListBlock
lemma computes_boolList {n : ℕ} (O : IndependenceOracle n) (x : Word) :
    Computes boolListCode O x (words (x.map (fun b => [b]))) (7*x.length+2) 0 (7*x.length+2) := by
  intro s bits
  have hr := runs_reverse (k:=1) 0 1 (by decide) O (regs [] [] [] s) x [] bits
  simp only [pairRegisters,update_regs_zero,update_regs_one,List.append_nil] at hr
  have hb := runs_boolList O x.reverse [] s (fun i => bits (2*x.length+1+i))
  simp only [List.map_nil,words,List.reverse_reverse,List.append_nil,List.length_reverse] at hb
  have ht := runs_seq O bits hr hb
  convert ht using 1 <;> first | rfl | omega

def consWordCode : Block 1 := seq (unpack 0 1)
  (fork (.pop 1 false false true) (push 0 false) (push 0 true))
lemma computes_consWord {n : ℕ} (O : IndependenceOracle n) (b : Bool) (x : Word) :
    Computes consWordCode O (pair [b] x) (b::x) 6 0 6 := by
  have h (b : Bool) : Computes (push 0 b) O x (b::x) 1 0 1 := by
    intro s bits
    simpa only [regs_zero,update_regs_zero] using runs_push O bits (regs x [] [] s) 0 b
  have ht := computes_select (push 0 false) (push 0 true) b (x:=x) (y:=b::x) (by cases b <;> exact h _)
  exact ht

def consListCode : Block 1 := push 0 true
lemma computes_consList {n : ℕ} (O : IndependenceOracle n) (x : Word) (xs : List Word) :
    Computes consListCode O (pair x (words xs)) (words (x::xs)) 1 0 1 := by
  intro s bits
  simpa only [regs_zero,update_regs_zero,consListCode,words] using runs_push O bits (regs (pair x (words xs)) [] [] s) 0 true

def appendCode : Block 1 := seq (unpack 0 1) (move 1 2 0)
lemma computes_append {n : ℕ} (O : IndependenceOracle n) (x y : Word) :
    Computes appendCode O (pair x y) (x++y) (7*x.length+3) 0 (7*x.length+3) := by
  intro s bits
  have hs := split_pair O x y [] s bits
  simp only [List.append_nil] at hs
  have hm := move_one_zero O x y s (fun i => bits (3*x.length+1+i))
  simpa only [appendCode,Nat.zero_add,show 3*x.length+1+(4*x.length+2)=7*x.length+3 by omega] using
    runs_seq O bits hs hm

def subBlock : Block 1 := ⟨16,subProgram 1 0 2,rfl⟩
def subTime (x y : Word) : ℕ := subCost false x y+2*(subDigits false x y).length+1
lemma runs_sub {n : ℕ} (O : IndependenceOracle n) (x y s : Word)
    (hxy : binaryValue y≤binaryValue x) (bits : ℕ → Bool) :
    Runs subBlock O bits (regs y x [] s) (regs [] (subDigits false x y) [] s)
      (subTime x y) 0 (subTime x y) := by
  dsimp only [Runs,subBlock]
  intro q w
  have h := (subtraction_block (k:=1) 1 0 2 (by decide) (by decide) (by decide) O
    (regs [] [] [] s) x y hxy q w bits).2.2
  convert h using 1 <;> simp only [subTime,subConfig,state,tripleRegisters,pairRegisters,update_regs_zero,
    update_regs_one,update_regs_two,lastLabel,Nat.add_zero]
  rfl

def subCode : Block 1 := seq (unpack 0 1) (seq subBlock (seq (move 1 2 0) normalCode))
lemma computes_sub {n : ℕ} (O : IndependenceOracle n) (x y : Word)
    (hxy : binaryValue y≤binaryValue x) :
    Computes subCode O (pair x y) (binaryValue x-binaryValue y).bits
      (3*x.length+1+subTime x y+4*(subDigits false x y).length+2+normalCost (subDigits false x y)) 0
      (3*x.length+1+subTime x y+4*(subDigits false x y).length+2+normalCost (subDigits false x y)) := by
  have hv := (subtraction_block (k:=1) 1 0 2 (by decide) (by decide) (by decide) O
    (regs [] [] [] []) x y hxy 0 0 (fun _ => false)).1
  intro s bits
  have hs := split_pair O x y [] s bits
  simp only [List.append_nil] at hs
  have hd := runs_sub O x y s hxy (fun i => bits (3*x.length+1+i))
  have hm := move_one_zero O (subDigits false x y) [] s (fun i => bits (3*x.length+1+(subTime x y+i)))
  simp only [List.append_nil] at hm
  have hn := computes_normalCode O (subDigits false x y) s
    (fun i => bits (3*x.length+1+(subTime x y+(4*(subDigits false x y).length+2+i))))
  rw [normalWord_eq_bits,hv] at hn
  have hh := runs_seq O bits hs (runs_seq O _ hd (runs_seq O _ hm hn))
  convert hh using 1 <;> first | rfl | omega
lemma bounded_sub {n : ℕ} (O : IndependenceOracle n) (x y : Word)
    (hxy : binaryValue y≤binaryValue x) :
    Bounded subCode O (pair x y) (binaryValue x-binaryValue y).bits (30*(x.length+y.length+1)) := by
  have h₁ := subDigits_length_cost false x y
  have h₂ := normalCost_le (subDigits false x y)
  refine ⟨_,0,_,?_,Nat.zero_le _,?_,computes_sub O x y hxy⟩ <;> dsimp only [subTime] <;> omega

def rankPrep : Block 1 where
  size := 5
  code := fun pc => match pc.val with
    | 0 => .pop 0 5 1 3
    | 1 => .push 2 false 2
    | 2 => .push 1 false 0
    | 3 => .push 2 true 4
    | 4 => .push 1 false 0
    | _ => .halt
  exit_halt := rfl
lemma runs_rankPrep {n : ℕ} (O : IndependenceOracle n) (x y z s : Word) (bits : ℕ → Bool) :
    Runs rankPrep O bits (regs x y z s)
      (regs [] (List.replicate x.length false++y) (x.reverse++z) s) (3*x.length+1) 0 (3*x.length+1) := by
  dsimp only [Runs]
  intro q w
  induction x generalizing y z w bits with
  | nil => simp [execution,machineStep,rankPrep,state,lastLabel]
  | cons b xs ih =>
    have h : execution rankPrep.code O (state (regs (b::xs) y z s) 0 q w) bits 3=
        state (regs xs (false::y) (b::z) s) 0 q (w+3) := by
      cases b <;> simp [execution,machineStep,rankPrep,state,Nat.add_assoc] <;> rfl
    rw [List.length_cons,show 3*(xs.length+1)+1=3+(3*xs.length+1) by omega,execution_add,h,ih]
    simp only [List.reverse_cons,List.append_assoc,List.singleton_append,Nat.add_zero]
    congr 1
    · simp [List.replicate_add,List.append_assoc]
    · omega

lemma update_regs_three_empty (x y z s : Word) : Function.update (regs x y z s) 3 []=regs x y z s := by
  funext i; fin_cases i <;> simp [regs]
lemma greedyRegisters_regs (x y z s : Word) : greedyRegisters (regs [] [] [] s) x y z []=regs x y z s := by
  funext i; fin_cases i <;> simp [greedyRegisters,regs]

def readyRank (which : Bool) : Block 1 := ⟨32,rankProgram which,rfl⟩
def rankCode (which : Bool) : Block 1 := seq rankPrep (seq (move 2 3 0) (seq (readyRank which) normalCode))
def rankWord {n : ℕ} (O : IndependenceOracle n) (which : Bool) (x : Word) : ℕ :=
  binaryValue (rankBits which O x.reverse)
lemma popcountBits_length (xs ys : Word) : (popcountBits xs ys).length≤xs.length+ys.length := by
  induction xs generalizing ys with
  | nil => simp [popcountBits]
  | cons b xs ih =>
    cases b with
    | false => simpa only [popcountBits,Bool.false_eq_true,ite_false,List.length_cons] using
        (ih ys).trans (by omega)
    | true =>
      have h := ih (incrementBits ys)
      have hi := incrementBits_length ys
      simp only [popcountBits,ite_true,List.length_cons]
      omega
lemma rankBits_length {n : ℕ} (O : IndependenceOracle n) (which : Bool) (x : Word) :
    (rankBits which O x).length≤x.length := by
  simpa only [rankBits,wordGreedy_length,List.length_nil,Nat.add_zero] using
    popcountBits_length (wordGreedy (wordOracle which O) x []) []
lemma computes_rank {n : ℕ} (O : IndependenceOracle n) (which : Bool) (x : Word) (hx : x.length=n) :
    Computes (rankCode which) O x (rankWord O which x).bits
      (7*n+3+rankTime which O x.reverse+normalCost (rankBits which O x.reverse))
      (greedyCalls x.reverse)
      (7*n+3+rankWork which O x.reverse+normalCost (rankBits which O x.reverse)) := by
  intro s bits
  have hp := runs_rankPrep O x [] [] s bits
  simp only [hx,List.append_nil] at hp
  have hm := runs_move (k:=1) 2 3 0 (by decide) (by decide) (by decide) O
    (regs [] (List.replicate n false) [] s) x.reverse [] (fun i => bits (3*n+1+i))
  simp only [tripleRegisters,pairRegisters,update_regs_zero,update_regs_two,update_regs_three_empty,
    List.append_nil,List.length_reverse,hx] at hm
  have hr : Runs (readyRank which) O (fun i => bits (3*n+1+(4*n+2+i)))
      (regs x.reverse (List.replicate n false) [] s) (regs (rankBits which O x.reverse) [] [] s)
      (rankTime which O x.reverse) (greedyCalls x.reverse) (rankWork which O x.reverse) := by
    intro q w
    convert rank_run which O (regs [] [] [] s) x.reverse (by simpa only [List.length_reverse] using hx) q w (fun i => bits (3*n+1+(4*n+2+i))) using 1 <;>
      (try simp only [readyRank,state,rankConfig,greedyRegisters_regs,lastLabel]) <;> rfl
  have hn := computes_normalCode O (rankBits which O x.reverse) s
    (fun i => bits (3*n+1+(4*n+2+(rankTime which O x.reverse+i))))
  rw [normalWord_eq_bits] at hn
  have hh := runs_seq O bits hp (runs_seq O _ hm (runs_seq O _ hr hn))
  convert hh using 1 <;> first | rfl | omega
lemma bounded_rank {n : ℕ} (O : IndependenceOracle n) (which : Bool) (x : Word) (hx : x.length=n) :
    Bounded (rankCode which) O x (rankWord O which x).bits (100*(n+1)^2) := by
  have hr : x.reverse.length=n := by simpa only [List.length_reverse] using hx
  have ht := rankTime_bound which O x.reverse hr
  have hw := rankWork_bound which O x.reverse hr
  have hl := rankBits_length O which x.reverse
  have hn := normalCost_le (rankBits which O x.reverse)
  have hq := greedyCalls_bound x.reverse
  simp only [List.length_reverse,hx] at hl hq
  refine ⟨_,_,_,?_,?_,?_,computes_rank O which x hx⟩ <;> nlinarith

lemma rankWord_correct {n : ℕ} (M₁ M₂ : Matroid (Fin n)) (O : IndependenceOracle n)
    (hO : ExactOracles M₁ M₂ O) (hE₁ : M₁.E=Set.univ) (hE₂ : M₂.E=Set.univ)
    (which : Bool) (x : Word) (hx : x.length=n) :
    rankWord O which x=((if which then M₂ else M₁).eRk (wordSet n x)).toNat := by
  simp only [rankWord,rankBits,popcount_value,binaryValue,Nat.zero_add]
  have hr := wordGreedy_rank (if which then M₂ else M₁) (by cases which <;> assumption)
    (wordOracle which O) (fun l _ => hO which (fun i => l[i.val]?.getD false)) x.reverse
    (by simpa only [List.length_reverse] using hx)
  simpa only [List.reverse_reverse] using hr
open scoped Classical in
lemma rankWord_eq_rankOracle {n : ℕ} (M₁ M₂ : Matroid (Fin n)) (O : IndependenceOracle n)
    (hO : ExactOracles M₁ M₂ O) (hE₁ : M₁.E=Set.univ) (hE₂ : M₂.E=Set.univ)
    (which : Bool) (x : Word) (hx : x.length=n) :
    rankWord O which x=rankOracle O which (wordSet n x).toFinset := by
  classical
  rw [rankWord_correct M₁ M₂ O hO hE₁ hE₂ which x hx,
    rankOracle_correct M₁ M₂ O hO hE₁ hE₂ which,Set.coe_toFinset]

inductive DataType where
  | unit | bool | nat | word
  | prod : DataType → DataType → DataType
  | list : DataType → DataType

@[reducible] def Value : DataType → Type
  | .unit => Unit
  | .bool => Bool
  | .nat => ℕ
  | .word => Word
  | .prod a b => Value a × Value b
  | .list a => List (Value a)

def encode : {a : DataType} → Value a → Word
  | .unit,_ => []
  | .bool,b => [b]
  | .nat,m => m.bits
  | .word,w => w
  | .prod _ _,(x,y) => pair (encode x) (encode y)
  | .list _,xs => words (xs.map encode)

def width {a : DataType} (x : Value a) : ℕ := (encode x).length

inductive Expression : DataType → DataType → Type where
  | ident {a} : Expression a a
  | constant {a b} : Value b → Expression a b
  | compose {a b c} : Expression a b → Expression b c → Expression a c
  | both {a b c} : Expression a b → Expression a c → Expression a (.prod b c)
  | fst {a b} : Expression (.prod a b) a
  | snd {a b} : Expression (.prod a b) b
  | branch {a b} : Expression a b → Expression a b → Expression (.prod .bool a) b
  | fold {a b} : Expression (.prod a b) b → Expression (.prod (.list a) b) b
  | cons {a} : Expression (.prod a (.list a)) (.list a)
  | consBit : Expression (.prod .bool .word) .word
  | append : Expression (.prod .word .word) .word
  | reverse : Expression .word .word
  | toList : Expression .word (.list .bool)
  | toBits : Expression .nat .word
  | toNat : Expression .word .nat
  | add : Expression (.prod .nat .nat) .nat
  | sub : Expression (.prod .nat .nat) .nat
  | rank : Bool → Expression .word .nat
  | mul : Expression (.prod .nat .nat) .nat
  | less : Expression (.prod .nat .nat) .bool
  | divRem : Expression (.prod .nat .nat) (.prod .nat .nat)
  | query : Bool → Expression .word .bool

def compile : {a b : DataType} → Expression a b → Block 1
  | _,_,.ident => skip 1
  | _,_,.constant x => constCode (encode x)
  | _,_,.compose p q => seq (compile p) (compile q)
  | _,_,.both p q => fanout (compile p) (compile q)
  | _,_,.fst => first
  | _,_,.snd => second
  | _,_,.branch p q => selectCode (compile p) (compile q)
  | _,_,.fold p => foldCode (compile p)
  | _,_,.cons => consListCode
  | _,_,.consBit => consWordCode
  | _,_,.append => appendCode
  | _,_,.reverse => reverseCode
  | _,_,.toList => boolListCode
  | _,_,.toBits => skip 1
  | _,_,.toNat => normalCode
  | _,_,.add => addCode
  | _,_,.sub => subCode
  | _,_,.rank b => rankCode b
  | _,_,.mul => mulCode
  | _,_,.less => cmpCode
  | _,_,.divRem => divCode
  | _,_,.query b => queryCode b

def evalFold {a b : DataType} (step : Value (.prod a b) → Option (Value b × ℕ)) :
    List (Value a) → Value b → Option (Value b × ℕ)
  | [],z => some (z,0)
  | x::xs,z => do
    let (z',c) ← step (x,z)
    let (y,d) ← evalFold step xs z'
    pure (y,7+6*width x+6*width (a:=.list a) xs+c+d)

def evaluate {n : ℕ} (O : IndependenceOracle n) : {a b : DataType} → Expression a b →
    Value a → Option (Value b × ℕ)
  | _,_,.ident,x => some (x,0)
  | _,_,.constant y,x => some (y,width x+width y+1)
  | _,_,.compose p q,x => do
    let (y,c) ← evaluate O p x
    let (z,d) ← evaluate O q y
    pure (z,c+d)
  | _,_,.both p q,x => do
    let (y,c) ← evaluate O p x
    let (z,d) ← evaluate O q x
    pure ((y,z),43*width x+39*width y+18*width z+50+c+d)
  | _,_,.fst,(x,y) => some (x,7*width x+width y+4)
  | _,_,.snd,(x,y) => some (y,4*width x+2)
  | _,_,.branch p q,(b,x) => do
    let (y,c) ← (if b then evaluate O q x else evaluate O p x)
    pure (y,5+c)
  | _,_,.fold p,(xs,z) => do
    let (y,c) ← evalFold (evaluate O p) xs z
    pure (y,3*width xs+2+c)
  | _,_,.cons,(x,xs) => some (x::xs,1)
  | _,_,.consBit,(b,xs) => some (b::xs,6)
  | _,_,.append,(x,y) => some (x++y,7*x.length+3)
  | _,_,.reverse,x => some (x.reverse,6*x.length+3)
  | _,_,.toList,x => some (x,7*x.length+2)
  | _,_,.toBits,x => some (x.bits,0)
  | _,_,.toNat,x => some (binaryValue x,5*x.length+4)
  | _,_,.add,(x,y) => some (x+y,20*(x.bits.length+y.bits.length+1))
  | _,_,.sub,(x,y) => if y≤x then some (x-y,30*(x.bits.length+y.bits.length+1)) else none
  | _,_,.rank b,x => if x.length=n then some (rankWord O b x,100*(n+1)^2) else none
  | _,_,.mul,(x,y) => some (x*y,60*(x.bits.length+y.bits.length+1)^2)
  | _,_,.less,(x,y) => some (decide (x<y),5*(x.bits.length+y.bits.length+1))
  | _,_,.divRem,(x,y) => if x=0 then none else
      some ((y%x,y/x),300*(x.bits.length+y.bits.length+1)^2)
  | _,_,.query b,x => if x.length=n then
      some (O b (fun i => x[i.val]?.getD false),3*n+3) else none

lemma bounded_fanout {n : ℕ} {O : IndependenceOracle n} {p q : Block 1} {x y z : Word} {B C : ℕ}
    (h : Bounded p O x y B) (g : Bounded q O x z C) :
    Bounded (fanout p q) O x (pair y z) (43*x.length+39*y.length+18*z.length+50+B+C) := by
  obtain ⟨t,a,w,ht,ha,hw,hp⟩ := h
  obtain ⟨u,b,v,hu,hb,hv,hq⟩ := g
  refine ⟨_,_,_,?_,?_,?_,computes_fanout hp hq⟩ <;> omega
lemma bounded_select {n : ℕ} {O : IndependenceOracle n} (p q : Block 1) (b : Bool) {x y : Word} {B : ℕ}
    (h : Bounded (if b then q else p) O x y B) :
    Bounded (selectCode p q) O (pair [b] x) y (5+B) := by
  obtain ⟨t,a,w,ht,ha,hw,hp⟩ := h
  refine ⟨_,_,_,?_,?_,?_,computes_select p q b hp⟩ <;> omega

lemma computes_bounded {n : ℕ} {O : IndependenceOracle n} {p : Block 1} {x y : Word} {c : ℕ}
    (h : Computes p O x y c 0 c) : Bounded p O x y c :=
  ⟨c,0,c,le_rfl,Nat.zero_le _,le_rfl,h⟩

lemma evalFold_loop {n : ℕ} {O : IndependenceOracle n} {a b : DataType}
    (p : Block 1) (f : Value (.prod a b) → Option (Value b × ℕ))
    (hf : ∀ x y c, f x=some (y,c) → Bounded p O (encode x) (encode y) c)
    (xs : List (Value a)) (z y : Value b) (c : ℕ) (h : evalFold f xs z=some (y,c)) :
    ∃ t q w, t≤1+c ∧ q≤c ∧ w≤1+c ∧ ∀ s bits,
      Runs (repeatBlock (listBody p) 1) O bits (regs (encode z) (encode (a:=.list a) xs) [] s)
        (regs (encode y) [] [] s) t q w := by
  induction xs generalizing z y c with
  | nil =>
    simp only [evalFold,Option.some.injEq,Prod.mk.injEq] at h
    rcases h with ⟨rfl,rfl⟩
    refine ⟨1,0,1,by omega,by omega,by omega,?_⟩
    intro s bits
    dsimp only [Runs, repeatBlock]
    intro q w
    simpa only [repeatBlock,state,loopConfig,encode,List.map_nil,words,Nat.add_zero,update_regs_one] using
      repeatProgram_empty (listBody p).code 1 O (regs (encode z) [] [] s) q w bits
  | cons x xs ih =>
    cases h₁ : f (x,z) with
    | none => simp [evalFold,h₁] at h
    | some r =>
      rcases r with ⟨z',c₁⟩
      cases h₂ : evalFold f xs z' with
      | none => simp [evalFold,h₁,h₂] at h
      | some r =>
        rcases r with ⟨y',c₂⟩
        simp [evalFold,h₁,h₂] at h
        rcases h with ⟨rfl,rfl⟩
        obtain ⟨t₁,q₁,w₁,ht₁,hq₁,hw₁,hp⟩ := hf _ _ _ h₁
        obtain ⟨t₂,q₂,w₂,ht₂,hq₂,hw₂,hr⟩ := ih z' y' c₂ h₂
        refine ⟨7+6*width x+6*width (a:=.list a) xs+t₁+t₂,q₁+q₂,
          7+6*width x+6*width (a:=.list a) xs+w₁+w₂,by omega,by omega,by omega,?_⟩
        intro s bits
        have hb := list_body hp (encode (a:=.list a) xs) s (fun i => bits (1+i))
        have hh := runs_repeat_cons (R:=regs (encode z) [] [] s) (b:=true)
          (by simpa only [update_regs_one] using hb)
          (hr s (fun i => bits (1+(6*(encode x).length+6*(encode (a:=.list a) xs).length+6+t₁)+i)))
        simp only [update_regs_one] at hh
        convert hh using 1 <;> first | rfl | (dsimp only [width]; omega)

lemma evalFold_bounded {n : ℕ} {O : IndependenceOracle n} {a b : DataType}
    (p : Block 1) (f : Value (.prod a b) → Option (Value b × ℕ))
    (hf : ∀ x y c, f x=some (y,c) → Bounded p O (encode x) (encode y) c)
    (xs : List (Value a)) (z y : Value b) (c : ℕ) (h : evalFold f xs z=some (y,c)) :
    Bounded (foldCode p) O (encode (a:=.prod (.list a) b) (xs,z)) (encode y) (3*width (a:=.list a) xs+2+c) := by
  obtain ⟨t,q,w,ht,hq,hw,hl⟩ := evalFold_loop p f hf xs z y c h
  refine ⟨3*width (a:=.list a) xs+1+t,q,3*width (a:=.list a) xs+1+w,by omega,by omega,by omega,?_⟩
  intro s bits
  have hs := split_pair O (encode (a:=.list a) xs) (encode z) [] s bits
  simp only [List.append_nil] at hs
  simpa only [Nat.zero_add, foldCode, encode, width] using runs_seq O bits hs (hl s (fun i => bits (3*width (a:=.list a) xs+1+i)))

theorem compile_correct {n : ℕ} (O : IndependenceOracle n) {a b : DataType}
    (e : Expression a b) : ∀ x y c, evaluate O e x=some (y,c) →
      Bounded (compile e) O (encode x) (encode y) c := by
  induction e with
  | ident =>
    intro x y c h
    simp only [evaluate,Option.some.injEq,Prod.mk.injEq] at h
    rcases h with ⟨rfl,rfl⟩
    exact computes_bounded (computes_skip O _)
  | constant v =>
    intro x y c h
    simp only [evaluate,Option.some.injEq,Prod.mk.injEq] at h
    rcases h with ⟨rfl,rfl⟩
    exact computes_bounded (computes_const O _ _)
  | compose p q ihp ihq =>
    intro x y c h
    cases hp : evaluate O p x with
    | none => simp [evaluate,hp] at h
    | some r =>
      rcases r with ⟨z,d⟩
      cases hq : evaluate O q z with
      | none => simp [evaluate,hp,hq] at h
      | some r =>
        rcases r with ⟨v,f⟩
        simp [evaluate,hp,hq] at h
        rcases h with ⟨rfl,rfl⟩
        exact bounded_seq (ihp _ _ _ hp) (ihq _ _ _ hq)
  | both p q ihp ihq =>
    intro x y c h
    cases hp : evaluate O p x with
    | none => simp [evaluate,hp] at h
    | some r =>
      rcases r with ⟨z,d⟩
      cases hq : evaluate O q x with
      | none => simp [evaluate,hp,hq] at h
      | some r =>
        rcases r with ⟨v,f⟩
        simp [evaluate,hp,hq] at h
        rcases h with ⟨rfl,rfl⟩
        exact bounded_fanout (ihp _ _ _ hp) (ihq _ _ _ hq)
  | fst =>
    intro ⟨x,z⟩ y c h
    simp only [evaluate,Option.some.injEq,Prod.mk.injEq] at h
    rcases h with ⟨rfl,rfl⟩
    exact computes_bounded (computes_first O _ _)
  | snd =>
    intro ⟨x,z⟩ y c h
    simp only [evaluate,Option.some.injEq,Prod.mk.injEq] at h
    rcases h with ⟨rfl,rfl⟩
    exact computes_bounded (computes_second O _ _)
  | branch p q ihp ihq =>
    intro ⟨b,x⟩ y c h
    have he : (if b then evaluate O q x else evaluate O p x)=evaluate O (if b then q else p) x := by cases b <;> rfl
    cases hp : evaluate O (if b then q else p) x with
    | none => simp [evaluate,he,hp] at h
    | some r =>
      rcases r with ⟨z,d⟩
      simp [evaluate,he,hp] at h
      rcases h with ⟨rfl,rfl⟩
      apply bounded_select
      cases b with
      | false => exact ihp _ _ _ hp
      | true => exact ihq _ _ _ hp
  | fold p ih =>
    intro ⟨xs,z⟩ y c h
    cases hp : evalFold (evaluate O p) xs z with
    | none => simp [evaluate,hp] at h
    | some r =>
      rcases r with ⟨v,d⟩
      simp [evaluate,hp] at h
      rcases h with ⟨rfl,rfl⟩
      exact evalFold_bounded (compile p) (evaluate O p) ih xs z v d hp
  | cons =>
    intro ⟨x,xs⟩ y c h
    simp only [evaluate,Option.some.injEq,Prod.mk.injEq] at h
    rcases h with ⟨rfl,rfl⟩
    exact computes_bounded (computes_consList O _ _)
  | consBit =>
    intro ⟨b,x⟩ y c h
    simp only [evaluate,Option.some.injEq,Prod.mk.injEq] at h
    rcases h with ⟨rfl,rfl⟩
    exact computes_bounded (computes_consWord O _ _)
  | append =>
    intro ⟨x,z⟩ y c h
    simp only [evaluate,Option.some.injEq,Prod.mk.injEq] at h
    rcases h with ⟨rfl,rfl⟩
    exact computes_bounded (computes_append O _ _)
  | reverse =>
    intro x y c h
    simp only [evaluate,Option.some.injEq,Prod.mk.injEq] at h
    rcases h with ⟨rfl,rfl⟩
    exact computes_bounded (computes_reverse O _)
  | toList =>
    intro x y c h
    simp only [evaluate,Option.some.injEq,Prod.mk.injEq] at h
    rcases h with ⟨rfl,rfl⟩
    exact computes_bounded (computes_boolList O _)
  | toBits =>
    intro x y c h
    simp only [evaluate,Option.some.injEq,Prod.mk.injEq] at h
    rcases h with ⟨rfl,rfl⟩
    exact computes_bounded (computes_skip O _)
  | toNat =>
    intro x y c h
    simp only [evaluate,Option.some.injEq,Prod.mk.injEq] at h
    rcases h with ⟨rfl,rfl⟩
    have hh := computes_bounded (computes_normalCode O x)
    rw [normalWord_eq_bits] at hh
    exact bounded_mono hh (normalCost_le x)
  | add =>
    intro ⟨x,z⟩ y c h
    simp only [evaluate,Option.some.injEq,Prod.mk.injEq] at h
    rcases h with ⟨rfl,rfl⟩
    simpa only [compile, encode, binaryValue_bits] using bounded_add O x.bits z.bits
  | sub =>
    intro ⟨x,z⟩ y c h
    simp only [evaluate] at h
    by_cases hx : z≤x
    · simp only [ite_eq_left hx,Option.some.injEq,Prod.mk.injEq] at h
      rcases h with ⟨rfl,rfl⟩
      simpa only [compile,encode,binaryValue_bits] using bounded_sub O x.bits z.bits
        (by simpa only [binaryValue_bits] using hx)
    · simp [hx] at h
  | rank b =>
    intro x y c h
    simp only [evaluate] at h
    by_cases hx : x.length=n
    · simp only [ite_eq_left hx,Option.some.injEq,Prod.mk.injEq] at h
      rcases h with ⟨rfl,rfl⟩
      exact bounded_rank O b x hx
    · simp [hx] at h
  | mul =>
    intro ⟨x,z⟩ y c h
    simp only [evaluate,Option.some.injEq,Prod.mk.injEq] at h
    rcases h with ⟨rfl,rfl⟩
    simpa only [compile, encode, binaryValue_bits] using bounded_mul O x.bits z.bits
  | less =>
    intro ⟨x,z⟩ y c h
    simp only [evaluate,Option.some.injEq,Prod.mk.injEq] at h
    rcases h with ⟨rfl,rfl⟩
    simpa only [compile, encode, binaryValue_bits] using bounded_cmp O x.bits z.bits
  | divRem =>
    intro ⟨x,z⟩ y c h
    simp only [evaluate] at h
    by_cases hx : x=0
    · simp [hx] at h
    · simp only [ite_eq_right hx] at h
      simp only [Option.some.injEq,Prod.mk.injEq] at h
      rcases h with ⟨rfl,rfl⟩
      have hh := bounded_div O x.bits z.bits
      rw [normalizedResult_pos _ _ (by simpa only [binaryValue_bits] using Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hx)] at hh
      simpa only [compile, encode, binaryValue_bits] using hh
  | query b =>
    intro x y c h
    simp only [evaluate] at h
    by_cases hx : x.length=n
    · simp only [ite_eq_left hx] at h
      simp only [Option.some.injEq,Prod.mk.injEq] at h
      rcases h with ⟨rfl,rfl⟩
      exact ⟨n+3,1,3*n+3,by omega,by omega,le_rfl,computes_query O b x hx⟩
    · simp [hx] at h

def foldValue {A B : Type*} (step : A × B → Option B) : List A → B → Option B
  | [],z => some z
  | x::xs,z => (step (x,z)).bind (foldValue step xs)

def run {n : ℕ} (O : IndependenceOracle n) : {a b : DataType} → Expression a b → Value a → Option (Value b)
  | _,_,.ident,x => some x
  | _,_,.constant y,_ => some y
  | _,_,.compose p q,x => (run O p x).bind (run O q)
  | _,_,.both p q,x => do let y ← run O p x; let z ← run O q x; pure (y,z)
  | _,_,.fst,(x,_) => some x
  | _,_,.snd,(_,y) => some y
  | _,_,.branch p q,(b,x) => if b then run O q x else run O p x
  | _,_,.fold p,(xs,z) => foldValue (run O p) xs z
  | _,_,.cons,(x,xs) => some (x::xs)
  | _,_,.consBit,(b,xs) => some (b::xs)
  | _,_,.append,(x,y) => some (x++y)
  | _,_,.reverse,x => some x.reverse
  | _,_,.toList,x => some x
  | _,_,.toBits,x => some x.bits
  | _,_,.toNat,x => some (binaryValue x)
  | _,_,.add,(x,y) => some (x+y)
  | _,_,.sub,(x,y) => if y≤x then some (x-y) else none
  | _,_,.mul,(x,y) => some (x*y)
  | _,_,.less,(x,y) => some (decide (x<y))
  | _,_,.divRem,(x,y) => if x=0 then none else some (y%x,y/x)
  | _,_,.query b,x => if x.length=n then some (O b (fun i => x[i.val]?.getD false)) else none
  | _,_,.rank b,x => if x.length=n then some (rankWord O b x) else none

lemma evalFold_forget {a b : DataType} (f : Value (.prod a b) → Option (Value b × ℕ))
    (g : Value (.prod a b) → Option (Value b)) (hfg : ∀ x,(f x).map Prod.fst=g x)
    (xs : List (Value a)) (z : Value b) : (evalFold f xs z).map Prod.fst=foldValue g xs z := by
  induction xs generalizing z with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons x xs ih =>
    rw [evalFold,foldValue,←hfg]
    cases hf : f (x,z) with
    | none => rfl
    | some r =>
      rcases r with ⟨z',c⟩
      simp only [Option.map_some,Option.bind_some]
      rw [←ih]
      cases hh : evalFold f xs z' <;> simp [hh]
lemma evaluate_forget {n : ℕ} (O : IndependenceOracle n) {a b : DataType} (e : Expression a b)
    (x : Value a) : (evaluate O e x).map Prod.fst=run O e x := by
  induction e with
  | compose p q ihp ihq =>
    simp only [evaluate,run,←ihp]
    cases hp : evaluate O p x with
    | none => rfl
    | some r =>
      rcases r with ⟨y,c⟩
      simp only [Option.map_some,Option.bind_some]
      rw [←ihq]
      cases hh : evaluate O q y <;> simp [hh]
  | both p q ihp ihq =>
    simp only [evaluate,run,←ihp,←ihq]
    cases evaluate O p x <;> cases evaluate O q x <;> rfl
  | branch p q ihp ihq =>
    rcases x with ⟨b,x⟩
    cases b <;> simp only [evaluate,run,Bool.false_eq_true,ite_false,ite_true,←ihp,←ihq] <;>
      first | (cases evaluate O p x <;> rfl) | (cases evaluate O q x <;> rfl)
  | fold p ih =>
    rcases x with ⟨xs,z⟩
    simp only [evaluate,run,←evalFold_forget (evaluate O p) (run O p) ih xs z]
    cases evalFold (evaluate O p) xs z <;> rfl
  | divRem => rcases x with ⟨x,y⟩; simp only [evaluate,run]; split_ifs <;> rfl
  | sub => rcases x with ⟨x,y⟩; simp only [evaluate,run]; split_ifs <;> rfl
  | query b => simp only [evaluate,run]; split_ifs <;> rfl
  | rank b => simp only [evaluate,run]; split_ifs <;> rfl
  | _ => rfl

lemma compile_run {n : ℕ} (O : IndependenceOracle n) {a b : DataType}
    (e : Expression a b) (x : Value a) (y : Value b) (h : run O e x=some y) :
    ∃ B, Bounded (compile e) O (encode x) (encode y) B := by
  rw [←evaluate_forget] at h
  cases he : evaluate O e x with
  | none => simp [he] at h
  | some r =>
    rcases r with ⟨y',c⟩
    simp only [he,Option.map_some,Option.some.injEq] at h
    subst y'
    exact ⟨c,compile_correct O e x y c he⟩

namespace Expression
infixr:80 " >>> " => compose

def onLeft {a b c} (p : Expression a b) : Expression (.prod a c) (.prod b c) :=
  both (fst >>> p) snd
def onRight {a b c} (p : Expression a b) : Expression (.prod c a) (.prod c b) :=
  both fst (snd >>> p)
def swap {a b} : Expression (.prod a b) (.prod b a) := both snd fst
def letIn {a b c} (p : Expression a b) (q : Expression (.prod a b) c) : Expression a c :=
  both ident p >>> q
def applyIf {a b} (test : Expression a .bool) (no yes : Expression a b) : Expression a b :=
  both test ident >>> branch no yes

def boolNot : Expression .bool .bool := both ident ident >>> branch (constant true) (constant false)
def boolAnd : Expression (.prod .bool .bool) .bool := branch (constant false) ident
def natEqZero : Expression .nat .bool := both ident (constant 1) >>> less
def natSub : Expression (.prod .nat .nat) .nat := applyIf less sub (constant 0)
def natDivRem : Expression (.prod .nat .nat) (.prod .nat .nat) :=
  applyIf (fst >>> natEqZero) divRem (both snd (constant 0))
def natDiv : Expression (.prod .nat .nat) .nat := natDivRem >>> snd
def natMod : Expression (.prod .nat .nat) .nat := natDivRem >>> fst

def listReverse {a} : Expression (.list a) (.list a) := both ident (constant []) >>> fold cons

def mapStep {a b c} (p : Expression (.prod a c) b) : Expression (.prod a (.prod (.list b) c)) (.prod (.list b) c) :=
  both
    (both (both fst (snd >>> snd) >>> p) (snd >>> fst) >>> cons)
    (snd >>> snd)
def mapWith {a b c} (p : Expression (.prod a c) b) : Expression (.prod (.list a) c) (.list b) :=
  both fst (both (constant []) snd) >>> fold (mapStep p) >>> fst >>> listReverse

def listLength {a} : Expression (.list a) .nat :=
  both ident (constant 0) >>> fold (both snd (constant 1) >>> add)
def wordLength : Expression .word .nat := toList >>> listLength

def wordRepeatStep : Expression (.prod .bool .word) .word :=
  letIn (snd >>> both ident ident >>> append)
    (both fst snd >>> both (fst >>> fst) snd >>> branch ident (both (constant false) ident >>> consBit))

def unary : Expression .nat .word :=
  both (toBits >>> reverse >>> toList) (constant []) >>> fold wordRepeatStep

end Expression

lemma foldValue_eq_foldl {a b : DataType} (f : Value (.prod a b) → Option (Value b))
    (g : Value b → Value a → Value b) (hf : ∀ x z, f (x,z)=some (g z x))
    (xs : List (Value a)) (z : Value b) : foldValue f xs z=some (xs.foldl g z) := by
  induction xs generalizing z with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons x xs ih => simp [foldValue,hf,ih]

namespace Expression
variable {n : ℕ} (O : IndependenceOracle n)
@[simp] lemma run_boolNot (b : Bool) : run O boolNot b=some (!b) := by
  cases b <;> rfl
@[simp] lemma run_boolAnd (b c : Bool) : run O boolAnd (b,c)=some (b && c) := by
  cases b <;> rfl
@[simp] lemma run_natEqZero (m : ℕ) : run O natEqZero m=some (decide (m=0)) := by
  simp [natEqZero,run]
@[simp] lemma run_natSub (x y : ℕ) : run O natSub (x,y)=some (x-y) := by
  simp only [natSub,applyIf,run]
  by_cases h : x<y
  · simp [h,Nat.sub_eq_zero_of_le (Nat.le_of_lt h)]
  · simp [h,Nat.le_of_not_gt h]
@[simp] lemma run_natDivRem (x y : ℕ) : run O natDivRem (x,y)=some (y%x,y/x) := by
  simp only [natDivRem,applyIf,run,run_natEqZero]
  by_cases h : x=0 <;> simp [h]
@[simp] lemma run_natDiv (x y : ℕ) : run O natDiv (x,y)=some (y/x) := by
  change ((run O natDivRem (x,y)).bind fun p => some p.2)=some (y/x)
  rw [run_natDivRem]; rfl
@[simp] lemma run_natMod (x y : ℕ) : run O natMod (x,y)=some (y%x) := by
  change ((run O natDivRem (x,y)).bind fun p => some p.1)=some (y%x)
  rw [run_natDivRem]; rfl
lemma run_listReverse {a : DataType} (xs : List (Value a)) :
    run O listReverse xs=some xs.reverse := by
  simp only [listReverse,run]
  have h := foldValue_eq_foldl (fun p : Value (.prod a (.list a)) => some (p.1::p.2))
    (fun zs x => x::zs) (fun _ _ => rfl) xs []
  simpa using h
lemma run_mapStep {a b c : DataType} (p : Expression (.prod a c) b)
    (f : Value a → Value c → Value b) (hp : ∀ x z, run O p (x,z)=some (f x z))
    (x : Value a) (xs : List (Value b)) (z : Value c) :
    run O (mapStep p) (x,(xs,z))=some (f x z::xs,z) := by
  simp [mapStep,run,hp]
lemma run_mapWith {a b c : DataType} (p : Expression (.prod a c) b)
    (f : Value a → Value c → Value b) (hp : ∀ x z, run O p (x,z)=some (f x z))
    (xs : List (Value a)) (z : Value c) :
    run O (mapWith p) (xs,z)=some (xs.map (fun x => f x z)) := by
  have hf : ∀ (ys : List (Value a)) (acc : List (Value b)),
      foldValue (run O (mapStep p)) ys (acc,z)=some ((ys.map (fun x => f x z)).reverse++acc,z) := by
    intro ys
    induction ys with
    | nil => intro acc; rfl
    | cons x ys ih => intro acc; simp [foldValue,run_mapStep O p f hp,ih,List.append_assoc]
  simp [mapWith,run,hf,run_listReverse]
lemma run_listLength {a : DataType} (xs : List (Value a)) :
    run O listLength xs=some xs.length := by
  have hf : ∀ (ys : List (Value a)) (z : ℕ),
      foldValue (fun p : Value (.prod a .nat) => some (p.2+1)) ys z=some (z+ys.length) := by
    intro ys
    induction ys with
    | nil => intro z; simp [foldValue]
    | cons x ys ih => intro z; simpa [foldValue,ih] using congrArg some (by omega : z+1+ys.length=z+(ys.length+1))
  simp [listLength,run,hf]
lemma run_wordLength (xs : Word) : run O wordLength xs=some xs.length := by
  simp [wordLength,run,run_listLength]
lemma run_wordRepeatStep (b : Bool) (w : Word) :
    run O wordRepeatStep (b,w)=some (if b then false::(w++w) else w++w) := by
  cases b <;> rfl
lemma unary_value (xs : List Bool) (w : Word) :
    ∃ out, foldValue (run O wordRepeatStep) xs.reverse w=some out ∧
      out.length=2^xs.length*w.length+binaryValue xs := by
  induction xs generalizing w with
  | nil => exact ⟨w,rfl,by simp [binaryValue]⟩
  | cons b xs ih =>
    obtain ⟨u,hu,hl⟩ := ih w
    have happ : ∀ (ys zs : List Bool) v,
        foldValue (run O wordRepeatStep) (ys++zs) v=
          (foldValue (run O wordRepeatStep) ys v).bind (foldValue (run O wordRepeatStep) zs) := by
      intro ys
      induction ys with
      | nil => intros; rfl
      | cons y ys ih => intros; simp [foldValue,ih,Option.bind_assoc]
    refine ⟨(if b then false::(u++u) else u++u),?_,?_⟩
    · rw [List.reverse_cons,happ,hu]
      simp only [Option.bind_some,foldValue]
      rw [run_wordRepeatStep]; rfl
    · cases b <;> simp [List.length_append,hl,binaryValue,Nat.pow_succ] <;> ring
lemma run_unary (m : ℕ) : ∃ w,run O unary m=some w ∧ w.length=m := by
  obtain ⟨w,hw,hlen⟩ := unary_value O m.bits []
  refine ⟨w,?_,?_⟩
  · simpa [unary,run] using hw
  · simpa [binaryValue_bits] using hlen
end Expression

@[simp] lemma width_pair {a b : DataType} (x : Value a) (y : Value b) :
    width (a:=.prod a b) (x,y)=2*width x+1+width y := by simp [width,encode]
@[simp] lemma width_nil {a : DataType} : width (a:=.list a) []=0 := rfl
@[simp] lemma width_cons {a : DataType} (x : Value a) (xs : List (Value a)) :
    width (a:=.list a) (x::xs)=2*width x+2+width (a:=.list a) xs := by
  simp [width,encode,words]; omega
lemma list_length_le_width {a : DataType} (xs : List (Value a)) :
    xs.length≤width (a:=.list a) xs := by
  induction xs with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons x xs ih => simp only [List.length_cons,width_cons]; omega

def FoldSafe {A B : Type*} (ok : A×B → Prop) (f : A×B → Option B) : List A → B → Prop
  | [],_ => True
  | x::xs,z => ok (x,z) ∧ ∀ y,f (x,z)=some y → FoldSafe ok f xs y

def Safe {n : ℕ} (O : IndependenceOracle n) (S : ℕ) : {a b : DataType} →
    Expression a b → Value a → Prop
  | _,_,e,x => width x≤S ∧ (∀ y,run O e x=some y → width y≤S) ∧
    match e,x with
    | .compose p q,x => Safe O S p x ∧ ∀ y,run O p x=some y → Safe O S q y
    | .both p q,x => Safe O S p x ∧ Safe O S q x
    | .branch p q,(b,x) => if b then Safe O S q x else Safe O S p x
    | .fold p,(xs,z) => FoldSafe (Safe O S p) (run O p) xs z
    | _,_ => True

lemma safe_input {n S : ℕ} {O : IndependenceOracle n} {a b : DataType}
    {p : Expression a b} {x : Value a} (h : Safe O S p x) : width x≤S := by
  cases p <;> exact h.1
lemma safe_output {n S : ℕ} {O : IndependenceOracle n} {a b : DataType}
    {p : Expression a b} {x : Value a} (h : Safe O S p x) {y : Value b}
    (hr : run O p x=some y) : width y≤S := by
  cases p <;> exact h.2.1 y hr

def chargeBound : {a b : DataType} → Expression a b → ℕ → ℕ
  | _,_,.compose p q,T => 10000*(T+1)^2+chargeBound p T+chargeBound q T
  | _,_,.both p q,T => 10000*(T+1)^2+chargeBound p T+chargeBound q T
  | _,_,.branch p q,T => 10000*(T+1)^2+chargeBound p T+chargeBound q T
  | _,_,.fold p,T => 10000*(T+1)^2+(T+1)*(10000*(T+1)^2+chargeBound p T)
  | _,_,_,T => 10000*(T+1)^2

lemma evalFold_charge {n : ℕ} (O : IndependenceOracle n) {a b : DataType}
    (p : Expression (.prod a b) b) (S E : ℕ)
    (hp : ∀ x y c,Safe O S p x → evaluate O p x=some (y,c) → c≤E)
    (xs : List (Value a)) (z y : Value b) (c : ℕ)
    (hs : FoldSafe (Safe O S p) (run O p) xs z) (hw : width (a:=.list a) xs≤S)
    (he : evalFold (evaluate O p) xs z=some (y,c)) :
    c≤xs.length*(7+12*S+E) := by
  induction xs generalizing z y c with
  | nil => simp [evalFold] at he; rcases he with ⟨rfl,rfl⟩; simp
  | cons x xs ih =>
    rw [evalFold] at he
    cases hh : evaluate O p (x,z) with
    | none => simp [hh] at he
    | some u =>
      rcases u with ⟨z',d⟩
      have hrun : run O p (x,z)=some z' := by rw [←evaluate_forget,hh]; rfl
      have hd := hp (x,z) z' d hs.1 hh
      have hw' : width (a:=.list a) xs≤S := by rw [width_cons] at hw; omega
      have hx : width x≤S := by rw [width_cons] at hw; omega
      cases ht : evalFold (evaluate O p) xs z' with
      | none => simp [hh,ht] at he
      | some u =>
        rcases u with ⟨y',e⟩
        simp [hh,ht] at he
        rcases he with ⟨rfl,rfl⟩
        have hh := ih z' y' e (hs.2 z' hrun) hw' ht
        simp only [List.length_cons,Nat.add_mul,Nat.one_mul]
        omega

lemma charge_primitive (T : ℕ) : 300*(2*T+1)^2+100*T+100≤10000*(T+1)^2 := by nlinarith

lemma evaluate_charge {n : ℕ} (O : IndependenceOracle n) {a b : DataType} (p : Expression a b)
    (S : ℕ) (x : Value a) (y : Value b) (c : ℕ) (hs : Safe O S p x)
    (he : evaluate O p x=some (y,c)) : c≤chargeBound p (S+n) := by
  induction p generalizing S c with
  | compose p q ihp ihq =>
    rcases hs with ⟨hx,hy,hp,hq⟩
    simp only [evaluate] at he
    cases hpv : evaluate O p x with
    | none => simp [hpv] at he
    | some u =>
      rcases u with ⟨z,d⟩
      have hr : run O p x=some z := by rw [←evaluate_forget,hpv]; rfl
      have hd := ihp S x z d hp hpv
      cases hqv : evaluate O q z with
      | none => simp [hpv,hqv] at he
      | some u =>
        rcases u with ⟨y',e⟩
        simp [hpv,hqv] at he
        rcases he with ⟨rfl,rfl⟩
        have hh := ihq S z y' e (hq z hr) hqv
        simp only [chargeBound]; omega
  | both p q ihp ihq =>
    rcases hs with ⟨hx,hy,hp,hq⟩
    simp only [evaluate] at he
    cases hpv : evaluate O p x with
    | none => simp [hpv] at he
    | some u =>
      rcases u with ⟨z,d⟩
      have hr : run O p x=some z := by rw [←evaluate_forget,hpv]; rfl
      have hz := safe_output hp hr
      have hd := ihp S x z d hp hpv
      cases hqv : evaluate O q x with
      | none => simp [hpv,hqv] at he
      | some u =>
        rcases u with ⟨z',e⟩
        have hr' : run O q x=some z' := by rw [←evaluate_forget,hqv]; rfl
        have hz' := safe_output hq hr'
        simp [hpv,hqv] at he
        rcases he with ⟨rfl,rfl⟩
        have hh := ihq S x z' e hq hqv
        have hb := charge_primitive (S+n)
        simp only [chargeBound]; nlinarith
  | branch p q ihp ihq =>
    rcases x with ⟨b,x⟩
    rcases hs with ⟨hx,hy,hh⟩
    cases b <;> simp only [Bool.false_eq_true,ite_false,ite_true] at hh <;>
      simp only [evaluate,Bool.false_eq_true,ite_false,ite_true] at he
    · cases hv : evaluate O p x with
      | none => simp [hv] at he
      | some u =>
        rcases u with ⟨y',d⟩
        simp [hv] at he
        rcases he with ⟨rfl,rfl⟩
        have hd := ihp S x y' d hh hv
        have hb := charge_primitive (S+n)
        simp only [chargeBound]; omega
    · cases hv : evaluate O q x with
      | none => simp [hv] at he
      | some u =>
        rcases u with ⟨y',d⟩
        simp [hv] at he
        rcases he with ⟨rfl,rfl⟩
        have hd := ihq S x y' d hh hv
        have hb := charge_primitive (S+n)
        simp only [chargeBound]; omega
  | fold p ih =>
    rcases x with ⟨xs,z⟩
    rcases hs with ⟨hx,hy,hh⟩
    have hw : width (a:=.list _) xs≤S := by rw [width_pair] at hx; omega
    have hlen := list_length_le_width xs
    simp only [evaluate] at he
    cases hv : evalFold (evaluate O p) xs z with
    | none => simp [hv] at he
    | some u =>
      rcases u with ⟨y',d⟩
      simp [hv] at he
      rcases he with ⟨rfl,rfl⟩
      have hd := evalFold_charge O p S (chargeBound p (S+n)) (fun x y c => ih S x y c) xs z y' d hh hw hv
      have hb := charge_primitive (S+n)
      have hmul : xs.length*(7+12*S+chargeBound p (S+n))≤(S+n+1)*(10000*(S+n+1)^2+chargeBound p (S+n)) :=
        Nat.mul_le_mul (by omega) (by omega)
      simp only [chargeBound]; omega
  | ident => simp only [evaluate,Option.some.injEq,Prod.mk.injEq] at he; rcases he with ⟨rfl,rfl⟩; exact Nat.zero_le _
  | constant z =>
    have hx := safe_input hs
    have hz := safe_output hs (y:=z) rfl
    simp only [evaluate,Option.some.injEq,Prod.mk.injEq] at he
    rcases he with ⟨rfl,rfl⟩
    have hb := charge_primitive (S+n)
    simp only [chargeBound]; omega
  | fst =>
    rcases x with ⟨u,v⟩
    have hx := safe_input hs
    rw [width_pair] at hx
    simp only [evaluate,Option.some.injEq,Prod.mk.injEq] at he
    rcases he with ⟨rfl,rfl⟩
    have hb := charge_primitive (S+n)
    simp only [chargeBound]; omega
  | snd =>
    rcases x with ⟨u,v⟩
    have hx := safe_input hs
    rw [width_pair] at hx
    simp only [evaluate,Option.some.injEq,Prod.mk.injEq] at he
    rcases he with ⟨rfl,rfl⟩
    have hb := charge_primitive (S+n)
    simp only [chargeBound]; omega
  | cons | consBit | append | add | sub | mul | less | divRem =>
    rcases x with ⟨x,y⟩
    have hx := safe_input hs
    have hb := charge_primitive (S+n)
    try simp only [width_pair] at hx
    simp only [evaluate] at he
    try split_ifs at he
    all_goals
      simp only [Option.some.injEq,Prod.mk.injEq] at he
      try contradiction
      rcases he with ⟨rfl,rfl⟩
      simp only [chargeBound,width,encode,pair_length] at hx ⊢
      nlinarith
  | reverse | toList | toBits | toNat | rank | query =>
    have hx := safe_input hs
    have hb := charge_primitive (S+n)
    simp only [evaluate] at he
    try split_ifs at he
    all_goals
      simp only [Option.some.injEq,Prod.mk.injEq] at he
      try contradiction
      rcases he with ⟨rfl,rfl⟩
      simp only [chargeBound,width,encode] at hx ⊢
      nlinarith

def chargeDegree : {a b : DataType} → Expression a b → ℕ
  | _,_,.compose p q => chargeDegree p+chargeDegree q+3
  | _,_,.both p q => chargeDegree p+chargeDegree q+3
  | _,_,.branch p q => chargeDegree p+chargeDegree q+3
  | _,_,.fold p => chargeDegree p+3
  | _,_,_ => 2

def chargeCoefficient : {a b : DataType} → Expression a b → ℕ
  | _,_,.compose p q => 10000+chargeCoefficient p+chargeCoefficient q
  | _,_,.both p q => 10000+chargeCoefficient p+chargeCoefficient q
  | _,_,.branch p q => 10000+chargeCoefficient p+chargeCoefficient q
  | _,_,.fold p => 20000+chargeCoefficient p
  | _,_,_ => 10000

lemma monomial_add_bound (T C D e f x y : ℕ) (hx : x≤C*(T+1)^e) (hy : y≤D*(T+1)^f) :
    10000*(T+1)^2+x+y≤(10000+C+D)*(T+1)^(e+f+3) := by
  have hbase : 1≤T+1 := by omega
  have hp : (T+1)^2≤(T+1)^(e+f+3) := Nat.pow_le_pow_right hbase (by omega)
  have he : (T+1)^e≤(T+1)^(e+f+3) := Nat.pow_le_pow_right hbase (by omega)
  have hf : (T+1)^f≤(T+1)^(e+f+3) := Nat.pow_le_pow_right hbase (by omega)
  have hx' := hx.trans (Nat.mul_le_mul_left C he)
  have hy' := hy.trans (Nat.mul_le_mul_left D hf)
  calc
    _ ≤ 10000*(T+1)^(e+f+3)+C*(T+1)^(e+f+3)+D*(T+1)^(e+f+3) := by omega
    _ = _ := by ring
lemma monomial_fold_bound (T C e x : ℕ) (hx : x≤C*(T+1)^e) :
    10000*(T+1)^2+(T+1)*(10000*(T+1)^2+x)≤(20000+C)*(T+1)^(e+3) := by
  have hbase : 1≤T+1 := by omega
  have hp : (T+1)^2≤(T+1)^(e+3) := Nat.pow_le_pow_right hbase (by omega)
  have hq : (T+1)^3≤(T+1)^(e+3) := Nat.pow_le_pow_right hbase (by omega)
  have he : (T+1)^(e+1)≤(T+1)^(e+3) := Nat.pow_le_pow_right hbase (by omega)
  calc
    _ ≤ 10000*(T+1)^2+(T+1)*(10000*(T+1)^2+C*(T+1)^e) := by gcongr
    _ = 10000*(T+1)^2+10000*(T+1)^3+C*(T+1)^(e+1) := by ring
    _ ≤ 10000*(T+1)^(e+3)+10000*(T+1)^(e+3)+C*(T+1)^(e+3) := by gcongr
    _ = _ := by ring

lemma chargeBound_polynomial {a b : DataType} (p : Expression a b) (T : ℕ) :
    chargeBound p T≤chargeCoefficient p*(T+1)^chargeDegree p := by
  induction p with
  | compose p q ihp ihq | both p q ihp ihq | branch p q ihp ihq =>
      exact monomial_add_bound T _ _ _ _ _ _ ihp ihq
  | fold p ih => exact monomial_fold_bound T _ _ _ ih
  | ident | constant | fst | snd | cons | consBit | append | reverse | toList | toBits | toNat |
    add | sub | mul | less | divRem | query | rank => exact Nat.le_refl _

lemma evaluate_polynomial {n : ℕ} (O : IndependenceOracle n) {a b : DataType} (p : Expression a b)
    (S : ℕ) (x : Value a) (y : Value b) (c : ℕ) (hs : Safe O S p x)
    (he : evaluate O p x=some (y,c)) :
    c≤chargeCoefficient p*(S+n+1)^chargeDegree p :=
  (evaluate_charge O p S x y c hs he).trans (chargeBound_polynomial p (S+n))

lemma foldSafe_mono {A B : Type*} (p q : A×B → Prop) (f : A×B → Option B)
    (hpq : ∀ x,p x → q x) (xs : List A) (z : B) (h : FoldSafe p f xs z) :
    FoldSafe q f xs z := by
  induction xs generalizing z with
  | nil => trivial
  | cons x xs ih => exact ⟨hpq _ h.1,fun y hy => ih y (h.2 y hy)⟩
lemma safe_mono {n S T : ℕ} {O : IndependenceOracle n} {a b : DataType}
    (p : Expression a b) (x : Value a) (h : Safe O S p x) (hST : S≤T) : Safe O T p x := by
  induction p with
  | compose p q ihp ihq =>
    exact ⟨h.1.trans hST,fun y hy => (h.2.1 y hy).trans hST,
      ihp _ h.2.2.1,fun y hy => ihq _ (h.2.2.2 y hy)⟩
  | both p q ihp ihq =>
    exact ⟨h.1.trans hST,fun y hy => (h.2.1 y hy).trans hST,ihp _ h.2.2.1,ihq _ h.2.2.2⟩
  | branch p q ihp ihq =>
    refine ⟨h.1.trans hST,fun y hy => (h.2.1 y hy).trans hST,?_⟩
    rcases x with ⟨v,x⟩
    cases v <;> simp only [Bool.false_eq_true,ite_false,ite_true] at *
    · exact ihp _ h.2.2
    · exact ihq _ h.2.2
  | fold p ih =>
    exact ⟨h.1.trans hST,fun y hy => (h.2.1 y hy).trans hST,
      foldSafe_mono _ _ _ (fun x hx => ih x hx) _ _ h.2.2⟩
  | _ => exact ⟨h.1.trans hST,fun y hy => (h.2.1 y hy).trans hST,trivial⟩

lemma safe_compose {n S : ℕ} (O : IndependenceOracle n) {a b c : DataType}
    (p : Expression a b) (q : Expression b c) (x : Value a)
    (hp : Safe O S p x) (hq : ∀ y,run O p x=some y → Safe O S q y) :
    Safe O S (.compose p q) x := by
  refine ⟨safe_input hp,?_,hp,hq⟩
  intro z hz
  simp only [run] at hz
  cases he : run O p x with
  | none => simp [he] at hz
  | some y =>
    simp only [he,Option.bind_some] at hz
    exact safe_output (hq y he) hz
lemma safe_both {n S : ℕ} (O : IndependenceOracle n) {a b c : DataType}
    (p : Expression a b) (q : Expression a c) (x : Value a)
    (hp : Safe O S p x) (hq : Safe O S q x) :
    Safe O (3*S+1) (.both p q) x := by
  have hS : S≤3*S+1 := by omega
  refine ⟨(safe_input hp).trans hS,?_,safe_mono p x hp hS,safe_mono q x hq hS⟩
  intro z hz
  simp only [run] at hz
  cases he : run O p x with
  | none => simp [he] at hz
  | some y =>
    simp only [he] at hz
    cases hf : run O q x with
    | none => simp [hf] at hz
    | some w =>
      simp only [hf,] at hz
      have hh : (y,w)=z := Option.some.inj hz
      cases hh
      have hy := safe_output hp he
      have hw := safe_output hq hf
      rw [width_pair]
      omega
lemma foldSafe_invariant {A B : Type*} (ok : A×B → Prop) (f : A×B → Option B)
    (P : B → Prop) (xs : List A) (z : B) (hz : P z)
    (hstep : ∀ x∈xs,∀ y,P y → ok (x,y) ∧ ∀ y',f (x,y)=some y' → P y') :
    FoldSafe ok f xs z := by
  induction xs generalizing z with
  | nil => trivial
  | cons x xs ih =>
    obtain ⟨hgood,hnext⟩ := hstep x (by simp) z hz
    exact ⟨hgood,fun y hy => ih y (hnext y hy) (fun v hv => hstep v (by simp [hv]))⟩
lemma foldValue_invariant {A B : Type*} (f : A×B → Option B) (P : B → Prop)
    (xs : List A) (z : B) (hz : P z)
    (hstep : ∀ x∈xs,∀ y,P y → ∀ y',f (x,y)=some y' → P y')
    (y : B) (hy : foldValue f xs z=some y) : P y := by
  induction xs generalizing z with
  | nil => cases hy; exact hz
  | cons x xs ih =>
    simp only [foldValue] at hy
    cases he : f (x,z) with
    | none => simp [he] at hy
    | some w =>
      simp only [he,Option.bind_some] at hy
      exact ih w (hstep x (by simp) z hz w he) (fun v hv => hstep v (by simp [hv])) hy
lemma safe_fold_invariant {n S : ℕ} (O : IndependenceOracle n) {a b : DataType}
    (p : Expression (.prod a b) b) (xs : List (Value a)) (z : Value b) (P : Value b → Prop)
    (hz : P z) (hw : width (a:=.prod (.list a) b) (xs,z)≤S)
    (hwidth : ∀ y,P y → width y≤S)
    (hstep : ∀ x∈xs,∀ y,P y → Safe O S p (x,y) ∧ ∀ y',run O p (x,y)=some y' → P y') :
    Safe O S (.fold p) (xs,z) := by
  refine ⟨hw,?_,foldSafe_invariant _ _ P xs z hz hstep⟩
  intro y hy
  exact hwidth y (foldValue_invariant _ P xs z hz (fun x hx v hv => (hstep x hx v hv).2) y hy)

inductive SizePolynomial where
  | constant : ℕ → SizePolynomial
  | input : SizePolynomial
  | add : SizePolynomial → SizePolynomial → SizePolynomial
  | mul : SizePolynomial → SizePolynomial → SizePolynomial
namespace SizePolynomial
def eval : SizePolynomial → ℕ → ℕ
  | .constant c,_ => c
  | .input,x => x
  | .add p q,x => p.eval x+q.eval x
  | .mul p q,x => p.eval x*q.eval x
def degree : SizePolynomial → ℕ
  | .constant _ => 0
  | .input => 1
  | .add p q | .mul p q => p.degree+q.degree
def coefficient : SizePolynomial → ℕ
  | .constant c => c
  | .input => 1
  | .add p q => p.coefficient+q.coefficient
  | .mul p q => p.coefficient*q.coefficient
lemma monotone (p : SizePolynomial) : Monotone p.eval := by
  intro x y h
  induction p with
  | constant c => rfl
  | input => exact h
  | add p q ihp ihq => exact Nat.add_le_add ihp ihq
  | mul p q ihp ihq => exact Nat.mul_le_mul ihp ihq
lemma bound (p : SizePolynomial) (x : ℕ) : p.eval x≤p.coefficient*(x+1)^p.degree := by
  induction p with
  | constant c => simp [eval,coefficient,degree]
  | input => simp [eval,coefficient,degree]
  | add p q ihp ihq =>
    have hp := Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by omega : 1≤x+1) (Nat.le_add_right p.degree q.degree)
    have hq := Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by omega : 1≤x+1) (Nat.le_add_left q.degree p.degree)
    dsimp only [eval,coefficient,degree]
    calc
      _ ≤ p.coefficient*(x+1)^(p.degree+q.degree)+q.coefficient*(x+1)^(p.degree+q.degree) :=
        Nat.add_le_add (ihp.trans (Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ hp)) (ihq.trans (Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ hq))
      _ = _ := by ring
  | mul p q ihp ihq =>
    dsimp only [eval,coefficient,degree]
    calc
      _ ≤ (p.coefficient*(x+1)^p.degree)*(q.coefficient*(x+1)^q.degree) := Nat.mul_le_mul ihp ihq
      _ = _ := by rw [pow_add]; ring
def subst : SizePolynomial → SizePolynomial → SizePolynomial
  | .constant c,_ => .constant c
  | .input,q => q
  | .add p r,q => .add (p.subst q) (r.subst q)
  | .mul p r,q => .mul (p.subst q) (r.subst q)
lemma eval_subst (p q : SizePolynomial) (x : ℕ) : (p.subst q).eval x=p.eval (q.eval x) := by
  induction p <;> simp_all [subst,eval]
end SizePolynomial

def Controlled {a b : DataType} (p : Expression a b) : Prop :=
  ∃ f : SizePolynomial,∀ {n : ℕ} (O : IndependenceOracle n) (x : Value a),Safe O (f.eval (width x)) p x
lemma controlled_input {a b : DataType} {p : Expression a b} (hp : Controlled p) :
    ∃ C d : ℕ,∀ {n : ℕ} (O : IndependenceOracle n) (S : ℕ) (x : Value a),
      width x≤S → Safe O (C*(S+1)^d) p x := by
  obtain ⟨f,hf⟩ := hp
  exact ⟨f.coefficient,f.degree,fun O S x hx => safe_mono p x (hf O x)
    ((f.monotone hx).trans (f.bound S))⟩
lemma controlled_compose {a b c : DataType} (p : Expression a b) (q : Expression b c)
    (hp : Controlled p) (hq : Controlled q) : Controlled (.compose p q) := by
  obtain ⟨f,hf⟩ := hp
  obtain ⟨g,hg⟩ := hq
  refine ⟨.add f (g.subst f),fun O x => ?_⟩
  apply safe_compose O p q x
  · exact safe_mono p x (hf O x) (by simp only [SizePolynomial.eval]; omega)
  · intro y hy
    have h := safe_output (hf O x) hy
    apply safe_mono q y (hg O y)
    rw [SizePolynomial.eval,SizePolynomial.eval_subst]
    exact (g.monotone h).trans (Nat.le_add_left _ _)
lemma controlled_both {a b c : DataType} (p : Expression a b) (q : Expression a c)
    (hp : Controlled p) (hq : Controlled q) : Controlled (.both p q) := by
  obtain ⟨f,hf⟩ := hp
  obtain ⟨g,hg⟩ := hq
  refine ⟨.add (.mul (.constant 3) (.add f g)) (.constant 1),fun O x => ?_⟩
  apply safe_both O p q x
  · exact safe_mono p x (hf O x) (Nat.le_add_right _ _)
  · exact safe_mono q x (hg O x) (Nat.le_add_left _ _)
lemma controlled_branch {a b : DataType} (p q : Expression a b)
    (hp : Controlled p) (hq : Controlled q) : Controlled (.branch p q) := by
  obtain ⟨f,hf⟩ := hp
  obtain ⟨g,hg⟩ := hq
  refine ⟨.add .input (.add f g),fun O x => ?_⟩
  rcases x with ⟨v,x⟩
  have hw : width x≤width (a:=.prod .bool a) (v,x) := by rw [width_pair]; omega
  have hp' : Safe O (width (a:=.prod .bool a) (v,x)+
      (f.eval (width (a:=.prod .bool a) (v,x))+g.eval (width (a:=.prod .bool a) (v,x)))) p x :=
    safe_mono p x (hf O x) ((f.monotone hw).trans (by omega))
  have hq' : Safe O (width (a:=.prod .bool a) (v,x)+
      (f.eval (width (a:=.prod .bool a) (v,x))+g.eval (width (a:=.prod .bool a) (v,x)))) q x :=
    safe_mono q x (hg O x) ((g.monotone hw).trans (by omega))
  refine ⟨by simp only [SizePolynomial.eval]; omega,?_,?_⟩
  · intro y hy
    cases v
    · exact safe_output hp' hy
    · exact safe_output hq' hy
  · cases v
    · exact hp'
    · exact hq'

@[simp] lemma width_nat (x : ℕ) : width (a:=.nat) x=x.bits.length := rfl
@[simp] lemma width_word (x : Word) : width (a:=.word) x=x.length := rfl
@[simp] lemma width_bool (x : Bool) : width (a:=.bool) x=1 := rfl
@[simp] lemma width_unit (x : Unit) : width (a:=.unit) x=0 := rfl
lemma bits_length_mono {a b : ℕ} (h : a≤b) : a.bits.length≤b.bits.length := by
  simpa only [Nat.size_eq_bits_len] using Nat.size_le_size h
lemma bits_length_le_value (a : ℕ) : a.bits.length≤a := by
  rw [Nat.size_eq_bits_len]
  exact Nat.size_le.mpr a.lt_two_pow_self
lemma bits_length_add (a b : ℕ) : (a+b).bits.length≤a.bits.length+b.bits.length+1 := by
  simp only [Nat.size_eq_bits_len]
  apply Nat.size_le.mpr
  have ha := Nat.lt_size_self a
  have hb := Nat.lt_size_self b
  have hpa : 1≤2^a.size := Nat.one_le_pow _ _ (by decide)
  have hpb : 1≤2^b.size := Nat.one_le_pow _ _ (by decide)
  rw [pow_succ,pow_add]
  nlinarith
lemma bits_length_mul (a b : ℕ) : (a*b).bits.length≤a.bits.length+b.bits.length := by
  simp only [Nat.size_eq_bits_len]
  apply Nat.size_le.mpr
  rw [pow_add]
  calc
    a*b≤(2^a.size)*b := Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ (Nat.lt_size_self a).le
    _ < (2^a.size)*(2^b.size) := Nat.mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left (Nat.lt_size_self b) (by positivity)
lemma bits_length_binaryValue (x : Word) : (binaryValue x).bits.length≤x.length := by
  rw [←normalWord_eq_bits]
  exact normal_length x
lemma width_list_bool (x : Word) : width (a:=.list .bool) x=4*x.length := by
  induction x with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons b xs ih =>
    rw [width_cons (a:=.bool),width_bool,ih,List.length_cons]
    omega
lemma width_list_append {a : DataType} (x y : List (Value a)) :
    width (a:=.list a) (x++y)=width (a:=.list a) x+width (a:=.list a) y := by
  induction x with
  | nil => simp
  | cons z x ih => simp only [List.cons_append,width_cons,ih]; omega
lemma width_list_reverse {a : DataType} (x : List (Value a)) :
    width (a:=.list a) x.reverse=width (a:=.list a) x := by
  induction x with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons z x ih => simp only [List.reverse_cons,width_list_append,width_cons,width_nil,ih]; omega
lemma width_list_member {a : DataType} (x : Value a) (xs : List (Value a)) (h : x∈xs) :
    width x≤width (a:=.list a) xs := by
  induction xs with
  | nil => cases h
  | cons z zs ih =>
    simp only [List.mem_cons] at h
    cases h with
    | inl h => subst x; rw [width_cons]; omega
    | inr h => have hi := ih h; rw [width_cons]; omega

def Atomic : {a b : DataType} → Expression a b → Prop
  | _,_,.compose _ _ | _,_,.both _ _ | _,_,.branch _ _ | _,_,.fold _ => False
  | _,_,_ => True

def constantWidth : {a b : DataType} → Expression a b → ℕ
  | _,_,.constant x => width x
  | _,_,_ => 0
lemma safe_atomic {n S : ℕ} (O : IndependenceOracle n) {a b : DataType}
    (p : Expression a b) (x : Value a) (ha : Atomic p) (hx : width x≤S)
    (hy : ∀ y,run O p x=some y → width y≤S) : Safe O S p x := by
  cases p <;> first | contradiction | exact ⟨hx,hy,trivial⟩
lemma atomic_width {n : ℕ} (O : IndependenceOracle n) {a b : DataType}
    (p : Expression a b) (x : Value a) (ha : Atomic p) (y : Value b) (hy : run O p x=some y) :
    width y≤8*(width x+constantWidth p+1) := by
  cases p with
  | compose | both | branch | fold => contradiction
  | ident => cases hy; simp only [constantWidth]; omega
  | constant z => cases hy; simp only [constantWidth]; omega
  | fst =>
    rcases x with ⟨u,v⟩
    cases hy
    simp only [width_pair,constantWidth]; omega
  | snd =>
    rcases x with ⟨u,v⟩
    cases hy
    simp only [width_pair,constantWidth]; omega
  | @cons a =>
    rcases x with ⟨u,v⟩
    cases hy
    rw [width_pair (a := a) (b := .list a)]
    simp only [width_cons,constantWidth]; omega
  | consBit =>
    rcases x with ⟨u,v⟩
    cases hy
    rw [width_pair (a := .bool) (b := .word)]
    simp only [width_word,List.length_cons,width_bool,constantWidth]; omega
  | append =>
    rcases x with ⟨u,v⟩
    cases hy
    rw [width_pair (a := .word) (b := .word)]
    simp only [width_word,List.length_append,constantWidth]; omega
  | reverse =>
    cases hy
    simp only [width_word,List.length_reverse,constantWidth]; omega
  | toList =>
    cases hy
    rw [width_list_bool]
    simp only [width_word,constantWidth]; omega
  | toBits =>
    cases hy
    simp only [width_word,width_nat,constantWidth]; omega
  | toNat =>
    cases hy
    have h := bits_length_binaryValue x
    simp only [width_word,width_nat,constantWidth]; omega
  | add =>
    rcases x with ⟨u,v⟩
    cases hy
    have h := bits_length_add u v
    rw [width_pair (a := .nat) (b := .nat)]
    simp only [width_nat,constantWidth]; omega
  | mul =>
    rcases x with ⟨u,v⟩
    cases hy
    have h := bits_length_mul u v
    rw [width_pair (a := .nat) (b := .nat)]
    simp only [width_nat,constantWidth]; omega
  | sub =>
    rcases x with ⟨u,v⟩
    simp only [run] at hy
    split_ifs at hy with hv
    · cases hy
      have h := bits_length_mono (Nat.sub_le u v)
      rw [width_pair (a := .nat) (b := .nat)]
      simp only [width_nat,constantWidth]; omega
  | less =>
    simp only [width_bool,constantWidth]; omega
  | divRem =>
    rcases x with ⟨u,v⟩
    simp only [run] at hy
    split_ifs at hy with hv
    · cases hy
      have h₁ := bits_length_mono (Nat.mod_le v u)
      have h₂ := bits_length_mono (Nat.div_le_self v u)
      simp only [width_pair (a := .nat) (b := .nat),width_nat,constantWidth]; omega
  | query b => simp only [width_bool,constantWidth]; omega
  | rank b =>
    simp only [run] at hy
    split_ifs at hy with hx
    · cases hy
      have h₁ := bits_length_binaryValue (rankBits b O x.reverse)
      have h₂ := rankBits_length O b x.reverse
      simp only [List.length_reverse] at h₂
      simp only [width_nat,width_word,constantWidth,rankWord]; omega
lemma controlled_atomic {a b : DataType} (p : Expression a b) (ha : Atomic p) : Controlled p := by
  refine ⟨.mul (.constant 8) (.add (.add .input (.constant (constantWidth p))) (.constant 1)),fun O x => ?_⟩
  apply safe_atomic O p x ha
  · dsimp [SizePolynomial.eval]; omega
  · exact fun y hy => atomic_width O p x ha y hy

lemma foldSafe_prefix {A B : Type*} (ok : A×B → Prop) (f : A×B → Option B)
    (xs : List A) (z : B)
    (h : ∀ pre x post,xs=pre++x::post → ∀ y,foldValue f pre z=some y → ok (x,y)) :
    FoldSafe ok f xs z := by
  induction xs generalizing z with
  | nil => trivial
  | cons x xs ih =>
    refine ⟨h [] x xs rfl z rfl,?_⟩
    intro y hy
    apply ih y
    intro pre a post he w hw
    apply h (x::pre) a post (by simpa using congrArg (List.cons x) he) w
    simp only [foldValue,hy,Option.bind_some]
    exact hw

lemma controlled_fold {a b : DataType} (p : Expression (.prod a b) b)
    (hp : Controlled p) (g : SizePolynomial)
    (hg : ∀ {n : ℕ} (O : IndependenceOracle n) (xs : List (Value a)) (z : Value b)
      (pre post : List (Value a)),xs=pre++post → ∀ y,foldValue (run O p) pre z=some y →
      width y≤g.eval (width (a:=.prod (.list a) b) (xs,z))) :
    Controlled (.fold p) := by
  obtain ⟨f,hf⟩ := hp
  let vP : SizePolynomial := .add (.add (.mul (.constant 2) .input) (.constant 1)) g
  let h : SizePolynomial := .add (.add .input g) (f.subst vP)
  refine ⟨h,fun O x => ?_⟩
  rcases x with ⟨xs,z⟩
  have hS : width (a:=.prod (.list a) b) (xs,z)≤h.eval (width (a:=.prod (.list a) b) (xs,z)) := by
    dsimp [h,SizePolynomial.eval]; omega
  have hgS : g.eval (width (a:=.prod (.list a) b) (xs,z))≤h.eval (width (a:=.prod (.list a) b) (xs,z)) := by
    dsimp [h,SizePolynomial.eval]; omega
  refine ⟨hS,?_,?_⟩
  · intro y hy
    exact (hg O xs z xs [] (by simp) y hy).trans hgS
  · apply foldSafe_prefix
    intro pre v post he y hy
    have hay : width y≤g.eval (width (a:=.prod (.list a) b) (xs,z)) := hg O xs z pre (v::post) he y hy
    have ha : width (a:=a) v≤width (a:=.prod (.list a) b) (xs,z) := by
      have hm : v∈xs := by rw [he]; simp
      have ha := width_list_member v xs hm
      rw [width_pair]; omega
    have hinput : width (a:=.prod a b) (v,y)≤vP.eval (width (a:=.prod (.list a) b) (xs,z)) := by
      rw [width_pair]
      dsimp [vP,SizePolynomial.eval]
      omega
    apply safe_mono p (v,y) (hf O (v,y))
    exact (f.monotone hinput).trans (by
      dsimp only [h,SizePolynomial.eval]
      rw [SizePolynomial.eval_subst]
      omega)

lemma mod_double_lt (a b : ℕ) (hb : 0<b) (hba : b≤a) : 2*(a%b)<a := by
  have hr := Nat.mod_lt a hb
  have hd := Nat.div_pos hba hb
  have hm := Nat.mul_le_mul_left b hd
  have he := Nat.mod_add_div a b
  omega
lemma mod_size_lt (a b : ℕ) (hb : 0<b) (hba : b≤a) : (a%b).size<a.size := by
  have ha : 0<a := lt_of_lt_of_le hb hba
  by_cases hz : a%b=0
  · simpa [hz] using Nat.size_pos.mpr ha
  · have h := Nat.size_le_size (Nat.le_of_lt (mod_double_lt a b hb hba))
    have hs : (2*(a%b)).size=(a%b).size+1 := by
      have he : 2*(a%b)=Nat.bit false (a%b) := by simp [Nat.bit_val]
      rw [he,Nat.size_bit (by simpa [Nat.bit_val] using hz)]
    rw [hs] at h
    omega

def gcdStep (p : ℕ × ℕ) : ℕ × ℕ := if p.2=0 then p else (p.2,p.1%p.2)
def gcdSteps : ℕ → ℕ × ℕ → ℕ × ℕ
  | 0,p => p
  | k+1,p => gcdSteps k (gcdStep p)
lemma gcdSteps_zero (k a : ℕ) : gcdSteps k (a,0)=(a,0) := by
  induction k with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ k ih => simpa [gcdSteps,gcdStep] using ih
lemma gcdSteps_done (k a b : ℕ) (hba : b≤a) (hk : a.size+b.size≤k) :
    gcdSteps k (a,b)=(Nat.gcd a b,0) := by
  induction k generalizing a b with
  | zero =>
    have ha : a=0 := Nat.size_eq_zero.mp (by omega)
    have hb : b=0 := Nat.size_eq_zero.mp (by omega)
    simp [ha,hb,gcdSteps]
  | succ k ih =>
    by_cases hb : b=0
    · subst b; simp [gcdSteps_zero]
    · have hb' := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hb
      have hl := mod_size_lt a b hb' hba
      have hs := Nat.size_le_size hba
      have hh := ih b (a%b) (Nat.le_of_lt (Nat.mod_lt a hb')) (by omega)
      simp only [gcdSteps,gcdStep,hb,ite_false]
      rw [hh,Nat.gcd_comm b (a%b),←Nat.gcd_rec,Nat.gcd_comm b a]

namespace Expression
abbrev NN := DataType.prod .nat .nat

def sortPair : Expression NN NN := applyIf less ident swap
def gcdStepCode : Expression NN NN :=
  applyIf (snd >>> natEqZero) (both snd (swap >>> natMod)) ident

def gcdCode : Expression NN .nat :=
  sortPair >>> both
    (both (fst >>> toBits) (snd >>> toBits) >>> append >>> toList)
    ident >>> fold (snd >>> gcdStepCode) >>> fst
lemma run_sortPair {n : ℕ} (O : IndependenceOracle n) (a b : ℕ) :
    run O sortPair (a,b)=some (if a<b then (b,a) else (a,b)) := by
  simp only [sortPair,applyIf,swap,run]
  by_cases h : a<b <;> simp [h]
lemma run_gcdStepCode {n : ℕ} (O : IndependenceOracle n) (a b : ℕ) :
    run O gcdStepCode (a,b)=some (gcdStep (a,b)) := by
  by_cases hb : b=0 <;>
    simp [gcdStepCode,applyIf,run,swap,natEqZero,natMod,natDivRem,gcdStep,hb]
lemma fold_gcdStepCode {n : ℕ} (O : IndependenceOracle n) (xs : List Bool) (p : ℕ × ℕ) :
    foldValue (run O (snd (a:=.bool) >>> gcdStepCode)) xs p=some (gcdSteps xs.length p) := by
  induction xs generalizing p with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons b xs ih =>
    rcases p with ⟨a,c⟩
    change ((run O gcdStepCode (a,c)).bind fun p =>
      foldValue (run O (snd (a:=.bool) >>> gcdStepCode)) xs p)=_
    rw [run_gcdStepCode,Option.bind_some,ih]
    rfl
lemma run_gcdCode {n : ℕ} (O : IndependenceOracle n) (a b : ℕ) :
    run O gcdCode (a,b)=some (Nat.gcd a b) := by
  unfold gcdCode
  have hs := run_sortPair O a b
  simp only [run]
  rw [hs]
  simp only [Option.bind_some]
  by_cases hab : a<b
  · simp only [hab,ite_true]
    change ((foldValue (run O (snd (a:=.bool) >>> gcdStepCode)) (b.bits++a.bits) (b,a)).bind
      fun p => some p.1)=some (Nat.gcd a b)
    rw [fold_gcdStepCode]
    simp only [List.length_append,Nat.size_eq_bits_len]
    rw [gcdSteps_done _ _ _ (Nat.le_of_lt hab) (by rfl)]
    simp [Nat.gcd_comm]
  · simp only [hab,ite_false]
    change ((foldValue (run O (snd (a:=.bool) >>> gcdStepCode)) (a.bits++b.bits) (a,b)).bind
      fun p => some p.1)=some (Nat.gcd a b)
    rw [fold_gcdStepCode]
    simp only [List.length_append,Nat.size_eq_bits_len]
    rw [gcdSteps_done _ _ _ (Nat.le_of_not_gt hab) (by rfl)]
    rfl
end Expression

open Expression
syntax "control" : tactic
macro_rules
| `(tactic| control) => `(tactic|
  first
  | assumption
  | apply controlled_compose <;> control
  | apply controlled_both <;> control
  | apply controlled_branch <;> control
  | exact controlled_atomic _ trivial)
lemma controlled_onLeft {a b c : DataType} (p : Expression a b) (hp : Controlled p) :
    Controlled (onLeft (c:=c) p) := by unfold onLeft; control
lemma controlled_onRight {a b c : DataType} (p : Expression a b) (hp : Controlled p) :
    Controlled (onRight (c:=c) p) := by unfold onRight; control
lemma controlled_swap {a b : DataType} : Controlled (Expression.swap (a:=a) (b:=b)) := by unfold Expression.swap; control
lemma controlled_letIn {a b c : DataType} (p : Expression a b) (q : Expression (.prod a b) c)
    (hp : Controlled p) (hq : Controlled q) : Controlled (letIn p q) := by unfold letIn; control
lemma controlled_applyIf {a b : DataType} (p : Expression a .bool) (q r : Expression a b)
    (hp : Controlled p) (hq : Controlled q) (hr : Controlled r) : Controlled (applyIf p q r) := by
  unfold applyIf; control
lemma controlled_boolNot : Controlled boolNot := by unfold boolNot; control
lemma controlled_boolAnd : Controlled boolAnd := by unfold boolAnd; control
lemma controlled_natEqZero : Controlled natEqZero := by unfold natEqZero; control
lemma controlled_natSub : Controlled natSub := by unfold natSub; control
lemma controlled_natDivRem : Controlled natDivRem := by unfold natDivRem; control
lemma controlled_natDiv : Controlled natDiv := by unfold natDiv; control
lemma controlled_natMod : Controlled natMod := by unfold natMod; control
lemma controlled_listReverse {a : DataType} : Controlled (listReverse (a:=a)) := by
  unfold listReverse
  apply controlled_compose
  · control
  · apply controlled_fold _ (controlled_atomic (cons (a:=a)) trivial) (.mul (.constant 2) .input)
    intro n O xs z pre post he y hy
    have hh := foldValue_eq_foldl (run O (cons (a:=a))) (fun z x => x::z) (fun _ _ => rfl) pre z
    rw [hh] at hy
    cases hy
    rw [List.foldl_flip_cons_eq_append',width_list_append,width_list_reverse]
    have hp : width (a:=.list a) pre≤width (a:=.list a) xs := by rw [he,width_list_append]; omega
    rw [width_pair (a:=.list a) (b:=.list a)]
    dsimp [SizePolynomial.eval]
    omega
lemma foldl_succ {A : Type*} (l : List A) (z : ℕ) : l.foldl (fun z _ => z+1) z=z+l.length := by
  induction l generalizing z with
  | nil => simp
  | cons x xs ih => simp only [List.foldl_cons,ih,List.length_cons]; omega
lemma controlled_listLength {a : DataType} : Controlled (listLength (a:=a)) := by
  unfold listLength
  apply controlled_compose
  · control
  · apply controlled_fold _ (by control) (.mul (.constant 2) .input)
    intro n O xs z pre post he y hy
    have hh := foldValue_eq_foldl (run O (both (snd (a:=a)) (constant 1) >>> Expression.add)) (fun z (_ : Value a) => z+1) (fun _ _ => rfl) pre z
    rw [hh] at hy
    cases hy
    have hv := foldl_succ pre z
    rw [hv,width_nat]
    have hbits := bits_length_add z pre.length
    have hlen := bits_length_le_value pre.length
    have hx := list_length_le_width xs
    have hp : pre.length≤xs.length := by rw [he,List.length_append]; omega
    rw [width_pair (a:=.list a) (b:=.nat),width_nat]
    dsimp [SizePolynomial.eval]
    omega
lemma controlled_wordLength : Controlled wordLength := by
  exact controlled_compose _ _ (controlled_atomic _ trivial) controlled_listLength
lemma gcdSteps_max (k a b : ℕ) : (gcdSteps k (a,b)).1≤ max a b ∧ (gcdSteps k (a,b)).2≤ max a b := by
  induction k generalizing a b with
  | zero => exact ⟨Nat.le_max_left _ _,Nat.le_max_right _ _⟩
  | succ k ih =>
    by_cases hb : b=0
    · simpa [hb,gcdStep,gcdSteps] using ih a 0
    · have hi := ih b (a%b)
      have hle : max b (a%b)≤ max a b := max_le (Nat.le_max_right _ _) ((Nat.mod_le _ _).trans (Nat.le_max_left _ _))
      simpa [gcdSteps,gcdStep,hb] using And.intro (hi.1.trans hle) (hi.2.trans hle)
lemma controlled_gcdStep : Controlled gcdStepCode := by unfold gcdStepCode; control
lemma controlled_gcd : Controlled gcdCode := by
  unfold gcdCode
  apply controlled_compose
  · control
  · apply controlled_compose
    · control
    · apply controlled_compose
      · apply controlled_fold _ (by control) (.mul (.constant 4) .input)
        intro n O xs z pre post he y hy
        rcases z with ⟨a,b⟩
        rw [fold_gcdStepCode] at hy
        cases hy
        have hh := gcdSteps_max pre.length a b
        have h₁ := bits_length_mono hh.1
        have h₂ := bits_length_mono hh.2
        have hm : (max a b).bits.length≤a.bits.length+b.bits.length := by
          rcases le_total a b with h|h
          · rw [max_eq_right h]; omega
          · rw [max_eq_left h]; omega
        rw [width_pair (a:=.nat) (b:=.nat),width_pair (a:=.list .bool) (b:=.prod .nat .nat),
          width_pair (a:=.nat) (b:=.nat)]
        simp only [width_nat,SizePolynomial.eval]
        omega
      · control

open Expression

def PolySafe {a b : DataType} (p : Expression a b) (R : ℕ → Value a → Prop) : Prop :=
  ∃ f : SizePolynomial,∀ {n : ℕ} (O : IndependenceOracle n) (S : ℕ) (x : Value a),
    R S x → Safe O (f.eval S) p x
lemma polySafe_of_controlled {a b : DataType} (p : Expression a b) (hp : Controlled p)
    (R : ℕ → Value a → Prop) (g : SizePolynomial) (hg : ∀ S x,R S x → width x≤g.eval S) :
    PolySafe p R := by
  obtain ⟨f,hf⟩ := hp
  refine ⟨f.subst g,fun O S x hx => ?_⟩
  apply safe_mono p x (hf O x)
  rw [SizePolynomial.eval_subst]
  exact f.monotone (hg S x hx)
lemma polySafe_mono {a b : DataType} (p : Expression a b) {R Q : ℕ → Value a → Prop}
    (hp : PolySafe p Q) (h : ∀ S x,R S x → Q S x) : PolySafe p R := by
  obtain ⟨f,hf⟩ := hp
  exact ⟨f,fun O S x hx => hf O S x (h S x hx)⟩
lemma polySafe_compose {a b c : DataType} (p : Expression a b) (q : Expression b c)
    (R : ℕ → Value a → Prop) (Q : ℕ → Value b → Prop)
    (hp : PolySafe p R) (hq : PolySafe q Q)
    (h : ∀ {n : ℕ} (O : IndependenceOracle n) S x,R S x → ∀ y,run O p x=some y → Q S y) :
    PolySafe (p >>> q) R := by
  obtain ⟨f,hf⟩ := hp
  obtain ⟨g,hg⟩ := hq
  refine ⟨.add f g,fun O S x hx => ?_⟩
  apply safe_compose O p q x
  · exact safe_mono p x (hf O S x hx) (Nat.le_add_right _ _)
  · intro y hy
    exact safe_mono q y (hg O S y (h O S x hx y hy)) (Nat.le_add_left _ _)
lemma polySafe_both {a b c : DataType} (p : Expression a b) (q : Expression a c)
    (R : ℕ → Value a → Prop) (hp : PolySafe p R) (hq : PolySafe q R) :
    PolySafe (.both p q) R := by
  obtain ⟨f,hf⟩ := hp
  obtain ⟨g,hg⟩ := hq
  refine ⟨.add (.mul (.constant 3) (.add f g)) (.constant 1),fun O S x hx => ?_⟩
  apply safe_both O p q x
  · exact safe_mono p x (hf O S x hx) (Nat.le_add_right _ _)
  · exact safe_mono q x (hg O S x hx) (Nat.le_add_left _ _)
lemma polySafe_fold {a b : DataType} (p : Expression (.prod a b) b)
    (R : ℕ → Value (.prod (.list a) b) → Prop) (Q : ℕ → Value (.prod a b) → Prop)
    (hp : PolySafe p Q) (g : SizePolynomial)
    (hinput : ∀ S x,R S x → width x≤g.eval S)
    (hacc : ∀ {n : ℕ} (O : IndependenceOracle n) S xs z,R S (xs,z) →
      ∀ pre post,xs=pre++post → ∀ y,foldValue (run O p) pre z=some y → width y≤g.eval S)
    (hstep : ∀ {n : ℕ} (O : IndependenceOracle n) S xs z,R S (xs,z) →
      ∀ pre x post,xs=pre++x::post → ∀ y,foldValue (run O p) pre z=some y → Q S (x,y)) :
    PolySafe (.fold p) R := by
  obtain ⟨f,hf⟩ := hp
  refine ⟨.add f g,fun O S x hx => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨xs,z⟩ := x
  refine ⟨(hinput S (xs,z) hx).trans (Nat.le_add_left _ _),?_,?_⟩
  · intro y hy
    exact (hacc O S xs z hx xs [] (by simp) y hy).trans (Nat.le_add_left _ _)
  · apply foldSafe_prefix
    intro pre x post he y hy
    exact safe_mono p (x,y) (hf O S (x,y) (hstep O S xs z hx pre x post he y hy))
      (Nat.le_add_right _ _)
lemma polySafe_controlled {a b : DataType} (p : Expression a b)
    (hp : PolySafe p (fun S x => width x≤S)) : Controlled p := by
  obtain ⟨f,hf⟩ := hp
  exact ⟨f,fun O x => hf O (width x) x le_rfl⟩

lemma run_mapStep_partial {n : ℕ} (O : IndependenceOracle n) {a b c : DataType}
    (p : Expression (.prod a c) b) (x : Value a) (zs : List (Value b)) (ctx : Value c) :
    run O (mapStep p) (x,(zs,ctx))=(run O p (x,ctx)).map (fun v => (v::zs,ctx)) := by
  simp only [mapStep,run,bind_pure_comp,Option.bind_some]
  cases he : run O p (x,ctx) <;> simp [he]
lemma fold_mapStep_bound {n : ℕ} (O : IndependenceOracle n) {a b c : DataType}
    (p : Expression (.prod a c) b) (xs : List (Value a)) (zs : List (Value b)) (ctx : Value c)
    (U : ℕ) (hu : ∀ x∈xs,∀ v,run O p (x,ctx)=some v → width v≤U)
    (y : Value (.prod (.list b) c)) (hy : foldValue (run O (mapStep p)) xs (zs,ctx)=some y) :
    width (a:=.list b) y.1≤width (a:=.list b) zs+xs.length*(2*U+2) ∧ y.2=ctx := by
  induction xs generalizing zs with
  | nil => cases hy; simp
  | cons x xs ih =>
    rw [foldValue,run_mapStep_partial] at hy
    cases he : run O p (x,ctx) with
    | none => simp [he] at hy
    | some v =>
      simp only [he,Option.map_some,Option.bind_some] at hy
      have hv := hu x (by simp) v he
      have hh := ih (v::zs) (fun x hx => hu x (by simp [hx])) hy
      rw [width_cons] at hh
      refine ⟨?_,hh.2⟩
      simp only [List.length_cons,Nat.add_mul,Nat.one_mul]
      omega
lemma controlled_mapStep {a b c : DataType} (p : Expression (.prod a c) b) (hp : Controlled p) :
    Controlled (mapStep p) := by unfold mapStep; control
lemma controlled_mapFold {a b c : DataType} (p : Expression (.prod a c) b) (hp : Controlled p) :
    Controlled (.fold (mapStep p)) := by
  obtain ⟨f,hf⟩ := hp
  let s : SizePolynomial := .add (.mul (.constant 3) .input) (.constant 1)
  let g : SizePolynomial := .mul (.add (.mul (.constant 4) .input) (.constant 3))
    (.add (.mul (.constant 2) (f.subst s)) (.constant 3))
  apply controlled_fold _ (controlled_mapStep p ⟨f,hf⟩) g
  intro n O xs z pre post he y hy
  rcases z with ⟨zs,ctx⟩
  let W := width (a:=.prod (.list a) (.prod (.list b) c)) (xs,(zs,ctx))
  have hx : width (a:=.list a) xs≤W := by dsimp [W]; rw [width_pair (a:=.list a) (b:=.prod (.list b) c)]; omega
  have hzs : width (a:=.list b) zs≤W := by dsimp [W]; rw [width_pair (a:=.list a) (b:=.prod (.list b) c),width_pair (a:=.list b) (b:=c)]; omega
  have hc : width ctx≤W := by dsimp [W]; rw [width_pair (a:=.list a) (b:=.prod (.list b) c),width_pair (a:=.list b) (b:=c)]; omega
  have hl : pre.length≤W := by
    have hh := list_length_le_width xs
    have he' := congrArg List.length he
    simp only [List.length_append] at he'
    omega
  let U := f.eval (3*W+1)
  have hh := fold_mapStep_bound O p pre zs ctx U (by
    intro x hxp v hv
    have hxx : x∈xs := by rw [he]; exact List.mem_append_left post hxp
    have hxb := (width_list_member x xs hxx).trans hx
    apply (safe_output (hf O (x,ctx)) hv).trans
    apply f.monotone
    rw [width_pair (a:=a) (b:=c)]
    omega) y hy
  have hm := Nat.mul_le_mul_right (2*U+2) hl
  have hy' : width (a:=.list b) y.1≤W+W*(2*U+2) := by omega
  change width y≤g.eval W
  have hw : width y=2*width (a:=.list b) y.1+1+width ctx := by
    obtain ⟨ys,vctx⟩ := y
    change width (a:=.prod (.list b) c) (ys,vctx)=2*width (a:=.list b) ys+1+width ctx
    rw [width_pair,show vctx=ctx from hh.2]
  rw [hw]
  simp only [g,SizePolynomial.eval,SizePolynomial.eval_subst]
  change _≤(4*W+3)*(2*U+3)
  nlinarith
lemma controlled_mapWith {a b c : DataType} (p : Expression (.prod a c) b) (hp : Controlled p) :
    Controlled (mapWith p) := by
  unfold mapWith
  apply controlled_compose
  · control
  · apply controlled_compose
    · exact controlled_mapFold p hp
    · apply controlled_compose
      · control
      · exact controlled_listReverse

def rationalPair (q : ℚ) : ℕ × ℕ := (q.num.natAbs,q.den)
def normalizePair (a b : ℕ) : ℕ × ℕ :=
  if b=0 then (0,1) else (a/Nat.gcd a b,b/Nat.gcd a b)
lemma rationalPair_div (a b : ℕ) : rationalPair ((a:ℚ)/(b:ℚ))=normalizePair a b := by
  have he : (a:ℚ)/(b:ℚ)=mkRat (a:ℤ) b := by
    simp only [Rat.mkRat_eq_divInt,Rat.divInt_eq_div,Int.cast_natCast]
  rw [he]
  by_cases hb : b=0 <;>
    simp [rationalPair,normalizePair,Rat.num_mkRat,Rat.den_mkRat,hb,Nat.gcd_comm,Int.natAbs_ediv_of_nonneg]
lemma rationalPair_value {q : ℚ} (hq : 0≤q) :
    ((rationalPair q).1:ℚ)/((rationalPair q).2:ℚ)=q := by
  dsimp [rationalPair]
  have hnum : 0≤q.num := Rat.num_nonneg.mpr hq
  have he : (q.num.natAbs:ℚ)=(q.num:ℚ) := by
    have hnat : (q.num.natAbs:ℤ)=q.num := Int.natAbs_of_nonneg hnum
    simpa only [Int.cast_natCast] using congrArg (fun z : ℤ => (z:ℚ)) hnat
  rw [he]
  exact Rat.num_div_den q
lemma rationalPair_den (q : ℚ) : 0<(rationalPair q).2 := q.den_pos

namespace Expression
lemma run_applyIf {n : ℕ} (O : IndependenceOracle n) {a b : DataType}
    (p : Expression a .bool) (q r : Expression a b) (x : Value a) :
    run O (applyIf p q r) x=(run O p x).bind (fun t => if t then run O r x else run O q x) := by
  simp [applyIf,run,Option.bind_assoc]
lemma run_letIn {n : ℕ} (O : IndependenceOracle n) {a b c : DataType}
    (p : Expression a b) (q : Expression (.prod a b) c) (x : Value a) :
    run O (letIn p q) x=(run O p x).bind (fun y => run O q (x,y)) := by
  simp [letIn,run,Option.bind_assoc]

def normalizeRat : Expression NN NN := applyIf (snd >>> natEqZero)
  (letIn gcdCode (both
    (both snd (fst >>> fst) >>> natDiv)
    (both snd (fst >>> snd) >>> natDiv)))
  (constant (0,1))

def ratCross : Expression (.prod NN NN) NN := both
  (both (fst >>> fst) (snd >>> snd) >>> mul)
  (both (snd >>> fst) (fst >>> snd) >>> mul)
def ratAdd : Expression (.prod NN NN) NN :=
  both (ratCross >>> add) (both (fst >>> snd) (snd >>> snd) >>> mul) >>> normalizeRat
def ratMul : Expression (.prod NN NN) NN :=
  both (both (fst >>> fst) (snd >>> fst) >>> mul)
       (both (fst >>> snd) (snd >>> snd) >>> mul) >>> normalizeRat
