lemma run_weightStep_raw {n : ℕ} (O : IndependenceOracle n) (p r a b : ℕ) (xs : List (Word×Word)) :
    run O weightStep (xs,((p,r),(a,b)))=some ((p,r),
      if p=r then (a,b) else
      normalizePair (a*(rationalPair (learningRatio xs p r)).1)
        (b*(rationalPair (learningRatio xs p r)).2)) := by
  simp only [weightStep,run_both,run_compose,run_fst,run_snd,Option.bind_some,run_applyIf]
  rw [run_natEqual]
  by_cases h : p=r
  · simp [h]
  · simp only [h,decide_false,Option.bind_some,Bool.false_eq_true,ite_false,Option.map_some]
    rw [run_learningRatio]
    simp only [Option.bind_some,Option.map_some]
    rw [run_ratMul_raw]; rfl
lemma weightStep_height {n : ℕ} (O : IndependenceOracle n) (xs : Value SampleData)
    (z y : Value (.prod NN NN)) (hy : run O weightStep (xs,z)=some y) :
    y.1=z.1 ∧ pairHeight y.2≤pairHeight z.2+width xs+1 := by
  obtain ⟨⟨p,r⟩,⟨a,b⟩⟩ := z
  rw [run_weightStep_raw] at hy
  cases hy
  refine ⟨rfl,?_⟩
  split_ifs with h
  · omega
  · have hh := pairHeight_ratMul_raw a b (rationalPair (learningRatio xs p r)).1
      (rationalPair (learningRatio xs p r)).2
    have hl := learningRatio_height xs p r
    simpa only [Prod.eta,Prod.snd,Nat.add_assoc] using hh.trans (Nat.add_le_add_left hl (pairHeight (a,b)))
lemma fold_weight_height {n : ℕ} (O : IndependenceOracle n) (xs : Value HistoryData)
    (z y : Value (.prod NN NN)) (hy : foldValue (run O weightStep) xs z=some y) :
    y.1=z.1 ∧ pairHeight y.2≤pairHeight z.2+width xs := by
  induction xs generalizing z with
  | nil => cases hy; exact ⟨rfl,by simp⟩
  | cons x xs ih =>
    rw [foldValue] at hy
    cases he : run O weightStep (x,z) with
    | none => simp [he] at hy
    | some w =>
      simp only [he,Option.bind_some] at hy
      have h₁ := weightStep_height O x z w he
      have h₂ := ih w hy
      refine ⟨h₂.1.trans h₁.1,?_⟩
      rw [width_cons (a:=SampleData)]
      omega
lemma controlled_weightFold : Controlled (.fold weightStep) := by
  apply controlled_fold weightStep controlled_weightStep (.mul (.constant 6) .input)
  intro n O xs z pre post he y hy
  have hh := fold_weight_height O pre z y hy
  have hp : width (a:=HistoryData) pre≤width (a:=HistoryData) xs := by rw [he,width_list_append]; omega
  have hw := width_le_pairHeight y.2
  have hz := pairHeight_le_width z.2
  rw [width_pair (a:=NN) (b:=NN),hh.1]
  simp only [SizePolynomial.eval,width_pair (a:=HistoryData) (b:=.prod NN NN),width_pair (a:=NN) (b:=NN)]
  omega
lemma controlled_historyWeight : Controlled historyWeightCode := by
  have h := controlled_weightFold
  unfold historyWeightCode
  cc
lemma controlled_multiplier : Controlled multiplierCode := by
  have h₁ := controlled_historyWeight
  have h₂ := controlled_defectPairs
  have h₃ := controlled_plainCode
  unfold multiplierCode
  cc

open Expression
lemma controlled_rho : Controlled rhoCode := by unfold rhoCode; cc
lemma run_deficiency_le {n : ℕ} (O : IndependenceOracle n) (r : ℕ) (x y : Word) (z : ℕ)
    (hz : run O deficiencyCode (r,(x,y))=some z) : z≤x.length+r := by
  simp only [deficiencyCode,run_compose,run_both,run_fst,run_snd,Option.bind_some,Option.map_some] at hz
  rw [run_wordLength,run_wordCount,run_wordNot] at hz
  simp only [run,Option.bind_some,Option.map_some] at hz
  split_ifs at hz <;> simp_all only [Option.bind_none,Option.map_none,Option.bind_some,Option.map_some] <;> try contradiction
  rw [run_natSub] at hz
  cases hz
  exact Nat.sub_le _ _
def weightSmall (S : ℕ) (x : Value WeightInput) : Prop :=
  width x≤S ∧ x.1.1.1≤S ∧ x.1.1.2≤S
lemma polySafe_anneal : PolySafe annealCode weightSmall := by
  have hrho := controlled_rho
  have hi : PolySafe
      (both (snd >>> fst >>> wordLength >>> rhoCode) (fst >>> fst >>> snd) >>> ratPowCode) weightSmall := by
    apply polySafe_ratPowerAfter _ _
      (polySafe_of_controlled _ (by cc) _ .input (by intro S x hx; exact hx.1)) .input
    intro n O S x hx y hy
    have hh := (run_both_parts O _ _ x y hy).2
    change some x.1.1.2=some y.2 at hh
    exact (Option.some.inj hh) ▸ hx.2.2
  unfold annealCode
  apply polySafe_ratPowerAfter _ _
    (polySafe_both _ _ _ hi (polySafe_of_controlled _ (by cc) _ .input (by intro S x hx; exact hx.1)))
    (.mul (.constant 2) .input)
  intro n O S x hx y hy
  have hh := (run_both_parts O _ _ x y hy).2
  change run O deficiencyCode (x.1.1.1,x.2)=some y.2 at hh
  have hb := run_deficiency_le O x.1.1.1 x.2.1 x.2.2 y.2 hh
  have hw : x.2.1.length≤S := (width_fst (a:=.word) (b:=.word) x.2).trans ((width_snd x).trans hx.1)
  dsimp only [SizePolynomial.eval]
  exact hb.trans ((Nat.add_le_add hw hx.2.1).trans_eq (by omega))
lemma polySafe_weight : PolySafe weightCode weightSmall := by
  have hm := controlled_multiplier
  unfold weightCode
  exact polySafe_post _ _ _ (polySafe_both _ _ _
    (polySafe_of_controlled _ (by cc) _ .input (by intro S x hx; exact hx.1)) polySafe_anneal) controlled_ratMul

abbrev OraclePredicate (a : DataType) := (n : ℕ) → IndependenceOracle n → ℕ → Value a → Prop

def OracleSafe {a b : DataType} (p : Expression a b) (R : OraclePredicate a) : Prop :=
  ∃ f : SizePolynomial,∀ {n : ℕ} (O : IndependenceOracle n) S x,R n O S x → Safe O (f.eval S) p x
lemma oracleSafe_lift {a b : DataType} (p : Expression a b) (R : ℕ → Value a → Prop)
    (h : PolySafe p R) : OracleSafe p (fun _ _ => R) := h
lemma oracleSafe_controlled {a b : DataType} (p : Expression a b) (hp : Controlled p)
    (R : OraclePredicate a) (g : SizePolynomial)
    (hg : ∀ n O S x,R n O S x → width x≤g.eval S) : OracleSafe p R := by
  obtain ⟨f,hf⟩ := hp
  refine ⟨f.subst g,fun O S x hx => ?_⟩
  apply safe_mono p x (hf O x)
  rw [SizePolynomial.eval_subst]
  exact f.monotone (hg _ O S x hx)
lemma oracleSafe_mono {a b : DataType} (p : Expression a b) {R Q : OraclePredicate a}
    (hp : OracleSafe p Q) (h : ∀ n O S x,R n O S x → Q n O S x) : OracleSafe p R := by
  obtain ⟨f,hf⟩ := hp
  exact ⟨f,fun O S x hx => hf O S x (h _ O S x hx)⟩
lemma oracleSafe_reparam {a b : DataType} (p : Expression a b) (R : OraclePredicate a)
    (hp : OracleSafe p R) (g : SizePolynomial) : OracleSafe p (fun n O S x => R n O (g.eval S) x) := by
  obtain ⟨f,hf⟩ := hp
  exact ⟨f.subst g,fun O S x hx => by rw [SizePolynomial.eval_subst]; exact hf O _ x hx⟩
lemma oracleSafe_compose {a b c : DataType} (p : Expression a b) (q : Expression b c)
    (R : OraclePredicate a) (Q : OraclePredicate b) (hp : OracleSafe p R) (hq : OracleSafe q Q)
    (h : ∀ n O S x,R n O S x → ∀ y,run O p x=some y → Q n O S y) : OracleSafe (p >>> q) R := by
  obtain ⟨f,hf⟩ := hp
  obtain ⟨g,hg⟩ := hq
  refine ⟨.add f g,fun O S x hx => ?_⟩
  apply safe_compose O p q x
  · exact safe_mono p x (hf O S x hx) (Nat.le_add_right _ _)
  · intro y hy
    exact safe_mono q y (hg O S y (h _ O S x hx y hy)) (Nat.le_add_left _ _)
lemma oracleSafe_both {a b c : DataType} (p : Expression a b) (q : Expression a c)
    (R : OraclePredicate a) (hp : OracleSafe p R) (hq : OracleSafe q R) : OracleSafe (both p q) R := by
  obtain ⟨f,hf⟩ := hp
  obtain ⟨g,hg⟩ := hq
  refine ⟨.add (.mul (.constant 3) (.add f g)) (.constant 1),fun O S x hx => ?_⟩
  apply safe_both O p q x
  · exact safe_mono p x (hf O S x hx) (Nat.le_add_right _ _)
  · exact safe_mono q x (hg O S x hx) (Nat.le_add_left _ _)
lemma oracleSafe_post {a b c : DataType} (p : Expression a b) (q : Expression b c)
    (R : OraclePredicate a) (hp : OracleSafe p R) (hq : Controlled q) : OracleSafe (p >>> q) R := by
  obtain ⟨f,hf⟩ := hp
  apply oracleSafe_compose p q R (fun _ _ S y => width y≤f.eval S) ⟨f,hf⟩
    (oracleSafe_controlled q hq _ f (by intros; assumption))
  intro n O S x hx y hy
  exact safe_output (hf O S x hx) hy
lemma oracleSafe_pull {a b c : DataType} (p : Expression a b) (q : Expression b c)
    (R : OraclePredicate a) (Q : OraclePredicate b) (hp : Controlled p)
    (g : SizePolynomial) (hw : ∀ n O S x,R n O S x → width x≤g.eval S)
    (hq : OracleSafe q Q)
    (hh : ∀ n O S x,R n O S x → ∀ y,run O p x=some y → Q n O S y) : OracleSafe (p >>> q) R :=
  oracleSafe_compose p q R Q (oracleSafe_controlled p hp R g hw) hq hh
lemma oracleSafe_input_bound {a b : DataType} (p : Expression a b) (R : OraclePredicate a)
    (hp : OracleSafe p R) : ∃ f : SizePolynomial,∀ n O S x,R n O S x → width x≤f.eval S := by
  obtain ⟨f,hf⟩ := hp
  exact ⟨f,fun _ O S x hx => safe_input (hf O S x hx)⟩
lemma oracleSafe_applyIf {a b : DataType} (t : Expression a .bool) (p q : Expression a b)
    (R : OraclePredicate a) (ht : OracleSafe t R)
    (hp : OracleSafe p (fun n O S x => R n O S x ∧ run O t x=some false))
    (hq : OracleSafe q (fun n O S x => R n O S x ∧ run O t x=some true)) :
    OracleSafe (applyIf t p q) R := by
  have hid : OracleSafe (ident (a:=a)) R := by
    obtain ⟨f,hf⟩ := oracleSafe_input_bound t R ht
    exact oracleSafe_controlled _ (by cc) R f hf
  have hboth := oracleSafe_both t ident R ht hid
  obtain ⟨f,hf⟩ := hboth
  obtain ⟨g,hg⟩ := hp
  obtain ⟨k,hk⟩ := hq
  unfold applyIf
  apply oracleSafe_compose (both t ident) (branch p q) R
    (fun n O S z => width z≤f.eval S ∧ R n O S z.2 ∧ run O t z.2=some z.1) ⟨f,hf⟩
  · refine ⟨.add f (.add g k),fun O S z hz => ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨v,x⟩ := z
    refine ⟨hz.1.trans (Nat.le_add_right _ _),?_,?_⟩
    · intro y hy
      cases v
      · exact (safe_output (hg O S x ⟨hz.2.1,hz.2.2⟩) hy).trans (by dsimp [SizePolynomial.eval]; omega)
      · exact (safe_output (hk O S x ⟨hz.2.1,hz.2.2⟩) hy).trans (by dsimp [SizePolynomial.eval]; omega)
    · cases v
      · exact safe_mono p x (hg O S x ⟨hz.2.1,hz.2.2⟩) (by dsimp [SizePolynomial.eval]; omega)
      · exact safe_mono q x (hk O S x ⟨hz.2.1,hz.2.2⟩) (by dsimp [SizePolynomial.eval]; omega)
  · intro n O S x hx z hz
    have hh := run_both_parts O t ident x z hz
    have he : x=z.2 := Option.some.inj hh.2
    exact ⟨safe_output (hf O S x hx) hz,he ▸ hx,he ▸ hh.1⟩

lemma oracleSafe_fold {a b : DataType} (p : Expression (.prod a b) b)
    (R : OraclePredicate (.prod (.list a) b)) (Q : OraclePredicate (.prod a b))
    (hp : OracleSafe p Q) (g : SizePolynomial)
    (hinput : ∀ {n : ℕ} (O : IndependenceOracle n) S x,R n O S x → width x≤g.eval S)
    (hacc : ∀ {n : ℕ} (O : IndependenceOracle n) S xs z,R n O S (xs,z) →
      ∀ pre post,xs=pre++post → ∀ y,foldValue (run O p) pre z=some y → width y≤g.eval S)
    (hstep : ∀ {n : ℕ} (O : IndependenceOracle n) S xs z,R n O S (xs,z) →
      ∀ pre x post,xs=pre++x::post → ∀ y,foldValue (run O p) pre z=some y → Q n O S (x,y)) :
    OracleSafe (.fold p) R := by
  obtain ⟨f,hf⟩ := hp
  refine ⟨.add f g,fun O S x hx => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨xs,z⟩ := x
  refine ⟨(hinput O S (xs,z) hx).trans (Nat.le_add_left _ _),?_,?_⟩
  · intro y hy
    exact (hacc O S xs z hx xs [] (by simp) y hy).trans (Nat.le_add_left _ _)
  · apply foldSafe_prefix
    intro pre x post he y hy
    exact safe_mono p (x,y) (hf O S (x,y) (hstep O S xs z hx pre x post he y hy))
      (Nat.le_add_right _ _)

lemma oracleSafe_iterateNat {a : DataType} (p : Expression a a)
    (R : OraclePredicate (.prod .nat a)) (Q : OraclePredicate a)
    (hp : OracleSafe p Q) (g : SizePolynomial)
    (hinput : ∀ {n : ℕ} (O : IndependenceOracle n) S k z,R n O S (k,z) → k+width (a:=a) z≤g.eval S)
    (hacc : ∀ {n : ℕ} (O : IndependenceOracle n) S k z,R n O S (k,z) →
      ∀ j,j≤k → ∀ y,iterateM (run O p) j z=some y → width (a:=a) y≤g.eval S)
    (hbody : ∀ {n : ℕ} (O : IndependenceOracle n) S k z,R n O S (k,z) →
      ∀ j,j<k → ∀ y,iterateM (run O p) j z=some y → Q n O S y) :
    OracleSafe (iterateNat p) R := by
  let T : SizePolynomial := .add (.mul (.constant 12) g) (.constant 4)
  have hnatwidth : ∀ {n : ℕ} (O : IndependenceOracle n) S x,R n O S x → width x≤T.eval S := by
    intro n O S x hx
    obtain ⟨k,z⟩ := x
    have hh : k+width (a:=a) z≤g.eval S := hinput O S k z hx
    have hb := bits_length_le_value k
    rw [width_pair (a:=.nat) (b:=a),width_nat]
    dsimp [T,SizePolynomial.eval]
    have h₁ := Nat.mul_le_mul_left 2 hh
    omega
  have hu : OracleSafe (onLeft (c:=a) unary) R := by
    unfold onLeft
    apply oracleSafe_both
    · apply oracleSafe_compose _ _ R (fun _ _ S k => k≤g.eval S)
        (oracleSafe_controlled Expression.fst (by control) R T (fun n O => hnatwidth O))
        (oracleSafe_reparam unary (fun _ _ S k => k≤S) (oracleSafe_lift _ _ polySafe_unary) g)
      intro n O S x hx y hy
      obtain ⟨k,z⟩ := x
      simp only [run_fst, Option.some.injEq] at hy
      subst y
      have hh : k+width (a:=a) z≤g.eval S := hinput O S k z hx
      exact (Nat.le_add_right k (width (a:=a) z)).trans hh
    · exact oracleSafe_controlled Expression.snd (by control) R T (fun n O => hnatwidth O)
  let Rw : OraclePredicate (.prod .word a) := fun n O S x => R n O S (x.1.length,x.2)
  let Rl : OraclePredicate (.prod (.list .bool) a) := fun n O S x => R n O S (x.1.length,x.2)
  have hw : ∀ {n : ℕ} (O : IndependenceOracle n) S x,Rw n O S x → width x≤T.eval S := by
    intro n O S x hx
    obtain ⟨w,z⟩ := x
    have hh : w.length+width (a:=a) z≤g.eval S := hinput O S w.length z hx
    rw [width_pair (a:=.word) (b:=a),width_word]
    dsimp [T,SizePolynomial.eval]
    omega
  have hfold : OracleSafe (.fold (snd >>> p)) Rl := by
    refine oracleSafe_fold (Expression.snd (a:=.bool) >>> p) Rl
      (fun n O S x => width x≤T.eval S ∧ Q n O S x.2) ?_ T ?_ ?_ ?_
    · apply oracleSafe_compose _ _ _ Q
        (oracleSafe_controlled Expression.snd (by control) _ T (by intro n O S x hx; exact hx.1)) hp
      intro n O S x hx y hy
      cases hy
      exact hx.2
    · intro n O S x hx
      obtain ⟨xs,z⟩ := x
      have hh : xs.length+width (a:=a) z≤g.eval S := hinput O S xs.length z hx
      rw [width_pair (a:=.list .bool) (b:=a),width_list_bool]
      dsimp [T,SizePolynomial.eval]
      omega
    · intro n O S xs z hx pre post he y hy
      rw [foldValue_iterateM] at hy
      have hj : pre.length≤xs.length := by rw [he,List.length_append]; omega
      have hh := hacc O S xs.length z hx pre.length hj y hy
      dsimp [T,SizePolynomial.eval]
      omega
    · intro n O S xs z hx pre b post he y hy
      rw [foldValue_iterateM] at hy
      have hj : pre.length<xs.length := by rw [he,List.length_append,List.length_cons]; omega
      have hh := hacc O S xs.length z hx pre.length hj.le y hy
      refine ⟨?_,hbody O S xs.length z hx pre.length hj y hy⟩
      rw [width_pair (a:=.bool) (b:=a),width_bool]
      dsimp [T,SizePolynomial.eval]
      omega
  unfold iterateNat iterateWord
  apply oracleSafe_compose _ _ R Rw hu
  · apply oracleSafe_compose _ _ Rw Rl
      (oracleSafe_controlled _ (by unfold onLeft; control) Rw T (fun n O => hw O)) hfold
    intro n O S x hx y hy
    cases hy
    exact hx
  · intro n O S x hx y hy
    obtain ⟨k,z⟩ := x
    obtain ⟨w,hw,hk⟩ := run_unary O k
    simp only [onLeft,run_both,run_compose,run_fst,run_snd,Option.bind_some,hw,Option.map_some] at hy
    cases hy
    change R n O S (w.length,z)
    rwa [hk]

namespace Effect
def bankScope {a : DataType} (R : OraclePredicate a) : OraclePredicate (.prod a BankData) :=
  fun n O S x => R n O S x.1 ∧ width (a:=BankData) x.2≤S
lemma scope_width {a b : DataType} (p : Expression a b) (R : OraclePredicate a)
    (hp : OracleSafe p R) : ∃ f : SizePolynomial,∀ n O S x,bankScope R n O S x → width x≤f.eval S := by
  obtain ⟨f,hf⟩ := oracleSafe_input_bound p R hp
  refine ⟨.add (.mul (.constant 2) f) (.add .input (.constant 1)),?_⟩
  intro n O S x hx
  have hh := hf n O S x.1 hx.1
  have hb : width (a:=BankData) x.2≤S := hx.2
  rw [width_pair (a:=a) (b:=BankData)]
  dsimp only [SizePolynomial.eval]
  omega
lemma safe_scope_fst {a b : DataType} (p : Expression a b) (R : OraclePredicate a)
    (hp : OracleSafe p R) : OracleSafe (fst (b:=BankData) >>> p) (bankScope R) := by
  obtain ⟨f,hf⟩ := scope_width p R hp
  apply oracleSafe_pull _ _ _ R (by cc) f hf hp
  intro n O S x hx y hy
  cases hy
  exact hx.1
lemma safe_scope_controlled {a b c : DataType} (p : Expression a b) (q : Expression (.prod a BankData) c)
    (R : OraclePredicate a) (hp : OracleSafe p R) (hq : Controlled q) : OracleSafe q (bankScope R) := by
  obtain ⟨f,hf⟩ := scope_width p R hp
  exact oracleSafe_controlled q hq _ f hf
lemma oracleSafe_pure {a b : DataType} (p : Expression a b) (R : OraclePredicate a)
    (hp : OracleSafe p R) : OracleSafe (pure p) (bankScope R) := by
  unfold pure
  apply oracleSafe_both
  · apply oracleSafe_both
    · exact safe_scope_controlled p _ R hp (by cc)
    · exact safe_scope_fst p R hp
  · exact safe_scope_controlled p _ R hp (by cc)
lemma oracleSafe_precompose {a b c : DataType} (p : Expression a b) (q : Effect b c)
    (R : OraclePredicate a) (Q : OraclePredicate b) (hp : OracleSafe p R)
    (hq : OracleSafe q (bankScope Q))
    (h : ∀ n O S x,R n O S x → ∀ y,run O p x=some y → Q n O S y) :
    OracleSafe (precompose p q) (bankScope R) := by
  unfold precompose onLeft
  apply oracleSafe_compose _ _ _ (bankScope Q)
    (oracleSafe_both _ _ _ (safe_scope_fst p R hp) (safe_scope_controlled p _ R hp (by cc))) hq
  intro n O S x hx y hy
  have hh := run_both_parts O (fst >>> p) snd x y hy
  have hp' : run O p x.1=some y.1 := hh.1

  have hb : x.2=y.2 := Option.some.inj hh.2
  exact ⟨h n O S x.1 hx.1 y.1 hp',hb ▸ hx.2⟩
lemma oracleSafe_keep {a b : DataType} (p : Effect a b) (R : OraclePredicate (.prod a BankData))
    (hp : OracleSafe p R) : OracleSafe (keep p) R := by
  obtain ⟨f,hf⟩ := oracleSafe_input_bound p R hp
  unfold keep Expression.letIn
  apply oracleSafe_post
  · exact oracleSafe_both _ _ _ (oracleSafe_controlled _ (by cc) R f hf) hp
  · cc
lemma oracleSafe_bind {a b c : DataType} (p : Effect a b) (q : Effect b c)
    (R : OraclePredicate a) (Q : OraclePredicate b)
    (hp : OracleSafe p (bankScope R)) (hq : OracleSafe q (bankScope Q))
    (h : ∀ n O S x bank,R n O S x → width (a:=BankData) bank≤S → ∀ y rest,
      run O p (x,bank)=some ((true,y),rest) → Q n O S y ∧ width (a:=BankData) rest≤S) :
    OracleSafe (bind p q) (bankScope R) := by
  obtain ⟨f,hf⟩ := hp
  let T : OraclePredicate (.prod (Optional b) BankData) := fun n O S z =>
    ∃ x bank,bankScope R n O S (x,bank) ∧ run O p (x,bank)=some z
  have hw : ∀ n O S z,T n O S z → width z≤f.eval S := by
    intro n O S z hz
    obtain ⟨x,bank,hx,he⟩ := hz
    exact safe_output (hf O S (x,bank) hx) he
  unfold bind
  apply oracleSafe_compose p _ (bankScope R) T ⟨f,hf⟩
  · apply oracleSafe_applyIf _ _ _ T
    · exact oracleSafe_controlled _ (by cc) T f hw
    · exact oracleSafe_controlled _ (by cc) _ f (by intro n O S z hz; exact hw n O S z hz.1)
    · apply oracleSafe_pull _ q _ (bankScope Q) (by cc) f
        (by intro n O S z hz; exact hw n O S z hz.1) hq
      intro n O S z hz y hy
      obtain ⟨⟨flag,v⟩,rest⟩ := z
      have hv : flag=true := Option.some.inj hz.2
      subst flag
      have hy' : (v,rest)=y := Option.some.inj hy
      subst y
      obtain ⟨x,bank,hx,he⟩ := hz.1
      exact h n O S x bank hx.1 hx.2 v rest he
  · intro n O S x hx z hz
    exact ⟨x.1,x.2,hx,hz⟩
lemma RealizesLaw.output_some {n : ℕ} {O : IndependenceOracle n} {A : Type*} {a b : DataType}
    {p : Effect a b} {e : A → Value b} {x : Value a} {t : DrawTree A}
    (h : RealizesLaw O p e x t) (bank : Bank) (y : Value b) (rest : Bank)
    (hy : run O p (x,bank)=some ((true,y),rest)) : ∃ v,y=e v ∧ width (a:=BankData) rest≤width (a:=BankData) bank := by
  obtain ⟨v,r,he,hw⟩ := h.outputs bank
  rw [hy] at he
  have he' := Option.some.inj he
  cases v with
  | none => cases (congrArg (fun z => z.1.1) he')
  | some v =>
    have hry : rest=r := congrArg Prod.snd he'
    have hyy : y=e v := congrArg (fun z => z.1.2) he'
    exact ⟨v,hyy,hry ▸ hw⟩
end Effect
end MachineCode

namespace DrawTree
lemma All.mono {A : Type*} {t : DrawTree A} {P Q : A → Prop}
    (h : All P t) (hq : ∀ x,P x → Q x) : All Q t := by
  induction t with
  | leaf x => exact hq x h
  | draw v k ih => exact fun i => ih i (h i)
lemma all_bind_of_all {A B : Type*} (t : DrawTree A) (f : A → DrawTree B)
    (P : A → Prop) (Q : B → Prop) (ht : All P t)
    (hf : ∀ x,P x → All Q (f x)) : All Q (t.bind f) := by
  induction t with
  | leaf x => exact hf x ht
  | draw v k ih => exact fun i => ih i (ht i)
lemma all_map_of_all {A B : Type*} (t : DrawTree A) (f : A → B)
    (P : A → Prop) (Q : B → Prop) (ht : All P t)
    (hf : ∀ x,P x → Q (f x)) : All Q (t.map f) :=
  all_bind_of_all t _ P Q ht hf
end DrawTree
namespace MachineCode

lemma bankEval_all {A : Type*} (t : DrawTree A) (P : A → Prop)
    (ht : DrawTree.All P t) (bank : Bank) (x : A)
    (hx : (bankEval t bank).1=some x) : P x := by
  induction t generalizing bank with
  | leaf a =>
    have he : a=x := Option.some.inj hx
    exact he ▸ ht
  | draw v k ih =>
    cases bank with
    | nil => cases hx
    | cons row bank =>
      simp only [bankEval] at hx
      split at hx
      · cases hx
      · exact ih _ (ht _) bank hx
open Expression
namespace Effect
lemma RealizesLaw.outputs_all {n : ℕ} {O : IndependenceOracle n}
    {A : Type*} {a b : DataType} {p : Effect a b} {e : A → Value b}
    {x : Value a} {t : DrawTree A} (h : RealizesLaw O p e x t)
    (P : A → Prop) (ht : DrawTree.All P t) (bank : Bank) :
    ∃ y : Option A,∃ rest : Bank,
      run O p (x,bank)=some (optionalValue b (y.map e),rest) ∧
      width (a:=BankData) rest≤width (a:=BankData) bank ∧
      ∀ v,y=some v → P v := by
  obtain ⟨u,hu,hp⟩ := h
  refine ⟨(bankEval u bank).1,(bankEval u bank).2,hp bank,bankEval_rest_width u bank,?_⟩
  intro v hv
  exact bankEval_all u P (hu.all P ht) bank v hv
lemma RealizesLaw.output_some_all {n : ℕ} {O : IndependenceOracle n}
    {A : Type*} {a b : DataType} {p : Effect a b} {e : A → Value b}
    {x : Value a} {t : DrawTree A} (h : RealizesLaw O p e x t)
    (P : A → Prop) (ht : DrawTree.All P t) (bank : Bank)
    (y : Value b) (rest : Bank) (hy : run O p (x,bank)=some ((true,y),rest)) :
    ∃ v,y=e v ∧ P v ∧ width (a:=BankData) rest≤width (a:=BankData) bank := by
  obtain ⟨v,r,he,hw,hv⟩ := h.outputs_all P ht bank
  rw [hy] at he
  have hh := Option.some.inj he
  cases v with
  | none => cases (congrArg (fun z => z.1.1) hh)
  | some v =>
    have hry : rest=r := congrArg Prod.snd hh
    have hyy : y=e v := congrArg (fun z => z.1.2) hh
    exact ⟨v,hyy,hv v rfl,hry ▸ hw⟩
lemma RealizesLaw.run_bound {n : ℕ} {O : IndependenceOracle n}
    {A : Type*} {a b : DataType} {p : Effect a b} {e : A → Value b}
    {x : Value a} {t : DrawTree A} (h : RealizesLaw O p e x t)
    (W : ℕ) (R : Value b → Prop)
    (ht : DrawTree.All (fun v => width (e v)≤W ∧ R (e v)) t)
    (bank : Bank) (y : Value (.prod (Optional b) BankData))
    (hy : run O p (x,bank)=some y) :
    width y≤2*(width (zeroValue b)+W+3)+1+width (a:=BankData) bank ∧
    (y.1.1=true → R y.1.2) := by
  obtain ⟨v,rest,he,hrest,hv⟩ := h.outputs_all _ ht bank
  have he' : y=(optionalValue b (v.map e),rest) := Option.some.inj (hy.symm.trans he)
  subst y
  constructor
  · have hw : width (optionalValue b (v.map e))≤width (zeroValue b)+W+3 := by
      apply width_optionalValue
      intro z hz
      obtain ⟨u,hu,hz⟩ := Option.map_eq_some_iff.mp hz
      subst z
      exact (hv u hu).1
    rw [width_pair (a:=Optional b) (b:=BankData)]
    omega
  · cases v with
    | none => intro h; cases h
    | some z => intro _; exact (hv z rfl).2
lemma RealizesLaw.rest_width {n : ℕ} {O : IndependenceOracle n}
    {A : Type*} {a b : DataType} {p : Effect a b} {e : A → Value b}
    {x : Value a} {t : DrawTree A} (h : RealizesLaw O p e x t)
    (bank : Bank) (y : Value (.prod (Optional b) BankData))
    (hy : run O p (x,bank)=some y) : width (a:=BankData) y.2≤width (a:=BankData) bank := by
  obtain ⟨v,rest,he,hrest⟩ := h.outputs bank
  have he' : y=(optionalValue b (v.map e),rest) := Option.some.inj (hy.symm.trans he)
  exact he' ▸ hrest

def BankMonotone {a b : DataType} (p : Effect a b) : Prop :=
  ∀ {n : ℕ} (O : IndependenceOracle n) (x : Value a) (bank : Bank) z,
    run O p (x,bank)=some z → width (a:=BankData) z.2≤width (a:=BankData) bank
lemma bank_pure {a b : DataType} (p : Expression a b) : BankMonotone (pure p) := by
  intro n O x bank z hz
  have hh := (run_both_parts (a:=.prod a BankData) (b:=Optional b) (c:=BankData) O (both (constant (b:=.bool) true) (fst >>> p)) snd (x,bank) z hz).2
  have he : bank=z.2 := Option.some.inj hh
  exact he ▸ le_rfl
lemma bank_fail {a b : DataType} : BankMonotone (fail (a:=a) (b:=b)) := by
  intro n O x bank z hz
  cases hz
  exact le_rfl
lemma bank_bind {a b c : DataType} (p : Effect a b) (q : Effect b c)
    (hp : BankMonotone p) (hq : BankMonotone q) : BankMonotone (bind p q) := by
  intro n O x bank z hz
  rw [bind,run_compose] at hz
  cases he : run O p (x,bank) with
  | none => simp [he] at hz
  | some y =>
    simp only [he,Option.bind_some] at hz
    obtain ⟨⟨v,y⟩,rest⟩ := y
    have hb := hp O x bank ((v,y),rest) he
    cases v
    · cases hz; exact hb
    · exact (hq O y rest z hz).trans hb
lemma run_keep_value {n : ℕ} (O : IndependenceOracle n) {a b : DataType}
    (p : Effect a b) (x : Value a) (bank : Bank) (v : Value (.prod (Optional b) BankData))
    (hp : run O p (x,bank)=some v) :
    run O (keep p) (x,bank)=some
      ((if v.1.1 then optionalValue (.prod a b) (some (x,v.1.2)) else optionalValue (.prod a b) none),v.2) := by
  rw [keep,run_letIn,hp]
  obtain ⟨⟨flag,y⟩,rest⟩ := v
  cases flag <;> rfl
lemma run_keep_some {n : ℕ} (O : IndependenceOracle n) {a b : DataType}
    (p : Effect a b) (x : Value a) (bank : Bank) (x' : Value a) (y : Value b) (rest : Bank)
    (h : run O (keep p) (x,bank)=some ((true,(x',y)),rest)) :
    x'=x ∧ run O p (x,bank)=some ((true,y),rest) := by
  cases he : run O p (x,bank) with
  | none => simp only [keep,run_letIn,he,Option.bind_none] at h; contradiction
  | some v =>
    rw [run_keep_value O p x bank v he] at h
    obtain ⟨⟨flag,y'⟩,r⟩ := v
    cases flag
    · cases h
    · cases h
      exact ⟨rfl,rfl⟩
lemma bank_keep {a b : DataType} (p : Effect a b) (hp : BankMonotone p) : BankMonotone (keep p) := by
  intro n O x bank z hz
  cases he : run O p (x,bank) with
  | none => simp only [keep,run_letIn,he,Option.bind_none] at hz; contradiction
  | some v =>
    rw [run_keep_value O p x bank v he] at hz
    cases hz
    exact hp O x bank v he
lemma bank_letIn {a b c : DataType} (p : Effect a b) (q : Effect (.prod a b) c)
    (hp : BankMonotone p) (hq : BankMonotone q) : BankMonotone (letIn p q) :=
  bank_bind _ _ (bank_keep p hp) hq
lemma bank_precompose {a b c : DataType} (p : Expression a b) (q : Effect b c)
    (hq : BankMonotone q) : BankMonotone (precompose p q) := by
  intro n O x bank z hz
  cases he : run O p x with
  | none => simp only [precompose,onLeft,run_compose,run_both,run_fst,run_snd,Option.bind_some,he,Option.bind_none] at hz; contradiction
  | some y =>
    rw [run_precompose O p q x y bank he] at hz
    exact hq O y bank z hz
lemma bank_map {a b c : DataType} (p : Effect a b) (q : Expression b c)
    (hp : BankMonotone p) : BankMonotone (map p q) := bank_bind _ _ hp (bank_pure q)
lemma bank_choose {a b : DataType} (t : Expression a .bool) (p q : Effect a b)
    (hp : BankMonotone p) (hq : BankMonotone q) : BankMonotone (choose t p q) := by
  intro n O x bank z hz
  cases he : run O t x with
  | none => simp only [choose,run_applyIf,run_compose,run_fst,Option.bind_some,he,Option.bind_none] at hz; contradiction
  | some flag =>
    rw [run_choose O t p q x bank flag he] at hz
    cases flag
    · exact hp O x bank z hz
    · exact hq O x bank z hz
lemma bank_draw : BankMonotone draw := by
  intro n O v bank z hz
  rw [run_draw] at hz
  cases hz
  exact width_drop (a:=RandomRows) bank 1
end Effect

open Expression
abbrev Attribute (a : DataType) := ℕ → Value a → Prop
def Attribute.Mono {a : DataType} (R : Attribute a) : Prop :=
  ∀ S T,S≤T → ∀ x,R S x → R T x
def AttrSafe {a b : DataType} (p : Expression a b) (R : Attribute a) : Prop :=
  PolySafe p (fun S x => width x≤S ∧ R S x)
lemma attrSafe_controlled {a b : DataType} (p : Expression a b) (hp : Controlled p)
    (R : Attribute a) : AttrSafe p R :=
  polySafe_of_controlled p hp _ .input (by intro S x hx; exact hx.1)
lemma attrSafe_mono {a b : DataType} (p : Expression a b) {R Q : Attribute a}
    (hp : AttrSafe p Q) (h : ∀ S x,R S x → Q S x) : AttrSafe p R :=
  polySafe_mono p hp (by intro S x hx; exact ⟨hx.1,h S x hx.2⟩)
lemma attrSafe_compose {a b c : DataType} (p : Expression a b) (q : Expression b c)
    (R : Attribute a) (Q : Attribute b) (hp : AttrSafe p R) (hq : AttrSafe q Q)
    (hm : Q.Mono)
    (h : ∀ {n : ℕ} (O : IndependenceOracle n) S x,R S x → ∀ y,run O p x=some y → Q S y) :
    AttrSafe (p >>> q) R := by
  obtain ⟨f,hf⟩ := hp
  let g : SizePolynomial := .add f .input
  apply polySafe_compose p q _ (fun S y => width y≤g.eval S ∧ Q (g.eval S) y) ⟨f,hf⟩
    (polySafe_reparam q _ hq g)
  intro n O S x hx y hy
  exact ⟨(safe_output (hf O S x hx) hy).trans (Nat.le_add_right _ _),
    hm S _ (Nat.le_add_left _ _) y (h O S x hx.2 y hy)⟩
lemma attrSafe_both {a b c : DataType} (p : Expression a b) (q : Expression a c)
    (R : Attribute a) (hp : AttrSafe p R) (hq : AttrSafe q R) : AttrSafe (both p q) R :=
  polySafe_both p q _ hp hq
lemma attrSafe_post {a b c : DataType} (p : Expression a b) (q : Expression b c)
    (R : Attribute a) (hp : AttrSafe p R) (hq : Controlled q) : AttrSafe (p >>> q) R :=
  polySafe_post p q _ hp hq
lemma attrSafe_pull {a b c : DataType} (p : Expression a b) (q : Expression b c)
    (R : Attribute a) (Q : Attribute b) (hp : Controlled p) (hq : AttrSafe q Q)
    (hm : Q.Mono)
    (h : ∀ {n : ℕ} (O : IndependenceOracle n) S x,R S x → ∀ y,run O p x=some y → Q S y) :
    AttrSafe (p >>> q) R :=
  attrSafe_compose p q R Q (attrSafe_controlled p hp R) hq hm h
lemma attrSafe_branch {a b : DataType} (p q : Expression a b) (R : Attribute a)
    (hp : AttrSafe p R) (hq : AttrSafe q R) : AttrSafe (branch p q) (fun S x => R S x.2) := by
  obtain ⟨f,hf⟩ := hp
  obtain ⟨g,hg⟩ := hq
  refine ⟨.add .input (.add f g),fun O S z hz => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨v,x⟩ := z
  have hw : width x≤S := (width_snd (a:=.bool) (b:=a) (v,x)).trans hz.1
  have hpf := safe_mono p x (hf O S x ⟨hw,hz.2⟩) (show f.eval S≤S+(f.eval S+g.eval S) by omega)
  have hqf := safe_mono q x (hg O S x ⟨hw,hz.2⟩) (show g.eval S≤S+(f.eval S+g.eval S) by omega)
  refine ⟨hz.1.trans (Nat.le_add_right _ _),?_,?_⟩
  · intro y hy
    cases v
    · exact safe_output hpf hy
    · exact safe_output hqf hy
  · cases v
    · exact hpf
    · exact hqf
lemma attrSafe_applyIf {a b : DataType} (t : Expression a .bool) (p q : Expression a b)
    (R : Attribute a) (hm : R.Mono) (ht : AttrSafe t R) (hp : AttrSafe p R) (hq : AttrSafe q R) :
    AttrSafe (applyIf t p q) R := by
  unfold applyIf
  apply attrSafe_compose _ _ R (fun S (z : Value (.prod .bool a)) => R S z.2)
    (attrSafe_both t ident R ht (attrSafe_controlled ident (by cc) R)) (attrSafe_branch p q R hp hq)
  · intro S T h z hz; exact hm S T h z.2 hz
  · intro n O S x hx z hz
    have he : x=z.2 := Option.some.inj (run_both_parts O t ident x z hz).2
    exact he ▸ hx
namespace Effect
abbrev EffectSafe {a b : DataType} (p : Effect a b) (R : Attribute a) :=
  AttrSafe p (fun S x => R S x.1)
lemma attr_pure {a b : DataType} (p : Expression a b) (R : Attribute a) (hm : R.Mono)
    (hp : AttrSafe p R) : EffectSafe (pure p) R := by
  unfold pure
  apply attrSafe_both
  · apply attrSafe_both
    · exact attrSafe_controlled _ (by cc) _
    · apply attrSafe_pull _ p _ R (by cc) hp hm
      intro n O S x hx y hy
      cases hy; exact hx
  · exact attrSafe_controlled _ (by cc) _
lemma attr_precompose {a b c : DataType} (p : Expression a b) (q : Effect b c)
    (R : Attribute a) (Q : Attribute b) (hp : AttrSafe p R) (hq : EffectSafe q Q)
    (hmR : R.Mono) (hmQ : Q.Mono)
    (h : ∀ {n : ℕ} (O : IndependenceOracle n) S x,R S x → ∀ y,run O p x=some y → Q S y) :
    EffectSafe (precompose p q) R := by
  unfold precompose onLeft
  apply attrSafe_compose _ q _ _ ?_ hq
  · intro S T h z hz; exact hmQ S T h z.1 hz
  · intro n O S x hx y hy
    exact h O S x.1 hx y.1 (run_both_parts O _ _ x y hy).1
  · apply attrSafe_both
    · apply attrSafe_pull _ p _ R (by cc) hp hmR
      intro n O S x hx y hy
      cases hy; exact hx
    · exact attrSafe_controlled _ (by cc) _
lemma attr_keep {a b : DataType} (p : Effect a b) (R : Attribute a)
    (hp : EffectSafe p R) : EffectSafe (keep p) R := by
  unfold keep Expression.letIn
  apply attrSafe_post
  · exact attrSafe_both _ _ _ (attrSafe_controlled _ (by cc) _) hp
  · cc
lemma attr_bind {a b c : DataType} (p : Effect a b) (q : Effect b c)
    (R : Attribute a) (Q : Attribute b) (hmQ : Q.Mono)
    (hp : EffectSafe p R) (hq : EffectSafe q Q)
    (h : ∀ {n : ℕ} (O : IndependenceOracle n) S x bank,R S x → ∀ y rest,
      run O p (x,bank)=some ((true,y),rest) → Q S y) : EffectSafe (bind p q) R := by
  let T : Attribute (.prod (Optional b) BankData) := fun S z => z.1.1=true → Q S z.1.2
  have hmT : T.Mono := by intro S U h z hz hf; exact hmQ S U h z.1.2 (hz hf)
  have hq' : AttrSafe (applyIf (fst >>> fst) (both (constant (optionalValue c none)) snd)
      (both (fst >>> snd) snd >>> q)) T := by

    apply (show OracleSafe _ (fun _ _ S x => width x≤S ∧ T S x) from ?_)
    apply oracleSafe_applyIf _ _ _ (fun _ _ S x => width x≤S ∧ T S x)
    · exact oracleSafe_controlled _ (by cc) _ .input (by intro n O S x hx; exact hx.1)
    · exact oracleSafe_controlled _ (by cc) _ .input (by intro n O S x hx; exact hx.1.1)
    · apply oracleSafe_pull _ q _ (fun _ _ S x => width x≤S ∧ Q S x.1) (by cc)
        (.mul (.constant 2) .input)
        (by intro n O S x hx; exact hx.1.1.trans (by dsimp [SizePolynomial.eval]; omega))
      · exact oracleSafe_lift q _ hq
      · intro n O S x hx y hy
        have hv : x.1.1=true := Option.some.inj hx.2
        cases hy
        refine ⟨?_,hx.1.2 hv⟩
        have hb := width_fst (a:=Optional b) (b:=BankData) x
        have hs := width_snd (a:=.bool) (b:=b) x.1
        rw [width_pair (a:=b) (b:=BankData)]
        have hi := hx.1.1
        rw [width_pair (a:=Optional b) (b:=BankData),width_pair (a:=.bool) (b:=b),width_bool] at hi
        omega
  unfold bind
  apply attrSafe_compose p _ _ T hp hq' hmT
  intro n O S x hx z hz hv
  obtain ⟨⟨flag,y⟩,rest⟩ := z
  dsimp only [Prod.fst] at hv
  subst flag
  exact h O S x.1 x.2 hx y rest hz
lemma attr_letIn {a b c : DataType} (p : Effect a b) (q : Effect (.prod a b) c)
    (R : Attribute a) (Q : Attribute (.prod a b)) (hmQ : Q.Mono)
    (hp : EffectSafe p R) (hq : EffectSafe q Q)
    (h : ∀ S x y,R S x → Q S (x,y)) : EffectSafe (letIn p q) R := by
  apply attr_bind (keep p) q R Q hmQ (attr_keep p R hp) hq
  intro n O S x bank hx z rest hz
  obtain ⟨x',y⟩ := z
  have he := (run_keep_some O p x bank x' y rest hz).1
  subst x'
  exact h S x y hx

lemma attr_controlled {a b : DataType} (p : Effect a b) (hp : Controlled p) (R : Attribute a) :
    EffectSafe p R := attrSafe_controlled p hp _
lemma attr_choose {a b : DataType} (t : Expression a .bool) (p q : Effect a b)
    (R : Attribute a) (hm : R.Mono) (ht : Controlled t) (hp : EffectSafe p R) (hq : EffectSafe q R) :
    EffectSafe (choose t p q) R := by
  apply attrSafe_applyIf _ _ _ (fun S (x : Value (.prod a BankData)) => R S x.1) (fun S T h x hx => hm S T h x.1 hx) _ hp hq
  exact attrSafe_controlled _ (by cc) _
lemma attr_letControlled {a b c : DataType} (p : Effect a b) (q : Effect (.prod a b) c)
    (R : Attribute a) (hp : EffectSafe p R) (hq : Controlled q) : EffectSafe (letIn p q) R :=
  attr_letIn p q R (fun _ _ => True) (by unfold Attribute.Mono; intros; trivial) hp (attr_controlled q hq _) (by intros; trivial)
lemma attr_mapControlled {a b c : DataType} (p : Effect a b) (q : Expression b c)
    (R : Attribute a) (hp : EffectSafe p R) (hq : Controlled q) : EffectSafe (map p q) R :=
  attr_bind p (pure q) R (fun _ _ => True) (by unfold Attribute.Mono; intros; trivial) hp
    (attr_controlled _ (controlled_pure q hq) _) (by intros; trivial)
lemma attr_preControlled {a b c : DataType} (p : Expression a b) (q : Effect b c)
    (R : Attribute a) (hm : R.Mono) (hp : AttrSafe p R) (hq : Controlled q) : EffectSafe (precompose p q) R :=
  attr_precompose p q R (fun _ _ => True) hp (attr_controlled q hq _) hm (by unfold Attribute.Mono; intros; trivial) (by intros; trivial)
lemma attr_withContext {a b c : DataType} (p : Effect (.prod c a) b) (R : Attribute (.prod c a))
    (hp : EffectSafe p R) : EffectSafe (withContext p) R := by
  unfold withContext
  exact attr_letControlled _ _ R hp (by ec)
lemma attr_retainOption {a b : DataType} (p : Effect a (Optional b)) (R : Attribute a)
    (hp : EffectSafe p R) : EffectSafe (retainOption p) R := by
  unfold retainOption
  exact attr_letControlled _ _ R hp (by ec)
lemma attr_some {a b : DataType} (p : Effect a b) (R : Attribute a)
    (hp : EffectSafe p R) : EffectSafe (someCode p) R := by
  unfold someCode
  exact attr_mapControlled _ _ R hp (by cc)

lemma oracleSafe_loopStep {a : DataType} (p : Effect a a)
    (R : OraclePredicate a) (hp : OracleSafe p (bankScope R))
    (g : SizePolynomial) :
    OracleSafe (loopStep p) (fun n O S x => width x≤g.eval S ∧
      (x.1.1=true → R n O S x.1.2 ∧ width (a:=BankData) x.2≤S)) := by
  unfold loopStep
  apply oracleSafe_applyIf
  · exact oracleSafe_controlled _ (by cc) _ g (by intro n O S x hx; exact hx.1)
  · exact oracleSafe_controlled _ (by cc) _ g (by intro n O S x hx; exact hx.1.1)
  · apply oracleSafe_pull _ p _ (bankScope R) (by cc) g
      (by intro n O S x hx; exact hx.1.1) hp
    intro n O S x hx y hy
    have hv : x.1.1=true := Option.some.inj hx.2
    cases hy
    exact hx.1.2 hv

lemma oracleSafe_repeat_scoped {a : DataType} (p : Effect a a)
    (R : OraclePredicate (.prod .nat a)) (Q : OraclePredicate a)
    (hp : OracleSafe p (bankScope Q)) (g : SizePolynomial)
    (hinput : ∀ n O S k x,R n O S (k,x) → k+width (a:=a) x≤g.eval S)
    (hprefix : ∀ n O S k x bank,R n O S (k,x) → width (a:=BankData) bank≤S →
      ∀ j,j≤k → ∀ y,iterateM (run O (loopStep p)) j (optionalValue a (some x),bank)=some y →
       width (a:=.prod (Optional a) BankData) y≤g.eval S ∧
       (y.1.1=true → Q n O S y.1.2 ∧ width (a:=BankData) y.2≤S)) :
    OracleSafe (repeatCode p) (bankScope R) := by
  let T : OraclePredicate (.prod .nat (.prod (Optional a) BankData)) := fun n O S z =>
    ∃ k x bank,R n O S (k,x) ∧ width (a:=BankData) bank≤S ∧ z=(k,(optionalValue a (some x),bank))
  let W : SizePolynomial := .add (.mul (.constant 20) g) (.add (.mul (.constant 2) .input) (.constant 20))
  have htwidth : ∀ n O S x,bankScope R n O S x → width x≤W.eval S := by
    intro n O S x hx
    obtain ⟨⟨k,z⟩,bank⟩ := x
    have hi : k+width (a:=a) z≤g.eval S := hinput n O S k z hx.1
    have h₁ := Nat.mul_le_mul_left 4 hi
    have hb : width (a:=BankData) bank≤S := hx.2
    have hk := bits_length_le_value k
    rw [width_pair (a:=.prod .nat a) (b:=BankData),width_pair (a:=.nat) (b:=a),width_nat]
    dsimp [W,SizePolynomial.eval]
    omega
  unfold repeatCode
  apply oracleSafe_pull _ _ (bankScope R) T (by cc) W htwidth
  · apply oracleSafe_iterateNat _ T _ (oracleSafe_loopStep p Q hp g) W
    · intro n O S k z hz
      obtain ⟨k',x,bank,hx,hb,he⟩ := hz
      cases he
      have hi : k+width (a:=a) x≤g.eval S := hinput n O S k x hx
      have h₁ := Nat.mul_le_mul_left 2 hi
      rw [width_pair (a:=Optional a) (b:=BankData),width_pair (a:=.bool) (b:=a),width_bool]
      change k+(2*(2*1+1+width (a:=a) x)+1+width (a:=BankData) bank)≤_
      have harith : ∀ (k v b G S : ℕ),k+v≤G → b≤S →
          k+(2*(2*1+1+v)+1+b)≤20*G+(2*S+20) := by
        intros; omega
      exact harith k (width (a:=a) x) (width (a:=BankData) bank) (g.eval S) S hi hb
    · intro n O S k z hz j hj y hy
      obtain ⟨k',x,bank,hx,hb,he⟩ := hz
      cases he
      have hh := (hprefix n O S k x bank hx hb j hj y hy).1
      dsimp [W,SizePolynomial.eval]
      omega
    · intro n O S k z hz j hj y hy
      obtain ⟨k',x,bank,hx,hb,he⟩ := hz
      cases he
      exact hprefix n O S k x bank hx hb j hj.le y hy
  · intro n O S x hx y hy
    cases hy
    exact ⟨x.1.1,x.1.2,x.2,hx.1,hx.2,rfl⟩

lemma oracleSafe_repeat_law {a : DataType} (p : Effect a a)
    (R : OraclePredicate (.prod .nat a)) (Q : OraclePredicate a)
    (hp : OracleSafe p (bankScope Q)) (g : SizePolynomial)
    (hinput : ∀ n O S k x,R n O S (k,x) → k+width (a:=a) x≤g.eval S)
    (hlaw : ∀ n O S k x,R n O S (k,x) → ∀ j,j≤k →
      ∃ (A : Type) (e : A → Value a) (t : DrawTree A),
        RealizesLaw O (repeatCode p) e (j,x) t ∧
        DrawTree.All (fun v => width (e v)≤g.eval S ∧ Q n O S (e v)) t) :
    OracleSafe (repeatCode p) (bankScope R) := by
  let W : SizePolynomial := .add (.mul (.constant 2) g)
    (.add .input (.constant (2*(width (zeroValue a)+3)+1)))
  apply oracleSafe_repeat_scoped p R Q hp W
  · intro n O S k x hx
    have hh : k+width (a:=a) x≤g.eval S := hinput n O S k x hx
    exact hh.trans (by omega :
      g.eval S≤2*g.eval S+(S+(2*(width (zeroValue a)+3)+1)))
  · intro n O S k x bank hx hb j hj y hy
    obtain ⟨A,e,t,ht,he⟩ := hlaw n O S k x hx j hj
    have hyr : run O (repeatCode p) ((j,x),bank)=some y := by rw [run_repeat]; exact hy
    have hh := ht.run_bound (g.eval S) (Q n O S) he bank y hyr
    have hr := ht.rest_width bank y hyr
    refine ⟨?_,fun hv => ⟨hh.2 hv,hr.trans hb⟩⟩
    dsimp [W,SizePolynomial.eval]
    omega

lemma oracleSafe_mapControlled {a b c : DataType} (p : Effect a b) (q : Expression b c)
    (R : OraclePredicate (.prod a BankData)) (hp : OracleSafe p R) (hq : Controlled q) :
    OracleSafe (map p q) R := by
  unfold map bind
  apply oracleSafe_post _ _ R hp
  have hh := controlled_pure q hq
  cc
lemma oracleSafe_letControlled {a b c : DataType} (p : Effect a b) (q : Effect (.prod a b) c)
    (R : OraclePredicate (.prod a BankData)) (hp : OracleSafe p R) (hq : Controlled q) :
    OracleSafe (letIn p q) R := by
  unfold letIn bind
  apply oracleSafe_post _ _ R (oracleSafe_keep p R hp)
  cc
lemma oracleSafe_withContext {a b c : DataType} (p : Effect (.prod c a) b)
    (R : OraclePredicate (.prod (.prod c a) BankData)) (hp : OracleSafe p R) :
    OracleSafe (withContext p) R := by
  unfold withContext
  exact oracleSafe_letControlled _ _ R hp (by ec)
lemma oracleSafe_retainOption {a b : DataType} (p : Effect a (Optional b))
    (R : OraclePredicate (.prod a BankData)) (hp : OracleSafe p R) :
    OracleSafe (retainOption p) R := by
  unfold retainOption
  exact oracleSafe_letControlled _ _ R hp (by ec)
lemma oracleSafe_withOptionContext {a b c : DataType} (p : Effect (.prod c a) (Optional b))
    (R : OraclePredicate (.prod (.prod c a) BankData)) (hp : OracleSafe p R) :
    OracleSafe (withOptionContext p) R := by
  unfold withOptionContext
  exact oracleSafe_letControlled _ _ R hp (by ec)
end Effect

lemma oracleSafe_attr {a b : DataType} (p : Expression a b) (A : Attribute a)
    (hA : A.Mono) (hp : AttrSafe p A) (R : OraclePredicate a) (g : SizePolynomial)
    (hw : ∀ n O S x,R n O S x → width x≤g.eval S)
    (ha : ∀ n O S x,R n O S x → A S x) : OracleSafe p R := by
  let W : SizePolynomial := .add g .input
  apply oracleSafe_mono p (oracleSafe_reparam p _ (oracleSafe_lift p _ hp) W)
  intro n O S x hx
  exact ⟨(hw n O S x hx).trans (Nat.le_add_right _ _),
    hA S _ (Nat.le_add_left _ _) x (ha n O S x hx)⟩
namespace Effect
lemma oracleSafe_effectAttr {a b : DataType} (p : Effect a b) (A : Attribute a)
    (hA : A.Mono) (hp : EffectSafe p A) (R : OraclePredicate a) (g : SizePolynomial)
    (hw : ∀ n O S x,R n O S x → width x≤g.eval S)
    (ha : ∀ n O S x,R n O S x → A S x) : OracleSafe p (bankScope R) := by
  apply oracleSafe_attr p (fun S x => A S x.1) (fun S T h x hx => hA S T h x.1 hx) hp _
    (.add (.mul (.constant 2) g) (.add .input (.constant 1)))
  · intro n O S x hx
    have hw' := hw n O S x.1 hx.1
    have hb := hx.2
    rw [width_pair (a:=a) (b:=BankData)]
    dsimp [SizePolynomial.eval]
    omega
  · intro n O S x hx; exact ha n O S x.1 hx.1
lemma oracleSafe_choose {a b : DataType} (test : Expression a .bool) (p q : Effect a b)
    (R : OraclePredicate (.prod a BankData)) (ht : Controlled test)
    (hp : OracleSafe p R) (hq : OracleSafe q R) : OracleSafe (choose test p q) R := by
  obtain ⟨f,hf⟩ := oracleSafe_input_bound p R hp
  apply oracleSafe_applyIf _ _ _ R
  · exact oracleSafe_controlled _ (by cc) R f hf
  · exact oracleSafe_mono p hp (by intro n O S x hx; exact hx.1)
  · exact oracleSafe_mono q hq (by intro n O S x hx; exact hx.1)
lemma oracleSafe_letIn {a b c : DataType} (p : Effect a b) (q : Effect (.prod a b) c)
    (R : OraclePredicate a) (Q : OraclePredicate (.prod a b))
    (hp : OracleSafe p (bankScope R)) (hq : OracleSafe q (bankScope Q))
    (h : ∀ n O S x bank,R n O S x → width (a:=BankData) bank≤S → ∀ y rest,
      run O p (x,bank)=some ((true,y),rest) → Q n O S (x,y) ∧ width (a:=BankData) rest≤S) :
    OracleSafe (letIn p q) (bankScope R) := by
  apply oracleSafe_bind (keep p) q R Q (oracleSafe_keep p _ hp) hq
  intro n O S x bank hx hb z rest hz
  obtain ⟨x',y⟩ := z
  have he := run_keep_some O p x bank x' y rest hz
  rw [he.1]
  exact h n O S x bank hx hb y rest he.2

def optionScope {a : DataType} (R : OraclePredicate a) : OraclePredicate (Optional a) :=
  fun n O S x => x=optionalValue a none ∨ x.1=true ∧ R n O S x.2
lemma optionScope_encode {A : Type*} {a : DataType} (R : OraclePredicate a)
    {n : ℕ} (O : IndependenceOracle n) (S : ℕ) (e : A → Value a)
    (he : ∀ z,R n O S (e z)) (v : Option A) : optionScope R n O S (optionEncode e v) := by
  cases v with
  | none => exact Or.inl rfl
  | some z => exact Or.inr ⟨rfl,he z⟩
lemma optionScope_width {a : DataType} (R : OraclePredicate a) (g : SizePolynomial)
    (hw : ∀ n O S x,R n O S x → width x≤g.eval S) :
    ∀ n O S x,optionScope R n O S x → width x≤
      (.add g (.constant (width (zeroValue a)+3)) : SizePolynomial).eval S := by
  intro n O S x hx
  rcases hx with rfl | ⟨hflag,hx⟩
  · rw [width_pair (a:=.bool) (b:=a),width_bool]
    change 2*1+1+width (zeroValue a)≤_
    dsimp [SizePolynomial.eval]
    omega
  · have hh := hw n O S x.2 hx
    rw [width_pair (a:=.bool) (b:=a),width_bool]
    dsimp [SizePolynomial.eval]
    omega
lemma oracleSafe_optionContinue {a b : DataType} (p : Effect a (Optional b))
    (R : OraclePredicate a) (hp : OracleSafe p (bankScope R)) :
    OracleSafe (optionContinue p) (bankScope (optionScope R)) := by
  obtain ⟨f,hf⟩ := oracleSafe_input_bound p (bankScope R) hp
  have hu : ∀ n O S x,R n O S x → width (a:=a) x≤f.eval S := by
    intro n O S x hx
    exact (width_fst (a:=a) (b:=BankData) (x,([] : Bank))).trans (hf n O S (x,[]) ⟨hx,by exact Nat.zero_le S⟩)
  let W : SizePolynomial := .add (.mul (.constant 2)
    (.add f (.constant (width (zeroValue a)+3)))) (.add .input (.constant 1))
  have hw : ∀ n O S x,bankScope (optionScope R) n O S x → width x≤W.eval S := by
    intro n O S x hx
    have hh := optionScope_width R f hu n O S x.1 hx.1
    have hb := hx.2
    rw [width_pair (a:=Optional a) (b:=BankData)]
    dsimp [W,SizePolynomial.eval] at *
    omega
  unfold optionContinue choose
  apply oracleSafe_applyIf _ _ _ _
  · exact oracleSafe_controlled _ (by cc) _ W hw
  · exact oracleSafe_controlled _ (by ec) _ W (by intro n O S x hx; exact hw n O S x hx.1)
  · unfold precompose onLeft
    apply oracleSafe_pull _ p _ (bankScope R) (by cc) W
      (by intro n O S x hx; exact hw n O S x hx.1) hp
    intro n O S x hx y hy
    have hv : x.1.1=true := Option.some.inj hx.2
    have he : (x.1.2,x.2)=y := Option.some.inj hy
    subst y
    refine ⟨?_,hx.1.2⟩
    rcases hx.1.1 with hnone | ⟨_,hh⟩
    · rw [hnone] at hv; cases hv
    · exact hh
lemma oracleSafe_optionBind {a b c : DataType} (p : Effect a (Optional b))
    (q : Effect b (Optional c)) (R : OraclePredicate a) (Q : OraclePredicate b)
    (hp : OracleSafe p (bankScope R)) (hq : OracleSafe q (bankScope Q))
    (h : ∀ n O S x bank,R n O S x → width (a:=BankData) bank≤S → ∀ y rest,
      run O p (x,bank)=some ((true,y),rest) → optionScope Q n O S y ∧ width (a:=BankData) rest≤S) :
    OracleSafe (optionBind p q) (bankScope R) :=
  oracleSafe_bind p _ R _ hp (oracleSafe_optionContinue q Q hq) h
end Effect

def contextAttr (S : ℕ) (x : Value WeightContext) : Prop := x.1.1≤S ∧ x.1.2≤S
def weightAttr (S : ℕ) (x : Value WeightInput) : Prop := contextAttr S x.1
lemma contextAttr_mono : Attribute.Mono (a:=WeightContext) contextAttr := by intro S T h x hx; exact ⟨hx.1.trans h,hx.2.trans h⟩
lemma weightAttr_mono : Attribute.Mono (a:=WeightInput) weightAttr := by intro S T h x hx; exact contextAttr_mono S T h x.1 hx
lemma attr_weight : AttrSafe weightCode weightAttr :=
  polySafe_mono weightCode polySafe_weight (by intro S x hx; exact ⟨hx.1,hx.2.1,hx.2.2⟩)
def acceptanceAttr (S : ℕ) (x : Value AcceptanceInput) : Prop := contextAttr S x.1
lemma acceptanceAttr_mono : Attribute.Mono (a:=AcceptanceInput) acceptanceAttr := by intro S T h x hx; exact contextAttr_mono S T h x.1 hx
lemma attr_acceptance : AttrSafe acceptanceCode acceptanceAttr := by
  unfold acceptanceCode
  apply attrSafe_post
  · apply attrSafe_both
    · apply attrSafe_pull _ weightCode acceptanceAttr weightAttr (by cc) attr_weight weightAttr_mono
      intro n O S x hx y hy
      cases hy
      exact hx
    · apply attrSafe_pull _ weightCode acceptanceAttr weightAttr (by cc) attr_weight weightAttr_mono
      intro n O S x hx y hy
      cases hy
      exact hx
  · cc
namespace Effect
def offerAttr (S : ℕ) (x : Value OfferInput) : Prop := weightAttr S x.1
lemma offerAttr_mono : Attribute.Mono (a:=OfferInput) offerAttr := by intro S T h x hx; exact weightAttr_mono S T h x.1 hx
lemma attr_offerCore : EffectSafe offerCore offerAttr := by
  unfold offerCore
  apply attr_choose _ _ _ offerAttr offerAttr_mono (by have h := controlled_chainCode; cc)
  · exact attr_controlled _ (by ec) _
  · apply attr_letControlled
    · apply attr_preControlled _ bernoulliCode offerAttr offerAttr_mono _ controlled_bernoulli
      apply attrSafe_pull acceptancePrep acceptanceCode offerAttr acceptanceAttr (by unfold acceptancePrep; cc)
        attr_acceptance acceptanceAttr_mono
      intro n O S x hx y hy
      cases hy
      exact hx
    · ec
def pairOfferAttr (S : ℕ) (x : Value (.prod WeightInput NN)) : Prop := weightAttr S x.1
lemma pairOfferAttr_mono : Attribute.Mono (a:=(.prod WeightInput NN)) pairOfferAttr := by intro S T h x hx; exact weightAttr_mono S T h x.1 hx
lemma attr_offer : EffectSafe offerCode pairOfferAttr := by
  have he := controlled_exchangeSet
  unfold offerCode
  apply attr_precompose _ _ pairOfferAttr offerAttr
    (attrSafe_controlled _ (by cc) _) attr_offerCore pairOfferAttr_mono offerAttr_mono
  intro n O S x hx y hy
  have hh : x.1=y.1 := Option.some.inj (run_both_parts O _ _ x y hy).1
  change weightAttr S y.1
  rw [←hh]
  exact hx
lemma attr_activeStep : EffectSafe activeStepCode weightAttr := by
  unfold activeStepCode
  apply attr_letIn _ _ weightAttr pairOfferAttr pairOfferAttr_mono
    (attr_controlled _ (by have h := controlled_proposal; ec) _) attr_offer
  intro S x y hx
  exact hx
lemma attr_step : EffectSafe stepCode weightAttr := by
  unfold stepCode
  apply attr_letIn _ _ weightAttr (fun S x => weightAttr S x.1)
    (fun S T h (x : Value (.prod WeightInput .bool)) hx => weightAttr_mono S T h x.1 hx)
    (attr_controlled _ (by have h := controlled_bernoulli; ec) _)
  · apply attr_choose _ _ _ _ (fun S T h (x : Value (.prod WeightInput .bool)) hx => weightAttr_mono S T h x.1 hx) (by cc)
    · apply attr_precompose _ _ _ weightAttr (attrSafe_controlled _ (by cc) _) attr_activeStep
        (fun S T h (x : Value (.prod WeightInput .bool)) hx => weightAttr_mono S T h x.1 hx) weightAttr_mono
      intro n O S x hx y hy
      cases hy; exact hx
    · exact attr_controlled _ (by ec) _
  · intro S x y hx; exact hx
end Effect

open scoped Classical
lemma width_stateEncode {n : ℕ} (T : Set (Fin n⊕Fin n)) : width (a:=StateData) (stateEncode T)=3*n+1 := by
  rw [width_pair (a:=.word) (b:=.word),width_word,width_word,stateEncode_left_length,stateEncode_right_length]
  omega
lemma width_sampleEncode {n : ℕ} (xs : List (Set (Fin n⊕Fin n))) :
    width (a:=SampleData) (sampleEncode xs)=xs.length*(6*n+4) := by
  induction xs with
  | nil => change width (a:=.list StateData) []=0*(6*n+4); rw [width_nil,Nat.zero_mul]
  | cons x xs ih =>
    change width (a:=.list StateData) (stateEncode x::sampleEncode xs)=_
    rw [width_cons (a:=StateData),width_stateEncode,ih,List.length_cons,Nat.add_mul,Nat.one_mul]
    omega
lemma width_observation {n N : ℕ} (v : PhaseSample n N) :
    width (a:=SampleData) (sampleEncode (observedSets n N v))≤(N+1)*(6*n+4) := by
  rw [width_sampleEncode]
  have hl : (observedSets n N v).length=N-1+1 := by
    simp only [observedSets,List.length_map]
    exact FiniteChain.Sample.toList_length v
  rw [hl]
  exact Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ (by omega)
lemma width_history_observed {n N : ℕ} (h : List (PhaseSample n N)) :
    width (a:=HistoryData) (historyEncode (h.map (observedSets n N)))≤h.length*(2*((N+1)*(6*n+4))+2) := by
  unfold historyEncode
  apply (width_list_le _ _ ?_).trans
  · simp only [List.length_map]; rfl
  · intro x hx
    obtain ⟨v,hv,rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hx
    obtain ⟨u,hu,rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hv
    exact width_observation u

open Expression
open Effect
open scoped Classical

structure SamplerModel (n : ℕ) (O : IndependenceOracle n) where
  M₁ : Matroid (Fin n)
  M₂ : Matroid (Fin n)
  exact : ExactOracles M₁ M₂ O
  ground₁ : M₁.E=Set.univ
  ground₂ : M₂.E=Set.univ
  positive : 0<n
  rank : ℕ
  samples : ℕ
  phases : ℕ
namespace SamplerModel
variable {n : ℕ} {O : IndependenceOracle n}
def tau (m : SamplerModel n O) := 20*n^4*(n*(m.phases+1)+2)
def cap (m : SamplerModel n O) := restartCap n m.phases
def Bounded (m : SamplerModel n O) (S : ℕ) : Prop :=
  n≤S ∧ m.rank≤S ∧ m.samples≤S ∧ m.phases≤S ∧ m.cap≤S ∧ m.tau≤S
abbrev Hist (m : SamplerModel n O) := List (PhaseSample n m.samples)
noncomputable def histValue (m : SamplerModel n O) (history : m.Hist) : Value HistoryData :=
  historyEncode (history.map (observedSets n m.samples))
noncomputable def weightContext (m : SamplerModel n O) (h : m.Hist) (j : ℕ) : Value WeightContext :=
  ((m.rank,j),m.histValue h)
noncomputable def weightValue (m : SamplerModel n O) (h : m.Hist) (j : ℕ)
    (x : ChainIndex (pairedSlots n)) : Value WeightInput := (m.weightContext h j,stateEncode x.val)
noncomputable def restartContext (m : SamplerModel n O) (h : m.Hist) : Value RestartContext :=
  ((m.rank,m.histValue h),(m.cap,m.tau))
noncomputable def restartValue (m : SamplerModel n O) (h : m.Hist) (j : ℕ)
    (x : PlainIndex (pairedSlots n)) : Value RestartState := ((m.restartContext h,j),stateEncode x.val.val)
noncomputable def phaseValue (m : SamplerModel n O) (h : m.Hist) : Value PhaseInput :=
  (params n m.rank m.samples m.phases,m.histValue h)
lemma width_histValue (m : SamplerModel n O) (S : ℕ) (hm : m.Bounded S)
    (h : m.Hist) (hh : h.length≤S) : width (m.histValue h)≤20*(S+1)^3 := by
  have he := width_history_observed h
  have hb : h.length*(2*((m.samples+1)*(6*n+4))+2)≤S*(2*((S+1)*(6*S+4))+2) := by
    gcongr
    · exact hm.2.2.1
    · exact hm.1
  exact he.trans (hb.trans (by nlinarith))
lemma width_weightValue (m : SamplerModel n O) (S : ℕ) (hm : m.Bounded S)
    (h : m.Hist) (hh : h.length≤S) (j : ℕ) (hj : j≤S) (x : ChainIndex (pairedSlots n)) :
    width (m.weightValue h j x)≤100*(S+1)^3 := by
  have hr := (bits_length_le_value m.rank).trans hm.2.1
  have hb := (bits_length_le_value j).trans hj
  have hs := width_stateEncode x.val
  have hn := hm.1
  have hh := m.width_histValue S hm h hh
  rw [weightValue,weightContext,width_pair (a:=WeightContext) (b:=StateData),
    width_pair (a:=NN) (b:=HistoryData),width_pair (a:=.nat) (b:=.nat),width_nat,width_nat,hs]
  have hp : S+1≤(S+1)^3 := Nat.le_self_pow (by decide) _
  omega
lemma width_restartValue (m : SamplerModel n O) (S : ℕ) (hm : m.Bounded S)
    (h : m.Hist) (hh : h.length≤S) (j : ℕ) (hj : j≤S) (x : PlainIndex (pairedSlots n)) :
    width (m.restartValue h j x)≤200*(S+1)^3 := by
  have hr := (bits_length_le_value m.rank).trans hm.2.1
  have hb := (bits_length_le_value j).trans hj
  have hc := (bits_length_le_value m.cap).trans hm.2.2.2.2.1
  have ht := (bits_length_le_value m.tau).trans hm.2.2.2.2.2
  have hs := width_stateEncode x.val.val
  have hn := hm.1
  have hh := m.width_histValue S hm h hh
  rw [restartValue,restartContext,width_pair (a:=.prod RestartContext .nat) (b:=StateData),
    width_pair (a:=RestartContext) (b:=.nat),width_pair (a:=.prod .nat HistoryData) (b:=NN),
    width_pair (a:=.nat) (b:=HistoryData),width_pair (a:=.nat) (b:=.nat),
    width_nat,width_nat,width_nat,width_nat,hs]
  have hp : S+1≤(S+1)^3 := Nat.le_self_pow (by decide) _
  omega
lemma width_phaseValue (m : SamplerModel n O) (S : ℕ) (hm : m.Bounded S)
    (h : m.Hist) (hh : h.length≤S) : width (m.phaseValue h)≤100*(S+1)^3 := by
  have hn := (bits_length_le_value n).trans hm.1
  have hr := (bits_length_le_value m.rank).trans hm.2.1
  have hs := (bits_length_le_value m.samples).trans hm.2.2.1
  have hl := (bits_length_le_value m.phases).trans hm.2.2.2.1
  have hc := (bits_length_le_value m.cap).trans hm.2.2.2.2.1
  have ht := (bits_length_le_value m.tau).trans hm.2.2.2.2.2
  have hh := m.width_histValue S hm h hh
  rw [phaseValue,width_pair (a:=AlgorithmParams) (b:=HistoryData)]
  rw [params,width_pair (a:=NN) (b:=.prod NN NN),width_pair (a:=NN) (b:=NN),
    width_pair (a:=.nat) (b:=.nat),width_pair (a:=.nat) (b:=.nat),width_pair (a:=.nat) (b:=.nat)]
  simp only [width_nat]
  dsimp only [cap,tau] at hc ht
  have hp : S+1≤(S+1)^3 := Nat.le_self_pow (by decide) _
  omega
end SamplerModel

def sourceWidthPoly (c : ℕ) : SizePolynomial :=
  .mul (.constant c) (.mul (.add .input (.constant 1))
    (.mul (.add .input (.constant 1)) (.add .input (.constant 1))))
lemma eval_sourceWidthPoly (c S : ℕ) : (sourceWidthPoly c).eval S=c*(S+1)^3 := by
  simp only [sourceWidthPoly,SizePolynomial.eval]; ring

def weightScope : OraclePredicate WeightInput := fun n O S z =>
  ∃ (m : SamplerModel n O),m.Bounded S ∧ ∃ h : m.Hist,h.length≤S ∧

lemma weightScope_width : ∀ n O S z,weightScope n O S z → width z≤(sourceWidthPoly 100).eval S := by
  intro n O S z hz
  obtain ⟨m,hm,h,hh,j,hj,x,rfl⟩ := hz
  rw [eval_sourceWidthPoly]
  exact m.width_weightValue S hm h hh j hj x

    (sourceWidthPoly 100) weightScope_width

lemma attr_storedStep : EffectSafe storedStepCode weightAttr := by
  unfold storedStepCode
  apply attr_precompose storedStepPrep stepCode weightAttr weightAttr
    (attrSafe_controlled _ (by unfold storedStepPrep; cc) _) attr_step weightAttr_mono weightAttr_mono
  intro n O S x hx y hy

  have hc := run_both_parts O _ _ x y.1 he.1
  have hp : x.1.1=y.1.1 := Option.some.inj hc.1
  change x.1.1.1≤S ∧ x.1.1.2≤S at hx
  change y.1.1.1≤S ∧ y.1.1.2≤S
  rw [←hp]; exact hx
lemma safe_storedStep : OracleSafe storedStepCode (bankScope weightScope) := by

    (sourceWidthPoly 100) weightScope_width

lemma oracleSafe_hitStep {a : DataType} (step : Effect a a) (test : Expression a .bool)
    (Q : OraclePredicate a) (hs : OracleSafe step (bankScope Q)) (ht : Controlled test)
    (g : SizePolynomial) (hw : ∀ n O S x,Q n O S x → width x≤g.eval S) :
    OracleSafe (hitStepCode step test) (bankScope (fun n O S x => Q n O S x.1)) := by
  let W : SizePolynomial := .add (.mul (.constant 2) g) (.constant 2)
  have hw' : ∀ n O S x,Q n O S x.1 → width (a:=.prod a .bool) x≤W.eval S := by
    intro n O S x hx
    have hh := hw n O S x.1 hx
    rw [width_pair (a:=a) (b:=.bool),width_bool]
    dsimp [W,SizePolynomial.eval]
    omega
  unfold hitStepCode
  apply oracleSafe_choose _ _ _ _ (by cc)
  · apply oracleSafe_mapControlled _ _ _ _ (by cc)
    exact oracleSafe_precompose fst step _ Q
      (oracleSafe_controlled _ (by cc) _ W hw') hs
      (by intro n O S x hx y hy; cases hy; exact hx)
  · exact oracleSafe_pure ident _ (oracleSafe_controlled _ (by cc) _ W hw')

abbrev SearchData := DataType.prod WeightInput .bool
def searchScope : OraclePredicate SearchData := fun n O S x => weightScope n O S x.1
def searchInputScope : OraclePredicate (.prod .nat SearchData) := fun n O S x =>
  x.1≤S+1 ∧ ∃ (m : SamplerModel n O),m.Bounded S ∧ ∃ h : m.Hist,h.length≤S ∧
    ∃ j,j≤S ∧ ∃ u : SearchState (ChainIndex (pairedSlots n)) (plainPredicate (pairedSlots n)),
      x.2=searchEncode (m.weightValue h j) u
lemma searchScope_width : ∀ n O S x,searchScope n O S x → width x≤(sourceWidthPoly 202).eval S := by
  intro n O S x hx
  have hh := weightScope_width n O S x.1 hx
  rw [eval_sourceWidthPoly] at hh ⊢
  rw [width_pair (a:=WeightInput) (b:=.bool),width_bool]
  have hp : 1≤(S+1)^3 := (Nat.succ_le_succ (Nat.zero_le S)).trans (Nat.le_self_pow (by decide) _)
  omega
lemma searchEncode_scope {n : ℕ} {O : IndependenceOracle n} (m : SamplerModel n O)
    (S : ℕ) (hm : m.Bounded S) (h : m.Hist) (hh : h.length≤S) (j : ℕ) (hj : j≤S)
    (u : SearchState (ChainIndex (pairedSlots n)) (plainPredicate (pairedSlots n))) :
    searchScope n O S (searchEncode (m.weightValue h j) u) := by
  cases u with
  | inl x => exact ⟨m,hm,h,hh,j,hj,x,rfl⟩
  | inr x => exact ⟨m,hm,h,hh,j,hj,x.val,rfl⟩
lemma safe_repeatHit : OracleSafe
    (repeatCode (hitStepCode (withContext storedStepCode) (snd >>> Expression.plainCode)))
    (bankScope searchInputScope) := by
  have hs : OracleSafe (withContext storedStepCode) (bankScope weightScope) :=
    oracleSafe_withContext storedStepCode _ safe_storedStep
  apply oracleSafe_repeat_law _ searchInputScope searchScope
    (oracleSafe_hitStep _ _ weightScope hs (by cc) _ weightScope_width) (sourceWidthPoly 204)
  · intro n O S k x hx
    obtain ⟨hk,m,hm,h,hh,j,hj,u,rfl⟩ := hx
    have hw := searchScope_width n O S _ (searchEncode_scope m S hm h hh j hj u)
    rw [eval_sourceWidthPoly] at hw ⊢
    have hp : S+1≤(S+1)^3 := Nat.le_self_pow (by decide) _
    have harith : ∀ (k v T P : ℕ), k≤T → T≤P → v≤202*P → k+v≤204*P := by intros; omega
    exact harith k _ (S+1) _ hk hp hw
  · intro n O S k x hx l hl
    obtain ⟨hk,m,hm,h,hh,j,hj,u,rfl⟩ := hx
    let f := canonicalStepTree n m.positive m.rank O m.samples h j
    let e := m.weightValue h j
    let P := plainPredicate (pairedSlots n)
    refine ⟨SearchState (ChainIndex (pairedSlots n)) P,searchEncode e,
      treeRepeat (searchStep f P) l u,?_,?_⟩
    · apply law_repeat O _ _ _ _ l u
      exact law_hitStep O (withContext storedStepCode) _ e f P
        (fun T => law_withContext O storedStepCode _ (m.weightContext h j) _ _
          (storedStepCode_source m.M₁ m.M₂ O m.exact m.ground₁ m.ground₂ m.rank m.samples h j m.positive T))
        (fun T => MachineCode.plainCode_source O T.val)
    · apply DrawTree.all_of_forall
      intro v
      have hv := searchEncode_scope m S hm h hh j hj v
      refine ⟨?_,hv⟩
      have hw := searchScope_width n O S _ hv
      rw [eval_sourceWidthPoly] at hw ⊢
      exact hw.trans (Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ (by decide : 202≤204))

def traceScope : OraclePredicate (.prod .nat WeightInput) := fun n O S x =>
  x.1≤S+1 ∧ weightScope n O S x.2
lemma traceScope_width : ∀ n O S x,traceScope n O S x → width x≤(sourceWidthPoly 110).eval S := by
  intro n O S x hx

  have hh := weightScope_width n O S x.2 hx.2
  rw [eval_sourceWidthPoly] at hh ⊢
  rw [width_pair (a:=.nat) (b:=WeightInput),width_nat]
  have hp : S+1≤(S+1)^3 := Nat.le_self_pow (by decide) _
  omega
lemma safe_trace : OracleSafe traceCode (bankScope traceScope) := by

    (oracleSafe_mapControlled _ _ _ safe_repeatHit (by unfold hitFinish; cc))

  subst y
  obtain ⟨m,hm,h,hh,j,hj,T,he⟩ := hx.2
  exact ⟨hx.1,m,hm,h,hh,j,hj,Sum.inl T,by rw [he]; rfl⟩

def restartScope : OraclePredicate RestartState := fun n O S z =>

lemma restartScope_width : ∀ n O S z,restartScope n O S z → width z≤(sourceWidthPoly 200).eval S := by
  intro n O S z hz

def traceRepeatScope : OraclePredicate (.prod .nat (Optional RestartState)) := fun n O S z =>
  z.1≤S ∧ ∃ (m : SamplerModel n O),m.Bounded S ∧ ∃ h : m.Hist,h.length≤S ∧
    ∃ j,j≤S ∧ ∃ x : PlainIndex (pairedSlots n),z.2=optionEncode (m.restartValue h j) (some x)
def restartOptWidth : SizePolynomial :=
  .add (sourceWidthPoly 200) (.constant (width (zeroValue RestartState)+3))
lemma restartOptWidth_bound {n : ℕ} {O : IndependenceOracle n} (m : SamplerModel n O)
    (S : ℕ) (hm : m.Bounded S) (h : m.Hist) (hh : h.length≤S) (j : ℕ) (hj : j≤S)
    (v : Option (PlainIndex (pairedSlots n))) :
    width (optionEncode (m.restartValue h j) v)≤restartOptWidth.eval S := by
  have hw := width_optionEncode (m.restartValue h j) v ((sourceWidthPoly 200).eval S)
    (fun x => by rw [eval_sourceWidthPoly]; exact m.width_restartValue S hm h hh j hj x)
  change _ ≤ (sourceWidthPoly 200).eval S + (width (zeroValue RestartState)+3)
  omega
lemma safe_repeatTrace : OracleSafe (repeatCode (optionContinue (withOptionContext traceAtCode)))
    (bankScope traceRepeatScope) := by
  apply oracleSafe_repeat_law _ traceRepeatScope (optionScope restartScope)
    (oracleSafe_optionContinue _ _ (oracleSafe_withOptionContext _ _ safe_traceAt))
    (.add .input restartOptWidth)
  · intro n O S k z hz
    obtain ⟨hk,m,hm,h,hh,j,hj,x,rfl⟩ := hz
    exact Nat.add_le_add hk (restartOptWidth_bound m S hm h hh j hj _)
  · intro n O S k z hz l hl
    obtain ⟨hk,m,hm,h,hh,j,hj,x,rfl⟩ := hz
    let e := m.restartValue h j
    let f := canonicalTraceTree n m.positive m.rank O m.samples h j m.cap
    let F : Option (PlainIndex (pairedSlots n)) → DrawTree (Option (PlainIndex (pairedSlots n))) :=
      fun u => match u with | none => .leaf none | some y => f y
    refine ⟨Option (PlainIndex (pairedSlots n)),optionEncode e,treeRepeat F l (some x),?_,?_⟩
    · apply law_repeat O _ _ F _ l (some x)
      intro u
      change RealizesLaw O (optionContinue (withOptionContext traceAtCode)) (optionEncode e)
        (optionEncode e u) (match u with | none => .leaf none | some y => f y)
      cases u <;> exact law_optionContinue O (withOptionContext traceAtCode) e e f _ (fun y =>
        law_withOptionContext O traceAtCode (fun x : PlainIndex (pairedSlots n) => stateEncode x.val.val)
          (m.restartContext h,j) (stateEncode y.val.val) (f y)
          (traceAtCode_source m.M₁ m.M₂ O m.exact m.ground₁ m.ground₂
            m.rank m.samples m.phases h m.positive m.cap j y))
    · apply DrawTree.all_of_forall
      intro v
      refine ⟨(restartOptWidth_bound m S hm h hh j hj v).trans (Nat.le_add_left _ _),?_⟩
      apply optionScope_encode
      intro y
      exact ⟨m,hm,h,hh,j,hj,y,rfl⟩

def iterateTraceScope : OraclePredicate (.prod .nat RestartState) := fun n O S z =>
  z.1≤S ∧ restartScope n O S z.2
lemma iterateTraceScope_width : ∀ n O S z,iterateTraceScope n O S z →
    width z≤(SizePolynomial.add (.mul (.constant 2) .input) (.add (.constant 1) (sourceWidthPoly 200))).eval S := by
  intro n O S z hz

  have hh := restartScope_width n O S z.2 hz.2
  rw [width_pair (a:=.nat) (b:=RestartState),width_nat]
  change _ ≤ 2*S+(1+(sourceWidthPoly 200).eval S)
  omega
lemma safe_iterateTrace : OracleSafe (iterateCode (withOptionContext traceAtCode))
    (bankScope iterateTraceScope) := by
  unfold iterateCode
  apply oracleSafe_precompose _ _ iterateTraceScope traceRepeatScope
    (oracleSafe_controlled _ (by cc) _ _ iterateTraceScope_width) safe_repeatTrace
  intro n O S z hz y hy
  have he : (z.1,(true,z.2))=y := Option.some.inj hy
  subst y
  obtain ⟨m,hm,h,hh,j,hj,x,he⟩ := hz.2
  exact ⟨hz.1,m,hm,h,hh,j,hj,x,by rw [he]; rfl⟩
lemma safe_restartTick : OracleSafe restartTick (bankScope restartScope) := by
  unfold restartTick
  apply oracleSafe_precompose restartTickPrep _ restartScope
    (fun n O S z => iterateTraceScope n O (S+1) z)
    (oracleSafe_controlled _ (by unfold restartTickPrep; cc) _ _ restartScope_width)
  · apply oracleSafe_mono _ (oracleSafe_reparam _ _ safe_iterateTrace (.add .input (.constant 1)))
    intro n O S z hz
    exact ⟨hz.1,hz.2.trans (Nat.le_add_right S 1)⟩
  · intro n O S z hz y hy
    obtain ⟨m,hm,h,hh,j,hj,x,rfl⟩ := hz
    have he : (m.tau,m.restartValue h (j+1) x)=y := Option.some.inj hy
    subst y
    exact ⟨hm.2.2.2.2.2.trans (Nat.le_add_right S 1),m,hm.mono (Nat.le_add_right S 1),
      h,hh.trans (Nat.le_add_right S 1),j+1,Nat.add_le_add_right hj 1,x,rfl⟩

namespace SamplerModel
noncomputable def restartInput {n : ℕ} {O : IndependenceOracle n} (m : SamplerModel n O)
    (h : m.Hist) (k : ℕ) : Value RestartInput := (n,(k,m.restartContext h))
lemma width_restartInput {n : ℕ} {O : IndependenceOracle n} (m : SamplerModel n O)
    (S : ℕ) (hm : m.Bounded S) (h : m.Hist) (hh : h.length≤S) (k : ℕ) (hk : k≤S) :
    width (m.restartInput h k)≤(sourceWidthPoly 210).eval S := by
  let x : PlainIndex (pairedSlots n) := Classical.choice
    (plainIndex_nonempty (pairedSlots n) (pairedSlots_fresh n) (pairedSlots_cover n))
  have hw := m.width_restartValue S hm h hh 0 (Nat.zero_le S) x
  have hc : width (m.restartContext h)≤200*(S+1)^3 :=
    (width_fst (a:=RestartContext) (b:=.nat) (m.restartContext h,0)).trans
      ((width_fst (a:=.prod RestartContext .nat) (b:=StateData) (m.restartValue h 0 x)).trans hw)
  have hn := (bits_length_le_value n).trans hm.1
  have hb := (bits_length_le_value k).trans hk
  rw [eval_sourceWidthPoly,restartInput,width_pair (a:=.nat) (b:=.prod .nat RestartContext),
    width_pair (a:=.nat) (b:=RestartContext),width_nat,width_nat]
  have hp : S+1≤(S+1)^3 := Nat.le_self_pow (by decide) _
  omega
end SamplerModel

def restartRepeatScope : OraclePredicate (.prod .nat (Optional RestartState)) := fun n O S z =>
  z.1≤S ∧ ∃ (m : SamplerModel n O),m.Bounded S ∧ ∃ h : m.Hist,h.length≤S ∧

    (oracleSafe_optionContinue _ _ safe_restartTick) (.add .input restartOptWidth)

    refine ⟨Option (PlainIndex (pairedSlots n)),optionEncode (m.restartValue h j),

    · apply DrawTree.all_of_forall
      intro v
      refine ⟨(restartOptWidth_bound m S hm h hh j (hj.trans hk) v).trans (Nat.le_add_left _ _),?_⟩
      apply optionScope_encode

  intro n O S z hz

lemma safe_restart : OracleSafe restartCode (bankScope restartInputScope) := by
  unfold restartCode
  apply oracleSafe_mapControlled _ _ _ _ (by cc)

  · apply oracleSafe_precompose fst plainCode restartInputScope (fun _ _ S x => x≤S)

    intro n O S z hz y hy

  (m.phaseValue h,stateEncode x.val)
lemma width_phaseState {n : ℕ} {O : IndependenceOracle n} (m : SamplerModel n O)
    (S : ℕ) (hm : m.Bounded S) (h : m.Hist) (hh : h.length≤S) (x : ChainIndex (pairedSlots n)) :
    width (m.phaseState h x)≤(sourceWidthPoly 210).eval S := by
  have hw := m.width_phaseValue S hm h hh
  rw [phaseState,width_pair (a:=PhaseInput) (b:=StateData),width_stateEncode,eval_sourceWidthPoly]
  have hn := hm.1
  have hp : S+1≤(S+1)^3 := Nat.le_self_pow (by decide) _
  omega
end SamplerModel

lemma phaseStateScope_width : ∀ n O S z,phaseStateScope n O S z → width z≤(sourceWidthPoly 210).eval S := by

lemma safe_phaseStep : OracleSafe phaseStepCode (bankScope phaseStateScope) := by

    (oracleSafe_controlled _ (by unfold phaseStepPrep; cc) _ _ phaseStateScope_width) safe_storedStep
