lemma repeatSample_length {X : Type*} (f : X → DrawTree X) (k : ℕ) (acc : List X) (x : X) :
    DrawTree.All (fun s => s.1.length=acc.length+k) (treeRepeat (sampleTickTree f) k (acc,x)) := by
  induction k generalizing acc x with
  | zero => exact Nat.add_zero _ |>.symm
  | succ k ih =>
    unfold treeRepeat sampleTickTree
    rw [DrawTree.map_bind]
    apply DrawTree.all_bind_of_all (f x) _ (fun _ => True) _ (DrawTree.all_of_forall _ _ (by intros; trivial))
    intro y _
    exact (ih (x::acc) y).mono (by intro s hs; simpa only [List.length_cons,Nat.add_assoc,Nat.add_comm 1 k] using hs)

abbrev SampleNodeData := DataType.prod PhaseInput StateData
abbrev SampleAccData := DataType.prod (.list SampleNodeData) SampleNodeData
noncomputable def sampleAccValue {n : ℕ} {O : IndependenceOracle n} (m : SamplerModel n O)
    (h : m.Hist) (s : List (ChainIndex (pairedSlots n)) × ChainIndex (pairedSlots n)) : Value SampleAccData :=
  (s.1.map (m.phaseState h),m.phaseState h s.2)
def sampleAccWidth : SizePolynomial :=
  .add (.mul (.constant 2) (.mul .input (.add (.mul (.constant 2) (sourceWidthPoly 210)) (.constant 2))))
    (.add (.constant 1) (sourceWidthPoly 210))
lemma sampleAccValue_width {n : ℕ} {O : IndependenceOracle n} (m : SamplerModel n O)
    (S : ℕ) (hm : m.Bounded S) (h : m.Hist) (hh : h.length≤S)
    (acc : List (ChainIndex (pairedSlots n))) (ha : acc.length≤S) (x : ChainIndex (pairedSlots n)) :
    width (sampleAccValue m h (acc,x))≤ sampleAccWidth.eval S := by
  have hw : ∀ y,width (m.phaseState h y)≤(sourceWidthPoly 210).eval S := m.width_phaseState S hm h hh
  have hl : width (a:=.list SampleNodeData) (acc.map (m.phaseState h))≤
      S*(2*(sourceWidthPoly 210).eval S+2) := by
    apply (width_list_le _ _ ?_).trans
    · simp only [List.length_map]; exact Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ ha
    · intro y hy
      obtain ⟨z,hz,rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hy
      exact hw z
  rw [sampleAccValue,width_pair (a:=.list SampleNodeData) (b:=SampleNodeData)]
  change 2*width (a:=.list SampleNodeData) (acc.map (m.phaseState h))+1+width (m.phaseState h x)
    ≤ 2*(S*(2*(sourceWidthPoly 210).eval S+2))+(1+(sourceWidthPoly 210).eval S)
  have hx := hw x
  omega
def sampleAccScope : OraclePredicate SampleAccData := fun n O S z =>
  ∃ (m : SamplerModel n O),m.Bounded S ∧ ∃ h : m.Hist,h.length≤S ∧
    ∃ acc : List (ChainIndex (pairedSlots n)),acc.length≤S ∧
    ∃ x : ChainIndex (pairedSlots n),z=sampleAccValue m h (acc,x)
lemma sampleAccScope_width : ∀ n O S z,sampleAccScope n O S z → width z≤ sampleAccWidth.eval S := by
  intro n O S z hz
  obtain ⟨m,hm,h,hh,acc,ha,x,rfl⟩ := hz
  exact sampleAccValue_width m S hm h hh acc ha x
lemma safe_sampleTick : OracleSafe (sampleTick (withContext phaseStepCode)) (bankScope sampleAccScope) := by
  unfold sampleTick
  apply oracleSafe_letControlled _ _ _ _ (by ec)
  apply oracleSafe_precompose snd _ sampleAccScope phaseStateScope
    (oracleSafe_controlled _ (by cc) _ _ sampleAccScope_width)
    (oracleSafe_withContext _ _ safe_phaseStep)
  intro n O S z hz y hy
  obtain ⟨m,hm,h,hh,acc,ha,x,rfl⟩ := hz
  cases hy
  exact ⟨m,hm,h,hh,x,rfl⟩
def sampleRepeatScope : OraclePredicate (.prod .nat SampleAccData) := fun n O S z =>
  z.1≤S ∧ ∃ (m : SamplerModel n O),m.Bounded S ∧ ∃ h : m.Hist,h.length≤S ∧
    ∃ x : ChainIndex (pairedSlots n),z.2=sampleAccValue m h ([],x)
lemma safe_sampleRepeat : OracleSafe (repeatCode (sampleTick (withContext phaseStepCode)))
    (bankScope sampleRepeatScope) := by
  apply oracleSafe_repeat_law _ sampleRepeatScope sampleAccScope safe_sampleTick (.add .input sampleAccWidth)
  · intro n O S k z hz
    obtain ⟨hk,m,hm,h,hh,x,rfl⟩ := hz
    exact Nat.add_le_add hk (sampleAccValue_width m S hm h hh [] (Nat.zero_le S) x)
  · intro n O S k z hz j hj
    obtain ⟨hk,m,hm,h,hh,x,rfl⟩ := hz
    let f := canonicalStepTree n m.positive m.rank O m.samples h h.length
    let e := m.phaseState h
    refine ⟨List (ChainIndex (pairedSlots n)) × ChainIndex (pairedSlots n),sampleAccValue m h,
      treeRepeat (sampleTickTree f) j ([],x),?_,?_⟩
    · apply law_repeat O _ _ _ _ j ([],x)
      apply law_sampleTick O (withContext phaseStepCode) e f
      intro y
      apply law_withContext
      exact phaseStepCode_source m.M₁ m.M₂ O m.exact m.ground₁ m.ground₂
        m.rank m.samples m.phases h m.positive y
    · apply (repeatSample_length f j [] x).mono
      intro v hv
      have hl : v.1.length≤S := by
        simp only [List.length_nil,Nat.zero_add] at hv
        exact hv.le.trans (hj.trans hk)
      exact ⟨(sampleAccValue_width m S hm h hh v.1 hl v.2).trans (Nat.le_add_left _ _),
        m,hm,h,hh,v.1,hl,v.2,rfl⟩
def sampleInputScope : OraclePredicate (.prod .nat SampleNodeData) := fun n O S z =>
  z.1≤S ∧ phaseStateScope n O S z.2
lemma sampleInputScope_width : ∀ n O S z,sampleInputScope n O S z →
    width z≤(SizePolynomial.add (.mul (.constant 2) .input) (.add (.constant 1) (sourceWidthPoly 210))).eval S := by
  intro n O S z hz
  have hk := (bits_length_le_value z.1).trans hz.1
  have hw := phaseStateScope_width n O S z.2 hz.2
  rw [width_pair (a:=.nat) (b:=SampleNodeData),width_nat]
  change _ ≤ 2*S+(1+(sourceWidthPoly 210).eval S)
  omega
lemma safe_sampleCode : OracleSafe (sampleCode (withContext phaseStepCode)) (bankScope sampleInputScope) := by
  unfold sampleCode
  apply oracleSafe_precompose _ _ sampleInputScope sampleRepeatScope
    (oracleSafe_controlled _ (by cc) _ _ sampleInputScope_width)
  · exact oracleSafe_mapControlled _ _ _ safe_sampleRepeat (by unfold sampleFinish; cc)
  · intro n O S z hz y hy
    cases hy
    obtain ⟨m,hm,h,hh,x,he⟩ := hz.2
    exact ⟨hz.1,m,hm,h,hh,x,by rw [he]; rfl⟩
lemma safe_phaseSample : OracleSafe phaseSampleCode (bankScope phaseStateScope) := by
  unfold phaseSampleCode
  apply oracleSafe_precompose _ _ phaseStateScope sampleInputScope
    (oracleSafe_controlled _ (by unfold phaseSamplePrep; cc) _ _ phaseStateScope_width)
  · exact oracleSafe_mapControlled _ _ _ safe_sampleCode (by unfold mapEach; cc)
  · intro n O S z hz y hy
    obtain ⟨m,hm,h,hh,x,rfl⟩ := hz
    have he : run O phaseSamplePrep (m.phaseState h x)=some (m.samples-1,m.phaseState h x) := by
      simp only [phaseSamplePrep,SamplerModel.phaseState,SamplerModel.phaseValue,params,
        run_both,run_compose,run_fst,run_snd,run_ident,run_constant,Option.bind_some,Option.map_some]
      rw [run_natSub]; rfl
    have hey := Option.some.inj (he.symm.trans hy)
    subst y
    exact ⟨(Nat.sub_le _ _).trans hm.2.2.1,m,hm,h,hh,x,rfl⟩
end Effect

open Expression
lemma attrSafe_mapStep {a b c : DataType} (p : Expression (.prod a c) b)
    (A : Attribute (.prod a c)) (hA : A.Mono) (hp : AttrSafe p A) :
    AttrSafe (mapStep p) (fun S z => A S (z.1,z.2.2)) := by
  unfold mapStep
  apply attrSafe_both
  · apply attrSafe_post _ _ _ _ (by cc)
    apply attrSafe_both
    · apply attrSafe_pull _ p _ A (by cc) hp hA
      intro n O S z hz y hy
      cases hy; exact hz
    · exact attrSafe_controlled _ (by cc) _
  · exact attrSafe_controlled _ (by cc) _

lemma attrSafe_mapFold {a b c : DataType} (p : Expression (.prod a c) b)
    (A : Attribute (.prod a c)) (hA : A.Mono) (hp : AttrSafe p A) :
    AttrSafe (.fold (mapStep p)) (fun S z => ∀ x∈z.1,A S (x,z.2.2)) := by
  obtain ⟨f,hf⟩ := hp
  let s : SizePolynomial := .add (.mul (.constant 3) .input) (.constant 1)
  let g : SizePolynomial := .mul (.add (.mul (.constant 4) .input) (.constant 3))
    (.add (.mul (.constant 2) (f.subst s)) (.constant 3))
  have hacc : ∀ {n : ℕ} (O : IndependenceOracle n) S xs zs ctx,
      width (a:=.prod (.list a) (.prod (.list b) c)) (xs,(zs,ctx))≤S →
      (∀ x∈xs,A S (x,ctx)) → ∀ pre post,xs=pre++post → ∀ y,
      foldValue (run O (mapStep p)) pre (zs,ctx)=some y → width y≤g.eval S ∧ y.2=ctx := by
    intro n O S xs zs ctx hw ha pre post he y hy
    have hx : width (a:=.list a) xs≤S := (width_fst _).trans hw
    have hzs : width (a:=.list b) zs≤S := (width_fst (a:=.list b) (b:=c) (zs,ctx)).trans ((width_snd _).trans hw)
    have hc : width ctx≤S := (width_snd (a:=.list b) (b:=c) (zs,ctx)).trans ((width_snd _).trans hw)
    have hl : pre.length≤S := by
      have hh := (list_length_le_width xs).trans hx
      rw [he,List.length_append] at hh
      omega
    let U := f.eval (s.eval S)
    have hh := fold_mapStep_bound O p pre zs ctx U (by
      intro x hxp v hv
      have hxx : x∈xs := by rw [he]; exact List.mem_append_left post hxp
      have hxb := (width_list_member x xs hxx).trans hx
      apply safe_output (hf O (s.eval S) (x,ctx) ⟨?_,?_⟩) hv
      · rw [width_pair (a:=a) (b:=c)]
        change _≤3*S+1
        omega
      · exact hA S _ (by change S≤3*S+1; omega) (x,ctx) (ha x hxx)) y hy
    have hm := Nat.mul_le_mul_right (2*U+2) hl
    have hy' : width (a:=.list b) y.1≤S+S*(2*U+2) := by omega
    refine ⟨?_,hh.2⟩
    have hw' : width y=2*width (a:=.list b) y.1+1+width ctx := by
      rw [width_pair (a:=.list b) (b:=c),hh.2]
    rw [hw']
    simp only [g,SizePolynomial.eval,SizePolynomial.eval_subst]
    change _≤(4*S+3)*(2*U+3)
    nlinarith
  let W : SizePolynomial := .add (.mul (.constant 3) .input) (.add g (.constant 1))
  apply polySafe_fold (mapStep p) _ (fun S (z : Value (.prod a (.prod (.list b) c))) => width z≤W.eval S ∧ A (W.eval S) (z.1,z.2.2))
    (polySafe_reparam _ _ (attrSafe_mapStep p A hA ⟨f,hf⟩) W) (.add .input g)
  · intro S z hz; exact hz.1.trans (Nat.le_add_right _ _)
  · intro n O S xs z hz pre post he y hy
    exact (hacc O S xs z.1 z.2 hz.1 hz.2 pre post he y hy).1.trans (Nat.le_add_left _ _)
  · intro n O S xs z hz pre x post he y hy
    have hh := hacc O S xs z.1 z.2 hz.1 hz.2 pre (x::post) he y hy
    have hm : x∈xs := by rw [he]; simp
    have hwx := (width_list_member x xs hm).trans ((width_fst _).trans hz.1)
    refine ⟨?_,?_⟩
    · rw [width_pair (a:=a) (b:=.prod (.list b) c)]
      change _≤3*S+(g.eval S+1)
      omega
    · rw [hh.2]
      exact hA S _ (by change S≤3*S+(g.eval S+1); omega) (x,z.2) (hz.2 x hm)
lemma attrSafe_mapWith {a b c : DataType} (p : Expression (.prod a c) b)
    (A : Attribute (.prod a c)) (hA : A.Mono) (hp : AttrSafe p A) :
    AttrSafe (mapWith p) (fun S z => ∀ x∈z.1,A S (x,z.2)) := by
  unfold mapWith
  apply attrSafe_pull _ _ _ (fun S (z : Value (.prod (.list a) (.prod (.list b) c))) => ∀ x∈z.1,A S (x,z.2.2)) (by cc)
  · exact attrSafe_post _ _ _ (attrSafe_mapFold p A hA hp) (by cc)
  · intro S T h z hz x hx; exact hA S T h (x,z.2.2) (hz x hx)
  · intro n O S z hz y hy
    cases hy; exact hz

lemma attrSafe_allRange {a : DataType} (p : Expression (.prod .nat a) .bool)
    (A : Attribute (.prod .nat a)) (hA : A.Mono) (hp : AttrSafe p A) :
    AttrSafe (allRange p) (fun S z => z.1≤S ∧ ∀ i<z.1,A S (i,z.2)) := by
  unfold allRange
  apply attrSafe_compose _ _ _ (fun S (z : Value (.prod (.list .nat) a)) => ∀ i∈z.1,A S (i,z.2))
  · apply attrSafe_both
    · apply attrSafe_pull fst rangeCode _ _ (by cc) attr_rangeCode
      · intro S T h x hx; exact hx.trans h
      · intro n O S z hz y hy; cases hy; exact hz.1
    · exact attrSafe_controlled _ (by cc) _
  · exact attrSafe_post _ _ _ (attrSafe_mapWith p A hA hp) (by cc)
  · intro S T h z hz i hi; exact hA S T h (i,z.2) (hz i hi)
  · intro n O S z hz y hy
    have he : run O (both (fst >>> rangeCode) snd) z=some (List.range z.1,z.2) := by
      simp only [run_both,run_compose,run_fst,run_snd,Option.bind_some,run_rangeCode,Option.map_some]
    have hey := Option.some.inj (he.symm.trans hy)
    subst y
    intro i hi
    exact hz.2 i (List.mem_range.mp hi)

lemma attr_slotRow : AttrSafe slotRowCode (fun S z => z.2.1≤S) := by
  unfold slotRowCode
  apply attrSafe_pull _ _ _ (fun S (z : Value (.prod .nat (.prod .nat HistoryData))) =>
    z.1≤S ∧ ∀ i<z.1,True) (by cc)
  · exact attrSafe_allRange _ (fun _ _ => True) (by intro S T h z hz; exact True.intro)
      (attrSafe_controlled _ (by have h := controlled_pairPositive; cc) _)
  · intro S T h z hz; exact ⟨hz.1.trans h,by intros; trivial⟩
  · intro n O S z hz y hy; cases hy; exact ⟨hz,by intros; trivial⟩
lemma attr_slotsPositive : AttrSafe slotsPositiveCode (fun S z => z.1≤S) := by
  unfold slotsPositiveCode
  apply attrSafe_pull _ _ _ (fun S (z : Value (.prod .nat (.prod .nat HistoryData))) =>
    z.1≤S ∧ ∀ i<z.1,z.2.1≤S) (by cc)
  · exact attrSafe_allRange slotRowCode (fun S z => z.2.1≤S)
      (by intro S T h z hz; exact hz.trans h) attr_slotRow
  · intro S T h z hz; exact ⟨hz.1.trans h,fun i hi => (hz.2 i hi).trans h⟩
  · intro n O S z hz y hy; cases hy; exact ⟨hz,fun _ _ => hz⟩
lemma attr_prefixPositive : AttrSafe prefixPositiveCode (fun S z => z.2.1≤S) := by
  unfold prefixPositiveCode
  apply attrSafe_pull _ _ _ (fun S (z : Value (.prod .nat HistoryData)) => z.1≤S)
    (by cc) attr_slotsPositive
  · intro S T h z hz; exact hz.trans h
  · intro n O S z hz y hy
    have he : z.2.1=y.1 := Option.some.inj (run_both_parts O _ _ z y hy).1
    exact he ▸ hz
lemma attr_historyPositive : AttrSafe historyPositiveCode (fun S z => z.1≤S) := by
  let prep : Expression (.prod .nat HistoryData) (.prod .nat (.prod .nat HistoryData)) :=
    both (snd >>> listLength >>> (both ident (constant 1) >>> add)) ident
  have hc : Controlled prep := by dsimp [prep]; cc
  obtain ⟨f,hf⟩ := hc
  let g : SizePolynomial := .add f (.add .input (.constant 1))
  change PolySafe (prep >>> allRange prefixPositiveCode) (fun S z => width z≤S ∧ z.1≤S)
  apply polySafe_compose prep _ _ (fun S z => width z≤g.eval S ∧
      (z.1≤g.eval S ∧ ∀ i<z.1,z.2.1≤g.eval S))
    (polySafe_of_controlled prep ⟨f,hf⟩ _ .input (by intro S z hz; exact hz.1))
    (polySafe_reparam _ _ (attrSafe_allRange prefixPositiveCode (fun S z => z.2.1≤S)
      (by intro S T h z hz; exact hz.trans h) attr_prefixPositive) g)
  intro n O S z hz y hy
  have hd : y=(z.2.length+1,z) := by
    have he : run O prep z=some (z.2.length+1,z) := by
      simp only [prep,run_both,run_compose,run_snd,run_ident,run_constant,
        Option.bind_some,Option.map_some,run_listLength]
      rfl
    exact Option.some.inj (hy.symm.trans he)
  have hw : width y≤f.eval S := (safe_output (hf O z) hy).trans (f.monotone hz.1)
  have hl := (list_length_le_width z.2).trans ((width_snd (a:=.nat) (b:=HistoryData) z).trans hz.1)
  refine ⟨hw.trans (Nat.le_add_right _ _),?_,?_⟩
  · rw [hd]
    change z.2.length+1≤f.eval S+(S+1)
    omega
  · intro i hi
    rw [hd]
    exact hz.2.trans (by change S≤f.eval S+(S+1); omega)

lemma oracleSafe_chooseScoped {a b : DataType} (t : Expression a .bool) (p q : Effect a b)
    (R : OraclePredicate a) (ht : OracleSafe t R)
    (hp : OracleSafe p (bankScope R)) (hq : OracleSafe q (bankScope R)) :
    OracleSafe (choose t p q) (bankScope R) := by
  apply oracleSafe_applyIf _ _ _ (bankScope R)
  · exact safe_scope_fst t R ht
  · exact oracleSafe_mono p hp (by intro n O S x hx; exact hx.1)
  · exact oracleSafe_mono q hq (by intro n O S x hx; exact hx.1)

    (hp : OracleSafe p R) : OracleSafe (someCode p) R := by

lemma attr_positiveTest : AttrSafe positiveTest (fun S z => z.1.1.1≤S) := by
  unfold positiveTest
  apply attrSafe_pull _ _ _ (fun S (z : Value (.prod .nat HistoryData)) => z.1≤S)
    (by cc) attr_historyPositive
  · intro S T h z hz; exact hz.trans h
  · intro n O S z hz y hy; cases hy; exact hz
lemma safe_positiveTest : OracleSafe positiveTest phaseScope := by
  apply oracleSafe_attr _ _ (by intro S T h z hz; exact hz.trans h)
    attr_positiveTest phaseScope _ phaseScope_width
  intro n O S z hz
  obtain ⟨m,hm,h,hh,rfl⟩ := hz
  exact hm.1
lemma safe_phaseNone : OracleSafe (noneCode (a:=PhaseInput) (b:=SampleData)) (bankScope phaseScope) := by
  exact oracleSafe_pure _ phaseScope (oracleSafe_controlled _ (by cc) _ _ phaseScope_width)
lemma safe_phase : OracleSafe phaseCode (bankScope phaseScope) := by
  unfold phaseCode
  apply oracleSafe_chooseScoped _ _ _ phaseScope safe_positiveTest safe_phaseNone
  apply oracleSafe_optionBind _ _ phaseScope phaseStateScope
    (oracleSafe_retainOption _ _ safe_start) (oracleSafe_some _ _ safe_phaseSample)
  intro n O S z bank hz hb y rest hy
  obtain ⟨m,hm,h,hh,rfl⟩ := hz
  have hl := law_retainOption O startCode (fun x : ChainIndex (pairedSlots n) => stateEncode x.val)
    (m.phaseValue h) _ (startCode_source m.M₁ m.M₂ O m.exact m.ground₁ m.ground₂
      m.rank m.samples m.phases h m.positive)
  obtain ⟨v,he,hr⟩ := hl.output_some bank y rest hy
  refine ⟨?_,hr.trans hb⟩
  rw [he]
  apply optionScope_encode
  intro x
  exact ⟨m,hm,h,hh,x,rfl⟩
lemma safe_witness : OracleSafe witnessCode (bankScope phaseScope) := by
  unfold witnessCode

variable {n : ℕ} (M₁ M₂ : Matroid (Fin n)) (O : IndependenceOracle n)

omit M₁ M₂ hO hE₁ hE₂ in

    run O plainMeanCode (r,sampleEncode xs)=some (rationalPair (rationalEmpirical (rationalPlain GS (fun _ => 1)) xs)) := by
  simp only [plainMeanCode,run_compose,run_both,run_snd,Option.bind_some]
  rw [run_countPlainCode,run_listLength]

def historyTickCode {a c} (p : Effect (.prod c (.list a)) (Optional a)) :
    Effect (.prod c (.list a)) (Optional (.prod c (.list a))) :=
  map (retainOption p) (optionMapCode (both (fst >>> fst)
    (both (fst >>> snd) (both snd (constant []) >>> cons) >>> listAppend)))
def historyTickTree {X : Type*} (K : List X → DrawTree (Option X)) (h : List X) : DrawTree (Option (List X)) :=
  (K h).map (Option.map (fun x => h++[x]))
lemma optionRepeat_none {X : Type*} (f : X → DrawTree (Option X)) (k : ℕ) :
    treeRepeat (fun x => match x with | none => .leaf none | some y => f y) k none=.leaf none := by
  induction k with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ k ih => exact ih
lemma iterate_history {X : Type*} (K : List X → DrawTree (Option X)) (k : ℕ) (h : List X) :
    DrawTree.iterate (historyTickTree K) k h=DrawTree.history K k h := by
  rw [←treeRepeat_option]
  induction k generalizing h with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ k ih =>
    simp only [treeRepeat,historyTickTree,DrawTree.map_bind,DrawTree.history,DrawTree.optionBind]
    congr 1
    funext u
    cases u with
    | none => exact optionRepeat_none _ k
    | some x => exact ih (h++[x])
lemma law_historyTickCode {n : ℕ} (O : IndependenceOracle n) {X : Type*} {a c}
    (p : Effect (.prod c (.list a)) (Optional a)) (e : X → Value a) (ctx : Value c)
    (K : List X → DrawTree (Option X)) (h : List X)
    (hp : RealizesLaw O p (optionEncode e) (ctx,h.map e) (K h)) :
    RealizesLaw O (historyTickCode p) (optionEncode (fun h => (ctx,h.map e))) (ctx,h.map e) (historyTickTree K h) := by
  apply law_optionMap O (retainOption p) _ (fun y => ((ctx,h.map e),e y)) _ _ _ (fun x => h++[x])
  · exact law_retainOption O p e (ctx,h.map e) (K h) hp
  · intro x
    simp only [run_both,run_compose,run_fst,run_snd,run_constant,Option.bind_some,Option.map_some]
    change ((run O listAppend (h.map e,[e x])).map fun l => (ctx,l))=_
    rw [run_listAppend]
    simp

def historyCode {a c} (p : Effect (.prod c (.list a)) (Optional a)) :
    Effect (.prod .nat (.prod c (.list a))) (Optional (.prod c (.list a))) := iterateCode (historyTickCode p)
lemma law_historyCode {n : ℕ} (O : IndependenceOracle n) {X : Type*} {a c}
    (p : Effect (.prod c (.list a)) (Optional a)) (e : X → Value a) (ctx : Value c)
    (K : List X → DrawTree (Option X))
    (hp : ∀ h,RealizesLaw O p (optionEncode e) (ctx,h.map e) (K h)) (k : ℕ) (h : List X) :
    RealizesLaw O (historyCode p) (optionEncode (fun h => (ctx,h.map e))) (k,(ctx,h.map e)) (DrawTree.history K k h) := by
  rw [←iterate_history]
  exact law_iterate O (historyTickCode p) _ _ (fun h => law_historyTickCode O p e ctx K h (hp h)) k h
end Effect

lemma ratio_nonnegative {n : ℕ} (O : IndependenceOracle n) (r : ℕ) (xs : List (Set (Fin n⊕Fin n))) :
    0≤rationalRatio (pairedSlots n) (fun S => rationalRho n^oracleDeficiency n r O S) xs := by

  · apply div_nonneg
    · apply List.sum_nonneg

  · apply div_nonneg

  rw [run_powCode,Option.bind_some,run_natRatCode,Option.bind_some,run_rangeCode]
  simp only [Option.bind_some]
  let f : ℕ → ℚ := fun j => rationalRatio GS (fun S => rationalRho n^oracleDeficiency n r O S)
    (historySample (observedSets n N) h j)
  have hm := run_mapWith_source O ratioAtCode id (fun j => rationalPair (f j))
    (params n r N L,historyEncode (h.map (observedSets n N)))
    (ratioAtCode_source M₁ M₂ O hO hE₁ hE₂ r N L h) (List.range L)

  rw [run_compose,hm]
  simp only [Option.bind_some]
  have he : (List.range L).map (fun j => rationalPair (f j))=((List.range L).map f).map rationalPair := by

    obtain ⟨j,hj,rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hq

  simp only [Option.bind_some,Option.map_some]

  simp only [run_compose,run_both,run_fst,run_snd,params,Option.bind_some,Option.map_some]
  rw [deficiencyCode_source M₁ M₂ O hO hE₁ hE₂ r _ _ (stateEncode_left_length _) (stateEncode_right_length _),

  · simp only [hz,decide_false,Option.bind_some,Bool.false_eq_true,ite_false,run_constant,oracleGuard]

lemma history_length {X : Type*} (K : List X → DrawTree (Option X)) (k : ℕ) (h : List X) :
    DrawTree.All (fun v => ∀ h',v=some h' → h'.length=h.length+k) (DrawTree.history K k h) := by
  induction k generalizing h with
  | zero => intro h' he; cases he; simp
  | succ k ih =>
    unfold DrawTree.history DrawTree.optionBind
    apply DrawTree.all_bind_of_all (K h) _ (fun _ => True) _ (DrawTree.all_of_forall _ _ (by intros; trivial))
    intro u _
    cases u with
    | none => intro h' he; cases he
    | some x =>
      apply (ih (h++[x])).mono
      intro v hv h' he
      have hh := hv h' he
      simpa only [List.length_append,List.length_singleton,Nat.add_assoc,Nat.add_comm 1 k] using hh
lemma safe_historyTick : OracleSafe (historyTickCode phaseCode) (bankScope phaseScope) := by
  unfold historyTickCode
  exact oracleSafe_mapControlled _ _ _ (oracleSafe_retainOption _ _ safe_phase) (by cc)
noncomputable def phaseOptWidth : SizePolynomial :=
  .add (sourceWidthPoly 100) (.constant (width (zeroValue PhaseInput)+3))
lemma phaseOptWidth_bound {n : ℕ} {O : IndependenceOracle n} (m : SamplerModel n O)
    (S : ℕ) (hm : m.Bounded S) (v : Option m.Hist)
    (hv : ∀ h,v=some h → h.length≤S) :
    width (optionEncode m.phaseValue v)≤phaseOptWidth.eval S := by
  cases v with
  | none =>
    rw [optionEncode,optionalValue,width_pair (a:=.bool) (b:=PhaseInput),width_bool]
    change 2*1+1+width (zeroValue PhaseInput)≤(sourceWidthPoly 100).eval S+(width (zeroValue PhaseInput)+3)
    omega
  | some h =>
    have hw := m.width_phaseValue S hm h (hv h rfl)
    rw [optionEncode,optionalValue,width_pair (a:=.bool) (b:=PhaseInput),width_bool]
    change 2*1+1+width (m.phaseValue h)≤(sourceWidthPoly 100).eval S+(width (zeroValue PhaseInput)+3)
    rw [eval_sourceWidthPoly]
    omega
lemma historyTick_source {n : ℕ} {O : IndependenceOracle n} (m : SamplerModel n O) (h : m.Hist) :
    RealizesLaw O (historyTickCode phaseCode) (optionEncode m.phaseValue) (m.phaseValue h)
      (historyTickTree (canonicalPhaseTree n m.positive m.rank O m.samples m.phases) h) := by
  have hl := law_historyTickCode O phaseCode
    (fun v : PhaseSample n m.samples => sampleEncode (observedSets n m.samples v))
    (params n m.rank m.samples m.phases)
    (canonicalPhaseTree n m.positive m.rank O m.samples m.phases) h (by
      simpa only [SamplerModel.phaseValue,SamplerModel.histValue,historyEncode,List.map_map,Function.comp_def] using
        phaseCode_source m.M₁ m.M₂ O m.exact m.ground₁ m.ground₂ m.rank m.samples m.phases h m.positive)
  change RealizesLaw O _ (optionEncode (fun h => m.phaseValue h)) _ _
  simpa only [SamplerModel.phaseValue,SamplerModel.histValue,historyEncode,List.map_map,Function.comp_def] using hl

def historyRepeatScope : OraclePredicate (.prod .nat (Optional PhaseInput)) := fun n O S z =>
  z.1≤S ∧ ∃ (m : SamplerModel n O),m.Bounded S ∧ z.2=optionEncode m.phaseValue (some [])
lemma safe_historyRepeat : OracleSafe (repeatCode (optionContinue (historyTickCode phaseCode)))
    (bankScope historyRepeatScope) := by
  apply oracleSafe_repeat_law _ historyRepeatScope (optionScope phaseScope)
    (oracleSafe_optionContinue _ _ safe_historyTick) (.add .input phaseOptWidth)
  · intro n O S k z hz
    obtain ⟨hk,m,hm,rfl⟩ := hz
    exact Nat.add_le_add hk (phaseOptWidth_bound m S hm (some []) (by intro h he; cases he; exact Nat.zero_le S))
  · intro n O S k z hz j hj
    obtain ⟨hk,m,hm,rfl⟩ := hz
    let K := canonicalPhaseTree n m.positive m.rank O m.samples m.phases
    let f := historyTickTree K
    let F : Option m.Hist → DrawTree (Option m.Hist) := fun u => match u with
      | none => .leaf none | some h => f h
    refine ⟨Option m.Hist,optionEncode m.phaseValue,treeRepeat F j (some []),?_,?_⟩
    · apply law_repeat O _ _ F _ j (some [])
      intro u
      change RealizesLaw O (optionContinue (historyTickCode phaseCode)) (optionEncode m.phaseValue)
        (optionEncode m.phaseValue u) (match u with | none => .leaf none | some h => f h)
      cases u <;> exact law_optionContinue O (historyTickCode phaseCode) m.phaseValue m.phaseValue f _
        (fun h => historyTick_source m h)
    · have he : treeRepeat F j (some [])=DrawTree.iterate f j [] := by
        convert treeRepeat_option f j ([] : m.Hist) using 2
        funext u; cases u <;> rfl
      rw [he]
      change DrawTree.All _ (DrawTree.iterate (historyTickTree K) j [])
      rw [iterate_history]
      apply (history_length K j []).mono
      intro v hv
      have hb : ∀ h,v=some h → h.length≤S := by
        intro h he
        have hh := hv h he
        simp only [List.length_nil,Nat.zero_add] at hh
        exact hh.le.trans (hj.trans hk)
      refine ⟨(phaseOptWidth_bound m S hm v hb).trans (Nat.le_add_left _ _),?_⟩
      cases v with
      | none => exact Or.inl rfl
      | some h => exact Or.inr ⟨rfl,m,hm,h,hb h rfl,rfl⟩
def historyInputScope : OraclePredicate (.prod .nat PhaseInput) := fun n O S z =>
  z.1≤S ∧ ∃ (m : SamplerModel n O),m.Bounded S ∧ z.2=m.phaseValue []
lemma historyInputScope_width : ∀ n O S z,historyInputScope n O S z →
    width z≤(SizePolynomial.add (.mul (.constant 2) .input) (.add (.constant 1) (sourceWidthPoly 100))).eval S := by
  intro n O S z hz
  obtain ⟨hk,m,hm,he⟩ := hz
  have hb := (bits_length_le_value z.1).trans hk
  have hw := m.width_phaseValue S hm [] (Nat.zero_le S)
  rw [width_pair (a:=.nat) (b:=PhaseInput),width_nat,he]
  change _≤2*S+(1+(sourceWidthPoly 100).eval S)
  rw [eval_sourceWidthPoly]
  omega
lemma safe_historyCode : OracleSafe (historyCode phaseCode) (bankScope historyInputScope) := by
  unfold historyCode iterateCode
  apply oracleSafe_precompose _ _ historyInputScope historyRepeatScope
    (oracleSafe_controlled _ (by cc) _ _ historyInputScope_width) safe_historyRepeat
  intro n O S z hz y hy
  cases hy
  obtain ⟨hk,m,hm,he⟩ := hz
  exact ⟨hk,m,hm,by rw [he]; rfl⟩
def algorithmScope : OraclePredicate AlgorithmParams := fun n O S z =>
  ∃ (m : SamplerModel n O),m.Bounded S ∧ z=params n m.rank m.samples m.phases
lemma algorithmScope_width : ∀ n O S z,algorithmScope n O S z → width z≤(sourceWidthPoly 100).eval S := by
  intro n O S z hz
  obtain ⟨m,hm,rfl⟩ := hz
  rw [eval_sourceWidthPoly]
  exact (width_fst (a:=AlgorithmParams) (b:=HistoryData) (m.phaseValue [])).trans
    (m.width_phaseValue S hm [] (Nat.zero_le S))
lemma safe_algorithmHistory : OracleSafe algorithmHistoryCode (bankScope algorithmScope) := by
  unfold algorithmHistoryCode
  apply oracleSafe_precompose _ _ algorithmScope historyInputScope
    (oracleSafe_controlled _ (by cc) _ _ algorithmScope_width) safe_historyCode
  intro n O S z hz y hy
  obtain ⟨m,hm,rfl⟩ := hz
  cases hy
  exact ⟨hm.2.2.2.1,m,hm,rfl⟩

lemma attrSafe_fst {a b c : DataType} (p : Expression a c) (A : Attribute a)
    (hp : AttrSafe p A) : AttrSafe (fst >>> p) (fun S (z : Value (.prod a b)) => A S z.1) := by
  obtain ⟨f,hf⟩ := hp
  refine ⟨.add .input f,fun O S x hx => ?_⟩
  have hw := (width_fst (a:=a) (b:=b) x).trans hx.1
  apply safe_compose O fst p x
  · exact ⟨hx.1.trans (Nat.le_add_right _ _),fun y hy => by cases hy; exact hw.trans (Nat.le_add_right _ _),trivial⟩
  · intro y hy
    cases hy
    exact safe_mono p x.1 (hf O S x.1 ⟨hw,hx.2⟩) (Nat.le_add_left _ _)
lemma attrSafe_snd {a b c : DataType} (p : Expression b c) (A : Attribute b)
    (hp : AttrSafe p A) : AttrSafe (snd >>> p) (fun S (z : Value (.prod a b)) => A S z.2) := by
  obtain ⟨f,hf⟩ := hp
  refine ⟨.add .input f,fun O S x hx => ?_⟩
  have hw := (width_snd (a:=a) (b:=b) x).trans hx.1
  apply safe_compose O snd p x
  · exact ⟨hx.1.trans (Nat.le_add_right _ _),fun y hy => by cases hy; exact hw.trans (Nat.le_add_right _ _),trivial⟩
  · intro y hy
    cases hy
    exact safe_mono p x.2 (hf O S x.2 ⟨hw,hx.2⟩) (Nat.le_add_left _ _)

lemma attrSafe_shift {a b : DataType} (p : Expression a b) (A : Attribute a)
    (hp : AttrSafe p A) : AttrSafe p (fun S x => A (S+1) x) := by
  apply polySafe_mono p (polySafe_reparam p _ hp (.add .input (.constant 1)))
  intro S x hx
  exact ⟨hx.1.trans (Nat.le_add_right S 1),hx.2⟩
lemma attr_anneal : AttrSafe annealCode weightAttr :=
  polySafe_mono annealCode polySafe_anneal (by intro S x hx; exact ⟨hx.1,hx.2.1,hx.2.2⟩)
lemma attr_weightedPlain : AttrSafe weightedPlainCode (fun S z => z.1≤S) := by
  unfold weightedPlainCode
  apply attrSafe_applyIf _ _ _ _ (by intro S T h z hz; exact hz.trans h)
    (attrSafe_controlled _ (by have h := controlled_plainCode; cc) _) (attrSafe_controlled _ (by cc) _)
  apply attrSafe_pull _ annealCode _ (fun S z => weightAttr (S+1) z) (by cc)
    (attrSafe_shift _ _ attr_anneal)
  · intro S T h z hz
    exact weightAttr_mono _ _ (Nat.add_le_add_right h 1) z hz
  · intro n O S z hz y hy
    cases hy
    exact ⟨hz.trans (Nat.le_add_right S 1),Nat.le_add_left 1 S⟩
lemma attr_weightedList : AttrSafe weightedListCode (fun S z => z.1≤S) := by
  unfold weightedListCode
  apply attrSafe_pull _ _ _ (fun S (z : Value (.prod SampleData .nat)) => ∀ x∈z.1,z.2≤S) (by cc)
  · apply attrSafe_mapWith _ (fun S (z : Value (.prod StateData .nat)) => z.2≤S) (by intro S T h z hz; exact hz.trans h)
    apply attrSafe_pull _ _ _ (fun S (z : Value (.prod .nat StateData)) => z.1≤S) (by cc) attr_weightedPlain
    · intro S T h z hz; exact hz.trans h
    · intro n O S z hz y hy; cases hy; exact hz
  · intro S T h z hz x hx; exact (hz x hx).trans h
  · intro n O S z hz y hy; cases hy; exact fun _ _ => hz
lemma controlled_plainMean : Controlled plainMeanCode := by
  have h := controlled_countPlain
  unfold plainMeanCode; cc
lemma attr_weightedMean : AttrSafe weightedMeanCode (fun S z => z.1≤S) := by
  unfold weightedMeanCode Expression.letIn
  apply attrSafe_post
  · exact attrSafe_both _ _ _ (attrSafe_controlled _ (by cc) _) attr_weightedList
  · unfold natRatCode; cc
lemma attr_ratio : AttrSafe ratioCode (fun S z => z.1≤S) := by
  unfold ratioCode
  exact attrSafe_post _ _ _ (attrSafe_both _ _ _ attr_weightedMean
    (attrSafe_controlled _ controlled_plainMean _)) controlled_ratDiv
lemma controlled_historyAt : Controlled historyAtCode := by unfold historyAtCode; cc
lemma attr_ratioAt : AttrSafe ratioAtCode (fun S z => z.2.1.1.2≤S) := by
  unfold ratioAtCode
  apply attrSafe_pull _ _ _ (fun S (z : Value (.prod .nat SampleData)) => z.1≤S) (by have h := controlled_historyAt; cc) attr_ratio
  · intro S T h z hz; exact hz.trans h
  · intro n O S z hz y hy
    have he : z.2.1.1.2=y.1 := Option.some.inj (run_both_parts O _ _ z y hy).1
    exact he ▸ hz
lemma attr_pow : AttrSafe Expression.powCode (fun S z => z.2≤S) := by
  apply polySafe_mono _ polySafe_powCode
  intro S z hz
  exact ⟨(width_fst (a:=.nat) (b:=.nat) z).trans hz.1,hz.2⟩
def estimatorAttr (S : ℕ) (z : Value PhaseInput) : Prop :=
  z.1.1.1≤S ∧ z.1.1.2≤S ∧ z.1.2.1.2≤S
lemma estimatorAttr_mono : Attribute.Mono (a:=PhaseInput) estimatorAttr := by
  intro S T h z hz; exact ⟨hz.1.trans h,hz.2.1.trans h,hz.2.2.trans h⟩
lemma attr_estimate : AttrSafe estimateCode estimatorAttr := by
  unfold estimateCode
  apply attrSafe_post
  · apply attrSafe_both
    · apply attrSafe_pull _ _ _ (fun S (z : Value (.prod .nat .nat)) => z.2≤S) (by cc)
      · exact attrSafe_post _ _ _ attr_pow (by unfold natRatCode; cc)
      · intro S T h z hz; exact hz.trans h
      · intro n O S z hz y hy; cases hy; exact hz.1
    · apply attrSafe_compose _ _ _ (fun S (z : Value (.prod (.list .nat) PhaseInput)) => ∀ i∈z.1,z.2.1.1.2≤S)
      · apply attrSafe_both
        · apply attrSafe_mono _ (attrSafe_fst _ _ (attrSafe_snd _ _ (attrSafe_fst _ _ (attrSafe_snd _ _ attr_rangeCode))))
          intro S z hz; exact hz.2.2
        · exact attrSafe_controlled _ (by cc) _
      · apply attrSafe_post _ _ _ _ controlled_ratProduct
        exact attrSafe_mapWith _ (fun S (z : Value (.prod .nat PhaseInput)) => z.2.1.1.2≤S)
          (by intro S T h z hz; exact hz.trans h) attr_ratioAt
      · intro S T h z hz i hi; exact (hz i hi).trans h
      · intro n O S z hz y hy
        have he : z=y.2 := Option.some.inj (run_both_parts O _ _ z y hy).2
        intro i hi
        rw [←he]; exact hz.2.1
  · exact controlled_ratMul
lemma attr_guard : AttrSafe guardCode (fun S z => estimatorAttr S z.1) := by
  unfold guardCode
  apply attrSafe_applyIf _ _ _ _ (fun S T h (z : Value (.prod PhaseInput StateData)) hz => estimatorAttr_mono S T h z.1 hz)
    (attrSafe_controlled _ (by cc) _) (attrSafe_controlled _ (by cc) _)
  apply attrSafe_pull fst _ _ estimatorAttr (by cc) attr_estimate estimatorAttr_mono
  intro n O S z hz y hy; cases hy; exact hz

lemma oracleSafe_optionMap {a b : DataType} (p : Expression a b)
    (R : OraclePredicate a) (hp : OracleSafe p R) : OracleSafe (optionMapCode p) (optionScope R) := by
  obtain ⟨f,hf⟩ := oracleSafe_input_bound p R hp
  let W : SizePolynomial := .add f (.constant (width (zeroValue a)+3))
  have hw : ∀ n O S x,optionScope R n O S x → width x≤W.eval S := optionScope_width R f hf
  unfold optionMapCode
  apply oracleSafe_applyIf _ _ _ (optionScope R)
  · exact oracleSafe_controlled _ (by cc) _ W hw
  · exact oracleSafe_controlled _ (by cc) _ W (by intro n O S x hx; exact hw n O S x hx.1)
  · apply oracleSafe_both
    · exact oracleSafe_controlled _ (by cc) _ W (by intro n O S x hx; exact hw n O S x hx.1)
    · apply oracleSafe_pull snd p _ R (by cc) W (by intro n O S x hx; exact hw n O S x hx.1) hp
      intro n O S x hx y hy
      cases hy
      have hv : x.1=true := Option.some.inj hx.2
      rcases hx.1 with hz | ⟨_,hr⟩
      · rw [hz] at hv; cases hv
      · exact hr

lemma safe_guard : OracleSafe guardCode phaseStateScope := by
  apply oracleSafe_attr _ _ (fun S T h (z : Value (.prod PhaseInput StateData)) hz => estimatorAttr_mono S T h z.1 hz)
    attr_guard phaseStateScope _ phaseStateScope_width
  intro n O S z hz
  obtain ⟨m,hm,h,hh,x,rfl⟩ := hz
  exact ⟨hm.1,hm.2.1,hm.2.2.2.1⟩
lemma safe_finalGuard : OracleSafe finalGuardCode (bankScope phaseScope) := by
  unfold finalGuardCode map
  apply oracleSafe_bind _ _ phaseScope (optionScope phaseStateScope)
    (oracleSafe_retainOption _ _ safe_witness) (oracleSafe_pure _ _ (oracleSafe_optionMap _ _ safe_guard))
  intro n O S z bank hz hb y rest hy
  obtain ⟨m,hm,h,hh,rfl⟩ := hz
  have hl := law_retainOption O witnessCode (fun x : PlainIndex (pairedSlots n) => stateEncode x.val.val)
    (m.phaseValue h) _ (witnessCode_source m.M₁ m.M₂ O m.exact m.ground₁ m.ground₂
      m.rank m.samples m.phases h m.positive)
  obtain ⟨v,he,hr⟩ := hl.output_some bank y rest hy
  refine ⟨?_,hr.trans hb⟩
  rw [he]
  apply optionScope_encode
  intro x
  exact ⟨m,hm,h,hh,x.val,rfl⟩

lemma safe_algorithm : OracleSafe algorithmCode (bankScope algorithmScope) := by
  unfold algorithmCode
  apply oracleSafe_optionBind _ _ algorithmScope phaseScope safe_algorithmHistory safe_finalGuard
  intro n O S z bank hz hb y rest hy
  obtain ⟨m,hm,rfl⟩ := hz
  have hl := algorithmHistoryCode_source m.M₁ m.M₂ O m.exact m.ground₁ m.ground₂
    m.rank m.samples m.phases m.positive
  have ha := history_length (canonicalPhaseTree n m.positive m.rank O m.samples m.phases) m.phases ([] : m.Hist)
  obtain ⟨v,he,hv,hr⟩ := hl.output_some_all _ ha bank y rest hy
  refine ⟨?_,hr.trans hb⟩
  rw [he]
  cases v with
  | none => exact Or.inl rfl
  | some h =>
    have hh : h.length≤S := by
      have he := hv h rfl
      simp only [List.length_nil,Nat.zero_add] at he
      exact he.le.trans hm.2.2.2.1
    exact Or.inr ⟨rfl,m,hm,h,hh,rfl⟩

open Expression
lemma oracleSafe_mapStep {a b c : DataType} (p : Expression (.prod a c) b)
    (Q : OraclePredicate (.prod a c)) (hp : OracleSafe p Q) (g : SizePolynomial) :
    OracleSafe (mapStep p) (fun n O S z => width z≤g.eval S ∧ Q n O S (z.1,z.2.2)) := by
  let R : OraclePredicate (.prod a (.prod (.list b) c)) := fun n O S z => width z≤g.eval S ∧ Q n O S (z.1,z.2.2)
  have hc : ∀ {d} (q : Expression (.prod a (.prod (.list b) c)) d),Controlled q → OracleSafe q R :=
    fun q hq => oracleSafe_controlled q hq R g (by intro n O S z hz; exact hz.1)
  unfold mapStep
  apply oracleSafe_both
  · apply oracleSafe_post _ _ R _ (by cc)
    apply oracleSafe_both
    · apply oracleSafe_pull _ p R Q (by cc) g (by intro n O S z hz; exact hz.1) hp
      intro n O S z hz y hy; cases hy; exact hz.2
    · exact hc _ (by cc)
  · exact hc _ (by cc)
lemma oracleSafe_mapFold {a b c : DataType} (p : Expression (.prod a c) b)
    (Q : OraclePredicate (.prod a c)) (hp : OracleSafe p Q) (g : SizePolynomial) :
    OracleSafe (.fold (mapStep p))
      (fun n O S z => width z≤g.eval S ∧ ∀ x∈z.1,Q n O S (x,z.2.2)) := by
  obtain ⟨f,hf⟩ := hp
  let U : SizePolynomial := .mul (.add (.mul (.constant 4) g) (.constant 3))
    (.add (.mul (.constant 2) f) (.constant 3))
  have hacc : ∀ {n : ℕ} (O : IndependenceOracle n) S xs zs ctx,
      width (a:=.prod (.list a) (.prod (.list b) c)) (xs,(zs,ctx))≤g.eval S →
      (∀ x∈xs,Q n O S (x,ctx)) → ∀ pre post,xs=pre++post → ∀ y,
      foldValue (run O (mapStep p)) pre (zs,ctx)=some y → width y≤U.eval S ∧ y.2=ctx := by
    intro n O S xs zs ctx hw ha pre post he y hy
    have hx : width (a:=.list a) xs≤g.eval S := (width_fst _).trans hw
    have hzs : width (a:=.list b) zs≤g.eval S := (width_fst (a:=.list b) (b:=c) (zs,ctx)).trans ((width_snd _).trans hw)
    have hc : width ctx≤g.eval S := (width_snd (a:=.list b) (b:=c) (zs,ctx)).trans ((width_snd _).trans hw)
    have hl : pre.length≤g.eval S := by
      have hh := (list_length_le_width xs).trans hx
      rw [he,List.length_append] at hh; omega
    have hh := fold_mapStep_bound O p pre zs ctx (f.eval S) (by
      intro x hxp v hv
      exact safe_output (hf O S (x,ctx) (ha x (by rw [he]; exact List.mem_append_left post hxp))) hv) y hy
    have hm := Nat.mul_le_mul_right (2*f.eval S+2) hl
    have hy' : width (a:=.list b) y.1≤g.eval S+g.eval S*(2*f.eval S+2) := by omega
    refine ⟨?_,hh.2⟩
    have hw' : width y=2*width (a:=.list b) y.1+1+width ctx := by
      rw [width_pair (a:=.list b) (b:=c),hh.2]
    rw [hw']
    simp only [U,SizePolynomial.eval]
    nlinarith
  let W : SizePolynomial := .add (.mul (.constant 3) g) (.add U (.constant 1))
  apply oracleSafe_fold (mapStep p) _
    (fun n O S (z : Value (.prod a (.prod (.list b) c))) => width z≤W.eval S ∧ Q n O S (z.1,z.2.2))
    (oracleSafe_mapStep p Q ⟨f,hf⟩ W) (.add g U)
  · intro n O S z hz; exact hz.1.trans (Nat.le_add_right _ _)
  · intro n O S xs z hz pre post he y hy
    exact (hacc O S xs z.1 z.2 hz.1 hz.2 pre post he y hy).1.trans (Nat.le_add_left _ _)
  · intro n O S xs z hz pre x post he y hy
    have hh := hacc O S xs z.1 z.2 hz.1 hz.2 pre (x::post) he y hy
    have hm : x∈xs := by rw [he]; simp
    have hx := (width_list_member x xs hm).trans ((width_fst _).trans hz.1)
    refine ⟨?_,?_⟩
    · rw [width_pair (a:=a) (b:=.prod (.list b) c)]
      change _≤3*g.eval S+(U.eval S+1); omega
    · rw [hh.2]; exact hz.2 x hm
lemma oracleSafe_mapWith {a b c : DataType} (p : Expression (.prod a c) b)
    (Q : OraclePredicate (.prod a c)) (hp : OracleSafe p Q) (g : SizePolynomial) :
    OracleSafe (mapWith p) (fun n O S z => width z≤g.eval S ∧ ∀ x∈z.1,Q n O S (x,z.2)) := by
  let R : OraclePredicate (.prod (.list a) c) := fun n O S z => width z≤g.eval S ∧ ∀ x∈z.1,Q n O S (x,z.2)
  let prep : Expression (.prod (.list a) c) (.prod (.list a) (.prod (.list b) c)) := both fst (both (constant []) snd)
  have hprep : OracleSafe prep R := oracleSafe_controlled prep (by dsimp [prep]; cc) R g (by intro n O S z hz; exact hz.1)
  obtain ⟨f,hf⟩ := hprep
  unfold mapWith
  apply oracleSafe_compose _ _ R
    (fun n O S (z : Value (.prod (.list a) (.prod (.list b) c))) => width z≤f.eval S ∧ ∀ x∈z.1,Q n O S (x,z.2.2)) ⟨f,hf⟩
  · exact oracleSafe_post _ _ _ (oracleSafe_mapFold p Q hp f) (by cc)
  · intro n O S z hz y hy
    refine ⟨safe_output (hf O S z hz) hy,?_⟩
    cases hy; exact hz.2

namespace Expression
abbrev InsertState := DataType.prod NN (.prod (.list NN) (.list NN))
def insertStep : Expression (.prod NN InsertState) InsertState :=
  both (snd >>> fst) (both (both fst (snd >>> snd >>> fst) >>> Expression.cons)
    (applyIf (both fst (snd >>> fst) >>> ratLess)
      (both (snd >>> fst) (both fst (snd >>> snd >>> fst) >>> Expression.cons) >>> Expression.cons)
      (both fst (snd >>> snd >>> snd) >>> Expression.cons)))
def insertInit : Expression (.prod NN (.list NN)) InsertState :=
  both fst (both (constant (b:=.list NN) [])
    (both fst (constant (b:=.list NN) []) >>> Expression.cons (a:=NN)))
def insertRatCode : Expression (.prod NN (.list NN)) (.list NN) :=
  both (snd >>> listReverse) insertInit >>> fold insertStep >>> snd >>> snd
def sortRatCode : Expression (.list NN) (.list NN) :=
  both listReverse (constant []) >>> fold insertRatCode
def medianCode : Expression (.list NN) NN :=
  both (both sortRatCode (listLength >>> both (constant 2) ident >>> natDiv)) (constant (0,1)) >>> getDCode

lemma run_insertStep {n : ℕ} (O : IndependenceOracle n) (q x : ℚ) (hq : 0≤q) (hx : 0≤x)
    (xs ys : List ℚ) :
    run O insertStep (rationalPair x,(rationalPair q,(xs.map rationalPair,ys.map rationalPair)))=
      some (rationalPair q,((x::xs).map rationalPair,
        (if x<q then x::ys else q::x::xs).map rationalPair)) := by
  simp only [insertStep,run_both,run_compose,run_fst,run_snd,Option.bind_some,Option.map_some,run_applyIf]
  rw [run_ratLess O x q hx hq]
  by_cases h : x<q <;> simp [h,run]
lemma run_insertRatCode {n : ℕ} (O : IndependenceOracle n) (q : ℚ) (hq : 0≤q)
    (xs : List ℚ) (hx : ∀ x∈xs,0≤x) :
    run O insertRatCode (rationalPair q,xs.map rationalPair)=
      some ((xs.orderedInsert (·≤·) q).map rationalPair) := by
  have hf : ∀ xs : List ℚ,(∀x∈xs,0≤x) →
      foldValue (run O insertStep) (xs.map rationalPair).reverse
        (rationalPair q,([], [rationalPair q]))=
      some (rationalPair q,(xs.map rationalPair,(xs.orderedInsert (·≤·) q).map rationalPair)) := by
    intro xs
    induction xs with
    | nil => intro hx; rfl
    | cons x xs ih =>
      intro hx
      simp only [List.map_cons,List.reverse_cons,foldValue_append]
      rw [ih (fun y hy => hx y (by simp [hy])),Option.bind_some,foldValue]
      rw [run_insertStep O q x hq (hx x (by simp)),Option.bind_some]
      simp only [foldValue,List.orderedInsert_cons]
      by_cases h : x<q
      · simp [h,not_le.mpr h]
      · simp [h,le_of_not_gt h]
  simp only [insertRatCode,insertInit,run_compose,run_both,run_fst,run_snd,run_constant,Option.bind_some,Option.map_some]
  rw [run_listReverse]
  change ((foldValue (run O insertStep) (xs.map rationalPair).reverse
    (rationalPair q,([],[rationalPair q]))).bind fun z => some z.2.2)=_
  rw [hf xs hx]
  rfl
lemma run_sortRatCode {n : ℕ} (O : IndependenceOracle n) (xs : List ℚ) (hx : ∀ x∈xs,0≤x) :
    run O sortRatCode (xs.map rationalPair)=some ((xs.mergeSort (·≤·)).map rationalPair) := by
  have hf : ∀ xs : List ℚ,(∀x∈xs,0≤x) →
      foldValue (run O insertRatCode) (xs.map rationalPair).reverse []=
      some ((xs.insertionSort (·≤·)).map rationalPair) := by
    intro xs
    induction xs with
    | nil => intro hx; rfl
    | cons x xs ih =>
      intro hx
      simp only [List.map_cons,List.reverse_cons,foldValue_append]
      rw [ih (fun y hy => hx y (by simp [hy])),Option.bind_some,foldValue]
      rw [run_insertRatCode O x (hx x (by simp)) _ (by
        intro y hy
        exact hx y (by simpa using Or.inr ((List.perm_insertionSort _ _).mem_iff.mp hy)))]
      rfl
  simp only [sortRatCode,run_compose,run_both,run_constant,run_listReverse,Option.bind_some,Option.map_some]
  change foldValue (run O insertRatCode) (xs.map rationalPair).reverse []=_
  rw [hf xs hx,List.mergeSort_eq_insertionSort]
lemma run_medianCode {n : ℕ} (O : IndependenceOracle n) (xs : List ℚ) (hx : ∀ x∈xs,0≤x) :
    run O medianCode (xs.map rationalPair)=some (rationalPair (rationalMedian xs)) := by
  simp only [medianCode,run_compose,run_both,run_ident,run_constant]
  rw [run_sortRatCode O xs hx]
  simp only [Option.bind_some,Option.map_some]
  rw [run_listLength]
  simp only [Option.bind_some,List.length_map]
  simp only [run_compose,run_both,run_constant,run_ident,Option.bind_some,Option.map_some]
  rw [run_natDiv]
  simp only [Option.bind_some,Option.map_some]
  rw [run_getDCode]
  unfold rationalMedian
  simp only [List.getD_eq_getElem?_getD,List.getElem?_map]
  cases (xs.mergeSort (·≤·))[xs.length/2]? <;> rfl
end Expression

lemma run_insertStep_raw {n : ℕ} (O : IndependenceOracle n) (x q : Value NN)
    (xs ys : List (Value NN)) : run O insertStep (x,(q,(xs,ys)))=
      some (q,(x::xs,if x.1*q.2<q.1*x.2 then x::ys else q::x::xs)) := by
  simp only [insertStep,run_both,run_compose,run_fst,run_snd,Option.bind_some,Option.map_some,
    run_applyIf,ratLess,ratCross]
  simp only [run,Option.bind_some,Option.map_some,decide_eq_true_eq]
  split <;> rfl
lemma insertFold_width {n : ℕ} (O : IndependenceOracle n) (xs : List (Value NN))
    (q : Value NN) (zs ys : List (Value NN)) (y : Value InsertState)
    (hy : foldValue (run O insertStep) xs (q,(zs,ys))=some y) :
    y.1=q ∧ width (a:=.list NN) y.2.1=width (a:=.list NN) zs+width (a:=.list NN) xs ∧
      width (a:=.list NN) y.2.2≤ max (width (a:=.list NN) ys)
        (2*width (a:=NN) q+2+width (a:=.list NN) zs)+width (a:=.list NN) xs := by
  induction xs generalizing zs ys with
  | nil => cases hy; exact ⟨rfl,by rw [width_nil,Nat.add_zero],by rw [width_nil,Nat.add_zero]; exact Nat.le_max_left _ _⟩
  | cons x xs ih =>
    rw [foldValue,run_insertStep_raw,Option.bind_some] at hy
    have hh := ih (x::zs) (if x.1*q.2<q.1*x.2 then x::ys else q::x::zs) hy
    refine ⟨hh.1,?_,?_⟩
    · simp only [width_cons (a:=NN)] at hh ⊢; omega
    · split at hh <;> simp only [width_cons (a:=NN)] at hh ⊢ <;> omega
lemma controlled_insertStep : Controlled insertStep := by unfold insertStep; cc
lemma controlled_insertFold : Controlled (.fold insertStep) := by
  apply controlled_fold _ controlled_insertStep (.add (.mul (.constant 5) .input) (.constant 5))
  intro n O xs z pre post he y hy
  obtain ⟨q,zs,ys⟩ := z
  have hh := insertFold_width O pre q zs ys y hy
  have hp : width (a:=.list NN) pre≤width (a:=.list NN) xs := by
    rw [he,width_list_append]; omega
  rw [width_pair (a:=NN) (b:=.prod (.list NN) (.list NN)),hh.1,
    width_pair (a:=.list NN) (b:=.list NN),hh.2.1]
  change 2*width (a:=NN) q+1+(2*(width (a:=.list NN) zs+width (a:=.list NN) pre)+1+width (a:=.list NN) y.2.2)≤5*width (a:=.prod (.list NN) InsertState) (xs,(q,(zs,ys)))+5
  rw [width_pair (a:=.list NN) (b:=InsertState),width_pair (a:=NN) (b:=.prod (.list NN) (.list NN)),
    width_pair (a:=.list NN) (b:=.list NN)]
  omega
lemma controlled_insertRat : Controlled insertRatCode := by
  have hi := controlled_insertFold
  unfold insertRatCode insertInit; cc
lemma insertRat_width {n : ℕ} (O : IndependenceOracle n) (q : Value NN) (xs ys : List (Value NN))
    (hy : run O insertRatCode (q,xs)=some ys) :
    width (a:=.list NN) ys≤width (a:=.list NN) xs+2*(2*width (a:=NN) q+2) := by
  simp only [insertRatCode,insertInit,run_compose,run_both,run_fst,run_snd,run_constant,
    Option.bind_some,Option.map_some,run_listReverse] at hy
  change ((foldValue (run O insertStep) xs.reverse (q,([],[q]))).bind fun z => some z.2.2)=some ys at hy
  cases he : foldValue (run O insertStep) xs.reverse (q,([],[q])) with
  | none => simp [he] at hy
  | some v =>
    simp only [he,Option.bind_some,Option.some.injEq] at hy
    subst ys
    have hh := (insertFold_width O xs.reverse q [] [q] v he).2.2
    simp only [width_nil (a:=NN),width_cons (a:=NN),width_list_reverse (a:=NN)] at hh
    omega
lemma sortFold_width {n : ℕ} (O : IndependenceOracle n) (xs zs ys : List (Value NN))
    (hy : foldValue (run O insertRatCode) xs zs=some ys) :
    width (a:=.list NN) ys≤width (a:=.list NN) zs+2*width (a:=.list NN) xs := by
  induction xs generalizing zs with
  | nil => cases hy; simp
  | cons x xs ih =>
    rw [foldValue] at hy
    cases he : run O insertRatCode (x,zs) with
    | none => simp [he] at hy
    | some v =>
      simp only [he,Option.bind_some] at hy
      have hv := insertRat_width O x zs v he
      have hh := ih v hy
      rw [width_cons]
      omega
lemma controlled_sortFold : Controlled (.fold insertRatCode) := by
  apply controlled_fold _ controlled_insertRat (.mul (.constant 3) .input)
  intro n O xs zs pre post he ys hy
  have hh := sortFold_width O pre zs ys hy
  have hp : width (a:=.list NN) pre≤width (a:=.list NN) xs := by
    rw [he,width_list_append]; omega
  change _≤3*width (a:=.prod (.list NN) (.list NN)) (xs,zs)
  rw [width_pair (a:=.list NN) (b:=.list NN)]
  omega
lemma controlled_sortRat : Controlled sortRatCode := by
  have hi := controlled_sortFold
  unfold sortRatCode; cc
lemma controlled_median : Controlled medianCode := by
  have hi := controlled_sortRat
  unfold medianCode; cc

namespace Expression

def optionalRatCode : Expression (Optional NN) NN := applyIf fst (constant (0,1)) snd
def singleCode : Expression (.prod AlgorithmParams BankData) NN :=
  Effect.algorithmCode >>> fst >>> applyIf fst (constant (0,1)) (snd >>> optionalRatCode)
def amplifiedCode : Expression (.prod AlgorithmParams (.list BankData)) NN :=
  swap >>> mapWith (swap >>> singleCode) >>> medianCode
lemma run_optionalRatCode {n : ℕ} (O : IndependenceOracle n) (x : Option ℚ) :
    run O optionalRatCode (optionEncode rationalPair x)=some (rationalPair (x.getD 0)) := by
  cases x <;> rfl
lemma run_singleCode {n : ℕ} (O : IndependenceOracle n) (x : Value AlgorithmParams)
    (t : DrawTree (Option ℚ))
    (ht : Effect.Realizes O Effect.algorithmCode (optionEncode rationalPair) x t)
    (bank : Bank) :
    run O singleCode (x,bank)=some (rationalPair ((bankEval t bank).1.join.getD 0)) := by
  rw [singleCode,run_compose,ht,Option.bind_some]
  cases h : (bankEval t bank).1 with
  | none => rfl
  | some v =>
    cases v <;> rfl
lemma run_amplifiedCode {n : ℕ} (O : IndependenceOracle n) (x : Value AlgorithmParams)
    (t : DrawTree (Option ℚ))
    (ht : Effect.Realizes O Effect.algorithmCode (optionEncode rationalPair) x t)
    (banks : List Bank) (hz : ∀ bank∈banks,0≤(bankEval t bank).1.join.getD 0) :
    run O amplifiedCode (x,banks)=
      some (rationalPair (rationalMedian (banks.map (fun bank => (bankEval t bank).1.join.getD 0)))) := by
  simp only [amplifiedCode,run_compose]
  change ((run O (mapWith (swap >>> singleCode)) (banks,x)).bind (run O medianCode))=_
  have hm := run_mapWith_source O (swap >>> singleCode) (fun bank : Bank => bank)
    (fun bank => rationalPair ((bankEval t bank).1.join.getD 0)) x
    (fun bank => by change run O singleCode (x,bank)=_; exact run_singleCode O x t ht bank) banks
  simp only [List.map_id_fun',id_eq] at hm
  rw [hm]
  simp only [Option.bind_some]
  rw [show banks.map (fun bank => rationalPair ((bankEval t bank).1.join.getD 0))=
    (banks.map (fun bank => (bankEval t bank).1.join.getD 0)).map rationalPair by simp only [List.map_map]; rfl]
  apply run_medianCode
  intro q hq
  obtain ⟨bank,hbank,rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hq
  exact hz bank hbank
end Expression

open Expression Effect
lemma safe_single : OracleSafe singleCode (bankScope algorithmScope) := by
  unfold singleCode
  exact oracleSafe_post _ _ _ safe_algorithm (by unfold optionalRatCode; cc)
def amplificationScope : OraclePredicate (.prod AlgorithmParams (.list BankData)) :=
  fun n O S z => algorithmScope n O S z.1 ∧ width (a:=.list BankData) z.2≤S
lemma amplificationScope_width : ∀ n O S z,amplificationScope n O S z →
    width z≤(.add (.mul (.constant 2) (sourceWidthPoly 100)) (.add .input (.constant 1)) : SizePolynomial).eval S := by
  intro n O S z hz
  have hp := algorithmScope_width n O S z.1 hz.1
  have hb := hz.2
  rw [width_pair (a:=AlgorithmParams) (b:=.list BankData)]
  change _≤2*(sourceWidthPoly 100).eval S+(S+1)
  omega
lemma safe_amplified : OracleSafe amplifiedCode amplificationScope := by
  let Q : OraclePredicate (.prod BankData AlgorithmParams) := fun n O S z => bankScope algorithmScope n O S (z.2,z.1)
  let W : SizePolynomial := .add (.mul (.constant 2) .input) (.add (.constant 1) (sourceWidthPoly 100))
  have hq : OracleSafe (Expression.swap >>> singleCode) Q := by
    refine oracleSafe_pull Expression.swap singleCode Q (bankScope algorithmScope) (by cc) W ?_ safe_single ?_
    · intro n O S z hz
      have hp := algorithmScope_width n O S z.2 hz.1
      have hb : width (a:=BankData) z.1≤S := hz.2
      rw [width_pair (a:=BankData) (b:=AlgorithmParams)]
      change 2*width (a:=BankData) z.1+1+width (a:=AlgorithmParams) z.2≤2*S+(1+(sourceWidthPoly 100).eval S)
      omega
    · intro n O S z hz y hy; cases hy; exact hz
  let T : OraclePredicate (.prod (.list BankData) AlgorithmParams) := fun n O S z => width z≤W.eval S ∧ ∀ bank∈z.1,Q n O S (bank,z.2)
  unfold amplifiedCode
  apply oracleSafe_pull Expression.swap _ amplificationScope T (by cc) _ amplificationScope_width
    (oracleSafe_post _ _ _ (oracleSafe_mapWith _ Q hq W) controlled_median)
  intro n O S z hz y hy
  cases hy
  refine ⟨?_,?_⟩
  · have hp := algorithmScope_width n O S z.1 hz.1
    have hb := hz.2
    rw [width_pair (a:=.list BankData) (b:=AlgorithmParams)]
    change _≤2*S+(1+(sourceWidthPoly 100).eval S)
    omega
  · intro bank hb
    exact ⟨hz.1,(width_list_member bank z.2 hb).trans hz.2⟩

def natPow : ℕ → Expression .nat .nat

  | k+1 => both ident (natPow k) >>> mul
lemma run_natPow {n : ℕ} (O : IndependenceOracle n) (k x : ℕ) :
    run O (natPow k) x=some (x^k) := by
  induction k with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ k ih => simp [natPow,run_compose,ih,run,pow_succ,Nat.mul_comm]
lemma controlled_natPow (k : ℕ) : Controlled (natPow k) := by
  induction k with
  | zero => unfold natPow; cc
  | succ k ih => unfold natPow; cc

def sumE {a} (p q : Expression a .nat) : Expression a .nat := both p q >>> add
def prodE {a} (p q : Expression a .nat) : Expression a .nat := both p q >>> mul
lemma run_sumE {n : ℕ} (O : IndependenceOracle n) {a} (p q : Expression a .nat)
    (x : Value a) (u v : ℕ) (hp : run O p x=some u) (hq : run O q x=some v) :
    run O (sumE p q) x=some (u+v) := by simp [sumE,run_compose,hp,hq,run]
lemma run_prodE {n : ℕ} (O : IndependenceOracle n) {a} (p q : Expression a .nat)
    (x : Value a) (u v : ℕ) (hp : run O p x=some u) (hq : run O q x=some v) :
    run O (prodE p q) x=some (u*v) := by simp [prodE,run_compose,hp,hq,run]
lemma controlled_sumE {a} (p q : Expression a .nat) (hp : Controlled p) (hq : Controlled q) :
    Controlled (sumE p q) := by unfold sumE; cc
lemma controlled_prodE {a} (p q : Expression a .nat) (hp : Controlled p) (hq : Controlled q) :
    Controlled (prodE p q) := by unfold prodE; cc

def ceilDivCode : Expression NN .nat :=

lemma run_ceilDivCode {n : ℕ} (O : IndependenceOracle n) (a b : ℕ) (ha : 0<a) :

def sampleCountCode : Expression (.prod .nat NN) .nat :=

    (sumE (snd >>> fst) (constant 1) >>> natPow 3)) (fst >>> natPow 14))

def chunkValues {α : Type*} (m h : ℕ) (xs : List α) : List (List α) :=
  (List.range m).map (fun i => (xs.drop (i*h)).take h)
def chunkStep {a : DataType} : Expression (.prod .nat (.prod (.list a) .nat)) (.list a) :=
  both (both (snd >>> fst) (prodE fst (snd >>> snd)) >>> dropCode) (snd >>> snd) >>> takeCode
def chunksCode {a : DataType} : Expression (.prod (.list a) NN) (.list (.list a)) :=
  both ((snd >>> fst) >>> rangeCode) (both fst (snd >>> snd)) >>> mapWith chunkStep
lemma run_chunkStep {n : ℕ} (O : IndependenceOracle n) {a : DataType}
    (i h : ℕ) (xs : List (Value a)) :
    run O chunkStep (i,(xs,h))=some ((xs.drop (i*h)).take h) := by
  simp only [chunkStep,prodE,run_compose,run_both,run_fst,run_snd,Option.bind_some,Option.map_some]
  simp only [run,Option.map_some,Option.bind_some]
  rw [run_dropCode,Option.bind_some,Option.bind_some,run_takeCode]
lemma run_chunksCode {n : ℕ} (O : IndependenceOracle n) {a : DataType}
    (xs : List (Value a)) (m h : ℕ) :
    run O chunksCode (xs,(m,h))=some (chunkValues m h xs) := by
  simp only [chunksCode,run_compose,run_both,run_fst,run_snd,Option.bind_some,Option.map_some]
  rw [run_rangeCode,Option.bind_some,Option.bind_some]
  exact run_mapWith O chunkStep (fun i ctx => (ctx.1.drop (i*ctx.2)).take ctx.2)
    (fun i ctx => run_chunkStep O i ctx.2 ctx.1) _ _
lemma chunkValues_zero {α : Type*} (h : ℕ) (xs : List α) : chunkValues 0 h xs=[] := rfl
lemma chunkValues_succ {α : Type*} (m h : ℕ) (xs : List α) :
    chunkValues (m+1) h xs=xs.take h::chunkValues m h (xs.drop h) := by
  simp only [chunkValues,List.range_succ_eq_map,List.map_cons,List.map_map,Nat.zero_mul,List.drop_zero]
  congr 1
  apply List.map_congr_left
  intro i hi
  simp only [Function.comp_apply,Nat.succ_eq_add_one,List.drop_drop,Nat.add_mul,Nat.one_mul,Nat.add_comm h]
lemma chunkValues_flatten {α : Type*} (h : ℕ) (xs : List (List α))
    (hx : ∀ x∈xs,x.length=h) : chunkValues xs.length h xs.flatten=xs := by
  induction xs with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons x xs ih =>
    have hh := hx x (by simp)
    have ht := ih (fun y hy => hx y (by simp [hy]))
    rw [List.length_cons,chunkValues_succ,List.flatten_cons,←hh,List.take_left,List.drop_left,hh,ht]
lemma chunkValues_ofFn {α : Type*} (m h : ℕ) (f : Fin m → Fin h → α) :
    chunkValues m h ((List.ofFn (fun i => List.ofFn (f i))).flatten)=
      List.ofFn (fun i => List.ofFn (f i)) := by
  convert chunkValues_flatten h (List.ofFn (fun i => List.ofFn (f i))) (by
    intro xs hx
    obtain ⟨i,rfl⟩ := List.mem_ofFn.mp hx
    exact List.length_ofFn) using 1 ; simp
end Expression
lemma controlled_chunkStep {a : DataType} : Controlled (chunkStep (a:=a)) := by
  unfold chunkStep prodE
  cc
lemma attr_chunksCode {a : DataType} : AttrSafe (chunksCode (a:=a)) (fun S x => x.2.1≤S) := by
  unfold chunksCode
  apply attrSafe_post
  · apply attrSafe_both
    · apply attrSafe_pull _ rangeCode _ _ (by cc) attr_rangeCode
        (fun S T h k hk => hk.trans h)
      intro n O S x hx y hy
      cases hy; exact hx
    · exact attrSafe_controlled _ (by cc) _
  · exact controlled_mapWith _ controlled_chunkStep

lemma ceil_nat_ratio (a b : ℕ) (ha : 0<a) : ⌈(b:ℚ)/a⌉₊=(b+a-1)/a := by
  apply le_antisymm
  · apply Nat.ceil_le.mpr
    apply (div_le_iff₀ (by exact_mod_cast ha)).mpr
    have h : b≤a*((b+a-1)/a) := (ceilDiv_le_iff_le_mul ha).mp (le_rfl : b⌈/⌉a≤b⌈/⌉a)
    exact_mod_cast (by simpa [Nat.mul_comm] using h)
  · change b⌈/⌉a≤⌈(b:ℚ)/a⌉₊
    apply (ceilDiv_le_iff_le_mul ha).mpr
    have h := Nat.le_ceil ((b:ℚ)/a)
    have h' := (div_le_iff₀ (by exact_mod_cast ha : (0:ℚ)<a)).mp h
    have h'' : (b:ℚ)≤(a:ℚ)*(⌈(b:ℚ)/a⌉₊:ℚ) := by simpa [mul_comm] using h'
    exact_mod_cast h''
lemma inverse_ceiling_input (ε : ℚ) (hε : 0<ε) :
    ⌈ε⁻¹⌉₊=(ε.den+ε.num.natAbs-1)/ε.num.natAbs := by
  have hp : 0<ε.num.natAbs := Int.natAbs_pos.mpr (ne_of_gt (Rat.num_pos.mpr hε))
  have hn : ((ε.num.natAbs:ℕ):ℚ)=ε.num := by
    rw [←Int.cast_natCast,Int.natCast_natAbs,abs_of_pos (Rat.num_pos.mpr hε)]
  rw [←ceil_nat_ratio _ _ hp]
  congr 1
  rw [hn]
  conv_lhs => rw [←Rat.num_div_den ε,inv_div]

def rowsCode : Expression (.prod (.list .bool) NN) RandomRows :=
  chunksCode >>> mapEach fromList
def bankCode : Expression (.prod (.list .bool) Shape3) BankData :=
  both (both fst (both (snd >>> fst) (prodE (snd >>> snd >>> fst) (snd >>> snd >>> snd))) >>> chunksCode)
    (snd >>> snd) >>> mapWith rowsCode
def banksCode : Expression (.prod (.list .bool) Shape4) (.list BankData) :=
  both (both fst (both (snd >>> fst) (prodE (snd >>> snd >>> fst)
      (prodE (snd >>> snd >>> snd >>> fst) (snd >>> snd >>> snd >>> snd)))) >>> chunksCode)
    (snd >>> snd) >>> mapWith bankCode

  both fst (both (snd >>> fst) (both (sumE (snd >>> fst) (constant 6)) (snd >>> snd)))

lemma run_rowsCode {n : ℕ} (O : IndependenceOracle n) (xs : List Bool) (D H : ℕ) :
    run O rowsCode (xs,(D,H))=some (chunkValues D H xs) := by

lemma run_bankCode {n : ℕ} (O : IndependenceOracle n) (xs : List Bool) (M D H : ℕ) :
    run O bankCode (xs,(M,(D,H)))=
      some ((chunkValues M (D*H) xs).map (chunkValues D H)) := by
  simp only [bankCode,prodE,run_compose,run_both,run_fst,run_snd,Option.bind_some,Option.map_some]
  simp only [run,Option.map_some,Option.bind_some,Option.bind_assoc]
  change ((run O chunksCode (xs,(M,D*H))).bind fun ys => run O (mapWith rowsCode) (ys,(D,H)))=_
  rw [run_chunksCode,Option.bind_some]
  exact run_mapWith O rowsCode (fun ys ctx => chunkValues ctx.1 ctx.2 ys)
    (fun ys ctx => run_rowsCode O ys ctx.1 ctx.2) _ _

    run O banksCode (xs,(R,(M,(D,H))))=

        (chunkValues M (D*H) ys).map (chunkValues D H))) := by
  simp only [banksCode,prodE,run_compose,run_both,run_fst,run_snd,Option.bind_some,Option.map_some]
  simp only [run,Option.map_some,Option.bind_some,Option.bind_assoc]
  change ((run O chunksCode (xs,(R,M*(D*H)))).bind fun ys => run O (mapWith bankCode) (ys,(M,(D,H))))=_
  rw [run_chunksCode,Option.bind_some]
  exact run_mapWith O bankCode (fun ys ctx =>
    (chunkValues ctx.1 (ctx.2.1*ctx.2.2) ys).map (chunkValues ctx.2.1 ctx.2.2))

lemma attr_rowsCode : AttrSafe rowsCode (fun S z => z.2.1≤S) := by
  unfold rowsCode

lemma attr_bankCode : AttrSafe bankCode (fun S z => z.2.1≤S ∧ z.2.2.1≤S) := by
  let A : Attribute (.prod (.list (.list .bool)) NN) := fun S z => z.2.1≤S
  have hm : A.Mono := by intro S T h z hz; exact hz.trans h
  unfold bankCode
  refine attrSafe_compose _ _ _ A ?_ ?_ hm ?_
  · apply attrSafe_both
    · apply attrSafe_pull _ chunksCode _ _ (by unfold prodE; cc) attr_chunksCode
        (fun S T h z hz => hz.trans h)
      intro n O S z hz y hy
      cases hy; exact hz.1
    · exact attrSafe_controlled _ (by cc) _
  · apply attrSafe_mono _ (attrSafe_mapWith rowsCode (fun S z => z.2.1≤S)
      (fun S T h z hz => hz.trans h) attr_rowsCode)
    intro S z hz xs hxs; exact hz
  · intro n O S z hz y hy
    have he := (run_both_parts O _ _ z y hy).2
    have he' : z.2.2=y.2 := Option.some.inj he
    dsimp only [A]
    rw [←he']
    exact hz.2
lemma attr_banksCode : AttrSafe banksCode (fun S z => z.2.1≤S ∧ z.2.2.1≤S ∧ z.2.2.2.1≤S) := by
  let A : Attribute (.prod (.list (.list .bool)) Shape3) := fun S z => z.2.1≤S ∧ z.2.2.1≤S
  have hm : A.Mono := by intro S T h z hz; exact ⟨hz.1.trans h,hz.2.trans h⟩
  unfold banksCode
  refine attrSafe_compose _ _ _ A ?_ ?_ hm ?_
  · apply attrSafe_both
    · apply attrSafe_pull _ chunksCode _ _ (by unfold prodE; cc) attr_chunksCode
        (fun S T h z hz => hz.trans h)
      intro n O S z hz y hy
      cases hy; exact hz.1
    · exact attrSafe_controlled _ (by cc) _
  · apply attrSafe_mono _ (attrSafe_mapWith bankCode (fun S z => z.2.1≤S ∧ z.2.2.1≤S)
      (fun S T h z hz => ⟨hz.1.trans h,hz.2.trans h⟩) attr_bankCode)
    intro S z hz xs hxs; exact hz
  · intro n O S z hz y hy
    have he := (run_both_parts O _ _ z y hy).2

    rw [←he']

lemma attr_reshapeCode : AttrSafe reshapeCode (fun S z => z.2.1≤S ∧ z.2.2.1+6≤S) := by
  unfold reshapeCode
  apply attrSafe_pull _ banksCode _ _ (by have h := controlled_shape4Code; cc) attr_banksCode
    (fun S T h z hz => ⟨hz.1.trans h,hz.2.1.trans h,hz.2.2.trans h⟩)

def preambleCode : Expression FrozenData (.prod .word PreparedData) :=

abbrev RawData := DataType.prod .word PreparedData
abbrev AmplifyInput := DataType.prod AlgorithmParams (.list BankData)
def reshapePrepared : Expression RawData AmplifyInput :=
  both (snd >>> fst) (both fst (snd >>> snd) >>> reshapeCode)

  applyIf (fst >>> fst >>> fst >>> natEqZero) amplifiedCode (constant (1,1))

lemma safe_preamble : OracleSafe preambleCode (fun _ O S x =>
    width x≤S ∧ ∀ k,run O frozenBitCount x=some k → k≤S) := by
  unfold preambleCode
  apply oracleSafe_both
  · apply oracleSafe_compose _ unary _ (fun _ _ S k => k≤S)
      (oracleSafe_controlled _ controlled_frozenBitCount _ .input (by intro n O S x hx; exact hx.1))
      (oracleSafe_lift _ _ polySafe_unary)
    intro n O S x hx k hk; exact hx.2 k hk
  · exact oracleSafe_controlled _ controlled_frozenPrepared _ .input (by intro n O S x hx; exact hx.1)
def rawScope : OraclePredicate RawData := fun n O S z =>
  width z≤S ∧ z.2.2.1≤S ∧ z.2.2.2.1+6≤S ∧
    z.2.1.1.1=n ∧ (0<n → algorithmScope n O S z.2.1)
lemma algorithmScope_mono {n : ℕ} {O : IndependenceOracle n} {S T : ℕ} {z : Value AlgorithmParams}
    (h : algorithmScope n O S z) (hst : S≤T) : algorithmScope n O T z := by
  obtain ⟨m,hm,he⟩ := h
  exact ⟨m,hm.mono hst,he⟩
lemma safe_reshapePrepared : OracleSafe reshapePrepared rawScope := by
  unfold reshapePrepared
  apply oracleSafe_both
  · exact oracleSafe_controlled _ (by cc) _ .input (by intro n O S x hx; exact hx.1)
  · apply oracleSafe_attr _ (fun S (z : Value RawData) => z.2.2.1≤S ∧ z.2.2.2.1+6≤S)
      (fun S T h z hz => ⟨hz.1.trans h,hz.2.trans h⟩) ?_ rawScope .input
      (by intro n O S z hz; exact hz.1) (by intro n O S z hz; exact ⟨hz.2.1,hz.2.2.1⟩)
    apply attrSafe_pull _ reshapeCode _ _ (by cc) attr_reshapeCode
      (fun S T h z hz => ⟨hz.1.trans h,hz.2.trans h⟩)
    intro n O S z hz y hy; cases hy; exact hz
def finishScope : OraclePredicate AmplifyInput := fun n O S z =>
  width z≤S ∧ z.1.1.1=n ∧ (0<n → algorithmScope n O S z.1)
lemma safe_finish : OracleSafe finishCode finishScope := by
  unfold finishCode
  apply oracleSafe_applyIf _ _ _ finishScope
  · exact oracleSafe_controlled _ (by cc) _ .input (by intro n O S z hz; exact hz.1)
  · apply oracleSafe_mono _ safe_amplified
    intro n O S z hz
    have hn : 0<n := by
      have he : decide (z.1.1.1<1)=false := Option.some.inj hz.2
      rw [hz.1.2.1] at he
      have hh : ¬ n<1 := of_decide_eq_false he
      omega
    exact ⟨hz.1.2.2 hn,(width_snd (a:=AlgorithmParams) (b:=.list BankData) z).trans hz.1.1⟩
  · exact oracleSafe_controlled _ (by cc) _ .input (by intro n O S z hz; exact hz.1.1)
lemma safe_postamble : OracleSafe postambleCode rawScope := by
  obtain ⟨f,hf⟩ := safe_reshapePrepared
  let g : SizePolynomial := .add f .input
  unfold postambleCode
  apply oracleSafe_compose _ _ rawScope (fun n O S z => finishScope n O (g.eval S) z)
    ⟨f,hf⟩ (oracleSafe_reparam _ _ safe_finish g)
  intro n O S z hz y hy
  have he : z.2.1=y.1 := Option.some.inj (run_both_parts O _ _ z y hy).1
  refine ⟨(safe_output (hf O S z hz) hy).trans (Nat.le_add_right _ _),?_,?_⟩
  · rw [←he]; exact hz.2.2.2.1
  · intro hn
    rw [←he]
    exact algorithmScope_mono (hz.2.2.2.2 hn) (Nat.le_add_left _ _)

def coinPush {k : ℕ} (a : Fin (k+8)) : Block k := fork .coin (push a false) (push a true)
lemma runs_coinPush {k n : ℕ} (O : IndependenceOracle n) (bits : ℕ → Bool)
    (R : Registers k) (a : Fin (k+8)) :
    Runs (coinPush a) O bits R (Function.update R a (bits 0::R a)) 2 0 2 := by
  cases h : bits 0
  · exact fork_run_no .coin _ _ O bits (by simp [Test.result,h])
      (runs_push O (fun i => bits (1+i)) R a false)
  · exact fork_run_yes .coin _ _ O bits (by simp [Test.result,h])
      (runs_push O (fun i => bits (1+i)) R a true)

def sampledWord : ℕ → (ℕ → Bool) → Word
  | 0,_ => []
  | m+1,bits => sampledWord m (fun i => bits (3+i)) ++ [bits 1]
lemma sampledWord_length (m : ℕ) (bits : ℕ → Bool) : (sampledWord m bits).length=m := by
  induction m generalizing bits with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ m ih => simp [sampledWord,ih]
lemma sampledWord_get (m : ℕ) (bits : ℕ → Bool) (i : ℕ) (hi : i < m) :
    (sampledWord m bits)[i]'(by rw [sampledWord_length]; exact hi)=
      bits (3*(m-1-i)+1) := by
  induction m generalizing bits i with
  | zero => omega
  | succ m ih =>
    by_cases him : i < m
    · simp only [sampledWord]
      rw [List.getElem_append_left (by rw [sampledWord_length]; exact him),ih _ _ him]
      congr 1
      omega
    · have he : i=m := by omega
      subst i
      simp [sampledWord,List.getElem_append_right,sampledWord_length]
lemma sampledWord_ofFn (m : ℕ) (bits : ℕ → Bool) :
    sampledWord m bits=List.ofFn (fun i : Fin m => bits (3*(m-1-i.val)+1)) := by
  apply List.ext_getElem
  · simp [sampledWord_length]
  · intro i hi hj
    simp only [List.getElem_ofFn]
    exact sampledWord_get m bits i (by simpa [sampledWord_length] using hi)
lemma runs_coinLoop {k n : ℕ} (O : IndependenceOracle n) (bits : ℕ → Bool)
    (R : Registers k) (a b : Fin (k+8)) (hab : a≠b) (xs : Word) :
    Runs (repeatBlock (coinPush b) a) O bits (Function.update R a xs)
      (Function.update (Function.update R b (sampledWord xs.length bits ++ R b)) a [])
      (3*xs.length+1) 0 (3*xs.length+1) := by
  induction xs generalizing R bits with
  | nil =>
    intro q w
    have h := repeatProgram_empty (coinPush b).code a O R q w bits
    convert h using 1 <;> simp [repeatBlock,sampledWord,state,loopConfig] ; rfl
  | cons x xs ih =>
    have hp := runs_coinPush O (fun i => bits (1+i)) (Function.update R a xs) b
    have hi := ih (fun i => bits (3+i)) (Function.update R b (bits 1::R b))
    have hc : Function.update (Function.update R a xs) b (bits 1::(Function.update R a xs) b)=
        Function.update (Function.update R b (bits 1::R b)) a xs := by
      rw [Function.update_of_ne hab.symm]
      exact Function.update_comm hab ..
    rw [hc] at hp
    have h := runs_repeat_cons (b:=x) hp hi
    convert h using 1 <;> simp only [sampledWord,List.length_cons]
    · simp only [Function.update_self,List.append_assoc,List.singleton_append]
      rw [Function.update_idem]
    · omega
    · omega

lemma runs_pack_any {k n : ℕ} (a d : Fin (k+8)) (had : a≠d)
    (O : IndependenceOracle n) (R : Registers k) (bits : ℕ → Bool) :
    Runs (pack a d) O bits R
      (Function.update (Function.update R a []) d (pair (R a) (R d)))
      (3*(R a).length+2) 0 (3*(R a).length+2) := by
  have h := runs_pack a d had O R (R a) (R d) bits
  have he : pairRegisters R a d (R a) (R d)=R := by
    simp [pairRegisters]
  rw [he] at h
  exact h
lemma runs_move_any {k n : ℕ} (a b d : Fin (k+8)) (hab : a≠b) (had : a≠d) (hbd : b≠d)
    (O : IndependenceOracle n) (R : Registers k) (hb : R b=[]) (hd : R d=[])
    (bits : ℕ → Bool) :
    Runs (move a b d) O bits R (Function.update (Function.update R a []) d (R a))
      (4*(R a).length+2) 0 (4*(R a).length+2) := by
  have h := runs_move a b d hab had hbd O R (R a) [] bits
  have he : tripleRegisters R a b d (R a) [] []=R := by
    unfold tripleRegisters pairRegisters
    rw [Function.update_eq_self]
    have h1 : Function.update R b []=R := by rw [←hb, Function.update_eq_self]
    rw [h1]
    rw [←hd,Function.update_eq_self]
  rw [he] at h
  simp only [List.append_nil] at h
  convert h using 1
  simp only [tripleRegisters, pairRegisters]
  rw [Function.update_comm hab,show Function.update R b []=R by rw [←hb,Function.update_eq_self]]
def sixRegs (a b c d e f : Word) : Registers 1 := fun i =>
  match i.val with
  | 0 => a | 1 => b | 2 => c | 3 => d | 4 => e | 5 => f | _ => []
def inputPack : Block 1 :=
  seq (pack 4 5) (seq (pack 2 3) (seq (pack 3 5) (seq (pack 0 1)
    (seq (pack 1 5) (move 5 2 0)))))
def inputTime (a b c d e f : Word) : ℕ :=
  (3*e.length+2)+((3*c.length+2)+((3*(pair c d).length+2)+((3*a.length+2)+
    ((3*(pair a b).length+2)+(4*(pair (pair a b) (pair (pair c d) (pair e f))).length+2)))))
lemma runs_inputPack {n : ℕ} (O : IndependenceOracle n) (bits : ℕ → Bool)
    (a b c d e f : Word) :
    Runs inputPack O bits (sixRegs a b c d e f)
      (regs (pair (pair a b) (pair (pair c d) (pair e f))) [] [] [])
      (inputTime a b c d e f) 0 (inputTime a b c d e f) := by
  have h1 (bits) : Runs (pack 4 5) O bits (sixRegs a b c d e f)
      (sixRegs a b c d [] (pair e f)) (3*e.length+2) 0 (3*e.length+2) := by
    convert runs_pack_any (k:=1) 4 5 (by decide) O (sixRegs a b c d e f) bits using 1
    all_goals first | rfl | (funext i; fin_cases i <;> simp [sixRegs])
  have h2 (bits) : Runs (pack 2 3) O bits (sixRegs a b c d [] (pair e f))
      (sixRegs a b [] (pair c d) [] (pair e f)) (3*c.length+2) 0 (3*c.length+2) := by
    convert runs_pack_any (k:=1) 2 3 (by decide) O (sixRegs a b c d [] (pair e f)) bits using 1
    all_goals first | rfl | (funext i; fin_cases i <;> simp [sixRegs])
  have h3 (bits) : Runs (pack 3 5) O bits (sixRegs a b [] (pair c d) [] (pair e f))
      (sixRegs a b [] [] [] (pair (pair c d) (pair e f)))
      (3*(pair c d).length+2) 0 (3*(pair c d).length+2) := by
    convert runs_pack_any (k:=1) 3 5 (by decide) O (sixRegs a b [] (pair c d) [] (pair e f)) bits using 1
    all_goals first | rfl | (funext i; fin_cases i <;> simp [sixRegs])
  have h4 (bits) : Runs (pack 0 1) O bits (sixRegs a b [] [] [] (pair (pair c d) (pair e f)))
      (sixRegs [] (pair a b) [] [] [] (pair (pair c d) (pair e f)))
      (3*a.length+2) 0 (3*a.length+2) := by
    convert runs_pack_any (k:=1) 0 1 (by decide) O (sixRegs a b [] [] [] (pair (pair c d) (pair e f))) bits using 1
    all_goals first | rfl | (funext i; fin_cases i <;> simp [sixRegs])
  have h5 (bits) : Runs (pack 1 5) O bits (sixRegs [] (pair a b) [] [] [] (pair (pair c d) (pair e f)))
      (sixRegs [] [] [] [] [] (pair (pair a b) (pair (pair c d) (pair e f))))
      (3*(pair a b).length+2) 0 (3*(pair a b).length+2) := by
    convert runs_pack_any (k:=1) 1 5 (by decide) O (sixRegs [] (pair a b) [] [] [] (pair (pair c d) (pair e f))) bits using 1
    all_goals first | rfl | (funext i; fin_cases i <;> simp [sixRegs])
  have h6 (bits) : Runs (move 5 2 0) O bits
      (sixRegs [] [] [] [] [] (pair (pair a b) (pair (pair c d) (pair e f))))
      (regs (pair (pair a b) (pair (pair c d) (pair e f))) [] [] [])
      (4*(pair (pair a b) (pair (pair c d) (pair e f))).length+2) 0
      (4*(pair (pair a b) (pair (pair c d) (pair e f))).length+2) := by
    convert runs_move_any (k:=1) 5 2 0 (by decide) (by decide) (by decide) O
      (sixRegs [] [] [] [] [] (pair (pair a b) (pair (pair c d) (pair e f)))) rfl rfl bits using 1
    all_goals first | rfl | (funext i; fin_cases i <;> simp [sixRegs,regs])
  exact runs_seq O bits (h1 _) (runs_seq O _ (h2 _) (runs_seq O _ (h3 _)
    (runs_seq O _ (h4 _) (runs_seq O _ (h5 _) (h6 _)))))
lemma inputTime_bound (a b c d e f : Word) :

open Expression
def preparedValue (n r : ℕ) (ε δ : ℚ) : Value PreparedData :=
  let L := annealLength n (accuracyExponent ε)
  let N := sampleCount n L ε
  (params n r N L,(repetitionCount δ,(algorithmDrawBound n N L,drawWordBound n N L)))
def rawValue (n r : ℕ) (ε δ : ℚ) (w : BitWord (fairBitCount n ε δ)) : Value RawData :=
