open Expression
namespace SizePolynomial
def pow (p : SizePolynomial) : ℕ → SizePolynomial
  | 0 => .constant 1
  | k+1 => .mul (pow p k) p
lemma eval_pow (p : SizePolynomial) (k x : ℕ) : (p.pow k).eval x=(p.eval x)^k := by
  induction k with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ k ih => simp only [pow,eval,ih,pow_succ]
end SizePolynomial

def masterParameter (n r : ℕ) (ε δ : ℚ) : ℕ :=
  1+n+inputLength n r ε δ+⌈ε⁻¹⌉₊+Nat.clog 2 ⌈δ⁻¹⌉₊
def atomPoly : SizePolynomial := .mul (.constant (10^22)) (.pow (.add .input (.constant 1)) 24)
def tauPoly : SizePolynomial :=
  .mul (.mul (.constant 20) (atomPoly.pow 4))
    (.add (.mul atomPoly (.add atomPoly (.constant 1))) (.constant 2))
def capPoly : SizePolynomial :=
  .mul (.mul (.mul (.constant 2000) ((SizePolynomial.add atomPoly (.constant 1)).pow 2)) (atomPoly.pow 2)) tauPoly
def fairPoly : SizePolynomial := .mul (.constant (10^66)) ((SizePolynomial.add .input (.constant 1)).pow 73)
def sourceEnvelope : SizePolynomial :=
  .add (.add (.add (.add atomPoly tauPoly) capPoly) fairPoly) (.constant 6)
def scopeEnvelope : SizePolynomial := .mul (.constant 100) (.add sourceEnvelope (.constant 1))
lemma master_pos (n r : ℕ) (ε δ : ℚ) : 0 < masterParameter n r ε δ := by
  unfold masterParameter; omega
lemma rank_le_ground {n r : ℕ} (M : Matroid (Fin n)) (hr : M.eRank=(r:ℕ∞)) : r ≤ n := by
  have h := M.eRank_le_encard_ground
  rw [hr] at h
  have hg : M.E.encard ≤ n := (Set.encard_mono (Set.subset_univ _)).trans_eq (by simp)
  exact_mod_cast h.trans hg
lemma master_fields (n r : ℕ) (ε δ : ℚ) :
    n ≤ masterParameter n r ε δ ∧ inputLength n r ε δ ≤ masterParameter n r ε δ ∧
    ε.den.bits.length ≤ masterParameter n r ε δ ∧ δ.den.bits.length ≤ masterParameter n r ε δ ∧
    ⌈ε⁻¹⌉₊ ≤ masterParameter n r ε δ ∧ bitResourceParameter n ε δ ≤ masterParameter n r ε δ := by
  unfold masterParameter bitResourceParameter inputLength
  omega
lemma atom_ge (T : ℕ) : T ≤ atomPoly.eval T ∧ 1 ≤ atomPoly.eval T := by
  simp only [atomPoly,SizePolynomial.eval,SizePolynomial.eval_pow]
  have h : T+1 ≤ (T+1)^24 := Nat.le_self_pow (by decide) _
  constructor <;> omega
lemma recipe_atom_bounds (n r : ℕ) (ε δ : ℚ) :
    let T := masterParameter n r ε δ
    let L := annealLength n (accuracyExponent ε)
    let N := sampleCount n L ε
    n ≤ atomPoly.eval T ∧ L ≤ atomPoly.eval T ∧ N ≤ atomPoly.eval T ∧
      drawWordBound n N L ≤ atomPoly.eval T ∧ algorithmDrawBound n N L ≤ atomPoly.eval T ∧
      repetitionCount δ ≤ atomPoly.eval T := by
  let T := masterParameter n r ε δ
  have hf := master_fields n r ε δ
  have hh := polynomial_recipe_bounds n ε.den.bits.length δ.den.bits.length ⌈ε⁻¹⌉₊ T
    (master_pos n r ε δ) hf.1 hf.2.2.1 hf.2.2.2.1 hf.2.2.2.2.1
  have hp (k : ℕ) (hk : k ≤ 24) : T^k ≤ (T+1)^24 :=
    (Nat.pow_le_pow_left (by omega : T ≤ T+1) k).trans
      (Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by omega : 1 ≤ T+1) hk)
  have h1 := hp 1 (by omega)
  simp only [pow_one] at h1
  refine ⟨hf.1.trans (atom_ge T).1,?_,?_,?_,?_,?_⟩
  all_goals simp only [atomPoly,SizePolynomial.eval_pow,SizePolynomial.eval]
  all_goals dsimp only [T] at h1 hp hh
  · exact hh.1.trans (by have h := hp 2 (by omega); omega)
  · exact hh.2.1.trans (by have h := hp 22 (by omega); omega)
  · exact hh.2.2.1.trans (by have h := hp 24 (by omega); omega)
  · exact hh.2.2.2.1.trans (by have h := hp 24 (by omega); omega)
  · exact hh.2.2.2.2.trans (by omega)
lemma envelope_parameters (n r : ℕ) (ε δ : ℚ) (hr : r ≤ n) :
    let T := masterParameter n r ε δ
    let S := sourceEnvelope.eval T
    let L := annealLength n (accuracyExponent ε)
    let N := sampleCount n L ε
    n ≤ S ∧ r ≤ S ∧ N ≤ S ∧ L ≤ S ∧ restartCap n L ≤ S ∧ 20*n^4*(n*(L+1)+2) ≤ S ∧
      repetitionCount δ ≤ S ∧ algorithmDrawBound n N L+6 ≤ S ∧ drawWordBound n N L ≤ S ∧
      fairBitCount n ε δ ≤ S ∧ inputLength n r ε δ ≤ S := by
  let T := masterParameter n r ε δ
  let A := atomPoly.eval T
  let L := annealLength n (accuracyExponent ε)
  have hh := recipe_atom_bounds n r ε δ
  have ht : 20*n^4*(n*(L+1)+2) ≤ tauPoly.eval T := by
    simp only [tauPoly,SizePolynomial.eval,SizePolynomial.eval_pow]
    gcongr
    · exact hh.1
    · exact hh.1
    · exact hh.2.1
  have hc : restartCap n L ≤ capPoly.eval T := by
    unfold restartCap
    simp only [capPoly,SizePolynomial.eval,SizePolynomial.eval_pow]
    gcongr <;> first | exact hh.2.1 | exact hh.1
  have hb : fairBitCount n ε δ ≤ fairPoly.eval T := by
    apply (fairBitCount_polynomial n ε δ).trans
    simp only [fairPoly,SizePolynomial.eval,SizePolynomial.eval_pow]
    gcongr
    have hf := (master_fields n r ε δ).2.2.2.2.2
    omega
  have hi : inputLength n r ε δ ≤ atomPoly.eval T :=
    (master_fields n r ε δ).2.1.trans (atom_ge T).1
  dsimp only [sourceEnvelope,SizePolynomial.eval]
  dsimp only at hh
  dsimp only [T,L] at ht hc hb hi
  exact ⟨by omega,by omega,by omega,by omega,by omega,by omega,
    by omega,by omega,by omega,by omega,by omega⟩

open Expression Effect
lemma width_six (a b c d e f : ℕ) :
    width (a:=FrozenData) ((a,b),((c,d),(e,f)))=
      4*a.bits.length+2*b.bits.length+4*c.bits.length+2*d.bits.length+
        2*e.bits.length+f.bits.length+7 := by
  rw [width_pair (a:=NN) (b:=.prod NN NN),width_pair (a:=NN) (b:=NN)]
  simp only [width_pair (a:=.nat) (b:=.nat),width_nat]
  omega
lemma width_frozen (n r : ℕ) (ε δ : ℚ) :
    width (frozenValue n r ε δ)≤4*inputLength n r ε δ := by
  rw [frozenValue,width_six]
  unfold inputLength
  omega
lemma width_prepared_bound (n r : ℕ) (ε δ : ℚ) (hr : r≤n) :
    width (preparedValue n r ε δ)≤35*sourceEnvelope.eval (masterParameter n r ε δ)+17 := by
  have hh := envelope_parameters n r ε δ hr
  dsimp only at hh
  have hn := (bits_length_le_value n).trans hh.1
  have hr := (bits_length_le_value r).trans hh.2.1
  have hN := (bits_length_le_value _).trans hh.2.2.1
  have hL := (bits_length_le_value _).trans hh.2.2.2.1
  have hc := (bits_length_le_value _).trans hh.2.2.2.2.1
  have ht := (bits_length_le_value _).trans hh.2.2.2.2.2.1
  have hR := (bits_length_le_value _).trans hh.2.2.2.2.2.2.1
  have hM := (bits_length_le_value _).trans (show algorithmDrawBound n
    (sampleCount n (annealLength n (accuracyExponent ε)) ε) (annealLength n (accuracyExponent ε))≤
    sourceEnvelope.eval (masterParameter n r ε δ) from by omega)
  have hH := (bits_length_le_value _).trans hh.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.1
  rw [preparedValue,width_pair (a:=AlgorithmParams) (b:=BankShape),params,width_six,
    width_pair (a:=.nat) (b:=NN),width_pair (a:=.nat) (b:=.nat)]
  simp only [width_nat]
  omega
lemma scopeEnvelope_ge (T : ℕ) : sourceEnvelope.eval T≤ scopeEnvelope.eval T := by
  simp only [scopeEnvelope,SizePolynomial.eval]
  omega
lemma rawValue_scope {n : ℕ} (r : ℕ) (M₁ M₂ : Matroid (Fin n)) (O : IndependenceOracle n)
    (hO : ExactOracles M₁ M₂ O) (hE₁ : M₁.E=Set.univ) (hE₂ : M₂.E=Set.univ)
    (hr₁ : M₁.eRank=(r:ℕ∞)) (ε δ : ℚ) (w : BitWord (fairBitCount n ε δ)) :
    rawScope n O (scopeEnvelope.eval (masterParameter n r ε δ)) (rawValue n r ε δ w) := by
  have hr := rank_le_ground M₁ hr₁
  have hs := scopeEnvelope_ge (masterParameter n r ε δ)
  have hh := envelope_parameters n r ε δ hr
  dsimp only at hh
  have hw := width_prepared_bound n r ε δ hr
  refine ⟨?_,hh.2.2.2.2.2.2.1.trans hs,hh.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.1.trans hs,rfl,?_⟩
  · rw [rawValue,width_pair (a:=.word) (b:=PreparedData),width_word,List.length_ofFn]
    simp only [scopeEnvelope,SizePolynomial.eval]
    omega
  · intro hn
    let m : SamplerModel n O := ⟨M₁,M₂,hO,hE₁,hE₂,hn,r,
      sampleCount n (annealLength n (accuracyExponent ε)) ε,annealLength n (accuracyExponent ε)⟩
    refine ⟨m,?_,rfl⟩
    exact ⟨hh.1.trans hs,hh.2.1.trans hs,hh.2.2.1.trans hs,hh.2.2.2.1.trans hs,
      hh.2.2.2.2.1.trans hs,hh.2.2.2.2.2.1.trans hs⟩
lemma frozen_preamble_scope {n : ℕ} (O : IndependenceOracle n) (r : ℕ) (ε δ : ℚ)
    (hr : r≤n) (hε : 0<ε) :
    width (frozenValue n r ε δ)≤ scopeEnvelope.eval (masterParameter n r ε δ) ∧
      ∀ k,run O frozenBitCount (frozenValue n r ε δ)=some k →
        k≤ scopeEnvelope.eval (masterParameter n r ε δ) := by
  have hh := envelope_parameters n r ε δ hr
  dsimp only at hh
  constructor
  · have hw := width_frozen n r ε δ
    simp only [scopeEnvelope,SizePolynomial.eval]
    omega
  · intro k hk
    rw [run_frozenBitCount O r ε δ hε,Option.some.injEq] at hk
    rw [←hk]
    exact hh.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.1.trans (scopeEnvelope_ge _)

open Expression
lemma compile_safe_bound {n : ℕ} (O : IndependenceOracle n) {a b : DataType}
    (p : Expression a b) (S : ℕ) (x : Value a) (y : Value b)
    (hs : Safe O S p x) (hr : run O p x=some y) :
    Bounded (compile p) O (encode x) (encode y)
      (chargeCoefficient p*(S+n+1)^chargeDegree p) := by
  rw [←evaluate_forget] at hr
  cases he : evaluate O p x with
  | none => simp [he] at hr
  | some v =>
    rcases v with ⟨y',c⟩
    simp only [he,Option.map_some,Option.some.injEq] at hr
    subst y'
    exact bounded_mono (compile_correct O p x y c he) (evaluate_polynomial O p S x y c hs he)

def compiledMajorant {a b : DataType} (p : Expression a b) (f : SizePolynomial) : SizePolynomial :=
  .mul (.constant (chargeCoefficient p)) ((SizePolynomial.add
    (.add f .input) (.constant 1)).pow (chargeDegree p))
lemma compile_majorant {n : ℕ} (O : IndependenceOracle n) {a b : DataType}
    (p : Expression a b) (f : SizePolynomial) (T : ℕ) (hn : n≤T)
    (x : Value a) (y : Value b) (hs : Safe O (f.eval T) p x) (hr : run O p x=some y) :
    Bounded (compile p) O (encode x) (encode y) ((compiledMajorant p f).eval T) := by
  apply bounded_mono (compile_safe_bound O p (f.eval T) x y hs hr)
  simp only [compiledMajorant,SizePolynomial.eval,SizePolynomial.eval_pow]
  gcongr

lemma frozen_uniform_safe : ∃ fp fq : SizePolynomial,
    ∀ (n r : ℕ) (M₁ M₂ : Matroid (Fin n)) (O : IndependenceOracle n) (ε δ : ℚ),
      ExactOracles M₁ M₂ O → M₁.E=Set.univ → M₂.E=Set.univ → M₁.eRank=(r:ℕ∞) → 0<ε →
      Safe O (fp.eval (masterParameter n r ε δ)) preambleCode (frozenValue n r ε δ) ∧
      ∀ w : BitWord (fairBitCount n ε δ),
        Safe O (fq.eval (masterParameter n r ε δ)) postambleCode (rawValue n r ε δ w) := by
  obtain ⟨fp,hp⟩ := safe_preamble
  obtain ⟨fq,hq⟩ := safe_postamble
  refine ⟨fp.subst scopeEnvelope,fq.subst scopeEnvelope,?_⟩
  intro n r M₁ M₂ O ε δ hO hE₁ hE₂ hr hε
  simp only [SizePolynomial.eval_subst]
  refine ⟨hp O _ _ (frozen_preamble_scope O r ε δ (rank_le_ground M₁ hr) hε),?_⟩
  intro w
  exact hq O _ _ (rawValue_scope r M₁ M₂ O hO hE₁ hE₂ hr ε δ w)
lemma SizePolynomial.monomial_bound (p : SizePolynomial) (T : ℕ) (hT : 0<T) :
    p.eval T ≤ (p.coefficient*2^p.degree+1)*T^p.degree := by
  have h : T+1≤2*T := by omega
  calc
    p.eval T ≤ p.coefficient*(T+1)^p.degree := p.bound T
    _ ≤ p.coefficient*(2*T)^p.degree := by gcongr
    _ ≤ (p.coefficient*2^p.degree+1)*T^p.degree := by
      rw [mul_pow,←Nat.mul_assoc]
      exact Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ (Nat.le_add_right _ _)

def outRegs (a b : Word) : Registers 1 := fun i => if i=6 then a else if i=7 then b else []
def outputPack : Block 1 := seq (unpack 0 6) (move 0 1 7)
def outputTime (a b : Word) : ℕ := (3*a.length+1)+(4*b.length+2)
lemma runs_outputPack {n : ℕ} (O : IndependenceOracle n) (bits : ℕ → Bool) (a b : Word) :
    Runs outputPack O bits (regs (pair a b) [] [] []) (outRegs a b)
      (outputTime a b) 0 (outputTime a b) := by
  let mid : Registers 1 := fun i => if i=0 then b else if i=6 then a else []
  have h1 (bits) : Runs (unpack 0 6) O bits (regs (pair a b) [] [] []) mid
      (3*a.length+1) 0 (3*a.length+1) := by
    convert runs_unpack_packed (k:=1) 0 6 (by decide) O (fun _ => []) a b bits using 1 <;>
      funext i <;> fin_cases i <;> simp [pairRegisters,regs,mid,pair]
  have h2 (bits) : Runs (move 0 1 7) O bits mid (outRegs a b)
      (4*b.length+2) 0 (4*b.length+2) := by
    convert runs_move_any (k:=1) 0 1 7 (by decide) (by decide) (by decide) O mid
      (by simp [mid]) (by simp [mid]) bits using 1
    all_goals first | rfl | (funext i; fin_cases i <;> simp [mid,outRegs])
  exact runs_seq O bits (h1 _) (h2 _)
lemma outputTime_bound (a b : Word) : outputTime a b≤4*(a.length+b.length)+3 := by
  unfold outputTime
  omega
lemma runs_coinLoop_regs {n : ℕ} (O : IndependenceOracle n) (bits : ℕ → Bool)
    (x counter : Word) :
    Runs (repeatBlock (coinPush 2) 1) O bits (regs x counter [] [])
      (regs x [] (sampledWord counter.length bits) [])
      (3*counter.length+1) 0 (3*counter.length+1) := by
  have h := runs_coinLoop O bits (regs x [] [] []) 1 2 (by decide) counter
  simpa only [update_regs_one,update_regs_two,regs_two,List.append_nil] using h
lemma runs_randomPack {n : ℕ} (O : IndependenceOracle n) (bits : ℕ → Bool) (p w : Word) :
    Runs (pack 2 0) O bits (regs p [] w []) (regs (pair w p) [] [] [])
      (3*w.length+2) 0 (3*w.length+2) := by
  simpa only [update_regs_zero,update_regs_two,regs_two,regs_zero] using
    runs_pack_any (k:=1) 2 0 (by decide) O (regs p [] w []) bits

def pipeline (pre post : Block 1) : Block 1 :=
  seq inputPack (seq pre (seq (unpack 0 1) (seq (repeatBlock (coinPush 2) 1)
    (seq (pack 2 0) (seq post outputPack)))))
def pipelineTime (i pre f post a b : ℕ) : ℕ :=
  i+(pre+((3*f+1)+((3*f+1)+((3*f+2)+(post+((3*a+1)+(4*b+2)))))))
lemma runs_pipeline {n : ℕ} (O : IndependenceOracle n) (bits : ℕ → Bool)
    (a b c d e f : Word) (pre post : Block 1) (counter params x y : Word)
    (tp qp wp tq qq wq : ℕ)
    (hp : Computes pre O (pair (pair a b) (pair (pair c d) (pair e f)))
      (pair counter params) tp qp wp)
    (hq : Computes post O
      (pair (sampledWord counter.length (fun j => bits (inputTime a b c d e f+tp+(3*counter.length+1)+j))) params)
        (pair x y) tq qq wq) :
    Runs (pipeline pre post) O bits (sixRegs a b c d e f) (outRegs x y)
      (pipelineTime (inputTime a b c d e f) tp counter.length tq x.length y.length)
      (qp+qq)
      (pipelineTime (inputTime a b c d e f) wp counter.length wq x.length y.length) := by
  have h0 := runs_inputPack O bits a b c d e f
  have h1 := hp [] (fun j => bits (inputTime a b c d e f+j))
  have h2 := split_pair O counter params [] [] (fun j => bits (inputTime a b c d e f+(tp+j)))
  simp only [List.append_nil] at h2
  let bs := fun j => bits (inputTime a b c d e f+(tp+((3*counter.length+1)+j)))
  have h3 := runs_coinLoop_regs O bs params counter
  have h4 := runs_randomPack O (fun j => bs (3*counter.length+1+j)) params (sampledWord counter.length bs)
  have h5 := hq [] (fun j => bs (3*counter.length+1+(3*(sampledWord counter.length bs).length+2+j)))
  have he : (fun j => bits (inputTime a b c d e f+tp+(3*counter.length+1)+j))=bs := by
    funext j; dsimp [bs]; congr 1; omega
  rw [he] at h5
  have h6 := runs_outputPack O
    (fun j => bs (3*counter.length+1+(3*(sampledWord counter.length bs).length+2+(tq+j)))) x y
  have h := runs_seq O bits h0 (runs_seq O _ h1 (runs_seq O _ h2
    (runs_seq O _ h3 (runs_seq O _ h4 (runs_seq O _ h5 h6)))))
  simpa only [pipeline,pipelineTime,outputTime,sampledWord_length,Nat.zero_add,Nat.add_zero] using h

def physicalWord (start m : ℕ) (bits : ℕ → Bool) : BitWord m :=
  fun i => bits (start+3*(m-1-i.val)+1)
lemma sampledWord_physical (start m : ℕ) (bits : ℕ → Bool) :
    sampledWord m (fun j => bits (start+j))=List.ofFn (physicalWord start m bits) := by
  rw [sampledWord_ofFn]
  apply congrArg List.ofFn
  funext i
  unfold physicalWord
  congr 1
def physicalPosition (start m B : ℕ) (h : start+3*m+1≤B) (i : Fin m) : Fin B :=
  ⟨start+3*(m-1-i.val)+1,by have hi := i.isLt; omega⟩
lemma physicalPosition_injective (start m B : ℕ) (h : start+3*m+1≤B) :
    Function.Injective (physicalPosition start m B h) := by
  intro i j he
  have hh := congrArg Fin.val he
  dsimp only [physicalPosition] at hh
  apply Fin.ext
  have hi := i.isLt
  have hj := j.isLt
  omega
lemma physicalWord_finite (start m B : ℕ) (h : start+3*m+1≤B) (w : BitWord B) :
    physicalWord start m (finiteBits w)=fun i => w (physicalPosition start m B h i) := by
  funext i
  unfold physicalWord finiteBits physicalPosition
  simp only [dite_eq_left (show start+3*(m-1-i.val)+1<B by have hi := i.isLt; omega)]
lemma physicalWord_law (start m B : ℕ) (h : start+3*m+1≤B) (φ : BitWord m → ℝ) :
    uniformAverage (fun w : BitWord B => φ (physicalWord start m (finiteBits w)))=uniformAverage φ := by
  simp_rw [physicalWord_finite start m B h]
  exact uniformAverage_bitEmbedding m B _ (physicalPosition_injective start m B h) φ

def terminalState (p : Block 1) (x y : Word) (q w : ℕ) : MachineConfig 1 p.size :=
  ⟨outRegs x y,lastLabel p.size,some ((binaryValue x:ℚ)/(binaryValue y:ℚ)),q,w+x.length+y.length+1⟩
lemma runs_terminal {n : ℕ} (p : Block 1) (O : IndependenceOracle n) (bits : ℕ → Bool)
    (R : Registers 1) (x y : Word) (t q w : ℕ) (h : Runs p O bits R (outRegs x y) t q w) :
    execution p.code O (state R 0 0 0) bits (t+1)=terminalState p x y q w := by
  rw [execution,h 0 0]
  simp only [Nat.zero_add]
  unfold machineStep state
  simp only [Option.isSome_none,Bool.false_eq_true,ite_false,p.exit_halt]
  simp only [outRegs,]
  rfl
lemma input_state (s n r : ℕ) (ε δ : ℚ) :
    initialConfig 1 s n r ε δ=state
      (sixRegs n.bits r.bits ε.num.natAbs.bits ε.den.bits δ.num.natAbs.bits δ.den.bits) 0 0 0 := rfl
lemma terminal_rational (p : Block 1) (z : ℚ) (hz : 0≤z) (q w : ℕ) :
    (terminalState p (rationalPair z).1.bits (rationalPair z).2.bits q w).output=some z := by
  change some ((binaryValue (rationalPair z).1.bits:ℚ)/(binaryValue (rationalPair z).2.bits:ℚ))=some z
  rw [binaryValue_bits,binaryValue_bits,rationalPair_value hz]

def pipelineBudget (i F cp cq W : ℕ) : ℕ := i+cp+9*F+cq+5*W+10
lemma pipeline_budget (i F cp cq W tp qp wp tq qq wq a b : ℕ)
    (htp : tp≤cp) (hqp : qp≤cp) (hwp : wp≤cp)
    (htq : tq≤cq) (hqq : qq≤cq) (hwq : wq≤cq) (ho : 2*a+1+b≤W) :
    pipelineTime i tp F tq a b+1≤pipelineBudget i F cp cq W ∧
    qp+qq≤pipelineBudget i F cp cq W ∧
    pipelineTime i wp F wq a b+a+b+1≤pipelineBudget i F cp cq W ∧
    i+tp+(3*F+1)+3*F+1≤pipelineBudget i F cp cq W := by
  unfold pipelineTime pipelineBudget
  omega

lemma pipeline_budgeted {n : ℕ} (O : IndependenceOracle n)
    (a b c d e f : Word) (pre post : Block 1) (counter params : Word)
    (cp cq W B : ℕ)
    (hp : Bounded pre O (pair (pair a b) (pair (pair c d) (pair e f)))
      (pair counter params) cp)
    (v : BitWord counter.length → ℚ) (hv : ∀ w,0≤v w)
    (hq : ∀ w,Bounded post O (pair (List.ofFn w) params)
      (pair (rationalPair (v w)).1.bits (rationalPair (v w)).2.bits) cq ∧
      2*(rationalPair (v w)).1.bits.length+1+(rationalPair (v w)).2.bits.length≤W)
    (hB : pipelineBudget (inputTime a b c d e f) counter.length cp cq W≤B) :
    ∃ start,start+3*counter.length+1≤B ∧ ∀ bits : ℕ → Bool,
      let out := execution (pipeline pre post).code O (state (sixRegs a b c d e f) 0 0 0) bits B
      out.output=some (v (physicalWord start counter.length bits)) ∧
        out.oracleCalls≤B ∧ out.bitOperations≤B := by
  obtain ⟨tp,qp,wp,htp,hqp,hwp,hp⟩ := hp
  let start := inputTime a b c d e f+tp+(3*counter.length+1)
  have hs : start+3*counter.length+1≤B := by
    apply le_trans _ hB
    unfold start pipelineBudget
    omega
  refine ⟨start,hs,?_⟩
  intro bits
  let w := physicalWord start counter.length bits
  obtain ⟨⟨tq,qq,wq,htq,hqq,hwq,hq⟩,ho⟩ := hq w
  have hr := runs_pipeline O bits a b c d e f pre post counter params
    (rationalPair (v w)).1.bits (rationalPair (v w)).2.bits tp qp wp tq qq wq hp
    (by rw [sampledWord_physical]; exact hq)
  have hb := pipeline_budget (inputTime a b c d e f) counter.length cp cq W
    tp qp wp tq qq wq (rationalPair (v w)).1.bits.length (rationalPair (v w)).2.bits.length
    htp hqp hwp htq hqq hwq ho
  have ht := runs_terminal (pipeline pre post) O bits _ _ _ _ _ _ hr
  have hout := terminal_rational (pipeline pre post) (v w) (hv w) (qp+qq)
    (pipelineTime (inputTime a b c d e f) wp counter.length wq
      (rationalPair (v w)).1.bits.length (rationalPair (v w)).2.bits.length)
  have hsome : (execution (pipeline pre post).code O (state (sixRegs a b c d e f) 0 0 0) bits
      (pipelineTime (inputTime a b c d e f) tp counter.length tq
        (rationalPair (v w)).1.bits.length (rationalPair (v w)).2.bits.length+1)).output.isSome := by
    rw [ht,hout]; rfl
  have he := execution_extend_output (pipeline pre post).code O (state (sixRegs a b c d e f) 0 0 0)
    bits _ B (hb.1.trans hB) hsome
  dsimp only
  rw [he,ht]
  exact ⟨hout,hb.2.1.trans hB,hb.2.2.1.trans hB⟩

lemma pipeline_budgeted_length {n : ℕ} (O : IndependenceOracle n)
    (a b c d e f : Word) (pre post : Block 1) (counter params : Word)
    (F cp cq W B : ℕ) (hF : counter.length=F)
    (hp : Bounded pre O (pair (pair a b) (pair (pair c d) (pair e f)))
      (pair counter params) cp)
    (v : BitWord F → ℚ) (hv : ∀ w,0≤v w)
    (hq : ∀ w,Bounded post O (pair (List.ofFn w) params)
      (pair (rationalPair (v w)).1.bits (rationalPair (v w)).2.bits) cq ∧
      2*(rationalPair (v w)).1.bits.length+1+(rationalPair (v w)).2.bits.length≤W)
    (hB : pipelineBudget (inputTime a b c d e f) F cp cq W≤B) :
    ∃ start,start+3*F+1≤B ∧ ∀ bits : ℕ → Bool,
      let out := execution (pipeline pre post).code O (state (sixRegs a b c d e f) 0 0 0) bits B
      out.output=some (v (physicalWord start F bits)) ∧
        out.oracleCalls≤B ∧ out.bitOperations≤B := by
  subst F
  exact pipeline_budgeted O a b c d e f pre post counter params cp cq W B hp v hv hq hB

def totalResourcePoly (fp fq : SizePolynomial) : SizePolynomial :=
  .mul (.constant 200) (.add (.add (.add sourceEnvelope (compiledMajorant preambleCode fp))
    (compiledMajorant postambleCode fq)) (.add fq (.constant 1)))
lemma totalResourcePoly_budget (fp fq : SizePolynomial) (n r : ℕ) (ε δ : ℚ) (hr : r≤n) :
    pipelineBudget
      (inputTime n.bits r.bits ε.num.natAbs.bits ε.den.bits δ.num.natAbs.bits δ.den.bits)
      (fairBitCount n ε δ) ((compiledMajorant preambleCode fp).eval (masterParameter n r ε δ))
      ((compiledMajorant postambleCode fq).eval (masterParameter n r ε δ))
      (fq.eval (masterParameter n r ε δ)) ≤
      (totalResourcePoly fp fq).eval (masterParameter n r ε δ) := by
  have hi := inputTime_bound n.bits r.bits ε.num.natAbs.bits ε.den.bits δ.num.natAbs.bits δ.den.bits
  change _ ≤ 100*inputLength n r ε δ at hi
  have ha := envelope_parameters n r ε δ hr
  have hF := ha.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.1
  have hI := ha.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2
  simp only [pipelineBudget,totalResourcePoly,SizePolynomial.eval]
  omega

noncomputable def treeBankOutput (t : DrawTree (Option ℚ)) (bank : Bank) : ℚ :=
  (bankEval t bank).1.join.getD 0
noncomputable def treeBanksOutput (t : DrawTree (Option ℚ)) (banks : List Bank) : ℚ :=
  rationalMedian (banks.map (treeBankOutput t))
lemma treeBankOutput_all (t : DrawTree (Option ℚ)) (Z : ℕ)
    (ht : DrawTree.All (fun a : Option ℚ => ∀ z,a=some z → 0≤z ∧ (Z=0 → z=0)) t)
    (bank : Bank) : 0≤treeBankOutput t bank ∧ (Z=0 → treeBankOutput t bank=0) := by
  unfold treeBankOutput
  cases h : (bankEval t bank).1 with
  | none => simp
  | some a =>
    cases a with
    | none => simp
    | some z =>
      simpa only [Option.join_some,Option.getD_some] using bankEval_all t _ ht bank (some z) h z rfl
lemma treeBanksOutput_all (t : DrawTree (Option ℚ)) (Z : ℕ)
    (ht : DrawTree.All (fun a : Option ℚ => ∀ z,a=some z → 0≤z ∧ (Z=0 → z=0)) t)
    (banks : List Bank) : 0≤treeBanksOutput t banks ∧ (Z=0 → treeBanksOutput t banks=0) := by
  constructor
  · apply rationalMedian_all (fun z => 0≤z) _ (by norm_num)
    intro z hz
    obtain ⟨bank,hbank,rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hz
    exact (treeBankOutput_all t Z ht bank).1
  · intro hZ
    apply rationalMedian_all (fun z => z=0) _ rfl
    intro z hz
    obtain ⟨bank,hbank,rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hz
    exact (treeBankOutput_all t Z ht bank).2 hZ
lemma reindexed_bank_law {t u : DrawTree (Option ℚ)} (h : DrawTree.Reindexed t u)
    (H D M : ℕ) (ht : DrawTree.Fits H M t) (φ : ℚ → ℝ) :
    uniformAverage (fun bits : Fin M → Fin D → BitWord H => φ (treeBankOutput u (bankEncode bits)))=
      uniformAverage (fun bits : Fin M → Fin D → BitWord H => φ ((DrawTree.run H D M t bits).join.getD 0)) := by
  unfold treeBankOutput
  simp only [bankEval_run H D M u (h.fits H M ht)]
  exact (h.run_observable H D M ht (fun a : Option (Option ℚ) => φ (a.join.getD 0))).symm
lemma reindexed_banks_law {t u : DrawTree (Option ℚ)} (h : DrawTree.Reindexed t u)
    (H D M R : ℕ) (ht : DrawTree.Fits H M t) (φ : ℚ → ℝ) :
    uniformAverage (fun bits : Fin R → Fin M → Fin D → BitWord H =>
      φ (treeBanksOutput u (List.ofFn (fun i => bankEncode (bits i)))))=
      uniformAverage (fun bits : Fin R → Fin M → Fin D → BitWord H =>
        φ (rationalMedian (List.ofFn (fun i => (DrawTree.run H D M t (bits i)).join.getD 0)))) := by
  simp only [treeBanksOutput,List.map_ofFn,Function.comp_def]
  exact uniformAverage_independent_eq (fun bits => treeBankOutput u (bankEncode bits))
    (fun bits => (DrawTree.run H D M t bits).join.getD 0) (reindexed_bank_law h H D M ht) R
    (fun z => φ (rationalMedian (List.ofFn z)))
lemma canonicalTree_all {n : ℕ} (hn : 0<n) (r N L : ℕ) (M₁ M₂ : Matroid (Fin n))
    (O : IndependenceOracle n) (hO : ExactOracles M₁ M₂ O)
    (hE₁ : M₁.E=Set.univ) (hE₂ : M₂.E=Set.univ)
    (hr₁ : M₁.eRank=(r:ℕ∞)) (hr₂ : M₂.eRank=(r:ℕ∞)) :
    DrawTree.All (fun a : Option ℚ => ∀ z,a=some z → 0≤z ∧ (commonBaseCount M₁ M₂=0 → z=0))
      (canonicalAlgorithmTree n hn r O N L) := by
  apply DrawTree.All.mono
    ((canonicalAlgorithmTree_to_rational n hn r O N L M₁ M₂ hO hE₁ hE₂ hr₁ hr₂).symm.all _
      (rationalAlgorithmTree_all n hn M₁ M₂ N L))
  intro a ha z hz
  exact ⟨(ha z hz).1,(ha z hz).2 hE₂ (hr₁.trans hr₂.symm)⟩

lemma bitMatrix_apply (a b : ℕ) (w : BitWord (a*b)) (i : Fin a) (j : Fin b) :
    bitMatrixEquiv a b w i j=w (finProdFinEquiv (i,j)) := rfl
lemma ofFn_bitMatrix (a b : ℕ) (w : BitWord (a*b)) :
    List.ofFn w=(List.ofFn (fun i => List.ofFn (bitMatrixEquiv a b w i))).flatten := by
  rw [List.ofFn_mul]
  apply congrArg List.flatten
  apply congrArg List.ofFn
  funext i
  apply congrArg List.ofFn
  funext j
  rw [bitMatrix_apply]
  congr 1
  apply Fin.ext
  simp [finProdFinEquiv,Nat.mul_comm,Nat.add_comm]
lemma chunks_bitMatrix (a b : ℕ) (w : BitWord (a*b)) :
    chunkValues a b (List.ofFn w)=List.ofFn (fun i => List.ofFn (bitMatrixEquiv a b w i)) := by
  rw [ofFn_bitMatrix,chunkValues_ofFn]
lemma run_banksCode_four {n : ℕ} (O : IndependenceOracle n) (R M D H : ℕ)
    (w : BitWord (R*(M*(D*H)))) :
    run O banksCode (List.ofFn w,(R,(M,(D,H))))=
      some (List.ofFn (fun i => bankEncode (fourBitEquiv R M D H w i))) := by
  rw [run_banksCode]
  simp only [chunks_bitMatrix,List.map_ofFn,Function.comp_def]
  rfl
lemma ofFn_finCongr {a b : ℕ} (h : a=b) (w : BitWord a) :
    List.ofFn w=List.ofFn ((Equiv.arrowCongr (finCongr h) (Equiv.refl Bool)) w) := by
  subst b
  rfl
lemma run_reshapeCode_four {n : ℕ} (O : IndependenceOracle n) (R M H : ℕ)
    (w : BitWord (R*(M*((M+6)*H)))) :
    run O reshapeCode (List.ofFn w,(R,(M,H)))=
      some (List.ofFn (fun i => bankEncode (fourBitEquiv R M (M+6) H w i))) := by
  change run O banksCode (List.ofFn w,(R,(M,(M+6,H))))=_
  exact run_banksCode_four O R M (M+6) H w
lemma run_reshapeCode_cast {n a : ℕ} (O : IndependenceOracle n) (R M H : ℕ)
    (h : a=R*(M*((M+6)*H))) (w : BitWord a) :
    run O reshapeCode (List.ofFn w,(R,(M,H)))=
      some (List.ofFn (fun i => bankEncode (fourBitEquiv R M (M+6) H
        ((Equiv.arrowCongr (finCongr h) (Equiv.refl Bool)) w) i))) := by
  subst a
  exact run_reshapeCode_four O R M H w

def bankReshapeEquiv {a : ℕ} (R M H : ℕ) (h : a=R*(M*((M+6)*H))) :
    BitWord a ≃ (Fin R → Fin M → Fin (M+6) → BitWord H) :=
  (Equiv.arrowCongr (finCongr h) (Equiv.refl Bool)).trans (fourBitEquiv R M (M+6) H)
lemma run_reshapeCode_equiv {n a : ℕ} (O : IndependenceOracle n) (R M H : ℕ)
    (h : a=R*(M*((M+6)*H))) (w : BitWord a) :
    run O reshapeCode (List.ofFn w,(R,(M,H)))=
      some (List.ofFn (fun i => bankEncode (bankReshapeEquiv R M H h w i))) := by
  exact run_reshapeCode_cast O R M H h w
lemma reshape_count (n : ℕ) (ε δ : ℚ) :
    let L := annealLength n (accuracyExponent ε)
    let N := sampleCount n L ε
    let M := algorithmDrawBound n N L
    let H := drawWordBound n N L
    fairBitCount n ε δ=repetitionCount δ*(M*((M+6)*H)) := by
  change repetitionCount δ * drawWordBound n (sampleCount n (annealLength n (accuracyExponent ε)) ε)
    (annealLength n (accuracyExponent ε)) * _ * _ = _
  ac_rfl

def reshapeWordEquiv (n : ℕ) (ε δ : ℚ) : BitWord (fairBitCount n ε δ) ≃ FPRASBank n ε δ :=
  bankReshapeEquiv (repetitionCount δ)
    (algorithmDrawBound n (sampleCount n (annealLength n (accuracyExponent ε)) ε) (annealLength n (accuracyExponent ε)))
    (drawWordBound n (sampleCount n (annealLength n (accuracyExponent ε)) ε) (annealLength n (accuracyExponent ε)))
    (reshape_count n ε δ)
lemma run_reshapeCode_source {n : ℕ} (O : IndependenceOracle n) (ε δ : ℚ)
    (w : BitWord (fairBitCount n ε δ)) :
    let L := annealLength n (accuracyExponent ε)
    let N := sampleCount n L ε
    run O reshapeCode (List.ofFn w,(repetitionCount δ,(algorithmDrawBound n N L,drawWordBound n N L)))=
      some (List.ofFn (fun i => bankEncode (reshapeWordEquiv n ε δ w i))) := by
  exact run_reshapeCode_equiv O _ _ _ (reshape_count n ε δ) w

lemma run_preamble_generic {n : ℕ} (O : IndependenceOracle n) (x : Value FrozenData)
    (F : ℕ) (p : Value PreparedData)
    (hF : run O frozenBitCount x=some F) (hp : run O frozenPrepared x=some p) :
    ∃ counter : Word,counter.length=F ∧ run O preambleCode x=some (counter,p) := by
  obtain ⟨counter,hc,hl⟩ := run_unary O F
  refine ⟨counter,hl,?_⟩
  simp only [preambleCode,run_both,run_compose,hF,hc,hp,Option.bind_some,Option.map_some]
lemma run_preambleCode {n : ℕ} (O : IndependenceOracle n) (r : ℕ) (ε δ : ℚ) (hε : 0<ε) :
    ∃ counter : Word,counter.length=fairBitCount n ε δ ∧
      run O preambleCode (frozenValue n r ε δ)=some (counter,preparedValue n r ε δ) := by

lemma run_reshapePrepared_generic {n : ℕ} (O : IndependenceOracle n) (w : Word)
    (p : Value AlgorithmParams) (shape : Value BankShape) (banks : Value (.list BankData))
    (h : run O reshapeCode (w,shape)=some banks) :
    run O reshapePrepared (w,(p,shape))=some (p,banks) := by
  simp only [reshapePrepared,run_both,run_compose,run_fst,run_snd,Option.bind_some,Option.map_some,h]
lemma run_reshapePrepared {n : ℕ} (O : IndependenceOracle n) (r : ℕ) (ε δ : ℚ)
    (w : BitWord (fairBitCount n ε δ)) :
    let L := annealLength n (accuracyExponent ε)
    let N := sampleCount n L ε
    run O reshapePrepared (rawValue n r ε δ w)=
      some (params n r N L,List.ofFn (fun i => bankEncode (reshapeWordEquiv n ε δ w i))) := by

def OutputCertificate {n : ℕ} (r : ℕ) (M₁ M₂ : Matroid (Fin n))
    (O : IndependenceOracle n) (ε δ : ℚ)
    (v : BitWord (fairBitCount n ε δ) → ℚ) : Prop :=
  (∀ w,run O postambleCode (rawValue n r ε δ w)=some (rationalPair (v w))) ∧
  (∀ w,0≤v w ∧ (commonBaseCount M₁ M₂=0 → v w=0)) ∧
  (∀ φ : ℚ → ℝ,uniformAverage (fun w => φ (v w))=
    uniformAverage (fun banks : FPRASBank n ε δ => φ (canonicalBoundedOutput n r O ε δ banks)))
lemma output_certificate {n : ℕ} (r : ℕ) (M₁ M₂ : Matroid (Fin n)) (O : IndependenceOracle n)
    (hO : ExactOracles M₁ M₂ O) (hE₁ : M₁.E=Set.univ) (hE₂ : M₂.E=Set.univ)
    (hr₁ : M₁.eRank=(r:ℕ∞)) (hr₂ : M₂.eRank=(r:ℕ∞))
    (ε δ : ℚ) : ∃ v,OutputCertificate r M₁ M₂ O ε δ v := by
  let L := annealLength n (accuracyExponent ε)
  let N := sampleCount n L ε
  by_cases hn : 0<n
  · obtain ⟨u,hu,he⟩ := algorithmCode_source M₁ M₂ O hO hE₁ hE₂ r N L hn
    have ht := canonicalTree_all hn r N L M₁ M₂ O hO hE₁ hE₂ hr₁ hr₂
    have huall := hu.all _ ht
    let v : BitWord (fairBitCount n ε δ) → ℚ := fun w =>
      treeBanksOutput u (List.ofFn (fun i => bankEncode (reshapeWordEquiv n ε δ w i)))
    refine ⟨v,?_,?_,?_⟩
    · intro w
      rw [postambleCode,run_compose,run_reshapePrepared,Option.bind_some]
      have hz : ∀ bank∈List.ofFn (fun i => bankEncode (reshapeWordEquiv n ε δ w i)),
          0≤(bankEval u bank).1.join.getD 0 := fun bank _ => (treeBankOutput_all u _ huall bank).1
      have hh := run_amplifiedCode O (params n r N L) u he _ hz
      have hc : run O (Expression.compose fst (Expression.compose fst (Expression.compose fst natEqZero)) : Expression AmplifyInput .bool)
          (params n r N L,List.ofFn (fun i => bankEncode (reshapeWordEquiv n ε δ w i)))=some false := by
        simp [params,run_natEqZero,run_compose,run_fst,ne_of_gt hn]
      rw [finishCode,run_applyIf,hc,Option.bind_some]
      simp only [Bool.false_eq_true,ite_false]
      exact hh
    · intro w; exact treeBanksOutput_all u _ huall _
    · intro φ
      have hfit := canonicalAlgorithmTree_fits n hn r O N L M₁ M₂ hO hE₁ hE₂ hr₁ hr₂
        (by dsimp [N,sampleCount]; omega)
      have hb := reindexed_banks_law hu (drawWordBound n N L) (algorithmDrawBound n N L+6)
        (algorithmDrawBound n N L) (repetitionCount δ) hfit φ
      calc
        _ = uniformAverage (fun banks : FPRASBank n ε δ =>
            φ (treeBanksOutput u (List.ofFn (fun i => bankEncode (banks i))))) :=
          uniformAverage_equiv (reshapeWordEquiv n ε δ) _
        _ = _ := by simpa only [canonicalBoundedOutput,dite_eq_left hn,
          canonicalAmplifiedOutput,canonicalFairOutput] using hb
  · refine ⟨fun _ => 1,?_,?_,?_⟩
    · intro w
      rw [postambleCode,run_compose,run_reshapePrepared,Option.bind_some]
      have hc : run O (Expression.compose fst (Expression.compose fst (Expression.compose fst natEqZero)) : Expression AmplifyInput .bool)
          (params n r N L,List.ofFn (fun i => bankEncode (reshapeWordEquiv n ε δ w i)))=some true := by
        simp [params,run_natEqZero,run_compose,run_fst,show n=0 by omega]
      rw [finishCode,run_applyIf,hc,Option.bind_some,ite_eq_left rfl]
      rfl
    · intro w
      have hn0 : n=0 := by omega
      subst n
      simp [commonBaseCount_empty]
    · intro φ
      simp only [canonicalBoundedOutput,dite_eq_right hn,uniformAverage_const]

open Expression
lemma encode_natPair (z : Value NN) : encode z=pair z.1.bits z.2.bits := rfl
lemma encode_rawValue (n r : ℕ) (ε δ : ℚ) (w : BitWord (fairBitCount n ε δ)) :
    encode (rawValue n r ε δ w)=pair (List.ofFn w) (encode (preparedValue n r ε δ)) := rfl
lemma width_natPair (z : Value NN) : width z=2*z.1.bits.length+1+z.2.bits.length := by
  rw [width,encode_natPair,pair_length]

lemma frozen_machine (fp fq : SizePolynomial) (n r : ℕ)
    (M₁ M₂ : Matroid (Fin n)) (O : IndependenceOracle n) (ε δ : ℚ)
    (hO : ExactOracles M₁ M₂ O) (hE₁ : M₁.E=Set.univ) (hE₂ : M₂.E=Set.univ)
    (hr₁ : M₁.eRank=(r:ℕ∞)) (hr₂ : M₂.eRank=(r:ℕ∞)) (hε : 0<ε)
    (hp : Safe O (fp.eval (masterParameter n r ε δ)) preambleCode (frozenValue n r ε δ))
    (hq : ∀ w : BitWord (fairBitCount n ε δ),
      Safe O (fq.eval (masterParameter n r ε δ)) postambleCode (rawValue n r ε δ w))
    (B : ℕ) (hB : (totalResourcePoly fp fq).eval (masterParameter n r ε δ)≤B) :
    ∃ (v : BitWord (fairBitCount n ε δ) → ℚ) (start : ℕ),
      OutputCertificate r M₁ M₂ O ε δ v ∧ start+3*fairBitCount n ε δ+1≤B ∧
      ∀ bits : ℕ → Bool,
        let out := execution fprasBlock.code O (initialConfig 1 fprasBlock.size n r ε δ) bits B
        out.output=some (v (physicalWord start (fairBitCount n ε δ) bits)) ∧
          out.oracleCalls≤B ∧ out.bitOperations≤B := by
  obtain ⟨v,hv⟩ := output_certificate r M₁ M₂ O hO hE₁ hE₂ hr₁ hr₂ ε δ
  obtain ⟨counter,hc,hpc⟩ := run_preambleCode O r ε δ hε
  have hn := (master_fields n r ε δ).1
  have hpre := compile_majorant O preambleCode fp (masterParameter n r ε δ) hn _ _ hp hpc
  have hpost (w : BitWord (fairBitCount n ε δ)) :
      Bounded (compile postambleCode) O (pair (List.ofFn w) (encode (preparedValue n r ε δ)))
        (pair (rationalPair (v w)).1.bits (rationalPair (v w)).2.bits)
        ((compiledMajorant postambleCode fq).eval (masterParameter n r ε δ)) ∧
      2*(rationalPair (v w)).1.bits.length+1+(rationalPair (v w)).2.bits.length≤
        fq.eval (masterParameter n r ε δ) := by
    constructor
    · have hm := compile_majorant O postambleCode fq (masterParameter n r ε δ) hn
        (rawValue n r ε δ w) (rationalPair (v w)) (hq w) (hv.1 w)
      rw [encode_rawValue,encode_natPair] at hm
      exact hm
    · have hw := safe_output (hq w) (hv.1 w)
      rw [width_natPair] at hw
      exact hw
  have hb := (totalResourcePoly_budget fp fq n r ε δ (rank_le_ground M₁ hr₁)).trans hB
  obtain ⟨start,hs,he⟩ := pipeline_budgeted_length O n.bits r.bits ε.num.natAbs.bits ε.den.bits
    δ.num.natAbs.bits δ.den.bits (compile preambleCode) (compile postambleCode)
    counter (encode (preparedValue n r ε δ)) (fairBitCount n ε δ)
    ((compiledMajorant preambleCode fp).eval (masterParameter n r ε δ))
    ((compiledMajorant postambleCode fq).eval (masterParameter n r ε δ))
    (fq.eval (masterParameter n r ε δ)) B hc hpre v (fun w => (hv.2.1 w).1) hpost hb
  exact ⟨v,start,hv,hs,he⟩

open scoped Classical

lemma physical_accuracy {n : ℕ} (r : ℕ) (M₁ M₂ : Matroid (Fin n))
    (O : IndependenceOracle n) (ε δ : ℚ)
    (hO : ExactOracles M₁ M₂ O) (hE₁ : M₁.E=Set.univ) (hE₂ : M₂.E=Set.univ)
    (hr₁ : M₁.eRank=(r:ℕ∞)) (hr₂ : M₂.eRank=(r:ℕ∞))
    (hε : 0<ε) (hε1 : ε<1) (hδ : 0<δ)
    (v : BitWord (fairBitCount n ε δ) → ℚ) (hv : OutputCertificate r M₁ M₂ O ε δ v)
    (start B : ℕ) (hstart : start+3*fairBitCount n ε δ+1≤B) :
    (1-δ)*(2:ℚ)^B ≤ (Nat.card {bits : BitWord B // relativeAccuracy ε (commonBaseCount M₁ M₂)
      (v (physicalWord start (fairBitCount n ε δ) (finiteBits bits)))}:ℚ) := by
  have h := (canonical_bounded_fair_experiment n r O M₁ M₂ hO hE₁ hE₂ hr₁ hr₂ ε δ hε hε1 hδ).2
  rw [←hv.2.2 (fun z => if relativeAccuracy ε (commonBaseCount M₁ M₂) z then (1:ℝ) else 0)] at h
  rw [←physicalWord_law start (fairBitCount n ε δ) B hstart
    (fun w => if relativeAccuracy ε (commonBaseCount M₁ M₂) (v w) then (1:ℝ) else 0)] at h
  rw [uniformAverage_indicator_card] at h
  have hcard : Fintype.card (BitWord B)=2^B := by simp [BitWord]
  rw [hcard,Nat.cast_pow,Nat.cast_ofNat] at h
  have hh := (le_div_iff₀ (by positivity : (0:ℝ)<2^B)).mp h
  exact_mod_cast hh
end MachineCode
end CommonBasesFPRAS

open CommonBasesFPRAS CommonBasesFPRAS.MachineCode

theorem common_bases_fpras : CommonBasesFPRAS.MainTheorem := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨fp,fq,hs⟩ := frozen_uniform_safe
  let p := totalResourcePoly fp fq
  refine ⟨1,fprasBlock.size,fprasBlock.code,p.coefficient*2^p.degree+1,p.degree,by omega,?_⟩
  intro n r M₁ M₂ O ε δ hE₁ hE₂ hr₁ hr₂ hO hε hε1 hδ hδ1
  have hh := hs n r M₁ M₂ O ε δ hO hE₁ hE₂ hr₁ hε
  let B := resourceBound (p.coefficient*2^p.degree+1) p.degree n r ε δ
  have hB : p.eval (masterParameter n r ε δ)≤B :=
    p.monomial_bound _ (master_pos n r ε δ)
  obtain ⟨v,start,hv,hstart,he⟩ := frozen_machine fp fq n r M₁ M₂ O ε δ hO hE₁ hE₂ hr₁ hr₂ hε hh.1 hh.2 B hB
  constructor
  · intro bits
    have h := he bits
    refine ⟨?_,h.2.1,h.2.2,?_⟩
    · rw [h.1]; rfl
    · intro z hz
      rw [h.1] at hz
      have hez := Option.some.inj hz
      subst z
      exact hv.2.1 _
  · have ha := physical_accuracy r M₁ M₂ O ε δ hO hE₁ hE₂ hr₁ hr₂ hε hε1 hδ v hv start B hstart
    have hpred (bits : BitWord B) :
        (∃ z,(execution fprasBlock.code O (initialConfig 1 fprasBlock.size n r ε δ) (finiteBits bits) B).output=some z ∧
          relativeAccuracy ε (commonBaseCount M₁ M₂) z) ↔
        relativeAccuracy ε (commonBaseCount M₁ M₂) (v (physicalWord start (fairBitCount n ε δ) (finiteBits bits))) := by
      rw [(he (finiteBits bits)).1]
      simp only [Option.some.injEq,exists_eq_left']
    change (1-δ)*(2:ℚ)^B ≤ (Nat.card {bits : BitWord B // ∃ z,
      (execution fprasBlock.code O (initialConfig 1 fprasBlock.size n r ε δ) (finiteBits bits) B).output=some z ∧
        relativeAccuracy ε (commonBaseCount M₁ M₂) z}:ℚ)
    simpa only [hpred] using ha

end OAI
